lfr.name: Vault of the Incarnates
lfr.description: The Primalists breached the Titan prison used to hold the Incarnates for millennia. Within, Raszageth performs a foul ritual to unleash her siblings, so together they can purge the world of the Titans' influence. The champions of Azeroth must assault this impregnable fortress and break their defenses to end this threat. While many could fall, defeat condemns all the realms to the Incarnates' reign of fire and blood.

bosses.name: Eranog
bosses.description: Eranog, commander of the Primalist forces, is relentless in his pursuit of power. With the Incarnates' release imminent, Eranog summons the whole of his army and will not hesitate to sacrifice his devoted followers to achieve victory.

tips.text:
• Eranog's molten axe inflicts Burning Wounds
• Molten Cleave inflicts massive damage to all players in front of Eranog.
• Army of Flame inflicts deadly damage to anyone caught in the elementals' path.

• Molten Cleave inflicts massive damage to all players in front of Eranog.
• Army of Flame inflicts deadly damage to anyone caught in the elementals' path.
• Flamescale Taraseks will fixate their target until slain.

• Molten Cleave inflicts massive damage to all players in front of Eranog.
• Army of Flame inflicts deadly damage to anyone caught in the elementals' path.
• Eranog inflicts increasing Fire damage with each Incinerating Roar

bosses.overview:
Eranog leads his primalist forces with a combination of brutal attacks and cunning strategies. The Primal Commander will summon deadly minions through Flamerifts that leave behind bubbling pools of Primal Flow.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Eranog will call forth an Army of Flame to encircle his opponents.

children.name: Flamerift
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Eranog also opens a Greater Flamerift that creates a Flamescale Captain.

children.name: Kill Order
children.text: The fixates on a player, pursuing them relentlessly.

children.name: Lava Flow
children.text: A pool of lava that inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec to players standing within it.

children.name: Molten Cleave
children.text: Eranog swings his molten axe, inflicting Fire damage to players in a frontal cone.

children.name: Incinerating Roar
children.text: Eranog roars, exhaling flames that inflict Fire damage to all players and an additional Fire damage every 2 sec for 28 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Molten Spikes
children.text:
Eranog pulls forth Molten Spikes from the chamber floor, inflicting Physical damage to players nearby and knocking them away.

These spikes explode into when Eranog bellows an Incinerating Roar.

children.name: Molten Fissure
children.text: Molten spikes explode, creating fissures that inflict Fire damage to players near the impact locations and knocking them upwards.

children.name: Burning Wound
children.text: Eranog's melee attacks cause searing wounds that inflict Fire damage every 2 sec for 14 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Army of Flame
children.text: Upon reaching 100 energy, Eranog summons an army of s and emits Pulsing Flames every 1 sec for 21 sec.

children.name: Pulsing Flames
children.text: Eranog's scales pulse with flames, inflicting Fire damage to all players

children.name: Incinerate
children.text: The inflicts Fire damage to players in their path and stuns them for 3 sec.

bosses.name: Terros
bosses.description: Primalists sought to pull Terros, an unyielding force of destruction, from the elemental plane. However, their ritual was interrupted. Trapped between two worlds, this hulking terror seeks to free himself and obliterate everything in his path.

tips.text:
•Rock Blast inflicts a large amount of damage and creates Awakened Earth.
•Concussive Slam creates a line of tectonic energy that destroys Awakened Earth.

•Rock Blast inflicts a large amount of damage and creates Awakened Earth.
•Shattering Impact and Resonating Annihilation cause Fractured Rubble to fall from the ceiling.

•Rock Blast inflicts a large amount of damage and creates Awakened Earth.
•Awakened Earth inflicts constant damage to all players and releases a Seismic Assault when destroyed.

bosses.overview:
Terros fights his assailants with an onslaught of destructive attacks, launching Rock Blasts that create Awakened Earth throughout the chamber as the battle rages. These pulsing pillars of earth inflict constant damage and are destroyed by Concussive Slam.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Terros casts Resonating Annihilation, destroying Awakened Earth and permanently covering a portion of the chamber in Resonant Aftermath.

abilities.name: Rock Blast
abilities.text: On Mythic difficulty, this ability inflicts damage to all players.

children.name: Aftershock
children.text: The aftershock of Rock Blast inflicts Nature damage to players nearby, knocking them upwards.

children.name: Awakened Earth
children.text:
The earth erupts beneath several players, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby and knocking them back.

Upon erupting, begins to inflict Nature damage to all players every 2 sec until destroyed. 

Upon destruction, releases a Seismic Assault.

children.name: Seismic Assault
children.text:
Seismic Assault inflicts Nature damage to all players.

Inflicts an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Resonating Annihilation
abilities.text:
Upon reaching 100 energy, Terros unleashes his volatile power with a brutal slam.

This slam inflicts Nature damage to all players in a frontal cone, destroys Awakened Earth, and leaves Resonant Aftermath in its wake.

The cavern shutters from the force of the impact, inflicting an additional Nature damage to all players and causing Fractured Rubble to fall from the ceiling.

children.name: Resonant Aftermath
children.text: The earth pulses with resonating energy, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec to players within the area.

children.name: Fractured Rubble
children.text: Rubble falls from the ceiling, inflicting Nature damage to players near the impact location.

abilities.name: Shattering Impact
abilities.text:
Terros fractures the earth, inflicting Nature damage to players near the impact location and knocking them upwards.

Causes Fractured Rubble to fall from the ceiling.

children.name: Fractured Rubble
children.text: Rubble falls from the ceiling, inflicting Nature damage to players near the impact location.

abilities.name: Concussive Slam
abilities.text:
Terros discharges a line of tectonic energy that inflicts Physical damage to players and increases damage taken by 40% for 45 sec. This effect stacks.

Destroys any Awakened Earth caught in the blast.

abilities.name: Frenzied Devastation
abilities.text: Upon filling the chamber with Resonant Aftermath, Terros begins radiating devastating waves of earthen energy that inflict Nature damage and increase damage taken from Frenzied Devastation by 50%.

abilities.name: Tectonic Barrage
abilities.text: If no player is within reach, Terros continually emits tectonic pulses that inflict Nature damage.

bosses.name: The Primal Council
bosses.description: These masters of the elements are ruthless in their pursuit of power. Embar Firepath is as merciless as the fire she commands. Opalfang wields the might of the earth to crush her enemies. Kadros Icewrath is cold and cruel, while his sibling Dathea Stormlash is as wild and unpredictable as a raging storm.

tips.text:
•Slashing Blaze inflicts high Fire damage to players in front of Embar.
•Crush massively increases Physical damage taken.

•Conductive Mark spreads to nearby players.
•Meteor Axes will destroy any Earthen Pillar they hit.
•Touching Scorched Ground removes applications of Primal Blizzard.

•Meteor Axes split damage evenly amongst players hit and destroy Earthen Pillars.
•Primal Blizzard inflicts heavy damage to all players and can trap them in Frost Tombs.

bosses.overview:
The Primal Council works together to wipe out players with elemental attacks. When brought to low health, council members begin channeling their Convocation spell until all members of the council are defeated.

The elemental magics of the Primal Council's abilities can interact with each other in different ways to both advantage and detriments.

children.name: Primal Blizzard
children.text:
Upon reaching 100 energy, Kadros channels a freezing storm for 10 sec. The chill inflicts Frost damage every 1 sec., increasing Frost damage taken by 10% and reducing Fire damage taken by 10% for 15 sec. This effect stacks. Scorched Ground removes this effect.

Upon reaching 10 applications, players are trapped in a Frost Tomb.

children.name: Frost Tomb
children.text: The player is overcome by the Primal Blizzard, and is trapped in a tomb of ice that inflicts Frost damage and an additional Frost damage every 1 sec. Until freed.

children.name: Frost Spike
children.text: Kadros propels a spike of ice at a random player, inflicting Frost damage.

children.name: Glacial Convocation
children.text:
Upon defeat, Kadros convokes the plane of ice, inflicting Frost damage to all players every 6 sec. This damage increases over time.

Kadros channels until all members of the Primal Council are defeated.

children.name: Conductive Mark
children.text:
Dathea marks the player with lightning, inflicting Nature damage on impact and an additional Nature damage periodically for10 sec. Increases Nature damage taken by 8% for each application. This effect stacks.

If an affected player comes within 5 yards of another player, the mark will duplicate to that target. Moving within 5 yards of an Earthen Pillar harmlessly removes the mark.

children.name: Lightning Bolt
children.text: Dathea hurls lightning at a random player, inflicting Nature damage.

children.name: Chain Lightning
children.text: A bolt of lightning strikes a random player, inflicting Nature damage and then jumping to nearby players.

children.name: Storming Convocation
children.text:
Upon defeat, Dathea convokes the plane of storms, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 6 sec. This damage increases over time.

Dathea channels until all members of the Primal Council are defeated.

children.name: Earthen Pillar
children.text: Opalfang erupts pillars of rock from the earth at locations of several players, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby and knocking them back.

children.name: Crush
children.text: Opalfang crushes her current target, inflicting Physical damage and increasing all Physical damage taken by 100%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Quaking Convocation
children.text:
Opalfang convokes primal earth, releasing forceful blasts of earthen magic that inflict Nature damage to all players every 6 sec. This damage increases over time.

Opalfang channels until all members of the Primal Council are defeated.

children.name: Meteor Axes
children.text: Embar targets two players and hurls conjured fire axes at them, inflicting Fire damage split between all targets nearby. Leaves behind Scorched Ground on impact for 70 sec.

children.name: Scorched Ground
children.text:
The impact of Embar's Meteor Axes scorches the ground for 70 sec, inflicting Fire damage every 2 sec. To players who stand in the area.

The heat dispels Primal Blizzard.

children.name: Slashing Blaze
children.text: Upon reaching 100 energy, Embar infuses her axe with lava and cleaves the player, inflicting Fire damage and an additional Fire damage every 1.5 sec. For 15 sec to all players in front of Embar. This effect stacks.

children.name: Burning Convocation
children.text:
Embar convokes the plane of fire, inflicting Fire damage to all players every 6 sec. This damage increases over time.

Embar channels until all members of the Primal Council are defeated.

bosses.name: Sennarth, the Cold Breath
bosses.description: Sennarth, Kurog Grimtotem's most vicious creation, is a massive arachnid infused with the unforgiving cold. Her singular purpose is to guard her brood of thousands, awaiting the day they'll hatch and enshroud Azeroth in a web of winter.

tips.text:
•Sticky Webbing provides protection against sliding on Icy Ground and being pushed and pulled.
•Caustic Eruption will destroy and remove both Sticky Webbing and Wrapped in Webs.
•Web Blast increases the damage taken from subsequent hits.
•Frostbreath Arachnids use Freezing Breath on all targets in front of themselves.

•Sticky Webbing provides protection against sliding on Icy Ground and being pushed and pulled.
•Chilling Blast causes players to inflict Frost damage to other nearby players with Frost Expulsion.
•Caustic Eruption will destroy and remove both Sticky Webbing and Wrapped in Webs.

•Sticky Webbing provides protection against sliding on Icy Ground and being pushed and pulled.
•Chilling Blast and Frost Expulsion will inflict high damage to players.

bosses.overview:
Sennarth assaults players with chilling attacks that coat the floor in slippery ice. After a brief battle in the lower reaches of the chamber, Sennarth begins her ascent towards the icy summit of her lair.

At each of the platforms along the staircase, Sennarth summons a Frostbreath Arachnid to her aid.

At the top of her lair, Sennarth freezes the ground permanently and descends from her web to devour her prey.

children.name: Breath of Ice
children.text: Sennarth exhales a frozen vapor that creates patches of.

children.name: Icy Ground
children.text: Standing atop inflicts Frost damage every 1 sec and causes players to slide.

children.name: Enveloping Webs
children.text: Sennarth causes spider webs to envelop several players, inflicting Physical damage and causing them to drop Sticky Webbing at their locations every 1 sec for 6 sec.

children.name: Sticky Webbing
children.text:
Standing within sticky cobwebs provides resistance to displacement and sliding, as well as reduces the player's movement speed by 25% for 30 sec. Can be removed by Caustic Eruption.

Upon reaching applications, the target becomes.

children.name: Wrapped in Webs
children.text: Spiderwebs enwrap the player, reducing their movement speed by 75% for 30 sec. Can be removed by Caustic Eruption.

children.name: Forceful Scream
children.text: In LFR and Normal difficulty, players drawn into Sennarth's pit become Wrapped in Webs.

children.name: Freezing Breath
children.text: The Frostbreath Arachnid emits a freezing breath, inflicting Frost damage in a frontal cone and creating patches of Icy Ground.

children.name: Ability
children.text: The Frostbreath Arachnid effuses a chilling vapor, increasing its Frost damage done by 20% and inflicting Frost damage to all players. This effect stacks.

children.name: Caustic Eruption
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, players struck by Caustic Eruption are afflicted by Dissolved Defenses.

children.name: Web Blast
children.text: Sennarth blasts her current target with a ball of webs, inflicting 100% of normal attack damage and causing them to suffer increased damage from Web Blasts for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Apex of Ice
children.text: Sennarth wreathes herself in a chilling storm, creating Icy Ground in a large area. As long as the storm persists, Sennarth takes 99% less damage and inflicts Frost damage to all players every 1 sec for 4 sec. This effect repeats and grows in intensity every 3 sec.

children.name: Icy Ground
children.text: Standing atop inflicts Frost damage every 1 sec and causes players to slide.

children.name: Suffocating Webs
children.text: Sennarth targets several players with spiderwebs, inflicting Physical damage every 1 sec for 6 sec. At the end of the duration, she knocks them back while instantly causing and releasing Sticky Webbing at their locations.

children.name: Sticky Webbing
children.text:
Standing within sticky cobwebs provides resistance to displacement and sliding, as well as reduces the player's movement speed by 25% for 30 sec. Can be removed by Caustic Eruption.

Upon reaching applications, the target becomes.

children.name: Wrapped in Webs
children.text: Spiderwebs enwrap the player, reducing their movement speed by 75% for 30 sec. Can be removed by Caustic Eruption.

children.name: Forceful Scream
children.text: In LFR and Normal difficulty, players drawn into Sennarth's pit become Wrapped in Webs.

children.name: Pervasive Cold
children.text: Sennarth chills the very air around herself, causing players to suffer 10% increased Frost damage until she dies. This effect stacks.

children.name: Caustic Eruption
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, players struck by Caustic Eruption are afflicted by Dissolved Defenses.

children.name: Permafrost
children.text: Permafrost forms on the lower reaches of Sennarth's lair, inflicting Frost damage every 1 sec to players within the affected area. This effect stacks.

bosses.name: Dathea, Ascended
bosses.description: Driven manic by her defeat, Dathea strikes a bargain with Raszageth to attain even greater power. Imbued with a fraction of the Incarnate's strength, Dathea gains control of the wind itself and unleashes its ferocity to tear her enemies apart.

tips.text:
• Crosswinds causes all Raging Tempests to move to new locations.
• Conductive Mark spreads and refreshes when players are close together.
• Cyclone pulls players toward Dathea and inflicts a high amount of damage.

• Players afflicted with Conductive Mark take increased Nature damage.
• Cyclone pulls players toward Dathea and inflicts a high amount of damage.
• Crosswinds causes all Raging Tempests to move to new locations.

• Zephyr Slam inflicts increasing damage and knockback to Dathea's current target.
• Dathea assaults her target with Aerial Buffet if they're not within reach.
• Dathea summons Volatile Infusers with Coalescing Storm.

bosses.overview:
Dathea uses her newfound power to summon Raging Tempests within the chamber. These tempests blow across the chamber at Dathea's command when she creates Crosswinds.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Dathea summons Volatile Infusers to her aid with Coalescing Storm. These minions explode upon death in a violent Blowback.

abilities.name: Coalescing Storm
abilities.text: Dathea harnesses primal energies to summon Volatile Infusers to her aid.

children.name: Blowback
children.text: Upon death the Volatile Infuser explodes violently, inflicting Nature damage to all players and knocking them back.

children.name: Diverted Essence
children.text: The Volatile Infuser channels its essence into Dathea, periodically increasing her damage by 10% for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Unstable Gusts
children.text: The Volatile Infuser periodically expels Unstable Gusts inflicting Nature damage to players near the impact locations.

children.name: Aerial Slash
children.text: The Volatile Infuser slashes its current target, inflicting Nature damage.

abilities.name: Raging Burst
abilities.text: Dathea fires off bolts of wind that upon impact inflicts Nature damage to all players within yds and creates a Raging Tempest at their location.

children.name: Raging Tempest
children.text: Inflicts Nature damage to any player that touches the tempest and knocks them up into the air.

children.name: Raging Winds
children.text: Raging Tempests periodically emit built up winds, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 4 sec.

abilities.name: Conductive Mark
abilities.text:
Dathea marks the player with lightning, inflicting Nature damage on impact, Nature damage every 1 sec, and increasing Nature damage taken by 10% for 10 sec. This effect stacks.

Moving within yards of other players will duplicate and refresh Conductive Mark.

abilities.name: Cyclone
abilities.text:
Dathea whips up a vortex at her location, pulling players towards her and inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec for 10 sec.

If a player is pulled into the vortex they are knocked upwards.

abilities.name: Crosswinds
abilities.text:
Dathea sends out a series of crosswinds, adjusting the location of every Raging Tempest.

Upon arriving at their new location each Tempest unleashes a burst of wind, inflicting Nature damage to all players nearby.

abilities.name: Zephyr Slam
abilities.text:
Dathea slams her empowered fist into her current target with a burst of air, inflicting Physical damage and knocking them back.

Each impact increases the damage and knockback taken by 50% for 55 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Aerial Buffet
abilities.text: If Dathea's current target is not within reach, she blasts them with a buffet of air that inflicts Nature damage.

bosses.name: Kurog Grimtotem
bosses.description: Once a prized pupil of Magatha Grimtotem, this master of the primal elements is preparing to unleash his most devastating creations. If Kurog is not stopped, his entities of storm, fire, ice, and earth will wreak havoc across the whole of Azeroth.

tips.text:
•Earth Breakers continually cast Skeletal Fractures.
•The longer Kurog's elementals remain alive, the more damage they do.
•While next to a Primal Altar, Kurog Grimtotem continually inflicts that altar's elemental damage to all players.

•Sundering Strike applies stacking Physical damage over time.
•While not next to an active Primal Altar, Kurog Grimtotem casts Elemental Surge.

bosses.overview:
Kurog Grimtotem gains increasing dominance over an element while nearby its altar within The Primal Convergence. Upon reaching 100 energy, Kurog summons two elementals according to his levels of elemental dominance.

After summoning forth an elemental from each altar, Kurog achieves Primal Attunement.

abilities.name: Stage One: Elemental Dominance
abilities.text: Kurog gains new abilities while near an elemental altar in The Primal Convergence.

children.name: Sundering Strike
children.text: Kurog unleashes an attack at his current target, inflicting Elemental damage to players in a frontal cone and knocking them back. Additionally, players suffer Elemental damage every 1 sec for 35 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Elemental Surge
children.text: Kurog periodically surges with the power of all four altars while standing in the center of the chamber, inflicting Elemental damage to all players every 0.5 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Flame Dominance
children.text: Kurog inflicts Fire damage to all players every 4 sec while attuned to the Altar of Flame. Increases the damage of Flame Dominance by 10%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Magma Burst
children.text: Kurog hurls magma at random players, inflicting Fire damage and causes a Magma Pool to form at their destination.

children.name: Magma Pool
children.text: Molten magma inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec to players standing within it.

children.name: Searing Carnage
children.text: The caster infuses players with fire, causing them to mark their current location every 1 sec for 5 sec. The marked location explodes after sec, inflicting Fire damage to players nearby.

children.name: Frost Dominance
children.text: Kurog inflicts Frost damage to all players every 4 sec while attuned to the Altar of Frost. Increases the damage of Frost Dominance by 10%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Biting Chill
children.text: Kurog afflicts all players with a biting chill that inflicts Frost damage every 1 sec for 10 sec.

children.name: Absolute Zero
children.text: The caster hurls a chunk of ice at a player, inflicting Frost damage split evenly among players nearby upon impact.

children.name: Earth Dominance
children.text: Kurog inflicts Nature damage to all players every 4 sec while attuned to the Altar of Earth. Increases the damage of Earth Dominance by 10%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Erupting Bedrock
children.text: The caster sends a tectonic ripple through the earth, inflicting Nature damage to players struck by the ripple.

children.name: Seismic Rupture
children.text: The caster pulls Earth Breakers from the ground, inflicting Nature damage to players with yards of the eruptions and knocking them back.

children.name: Skeletal Fractures
children.text: Earth Breaker attacks fracture bones, increasing the player's Physical damage taken by 6% for 10 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Storm Dominance
children.text: Kurog inflicts Nature damage to all players every 4 sec while attuned to the Altar of Storm. Increases the damage of Storm Dominance by 10%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Shocking Burst
children.text: Kurog charges several players with electricity for 5 sec. Upon expiration, charged players inflict Nature damage to players nearby.

children.name: Thunder Strike
children.text:
The caster calls down thunder, inflicting Nature damage to players near the impact locations.

Impacts that fail to hit a player inflict Nature damage to all players.

children.name: Primal Barrier
children.text: Kurog surrounds himself with a barrier of elemental energy, reducing damage taken by 99%.

children.name: Blistering Presence
children.text: The elemental surges with power, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Magma Flow
children.text: Magma seeps from the elemental as it is struck, creating lava pools at random locations that inflict Fire damage every 1 sec.

children.name: Magma Pool
children.text: Molten magma inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec to players standing within it.

children.name: Chilling Presence
children.text: The elemental surges with power, inflicting Frost damage every 1 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Frost Binds
children.text: The Frozen Destroyer unleashes a nova of frost that inflicts Frost damage to all players and an additional Frost damage every 2 sec for 20 sec. The chilling blast also reduces movement speed by 10%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Freezing Tempest
children.text:
The Frozen Destroyer conjures violent winds centered on itself for 8 sec, inflicting Frost damage every 1 sec to players farther than yards away.

The winds are slower within yards, inflicting Frost damage every 1 sec.

children.name: Shattering Presence
children.text: The elemental surges with power, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Breaking Gravel
children.text:
Each consecutive melee attack against the same target increases the elemental's Physical damage by 3%. This effect stacks.

Breaking Gravel is removed when the elemental melee attacks a new target.

children.name: Ground Shatter
children.text: The Tectonic Crusher infuses several players with volatile earth for 5 sec. Upon expiration, infused players inflict Nature damage to players nearby.

children.name: Violent Upheaval
children.text: Slams the earth, causing rocks to erupt from nearby locations, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby and knocking them away.

children.name: Thundering Presence
children.text: The elemental surges with power, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Storm Break
children.text: Vanishes and appears behind a random enemy to unleash Lethal Current.

children.name: Lethal Current
children.text: Channels a lethal current into the closest player, inflicting Nature damage to all players near the target every 1 sec for 6 sec.

children.name: Primal Attunement
children.text: At full power Kurog achieves total attunement with the primal elements gaining all the altar abilities at once. In addition, Grimtotem surges with elemental power, inflicting Elemental damage every 0.5 sec. This effect stacks.

bosses.name: Broodkeeper Diurna
bosses.description: Broodkeeper Diurna is the fierce guardian of the Primalist Clutchwarren. She devotes her considerable strength to protect the unhatched and seeks vengeance for the one she lost.

tips.text:
•Rapid Incubation marks future egg targets as Diurna moves about The Clutchwarren.
•Mortal Stoneclaws inflicts high damage and reduces healing recieved, and Broodkeeper's Fury increases the duration of the healing reduction.
•Primalist Reinforcements should be engaged quickly as to prevent them from healing, increasing damage done, and reducing damage taken from Diurna's Broodkeeper's Bond.

•Utilize Greatstaff's Wrath and Empowered Greatstaff's Wrath to break eggs targeted by Diurna's Rapid Incubation.
•Primalist Mages can inflict high damage with Ice Barrage when left uncontrolled.
•Prior to Diurna gaining Broodkeeper's Fury, players within Diurna's Gaze take increased damage.

•Utilize Greatstaff's Wrath and Empowered Greatstaff's Wrath to break eggs targeted by Diurna's Rapid Incubation.
•Icy Shroud and Frozen Shroud absorb incoming healing, snaring or rooting the afflicted player.
•Prior to Diurna gaining Broodkeeper's Fury, players within Diurna's Gaze take increased damage.

bosses.overview:
Broodkeeper Diurna gains storm energy as the battle ensues, defending the Primalist Clutch with primal elements and calling upon Primalist Reinforcements. At 100 storm energy she casts Rapid Incubation on the Primalist eggs, expediting the growth of the dragon inside. Players incurring Greatstaff's Wrath and Empowered Greatstaff's Wrath can break these eggs, else lieutenants from each Primal element's eggs join the battle.

Upon gaining Broodkeeper's Fury, Diurna lashes out harnessing the primal elements with enhanced skill.

children.name: Broodkeeper's Bond
children.text:
The Broodkeeper's diligent care links her life essence to the unhatched eggs, preventing all damage below 2% remaining health. This effect stacks for each intact egg in the room.

Additionally, this aura increases the damage done of nearby allies by 50%, decreases damage taken by 25%, and heals 3% of their total health every second for. This effect stacks.

children.name: Greatstaff of the Broodkeeper
children.text:
The Broodkeeper embeds her greatstaff nearby, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby every sec for.

Additionally, Diurna immediately gains |4application:applications; of Greatstaff's Wrath.

children.name: Greatstaff's Wrath
children.text:
Increases Greatstaff of the Broodkeeper's damage done by 10%.$?diff15|diff16
[ This effect stacks.][]

Players may cast while near the embedded weapon, consuming one application of Greatstaff's Wrath and causing a beam to pursue the player.

The focused beam inflicts Nature damage to players nearby every half-second during pursuit, shattering any egg in its path terminating the beam.

children.name: Rapid Incubation
children.text: The Broodkeeper infuses magic into the nearest eggs. After, these eggs hatch exposing the enemy within.

children.name: Wildfire
children.text:
On Normal difficulty, Wildfire additionally explodes after a short delay.

On Heroic difficulty, Wildfire additionally inflicts damage in a radius around each targeted player.

On Mythic difficulty, Wildfire additionally launches flames to nearby locations.

children.name: Icy Shroud
children.text: Diurna expels a surge of frost to players nearby, reducing their movement speed by 30% and causing their next healing to be absorbed.

children.name: Mortal Stoneclaws
children.text: Diurna grievously wounds her target, inflicting Physical damage and Nature damage, applying Crushing Stoneclaws and Mortal Wounds.

children.name: Mortal Wounds
children.text: Reduces the effectiveness of any healing effects received by 65% for. This effect stacks, and cannot be mitigated or avoided.

children.name: Crushing Stoneclaws
children.text: Inflicts Nature damage every sec. For. This effect stacks.

children.name: The Clutchwarren
children.text: The primal energies that flow through the Clutchwarren empower those within, increasing movement speed by 15%.

children.name: Diurna's Gaze
children.text: The Broodkeeper keeps a watchful eye on nearby enemies, increasing damage taken by 10% to players nearby, removing the movement speed bonus granted by The Clutchwarren.

children.name: Nascent Proto-Dragon
children.text: Awoken through Rapid Incubation, these enemies join Diurna in combat defending their kin.

children.name: Vicious Thrust
children.text: The legionnaire stabs at a foe, inflicting Physical damage.

children.name: Ice Barrage
children.text: The mage hurls frozen ice at a target, inflicting Frost damage and up to an additional Frost damage every sec. For.

children.name: Tremors
children.text: The Earthreaver sends out rumbling tremors that explode upon contact, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby. Afflicted players suffer Nature damage every half-second and are stunned for. This effect stacks.

children.name: Flame Sentry
children.text: The Flamebender conjures Flame Sentries nearby which rotate for. Players suffer Fire damage every half-second while inside the sentry's effect.

children.name: Chilling Tantrum
children.text: The Proto-Dragon thrashes about for, inflicting Frost damage every sec. To players nearby, reducing their movement speed by 10% for.

children.name: Ionizing Charge
children.text: The Stormbringer electrifies afflicted players with lightning energy, jolting players nearby for Nature damage every half-second for.

children.name: Broodkeeper's Fury
children.text: Diurna's Fury knows no bounds, increasing damage done by 15%, and empowering abilities with additional power. Additionally, this doubles the duration of Mortal Wounds. This effect stacks and increases in intensity every sec.

children.name: Empowered Greatstaff of the Broodkeeper
children.text:
The Broodkeeper embeds her greatstaff, inflicting Nature damage every sec for.

Additionally, Diurna immediately gains |4application:applications; of Empowered Greatstaff's Wrath.

children.text:
Increases Empowered Greatstaff of the Broodkeeper's damage done by 30%.$?diff14|diff15|diff16
[ This effect stacks, beginning at charges.][]

Diurna empowers the embedded weapon, invoking its wrath, consuming one application of Empowered Greatstaff's Wrath for each targeted player, causing a beam to pursue them.

The focused beam inflicts Nature damage to players nearby every half-second during pursuit, shattering any egg in its path terminating the beam.

children.name: Frozen Shroud
children.text: Diurna expels a surge of ice, immobilizing them within an attackable rime causing their next healing to be absorbed.

children.name: Wildfire
children.text:
On Normal difficulty, Wildfire additionally explodes after a short delay.

On Heroic difficulty, Wildfire additionally inflicts damage in a radius around each targeted player.

On Mythic difficulty, Wildfire additionally launches flames to nearby locations.

children.name: Mortal Stoneclaws
children.text: Diurna grievously wounds her target, inflicting Physical damage and Nature damage, applying Crushing Stoneclaws and Mortal Wounds.

children.name: Mortal Wounds

children.name: Crushing Stoneclaws

bosses.name: Raszageth the Storm-Eater
bosses.description: Raszageth devoutly believes that dragonkind was meant to be as wild and free as the storm itself. Should she succeed at freeing her fellow Incarnates from their ancient prison, Raszageth and her kin will topple the Aspects and scour the world clean of every trace of the titans' influence.

tips.text:
• Volatile Sparks are destroyed if Volatile is removed or Burst is interrupted.
• Fulminating Charge inflicts damage to players in an area around the wearer and jumps to the closest player within range upon expiration.
• Static Field reduces movement speed and forced movement effects on players standing in the area.
• Seeking Stormlings will cast Fuse if they successfully reach the Colossal Stormfiend that created it with Storm Break.

• Volatile Sparks are destroyed if Volatile is removed or Burst is interrupted.
• Thunderous Energy inflicts damage equivalent to the total damage dealt by Thunderous Blast to the victim.
• Static Field reduces movement speed and forced movement effects on players standing in the area.
• Fulminating Charge inflicts damage damage in an area and applies Lingering Charge to the wearer upon expiration.

• Volatile Sparks are destroyed if Volatile is removed or Burst is interrupted.

• Static Field reduces movement speed and forced movement effects on players standing in the area.
• Surging Ruiners will move and attack players once Surge is removed.

bosses.overview:
Raszageth and her Primalist forces seek to shatter the prisons that hold her siblings. As the battle begins, Raszageth uses Hurricane Wing to sweep her assailants from the central platform.

Upon reaching 65% health, Raszageth begins an aerial assault against Fyrakk's and Vyranoth's prisons with Lightning Devastation while summoning ground forces to attack the prisons directly. Surging Ruiners Surge with lightning, draining the vault of its power.

When the integrity of the vault falls to 50%, Raszageth lands on Iridikron's prison and begins to drain the vault's power using Stormsurge.

When the integrity of the vault falls to, Raszageth takes off and summons Colossal Stormfiends to drain the vault of its remaining power.

As the vault fails, Raszageth returns to the central platform and becomes the heart of a Raging Storm. The Storm-Eater brings the full force of her abilities against her assailants as she ushers in the dark clouds of a new age.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Raszageth summons a massive gust of wind. Inflicts Nature damage to all players. Additionally, players are pushed away and suffer Nature damage every 0.5 sec for 3 sec.$?diff16 [

The Volatile Spark is destroyed if the cast succeeds or is interrupted.

normal.name: Vault of the Incarnates
normal.description: The Primalists breached the Titan prison used to hold the Incarnates for millennia. Within, Raszageth performs a foul ritual to unleash her siblings, so together they can purge the world of the Titans' influence. The champions of Azeroth must assault this impregnable fortress and break their defenses to end this threat. While many could fall, defeat condemns all the realms to the Incarnates' reign of fire and blood.

bosses.name: Eranog
bosses.description: Eranog, commander of the Primalist forces, is relentless in his pursuit of power. With the Incarnates' release imminent, Eranog summons the whole of his army and will not hesitate to sacrifice his devoted followers to achieve victory.

• Molten Cleave inflicts massive damage to all players in front of Eranog.
• Army of Flame inflicts deadly damage to anyone caught in the elementals' path.

bosses.overview:
Eranog leads his primalist forces with a combination of brutal attacks and cunning strategies. The Primal Commander will summon deadly minions through Flamerifts that leave behind bubbling pools of Primal Flow.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Eranog will call forth an Army of Flame to encircle his opponents.

children.name: Flamerift
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Eranog also opens a Greater Flamerift that creates a Flamescale Captain.

children.name: Kill Order
children.text: The fixates on a player, pursuing them relentlessly.

children.name: Lava Flow
children.text: A pool of lava that inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec to players standing within it.

children.name: Molten Cleave
children.text: Eranog swings his molten axe, inflicting Fire damage to players in a frontal cone.

children.name: Incinerating Roar
children.text: Eranog roars, exhaling flames that inflict Fire damage to all players and an additional Fire damage every 2 sec for 28 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Molten Spikes
children.text:
Eranog pulls forth Molten Spikes from the chamber floor, inflicting Physical damage to players nearby and knocking them away.

These spikes explode into when Eranog bellows an Incinerating Roar.

children.name: Molten Fissure
children.text: Molten spikes explode, creating fissures that inflict Fire damage to players near the impact locations and knocking them upwards.

children.name: Burning Wound
children.text: Eranog's melee attacks cause searing wounds that inflict Fire damage every 2 sec for 14 sec. This effect stacks.

bosses.name: Terros
bosses.description: Primalists sought to pull Terros, an unyielding force of destruction, from the elemental plane. However, their ritual was interrupted. Trapped between two worlds, this hulking terror seeks to free himself and obliterate everything in his path.

tips.text:
•Rock Blast inflicts a large amount of damage and creates Awakened Earth.
•Concussive Slam creates a line of tectonic energy that destroys Awakened Earth.

•Rock Blast inflicts a large amount of damage and creates Awakened Earth.
•Shattering Impact and Resonating Annihilation cause Fractured Rubble to fall from the ceiling.

•Rock Blast inflicts a large amount of damage and creates Awakened Earth.

bosses.overview:
Terros fights his assailants with an onslaught of destructive attacks, launching Rock Blasts that create Awakened Earth throughout the chamber as the battle rages. These pulsing pillars of earth inflict constant damage and are destroyed by Concussive Slam.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Terros casts Resonating Annihilation, destroying Awakened Earth and permanently covering a portion of the chamber in Resonant Aftermath.

abilities.name: Rock Blast
abilities.text: On Mythic difficulty, this ability inflicts damage to all players.

children.name: Aftershock
children.text: The aftershock of Rock Blast inflicts Nature damage to players nearby, knocking them upwards.

children.name: Awakened Earth
children.text:
The earth erupts beneath several players, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby and knocking them back.

Upon erupting, begins to inflict Nature damage to all players every 2 sec until destroyed. 

Upon destruction, releases a Seismic Assault.

children.name: Seismic Assault
children.text:
Seismic Assault inflicts Nature damage to all players.

Inflicts an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Resonating Annihilation
abilities.text:
Upon reaching 100 energy, Terros unleashes his volatile power with a brutal slam.

This slam inflicts Nature damage to all players in a frontal cone, destroys Awakened Earth, and leaves Resonant Aftermath in its wake.

The cavern shutters from the force of the impact, inflicting an additional Nature damage to all players and causing Fractured Rubble to fall from the ceiling.

children.name: Resonant Aftermath
children.text: The earth pulses with resonating energy, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec to players within the area.

children.name: Fractured Rubble
children.text: Rubble falls from the ceiling, inflicting Nature damage to players near the impact location.

abilities.name: Shattering Impact
abilities.text:
Terros fractures the earth, inflicting Nature damage to players near the impact location and knocking them upwards.

Causes Fractured Rubble to fall from the ceiling.

children.name: Fractured Rubble

Destroys any Awakened Earth caught in the blast.

abilities.name: Frenzied Devastation
abilities.text: Upon filling the chamber with Resonant Aftermath, Terros begins radiating devastating waves of earthen energy that inflict Nature damage and increase damage taken from Frenzied Devastation by 50%.

abilities.name: Tectonic Barrage
abilities.text: If no player is within reach, Terros continually emits tectonic pulses that inflict Nature damage.

bosses.name: The Primal Council
bosses.description: These masters of the elements are ruthless in their pursuit of power. Embar Firepath is as merciless as the fire she commands. Opalfang wields the might of the earth to crush her enemies. Kadros Icewrath is cold and cruel, while his sibling Dathea Stormlash is as wild and unpredictable as a raging storm.

tips.text:
•Slashing Blaze inflicts high Fire damage to players in front of Embar.
•Crush massively increases Physical damage taken.

•Conductive Mark spreads to nearby players.
•Meteor Axes will destroy any Earthen Pillar they hit.
•Touching Scorched Ground removes applications of Primal Blizzard.

•Meteor Axes split damage evenly amongst players hit and destroy Earthen Pillars.
•Primal Blizzard inflicts heavy damage to all players and can trap them in Frost Tombs.

bosses.overview:
The Primal Council works together to wipe out players with elemental attacks. When brought to low health, council members begin channeling their Convocation spell until all members of the council are defeated.

The elemental magics of the Primal Council's abilities can interact with each other in different ways to both advantage and detriments.

children.name: Primal Blizzard
children.text:
Upon reaching 100 energy, Kadros channels a freezing storm for 10 sec. The chill inflicts Frost damage every 1 sec., increasing Frost damage taken by 10% and reducing Fire damage taken by 10% for 15 sec. This effect stacks. Scorched Ground removes this effect.

Upon reaching 10 applications, players are trapped in a Frost Tomb.

children.name: Frost Tomb
children.text: The player is overcome by the Primal Blizzard, and is trapped in a tomb of ice that inflicts Frost damage and an additional Frost damage every 1 sec. Until freed.

children.name: Frost Spike
children.text: Kadros propels a spike of ice at a random player, inflicting Frost damage.

children.name: Glacial Convocation
children.text:
Upon defeat, Kadros convokes the plane of ice, inflicting Frost damage to all players every 6 sec. This damage increases over time.

Kadros channels until all members of the Primal Council are defeated.

children.name: Conductive Mark
children.text:
Dathea marks the player with lightning, inflicting Nature damage on impact and an additional Nature damage periodically for10 sec. Increases Nature damage taken by 8% for each application. This effect stacks.

If an affected player comes within 5 yards of another player, the mark will duplicate to that target. Moving within 5 yards of an Earthen Pillar harmlessly removes the mark.

children.name: Lightning Bolt
children.text: Dathea hurls lightning at a random player, inflicting Nature damage.

children.name: Chain Lightning
children.text: A bolt of lightning strikes a random player, inflicting Nature damage and then jumping to nearby players.

children.name: Storming Convocation
children.text:
Upon defeat, Dathea convokes the plane of storms, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 6 sec. This damage increases over time.

Dathea channels until all members of the Primal Council are defeated.

children.name: Earthen Pillar

children.name: Crush

children.name: Quaking Convocation

Opalfang convokes primal earth, releasing forceful blasts of earthen magic that inflict Nature damage to all players every 6 sec. This damage increases over time.

Opalfang channels until all members of the Primal Council are defeated.

children.name: Meteor Axes

children.name: Scorched Ground

The impact of Embar's Meteor Axes scorches the ground for 70 sec, inflicting Fire damage every 2 sec. To players who stand in the area.

The heat dispels Primal Blizzard.

children.name: Slashing Blaze
children.text: Upon reaching 100 energy, Embar infuses her axe with lava and cleaves the player, inflicting Fire damage and an additional Fire damage every 1.5 sec. For 15 sec to all players in front of Embar. This effect stacks.

children.name: Burning Convocation
children.text:
Embar convokes the plane of fire, inflicting Fire damage to all players every 6 sec. This damage increases over time.

Embar channels until all members of the Primal Council are defeated.

bosses.name: Sennarth, the Cold Breath
bosses.description: Sennarth, Kurog Grimtotem's most vicious creation, is a massive arachnid infused with the unforgiving cold. Her singular purpose is to guard her brood of thousands, awaiting the day they'll hatch and enshroud Azeroth in a web of winter.

tips.text:
•Sticky Webbing provides protection against sliding on Icy Ground and being pushed and pulled.
•Caustic Eruption will destroy and remove both Sticky Webbing and Wrapped in Webs.
•Web Blast increases the damage taken from subsequent hits.
•Frostbreath Arachnids use Freezing Breath on all targets in front of themselves.

•Sticky Webbing provides protection against sliding on Icy Ground and being pushed and pulled.
•Chilling Blast causes players to inflict Frost damage to other nearby players with Frost Expulsion.
•Caustic Eruption will destroy and remove both Sticky Webbing and Wrapped in Webs.

•Sticky Webbing provides protection against sliding on Icy Ground and being pushed and pulled.
•Chilling Blast and Frost Expulsion will inflict high damage to players.

bosses.overview:
Sennarth assaults players with chilling attacks that coat the floor in slippery ice. After a brief battle in the lower reaches of the chamber, Sennarth begins her ascent towards the icy summit of her lair.

At each of the platforms along the staircase, Sennarth summons a Frostbreath Arachnid to her aid.

At the top of her lair, Sennarth freezes the ground permanently and descends from her web to devour her prey.
