•Scouring Eternity inflicts lethal damage to players not safely hidden behind an Astral Formation.

bosses.overview:
Scalecommander Sarkareth begins the fight with Oppressing Howl and attempts to obliterate players with Glittering Surge.

When weakened, he draws upon the power of the Void to enhance his draconic powers, using Abyssal Breath and Ebon Might to summon and strengthen images of himself.

When severely wounded, Sarkareth destroys the room to fully draw in powers of the Void and convert his abilities to their most powerful forms.

abilities.name: Oblivion
abilities.text: Being struck with most Void abilities causes Oblivion, inflicting Shadow damage every sec for 25 sec. Upon reaching applications, the affected player is lost in the Emptiness Between Stars.

children.name: Lost in Space
children.text: The target is stranded alone in the vast infinite of space, reducing damage done by 99%. After 20 sec, if the target has not recovered fragments of their mind, they are lost forever and perish.

children.name: Astral Flare
children.text: While stranded within the Emptiness Between Stars, players can absorb Astral Flares to gain 5% increased Haste and 10% increased movement speed for 23 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Stage One: The Legacy of the Dracthyr
abilities.text: Scalecommander Sarkareth uses the full might of his dracthyr abilities to deter his foes.

children.name: Oppressing Howl
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, this grants 2 applications of Oppressing Howl. Searing Breath and Mass Disintegrate can each remove one application.

children.name: Glittering Surge
children.text:
Sarkareth releases pure magic, inflicting Arcane damage to all players every 1 sec for 8 sec.

If Glittering Surge strikes a player with Oppressing Howl, it removes that effect and applies Dazzled.

children.name: Dazzled
children.text: The player's senses are dazzled, stunning them and inflicting Arcane damage every 1 sec for 20 sec.

children.name: Scorching Bomb
children.text: Sarkareth places several Scorching Bombs on nearby players. Each inflicts Fire damage to players nearby every 1 sec. After 12 sec, the bombs explode with a Scorching Detonation.

children.name: Scorching Detonation
children.text: A fiery blast consumes the bomb, inflicting Fire damage to all players instantly with an additional Fire damage every 1 sec for 5 sec.

children.name: Burning Ground
children.text: When a Scorching Bomb erupts, it creates a patch of Burning Ground. This ground inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec to players within.

children.name: Mass Disintegrate
children.text:
Sarkareth forms a shimmering image that marks players. After 6 sec, energy erupts from the image in a line towards its targets inflicting Arcane damage.

If Mass Disintegrate strikes a target with Oppressing Howl, it removes that effect and applies Disintegrated.

children.name: Disintegrated
children.text: The target's mind and body are heavily fractured, reducing movement speed by 25% and inflicting Arcane damage every 5 sec.

children.name: Searing Breath
children.text:
Sarkareth breathes flames in a frontal cone, inflicting Fire damage instantly with an additional Fire damage every 1 sec for 12 sec. This attack repeats times and stacks.

If Searing Breath strikes a target with Oppressing Howl, it removes that effect and applies Seared.

children.name: Seared
children.text: Searing wounds burn the player, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec.

children.name: Burning Claws
children.text:
Sarkareth slashes his current target, inflicting Physical damage with an additional Fire damage every 1 sec for 27 sec. This effect stacks.

Upon expiration, releases a Blazing Blast.

children.name: Blazing Blast
children.text: The player erupts with a burning nova, inflicting 15% of the total Fire damage taken from Burning Claws to all players as Fire damage.

abilities.name: Stage Two: A Touch of the Forbidden
abilities.text: Sarkareth draws in power from the Void to enhance his latent abilities.

children.name: Void Bomb
children.text: Sarkareth places Void Bombs on nearby players. Each inflicts Shadow damage to players nearby every 1 sec. After 20 sec, the bombs explode with a.

children.name: Void Surge
children.text: The bomb erupts with void energy, inflicting Shadow damage to all players every 1 sec for 4 sec.

children.name: Void Fracture
children.text: A player stepping into the Void Bomb causes the void energy to dissipate into the player. Upon removal, the void energy erupts with a Void Surge unless that player is within the Emptiness Between Stars.

children.name: Abyssal Breath
children.text: Sarkareth takes in a deep breath and flies to a location, inflicting Shadow damage in a line and knocking players back.

children.name: Null Glimmer
children.text: Upon casting Abyssal Breath, Sarkareth leaves behind images of himself.

children.name: Null Blast
children.text: The image releases a mighty scream, inflicting Arcane damage to all players and interrupting spellcasting.

children.name: Desolate Blossom
children.text: Sarkareth grows bulbs of void energy at player locations which pulse waves to all players and creatures within them every 0.5 sec, absorbing up to healing for 1 min.

children.name: Ebon Might
children.text: Upon casting any spell, Sarkareth empowers his allies with the might of the Black dragons. This effect increases their damage done and movement speed by 20%. Upon reaching applications, the target becomes immune to crowd controlling and interrupting effects.

children.name: Void Claws
children.text:
Sarkareth slashes his current target, inflicting Physical damage with an additional Shadow damage every 2 sec and reducing healing received by 25% for 18 sec. This effect stacks.

Upon expiration, releases a Void Blast.

children.name: Void Blast
children.text: The player erupts with a void nova, inflicting 25% of the total Shadow damage taken from Void Claws to players nearby as Shadow damage.

abilities.name: Stage Three: The Seas of Infinity
abilities.text: Eschewing his draconic abilities, Sarkareth fully embraces the Void in a final bid for power.

children.name: Cosmic Ascension
children.text: Sarkareth flies up through a void portal before crashing through the floor and inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby and knocking back players struck.

children.name: Astral Formations
children.text: Sarkareth pulls several asteroids out of space to crash into the ground. These formations inflict Shadow damage to nearby players every 2 sec.

children.name: Null Glimmer
children.text: Upon casting Cosmic Ascension, Sarkareth leaves behind images of himself.

children.name: Null Blast
children.text: The image releases a mighty scream, inflicting Arcane damage to all players and interrupting spellcasting.

children.name: Void Might
children.text: After ascending to the stars, Sarkareth empowers himself with Cosmic energy, increasing his damage done by 10%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Scouring Supernova
children.text: Sarkareth causes a massive supernova to grow and erupt, inflicting Shadow damage and knocking back all players not behind an Astral Formation.

children.name: Astral Eruption
children.text: Cosmic energy destabilizes Astral Formations, causing them to explode and inflict Shadow damage to players nearby and knock back players nearby.

children.name: Motes of Oblivion
children.text: Oblivion motes rain from above, inflicting Shadow damage in addition to applications of Oblivion to players near the impact.

children.name: Void Claws
children.text:
Sarkareth slashes his current target and a frontal cone, inflicting Physical damage with an additional Shadow damage every 2 sec and reducing healing received by 25% for 21 sec. This effect stacks.

Upon expiration, releases a.

children.name: Void Blast
children.text: A void nova erupts from the target, inflicting 25% of the total Shadow damage taken from Void Slash to all players as Shadow damage.

loot.name: Highland Drake: Embodiment of the Hellforged
Highland Drake: Embodiment of the Hellforged

normal.name: Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible
normal.description: Millennia ago, Neltharion established Aberrus, a secret laboratory where he conducted world altering experiments. Recently rediscovered, Aberrus is now under attack from all sides as forces seeking to claim the Earth-Warder's legacy search for any power that remains. The champions of Azeroth must venture into the shadows and ensure Neltharion's dark power doesn't fall into the wrong hands.

bosses.name: Kazzara, the Hellforged
bosses.description: Although Neltharion would not use them himself until much later, he experimented with elementium plating in the early days of Aberrus. The end result of elementium and shadowflame was Kazzara, who was deemed far too unstable for release. Driven mad by the excruciating pain of her elementium plates, she now serves as the guardian of the Shadowed Crucible.

tips.text:
•Terror Claws inflict heavy damage and increase damage taken from further casts.
•Upon reaching 100 energy, Hellbeam is unleashed inflicting massive damage to anyone caught in the effect.

•Rays of Anguish hunt players and leave behind a Molten Scar.
•Upon reaching 100 energy, Hellbeam is unleashed inflicting massive damage to anyone caught in the effect.

•Rays of Anguish hunt players and leave behind a Molten Scar.
•Wings of Extinction and Infernal Heart inflict heavy raidwide damage.

bosses.overview: As combat unfolds, Kazzara tears open Dread Rifts from which Rays of Anguish will form to hunt players. At 80%, 60%, and 40% health remaining, plates of Kazzara's menacing armor are shattered off during Hellsteel Carnage, intensifying her Infernal Heart.

abilities.name: Elementium Plating
abilities.text: Powerful elementium plates maintain the integrity of Kazzara's volatile core. At 80%, 60%, and 40% health, sections of armor are shattered off into. The calamitous blast inflicts Shadowflame damage to all players.

children.name: Infernal Heart
children.text: Kazzara's exposed core pulses with her molten heartbeat inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players every 4 sec, hastening as she loses more armor.

children.name: Hellsteel Fragment
children.text: Kazzara's armor shatters into blazing metal scraps, each inflicting Shadowflame damage near impact.

children.name: Revenant's Blood
children.text: Kazzara's gruesome wounds spew out masses of her lifeblood, each inflicting Shadowflame damage near impact.

abilities.name: Dread Rifts
abilities.text:
Kazzara releases a furious roar that incites a burning mark within several players. After 5 sec, unworldly rifts tear open beneath these players in a torrent of dreadfire inflicting Shadowflame damage nearby.

Kazzara's exposed core causes Dread Rifts to target an additional player for each piece of armor that has been shattered.

children.name: Riftburn
children.text: The searing heat of the inflicts Shadowflame damage every 1 sec to players standing within the effect.

children.name: Molten Scar
children.text: Scorched ground that inflicts Shadowflame damage every 1 sec to players standing within.

abilities.name: Rays of Anguish
abilities.text: Kazzara summons fragments of blazing energy to blast out from Dread Rifts. Each fragment ignites a blistering beam and hunts a nearby player, leaving a Molten Scar in its wake. Touching the beam inflicts Shadowflame damage every 0.3 sec.

children.name: Molten Scar
children.text: Scorched ground that inflicts Shadowflame damage every 1 sec to players standing within the effect.

abilities.name: Hellbeam
abilities.text:
Upon reaching 100 energy, Kazzara unleashes an annihilating beam from her jaws, inflicting Shadowflame damage every 0.3 sec for 3 sec to any players caught inside. The superheated breath inflicts an additional Shadowflame damage every 0.3 sec to all players.

Kazzara disgorges increasing amounts of Revenant's Blood as her armor is shattered off.

children.name: Revenant's Blood
children.text: Kazzara's gruesome wounds spew out masses of her lifeblood, each inflicting Shadowflame damage near impact.

abilities.name: Wings of Extinction
abilities.text: Kazzara thrashes her fiery wings, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players and pushing them away. The flames linger, inflicting an additional Shadowflame damage every 2 sec for 20 sec.

abilities.name: Terror Claws
abilities.text: Kazzara lacerates her target, inflicting Physical damage and Shadowflame damage. The charred gashes inflict Shadowflame damage every 1 sec and increase damage taken from further Terror Claws by 200% for 25 sec.

bosses.name: The Amalgamation Chamber
bosses.description: The Eternal Blaze burns with the heat of a thousand suns, while the Essence of Shadow blooms with darkness incarnate. Although exceptionally powerful on their own, when combined they surge with the unchecked might of shadowflame, creating a whirlwind of ultimate destruction.

tips.text:
• The Eternal Blaze and Essence of Shadow combine their health to form the Shadowflame Amalgamation when one reaches 50% health remaining.
• Corrupting Shadows and Blazing Heat are periodically applied to players nearby each elemental.

• Corrupting Shadows and Blazing Heat are periodically applied to players nearby each elemental.
• Fiery Meteor inflicts massive damage, split among players in the effect.
• Shadowflame Contamination inflicts increasing damage until the Shadowflame Amalgamation is defeated.

• Shadow Spike and Flame Slash inflict heavy magic damage.
•The combination of Withering Vulnerability and Shadowflame Burst inflicts massive damage.

bosses.overview: The Eternal Blaze and The Essense of Shadow pulse with energy, applying Blazing Heat and Corrupting Shadow to nearby players. When either elemental reaches 50% health remaining, the two elementals combine to create The Shadowflame Amalgamation.

children.name: Corrupting Shadow
children.text: The Essence of Shadow pulses every 5 sec, applying Corrupting Shadow to players nearby. This dark energy inflicts Shadow damage every 5 sec and reduces maximum health by 1%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Coalescing Void
children.text: The Essence of Shadow detonates a mass of coalescent dark energy, inflicting Shadow damage to players near the detonation point. Players farther from the detonation receive less damage.

children.name: Umbral Detonation
children.text: The Essence of Shadow wreathes several players in darkness. Each player erupts after, inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby and creating Lingering Umbra.

children.name: Lingering Umbra
children.text: The dark residue inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec to players within the area.

children.name: Shadow Spike
children.text: The Essence of Shadow pierces its current target with a dark spike, inflicting Shadow Damage.

children.name: Blazing Heat
children.text: The Eternal Blaze pulses every 5 sec, applying Blazing Heat to players nearby. This searing heat inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Fiery Meteor
children.text: The Eternal Blaze calls down a fiery meteor nearby, inflicting Fire damage split evenly among all players near the impact location. If Fiery Meteor fails to hit at least one player, it detonates and inflicts Fire damage to all players.

children.name: Swirling Flame
children.text: The Eternal Blaze expels swirling flames in the direction of a nearby player that inflicts Fire damage to players caught in their path.

children.name: Flame Slash
children.text: The Eternal Blaze slashes its current target with fiery claws, inflicting Fire damage.

children.name: Splintered Flames
children.text: Cinders of The Eternal Blaze's essence fly off around her inflicting Fire Damage to players near the impact.

children.name: Splintered Shadow
children.text: Splinters of The Essence of Shadow fly off around him inflicting Shadow Damage to players near the impact.

children.name: Shadowflame Contamination
children.text: The Shadowflame Amalgamation pulses every 10 sec, applying Shadowflame Contamination to all players. This dark flame inflicts Shadowflame damage every 2 sec and reduces maximum health by 1%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Gloom Conflagration
children.text:
The Shadowflame Amalgamation calls down a dark meteor nearby, inflicting Shadowflame damage split evenly among all players near the impact location. If Gloom Conflagration fails to hit at least players, it detonates and inflicts Shadowflame damage to all players.

The impact creates an orb of energy that detonates shortly afterwards, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players. Players farther from the detonation point receive less damage.

children.name: Blistering Twilight
children.text:
The Shadowflame Amalgamation wreathes several players in shadowflame. Each target erupts after, inflicting Shadowflame damage to players nearby and creating Engulfing Heat.

Each target also erupts with Swirling Shadowflame.

children.name: Swirling Shadowflame
children.text: Blistering Twilight causes dark flames to erupt outwards from the target, inflicting Shadowflame damage and knocking back players caught in their path.

children.name: Engulfing Heat
children.text: The engulfing flames left behind by Blistering Twilight inflict Shadowflame damage every 1 to players within the area.

children.name: Withering Vulnerability
children.text: The Shadowflame Amalgamation slashes its current target with dark claws, inflicting Physical damage and increasing their Shadowflame damage taken by 200% for 10 sec.

children.name: Shadowflame Burst
children.text: The Shadowflame Amalgamation releases a burst of flames in the direction of its current target, inflicting Shadowflame damage to players in a frontal cone.

bosses.name: The Forgotten Experiments
bosses.description: The development of the dracthyr produced many iterations, some more successful than others. Early versions of the experiment proved far too volatile to destroy. Kept dormant for thousands of years, these creations have now awakened, and seek to test their prowess against the champions of Azeroth.

tips.text:
•Infused Strikes inflict increasing Arcane damage.
•Rionthus soars across the room during Deep Breath.

•Neldris dashes between marked players with Rending Charge, affecting anyone in her path.
•Unstable Essence creates an explosion upon removal and jumps to a nearby player.
•Rionthus gains a shield that absorbs damage if Temporal Anomalies reach him.

•Neldris' Rending Charge inflicts heavy bleed damage on several targets.
•Violent Eruption inflicts heavy damage to all players.
•Unstable Essence creates an explosion upon removal and jumps to a nearby player.

bosses.overview: The forgotten experiments within Neltharion's laboratory each represent a dark stage in the development of the dracthyr. Neldris enters the fray first and assaults the laboratory's intruders with Rending Charge.

children.name: Rending Charge
children.text: Neldris charges between several players, inflicting Physical damage to anyone in her path, knocking them back, and causing them to bleed for Physical damage every 1 sec for 15 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Massive Slam
children.text: Neldris unleashes a shockwave that inflicts Physical damage to players in a frontal cone.

children.name: Bellowing Roar
children.text: Neldris bellows an arcane roar, inflicting up to Arcane damage. Players farther from Neldris take less damage.

children.name: Infused Strikes
children.text:
The experiment's melee attacks inflict Arcane damage every 1 sec. This effect stacks.

Touching another player afflicted by Infused Strikes removes all applications and causes an Infused Explosion.

children.name: Infused Explosion
children.text: The energy from Infused Strikes explodes, inflicting Arcane damage to all players and an additional Arcane damage every 2 sec for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Unstable Essence
children.text:
Thadrion infuses players with unstable energy, inflicting Arcane damage every 2 sec and growing in intensity over time.

Upon removal, the energy briefly coalesces and then explodes, inflicting Arcane damage to players nearby and leaving behind an.

A lingering trace of energy then jumps to a nearby player and applies Unstable Essence.

children.name: Volatile Spew
children.text: Thadrion spews forth arcane globules that inflict Arcane damage to players near the impact locations.

children.name: Violent Eruption
children.text:
Thadrion erupts with energy, inflicting Arcane damage to all players every 1 sec for 8 sec. 

S react to the violent energy, inflicting Arcane damage to all players every 1 sec during Violent Eruption.

children.name: Infused Strikes
children.text:
The experiment's melee attacks inflict Arcane damage every 1 sec. This effect stacks.

Touching another player afflicted by Infused Strikes removes all applications and causes an Infused Explosion.

children.name: Infused Explosion
children.text: The energy from Infused Strikes explodes, inflicting Arcane damage to all players and an additional Arcane damage every 2 sec for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Deep Breath
children.text: Rionthus takes in a deep breath and flies across the laboratory, spewing molten cinders that inflict Volcanic damage every 0.5 sec for 1 sec to players in his path.

children.name: Temporal Anomaly
children.text:
Rionthus creates a vortex of temporal energy that begins to drift toward him. If the anomaly collides with Rionthus, he gains a shield that absorbs damage equal to 10% of his maximum health.

If a player collides with the anomaly, it inflicts Arcane damage and is knocked away.

children.name: Disintegrate
children.text:
Rionthus tears into players with blasts of blue magic, inflicting Spellfrost damage every 1 sec over 3 sec.

The magic lingers, slowing affected players by 30% and causing them to inflict Spellfrost damage every 1 sec to players nearby for 16 sec.

children.name: Infused Strikes
children.text:
The experiment's melee attacks inflict Arcane damage every 1 sec. This effect stacks.

Touching another player afflicted by Infused Strikes removes all applications and causes an Infused Explosion.

children.name: Infused Explosion
children.text: The energy from Infused Strikes explodes, inflicting Arcane damage to all players and an additional Arcane damage every 2 sec for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

bosses.name: Assault of the Zaqali
bosses.description: Led by Warlord Kagni, the Zaqali warband has launched an all-out assault against the Shadowed Crucible in search of their missing Elder, Rashok. Brutal and ruthless, Kagni is willing to employ any tactic to succeed.

tips.text:
• Warlord Kagni jumps between battlements periodically with Devastating Leap.
• Heavy Cudgel causes massive Physical damage.
• Zaqali forces arrive on each battlement simultaneously and trigger Barrier Backfire upon reaching the Elder's Door.

• Warlord Kagni jumps between battlements periodically with Devastating Leap.
• Heavy Cudgel causes Cave Rubble to drop onto the battlements.
• Magma Mystics gain applications of Molten Empowerment while protected by Molten Barrier.

• Heavy Cudgel causes Cave Rubble to drop onto the battlements.
• Obsidian Guards inflict damage while on each battlement with Scorching Roar.
• Warlord Kagni inflicts massive damage with Catastrophic Slam.

bosses.overview:
As the battle begins, Warlord Kagni calls upon his Zaqali warband to assault the two protruding battlements. Warlord Kagni periodically sends himself onto the opposing battlement with Devastating Leap and causes Cave Rubble to fall with Heavy Cudgel.

Upon reaching 25% remaining health, Warlord Kagni stages a final desparate assault on the Elder's Door with Catastrophic Slams.

abilities.name: Barrier Backfire
abilities.text: The Elder's Door is protected by a runic barrier that backfires when attacked by Zaqali forces, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players and an additional Shadowflame damage every 0.5 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Devastating Leap
children.text:
At full energy, Warlord Kagni leaps between the battlements. When landing, he slams his hammer into the ground inflicting Volcanic damage to players nearby and knocking them away.

Molten fissures radiate from the impact location, inflicting Volcanic damage.

children.name: Heavy Cudgel
children.text:
Warlord Kagni slams his massive cudgel in the direction of his current target, inflicting Physical damage to players in a frontal cone and increasing their Physical damage taken by 15% for 45 sec. This effect stacks.

The force of the impact causes Cave Rubble to fall.

children.name: Cave Rubble
children.text: Rubble falls from the cavern's ceiling, inflicting Physical damage to players near the impact locations.

children.name: Molten Barrier
children.text: The Magma Mystic protects itself within a shield of lava that absorbs damage. The barrier pulses with flame while the shield holds, inflicting Fire damage to all players every 4 sec and granting the mystic Molten Empowerment.

children.name: Molten Empowerment
children.text: Increases the Magma Mystic's fire damage by 20%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Magma Flow
children.text: The caster hurls lava at random players, inflicting Lava damage on impact and an additonal Lava damage every 3 sec for 15 sec.

children.name: Lava Bolt
children.text: The Magma Mystic fires a searing bolt of lava, inflicting Volcanic damage to the target.

children.name: Blazing Spear
children.text:
The huntsman sets his aim on several players, heaving a Blazing Spear at their location that initially inflicts Physical damage to players near the impact.

The Blazing Spear remains in the ground and after a short duration, explodes inflicting Fire damage to players nearby.

children.name: Scorching Roar
children.text: The Obsidian Guard unleashes a burning roar that sears players nearby, inflicting Fire damage every 0.5 sec for 1.5 sec.

children.name: Zaqali Wallclimber
children.text: Wallclimbers periodically ascend the rampart walls and attempt to breach the sealed door. Their melee attacks cause Barrier Backfire.

children.name: Siege Arbalest
children.text: Siege Arbalests fire bolts along the ramparts inflicting Physical damage to all players near the impact.

children.name: Catastrophic Slam
children.text: In Heroic difficulty, Catastrophic Slam causes Weakened Vitality.

children.name: Flaming Cudgel
children.text:
Warlord Kagni slams his massive cudgel in the direction of his current target, inflicting Physical damage to players in a frontal cone and increasing their Physical damage taken by 15% for 45 sec. This effect stacks.

The force of the impact causes all players to erupt in flame, inflicting Fire damage to targets near their location.

children.name: Desperate Immolation
children.text: Warlord Kagni drains Ignara's life, regaining 35% of his maximum health and gaining Ignara's Fury.

children.name: Ignara's Fury
children.text: Warlord Kagni smolders with Ignara's flame, periodically inflicting Fire damage to all players every 1.5 sec.

bosses.name: Rashok, the Elder
bosses.description: Imprisoned within Aberrus for a millennia, the Zaqali elder Rashok has been perpetually drained of the raging flame within him to power Neltharion's twisted laboratory. Existing on the edge of death for so long has driven the elder mad. Should he break free, his vengeance will scour the Shadowed Crucible's halls.

tips.text:
• Rashok gains Ancient Fury at 100 energy and begins to pulse deadly Shadowflame to all players.
• Rashok is incapacitated and gradually loses energy while inside the Elder's Conduit.
• Rashok executes a series of deadly attacks during Wrath of Djaruun.

•Searing Slam creates a Lava Vortex at the impact location.
•Doom Flames inflict massive Shadowflame damage to all players if it fails to hit at least one player.

•Rashok inflicts heavy damage to all players with Scorching Heatwave while inside the Elder's Conduit.
•Searing Slam inflicts more damage each time it's cast.

bosses.overview:
Rashok gradually gains energy over time while outside the Elder's Conduit. At 100 energy, Rashok gains Ancient Fury and begins to pulse deadly Shadowflame damage.

Rashok's powerful Searing Slam creates a Lava Vortex which pours forth Lava Wave across the chamber.

children.name: Ancient Fury
children.text: Upon reaching 100 energy, Rashok becomes immune to the Elder's Conduit and overloads with pulsing flame, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players every 1 sec.

children.name: Searing Slam
children.text:
Rashok leaps toward a target player and slams the ground, creating a Lava Vortex at that location and inflicting Fire damage to all players. This damage is increased by 20% for each Lava Vortex in the chamber.

The slam's impact causes each Lava Vortex to pour forth.

A Lava Explosion erupts if Searing Slam hits a Lava Vortex.

 Hit by Searing Slam is destroyed.

children.name: Lava Vortex
children.text: Scalding vortex of lava that inflicts Fire damage every 2 sec to players within the area. Pours forth.

children.name: Lava Wave
children.text: A roiling wave of lava that inflicts Fire damage every sec to players within the area.

children.name: Lava Explosion
children.text: The Lava Vortex explodes if hit by Searing Slam, inflicting Fire damage to all players every 1 sec for 10 sec.

children.name: Doom Flames
children.text:
Rashok launches a barrage of shadowflame missiles across the chamber. Each missile inflicts Shadowflame damage to players near its impact location and an additional Shadowflame damage every 1 sec for 8 sec. This effect stacks.

Each missile that fails to hit a player erupts, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players.

children.name: Shadowlava Blast
children.text: Rashok unleashes a blast of shadowlava from Djaruun, inflicting Shadowflame damage to players in a frontal cone.

children.name: Tank Hit
children.text:
Rashok smashes the ground with the Shadowflame-infused Djaruun, inflicting Shadowflame damage split evenly among players near the impact location. All players are afflicted with.

Rashok gains up to energy, reduced by the number of players hit.

children.name: Wrath of Djaruun
children.text: Rashok unleashes a powerful combination of attacks with Djaruun, Pillar of the Elder Flame, at his current target.

children.name: Flaming Slash
children.text: Rashok slashes at his current target, inflicting Fire damage and increasing damage taken by Flaming Slash by 500% for 6 sec.

children.name: Earthen Crush
children.text: Rashok crushes his current target, inflicting Physical damage and increasing damage taken by Earthen Crush by 1000% for 6 sec.

children.name: Smoldering Rage
children.text:
Rashok roars in pain, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players as he breaks free from the Elder's Conduit.

Rashok's inner flame smolders as he breaks free from his prison, increasing the damage of Scorching Heatwave by 500%.

abilities.name: Elder's Conduit
abilities.text: Rashok's energy is being drained by the Elder's Conduit, causing a series of violent reactions in the chamber.

children.name: Shattered Conduit
children.text: After draining Rashok's energy times, the conduit shatters, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players nearby and becomes unusable.

children.name: Scorching Heatwave
children.text: Rashok periodically emits scorching heat as his energy is drained by the Elder's Conduit, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players and applying.

children.name: Shadowflame Fissures
children.text: Shadowflame energy erupts from Rashok's body as he is drained, inflicting Shadowflame damage to players near the impact location.

loot.name: Djaruun, Pillar of the Elder Flame

bosses.name: The Vigilant Steward, Zskarn
bosses.description: Long ago, Zskarn was tasked with testing the mettle of Neltharion's experiments. Only the most powerful would pass muster and keep their lives. The latest visitors to the Shadowed Crucible have attracted his unwavering attention--but his approval will be much harder to earn.

tips.text:
• Tactical Destruction unleashes multiple waves of Dragonfire from nearby dragon statues that are lethal to players caught within.
• Searing Claws inflicts increasing Fire damage to Zskarn's current target with each swing.
• Shrapnel Bomb inflicts massive Physical damage to all players if not dealt with in time.

• Tactical Destruction unleashes multiple waves of Dragonfire from nearby dragon statues that are lethal to players caught within.
• Blast Wave inflicts heavy Fire damage and knocks players back.
• Dragonfire Golems attempt to activate additional Dragonfire Traps.

• Tactical Destruction unleashes multiple waves of Dragonfire from nearby dragon statues that are lethal to players caught within.
• Blast Wave inflicts heavy Fire damage and knocks players back.
• Unstable Embers inflicts high damage to several players and causes them to damage nearby allies.

bosses.overview:
A master at manipulating the battlefield, Zskarn utilizes several deadly traps to test the capabilities of players. Zskarn creates Dragonfire Golems to aid him by activating nearby Dragonfire Traps to burn players in the vicinity.

Zskarn passively generates energy, and upon reaching 100 energy unleashes waves of Tactical Destruction from nearby Dragon Statues to decimate players.

abilities.name: Dragonfire Traps
abilities.text: Zskarn activates several nearby Dragonfire Traps that inflict Fire damage every 1 sec for 6 sec to all players near the trap. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Animate Golems
abilities.text: Zskarn animates several Dragonfire Golems to assist him by seeking out and activating inactive Dragonfire Traps.

children.name: Activate Dragonfire Trap
children.text:
Dragonfire Golems attempt to activate inactive Dragonfire Traps.

If no inactive Dragonfire Traps are detected, Dragonfire Golems assist Zskarn to eliminate players.

children.name: Salvage Parts
children.text: Rummage through a defeated Dragonfire Golem's parts, searching for a way to disable Dragonfire Traps.

children.name: Deactivate Dragonfire Trap
children.text: Deactivate the targeted active Dragonfire Trap.

abilities.name: Tactical Destruction
abilities.text: Upon reaching 100 energy, Zskarn unleashes a series of rapid eruptions from nearby dragon statues, inflicting Fire damage to all players caught within the blast.

abilities.name: Shrapnel Bomb
abilities.text:
After 30 seconds Shrapnel Bomb detonates inflicting Physical damage and an additional Physical damage every 1 sec for 10 sec to all players.

Triggering a Shrapnel Bomb early instead causes a localized detonation, inflicting Physical damage to the player that triggered the detonation and an additional Physical damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

abilities.name: Blast Wave
abilities.text: Zskarn unleashes a Blast Wave that knocks all players back, inflicting Fire damage on impact and an additional Fire damage every 0.5 sec for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Searing Claws
abilities.text: Zskarn's claws burn his current target, inflicting Fire damage every 2 sec for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

bosses.name: Magmorax
bosses.description: Raised from a pup by Neltharion, the only thing stronger than the loyalty of Magmorax is his appetite. The lava hydra guards the passage into the deepest chambers of the Shadowed Crucible, keeping his master's secrets safely hidden from prying eyes.

tips.text:
• Magmorax enters a Blazing Tantrum when within a Magma Puddle.
• Magma Puddle continues to grow over time.
• Incinerating Maws inflict heavy damage on his current target and increases the damage taken from subsequent attacks of Incinerating Maws.

• Molten Spittle creates a Magma Puddle at multiple players' locations.
• Magma Puddle continues to grow over time.
• Lava Ejection inflicts massive Fire damage to all players and leaves a Magma Puddle behind if it fails to hit at least one player.

• Searing Heat inflicts increasing damage to players standing within a Magma Puddle.
• Magma Puddle continues to grow over time.
• Magmorax inflicts increasing Fire damage with every Igniting Roar.

bosses.overview:
Magmorax launches Molten Spittle at players' locations that form Magma Puddles on impact. While Magmorax stands within a puddle, he gains Blazing Tantrum.

Over the course of the fight, Magmorax gains molten energy. Upon reaching 100 energy, Magmorax unleashes Catastrophic Eruption, destroying all in his domain.

abilities.name: Catastrophic Eruption
abilities.text:
Upon reaching 100 energy, Magmorax erupts into flame, increasing Physical damage done by 150%.

The explosion inflicts Fire damage to all players every 2 sec and increases Fire damage taken by 50%. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Molten Spittle
abilities.text:
Magmorax covers random players in fiery spit, inflicting Fire damage every 1.5 sec for 6 sec.

Upon removal the player explodes, inflicting Fire damage to players nearby and creating a Magma Puddle.

children.name: Magma Puddle
children.text:
A pool of magma that continues to grow during the course of the fight. Players standing in the pool ignite with, shrinking the pool over time.

In addition, Magmorax entering a pool causes him to erupt into a Blazing Tantrum.

children.name: Searing Heat
children.text: Magma Puddles set players within the area ablaze, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec.

children.name: Blazing Tantrum
children.text: While standing within a Magma Puddle, Magmorax gains energy and inflicts Fire damage to all players every 1 sec.

abilities.name: Igniting Roar
abilities.text:
Magmorax roars, inflicting Fire damage on impact and an additional Fire damage every 1 sec to all players. This effect stacks.

Additionally, Magmorax expels numerous Lava Ejections into the chamber.

children.name: Lava Ejection
children.text:
Magmorax expels globs of burning magma onto the ground. Each glob of magma inflicts Fire damage to players near the impact location.

Each glob that fails to hit a player explodes, inflicting Fire damage to all players and leaving a Magma Puddle behind.

abilities.name: Overpowering Stomp
abilities.text: Magmorax stomps the ground, inflicting Physical damage to all players and knocking them back.

abilities.name: Blazing Breath
abilities.text: Magmorax spews lava in a frontal cone, inflicting Fire damage to all players caught in his breath.

abilities.name: Incinerating Maws
abilities.text: Magmorax's heads bite at his current target. Each attack inflicts Physical damage and an additional Fire damage every 1.5 sec for 30 sec. This effect also increases the damage taken from subsequent Incinerating Maws taken by 50% for 30 sec. This effect stacks.

bosses.name: Echo of Neltharion
bosses.description: Tucked away in the depths of the Shadowed Crucible, Neltharion's sanctum was a place of refuge and research for the Earth-Warder. Some say that echoes of his powerful presence still linger here, contemplating the future of the black dragonflight and how to obtain the power to ensure its success.

tips.text:
• Calamitous Strike greatly increases players' damage taken.
• Sunder Shadow inflicts Physical damage and leaves players' corporeal bodies vulnerable to Shadow Strike.
• Calamitous Strike and Sunder Shadow knock players back with enough force to destroy Twisted Earth.

• Rushing Darkness knocks players backwards with enough force to destroy Twisted Earth.
• Neltharion protects himself with Shadow Barrier upon reaching 35% health if any Voices From Beyond remain.
• Twisted Aberrations periodically emerge from the portals created by Sunder Reality.

• Calamitous Strike greatly increases players' damage taken.
• Players hit by Sunder Shadow, are vulnerable just before Shadow Strike.
• Shatter inflicts damage to all players each time a wall is shattered.

bosses.overview:
The Echo of Neltharion periodically raises walls of Twisted Earth throughout the chamber. As the battle begins, Neltharion causes Echoing Fissures to erupt in the newly confined space.

Upon reaching 60% remaining health, Neltharion Surrenders to Corruption, summoning Voices From Beyond throughout the chamber.

Once all Voices From Beyond are slain, Neltharion begins to rip open portals to overwhelm players with Twisted Abberations and the might of his Ebon Destruction.

children.name: Twisted Earth
children.text: Neltharion raises walls of earth from the chamber's floor, causing Volcanic Blast where they emerge.

children.name: Volcanic Blast
children.text: The erupting segment of Twisted Earth inflicts Volcanic damage to players in yards, and knocks them away.

children.name: Volcanic Heart
children.text:
Neltharion infuses players with volcanic energy that explodes after 7 sec, inflicting Volcanic damage to players nearby, and an additional Volcanic damage every 1.5 sec for 15 sec.

This effect stacks.

children.name: Echoing Fissure
children.text:
Neltharion shatters the ground beneath him, inflicting Volcanic damage players near the impact, and an additional Volcanic damage to all other players. The effect echoes at each previous location when Echoing Fissure is cast.

Each cast causes Collapsed Earth and spreads Seeping Lava.

children.name: Collapsed Earth
children.text: Rubble falls from the ceiling, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby and stunning them for 1 sec.

children.name: Seeping Lava
children.text: Lava seeps out from each Echoing Fissure, inflicting Volcanic damage every 1 sec. To players within the area.

children.name: Rushing Darkness
children.text:
Neltharion blasts several players for Shadow damage and knocks them away, inflicting an additional Shadow damage to any players between Neltharion and his targets and silencing them for 3 sec.

Colliding with a segment of Twisted Earth causes it to Shatter.

children.name: Shatter
children.text:
Impacting a segment of shatters it, inflicting Physical damage to the impacting player. Fragments burst from the impact, inflicting Physical damage to all players every 1 sec. For 6 sec. This effect stacks.

Pelts the chamber with Shattered Rock.

children.name: Shattered Rock
children.text: Rock fragments inflict Nature damage to players standing at the impact location.

children.name: Calamitous Strike
children.text:
Neltharion strikes his current target with his massive blade, inflicting Physical damage and knocking them away. Increases Physical damage taken by 200% for 37 sec.

Colliding with a segment of Twisted Earth causes it to Shatter.

children.name: Shatter
children.text:
Impacting a segment of shatters it, inflicting Physical damage to the impacting player. Fragments burst from the impact, inflicting Physical damage to all players every 1 sec. For 6 sec. This effect stacks.

Pelts the chamber with Shattered Rock.

children.name: Shattered Rock
children.text: Rock fragments inflict Nature damage to players standing at the impact location.

children.name: Raze the Earth
children.text: Neltharion causes any remaining Twisted Earth to erupt with a Volcanic Blast and Collapsed Earth to fall.

children.name: Volcanic Blast
children.text: The erupting segment of Twisted Earth inflicts Volcanic damage to players in yards, and knocks them away.

children.name: Collapsed Earth
children.text: Rubble falls from the ceiling, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby and stunning them for 1 sec.

children.name: Surrender to Corruption
children.text:
Neltharion surrenders to darkness, inflicting Shadow damage to all players every 1 sec. And a final burst of Shadow damage as the channel ends.

Neltharion afflicts several players with.

children.name: Empower Shadows
children.text: The Voice from Beyond empowers Neltharion with dark power, allowing him to cast Shadow Barrier upon reaching 35% remaining health.

children.name: Shadow Barrier
children.text: Neltharion shields himself in darkness, reducing damage taken by 99%.

children.name: Hidden in Void
children.text: The Voice From Beyond shrouds itself in shadow, absorbing damage. When the shield breaks, the Voice From Beyond begins casting Ruptured Veil.

children.name: Ruptured Veil
children.text: The Voice From Beyond ruptures the veil of reality, inflicting Shadow damage to all players every 4 sec. Until slain.

children.name: Volcanic Heart
children.text:
Neltharion infuses players with volcanic energy that explodes after 7 sec, inflicting Volcanic damage to players nearby, and an additional Volcanic damage every 1.5 sec for 15 sec.

This effect stacks.

children.name: Twisted Earth
children.text: Neltharion raises walls of earth from the chamber's floor, causing Volcanic Blast where they emerge.

children.name: Volcanic Blast
children.text: The erupting segment of Twisted Earth inflicts Volcanic damage to players in yards, and knocks them away.

children.name: Umbral Annihilation
children.text: Neltharion draws in dark power to annihilate players, inflicting Shadow damage to all players. Each cast increases damage done by Umbral Annihilation by 100%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Crumbling Facade
children.text: Rubble periodically falls from the damaged ceiling, inflicting Volcanic damage to players nearby.

children.name: Rushing Darkness
children.text:
Neltharion blasts several players for Shadow damage and knocks them away, inflicting an additional Shadow damage to any players between Neltharion and his targets and silencing them for 3 sec.

Colliding with a segment of Twisted Earth causes it to Shatter.

children.name: Shatter
children.text:
Impacting a segment of shatters it, inflicting Physical damage to the impacting player. Fragments burst from the impact, inflicting Physical damage to all players every 1 sec. For 6 sec. This effect stacks.

Pelts the chamber with Shattered Rock.

children.name: Shattered Rock
children.text: Rock fragments inflict Nature damage to players standing at the impact location.

children.name: Sunder Shadow
children.text:
Neltharion sunders his current target's shadow from their body, inflicting Physical damage. Neltharion immediately attacks the target's body with Shadow Strike.

While in control of their shadow, the target is incorporeal and can move through Twisted Earth.

children.name: Shadow Strike
children.text:
Neltharion strikes the player's body while they are incorporeal, inflicting Physical damage to the body and hurtling it towards the player. The player rejoins their body and receives its missing health as Shadow damage. Increases damage taken from Sunder Shadow by 300% for 40 sec.

The player's body colliding with a segment of Twisted Earth causes it to Shatter.

children.name: Shatter
children.text:
Impacting a segment of shatters it, inflicting Physical damage to the impacting player. Fragments burst from the impact, inflicting Physical damage to all players every 1 sec. For 6 sec. This effect stacks.

Pelts the chamber with Shattered Rock.

children.name: Shattered Rock
children.text: Rock fragments inflict Nature damage to players standing at the impact location.

children.name: Sunder Reality
children.text:
Neltharion rips nearby Twisted Earth into portals to the void realm, inflicting Shadow damage to players in yards of the impact. The portal continuously allows Twisted Aberrations into reality.

Players standing in portals gain Sundered Reality.

children.name: Twisted Aberration
children.text: Twisted Aberrations hunger for flesh and chaos, endlessly hunting down life to shred and devour with their razor sharp claws and teeth.

children.name: Sundered Reality
children.text: Portals distort reality for nearby players, inflicting Shadow damage every 1.5 sec. To players within the area, reducing damage taken from Ebon Destruction by 99%.

children.name: Ebon Destruction
children.text:
Neltharion draws upon his might and blasts all players for Volcanic damage, and an additional Fire damage every 1.5 sec for 15 sec.

This power dispels any Sundered Reality near players.

children.name: Rushing Darkness
children.text:
Neltharion blasts several players for Shadow damage and knocks them away, inflicting an additional Shadow damage to any players between Neltharion and his targets and silencing them for 3 sec.

Colliding with a segment of Twisted Earth causes it to Shatter.

children.name: Shatter
children.text:
Impacting a segment of shatters it, inflicting Physical damage to the impacting player. Fragments burst from the impact, inflicting Physical damage to all players every 1 sec. For 6 sec. This effect stacks.

Pelts the chamber with Shattered Rock.

children.name: Shattered Rock
children.text: Rock fragments inflict Nature damage to players standing at the impact location.

children.name: Calamitous Strike
children.text:
Neltharion strikes his current target with his massive blade, inflicting Physical damage and knocking them away. Increases Physical damage taken by 200% for 37 sec.

Colliding with a segment of Twisted Earth causes it to Shatter.

children.name: Shatter
children.text:
Impacting a segment of shatters it, inflicting Physical damage to the impacting player. Fragments burst from the impact, inflicting Physical damage to all players every 1 sec. For 6 sec. This effect stacks.

Pelts the chamber with Shattered Rock.

children.text: Rock fragments inflict Nature damage to players standing at the impact location.

bosses.name: Scalecommander Sarkareth
bosses.description: As leader of the Sundered Flame, Scalecommander Sarkareth broke away from the rest of the dracthyr to forge a new future. He has since led his forces to Aberrus, intent on claiming the legacy he believes rightfully belongs to his kind and willing to do anything to obtain it.

tips.text:
•Blazing Blast inflicts damage to the raid based on the total Fire damage taken from Burning Claws over its duration.
•When Sarkareth uses Glittering Surge, it applies Dazzled to all players who still have Oppressing Howl.
•Abyssal Breath creates temporal images of Sarkareth, which then gain power over time from Ebon Might.
•Scouring Eternity inflicts lethal damage to players not safely hidden behind an Astral Formation.

•When Sarkareth uses Glittering Surge, it applies Dazzled to all players who still have Oppressing Howl.
•Void Bomb erupts for high raid damage unless detonated within the Emptiness Between Stars.
•Abyssal Breath creates temporal images of Sarkareth, which then gain power over time from Ebon Might.
•Scouring Eternity inflicts lethal damage to players not safely hidden behind an Astral Formation.

•When Sarkareth uses Glittering Surge, it applies Dazzled to all players who still have Oppressing Howl.
•Void Bomb erupts for high raid damage unless detonated within the Emptiness Between Stars.
•Scouring Eternity inflicts lethal damage to players not safely hidden behind an Astral Formation.

bosses.overview:
Scalecommander Sarkareth begins the fight with Oppressing Howl and attempts to obliterate players with Glittering Surge.

When weakened, he draws upon the power of the Void to enhance his draconic powers, using Abyssal Breath and Ebon Might to summon and strengthen images of himself.

When severely wounded, Sarkareth destroys the room to fully draw in powers of the Void and convert his abilities to their most powerful forms.

abilities.name: Oblivion
abilities.text: Being struck with most Void abilities causes Oblivion, inflicting Shadow damage every sec for 25 sec. Upon reaching applications, the affected player is lost in the Emptiness Between Stars.

children.name: Lost in Space
children.text: The target is stranded alone in the vast infinite of space, reducing damage done by 99%. After 20 sec, if the target has not recovered fragments of their mind, they are lost forever and perish.

children.name: Astral Flare
children.text: While stranded within the Emptiness Between Stars, players can absorb Astral Flares to gain 5% increased Haste and 10% increased movement speed for 23 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Stage One: The Legacy of the Dracthyr
abilities.text: Scalecommander Sarkareth uses the full might of his dracthyr abilities to deter his foes.

children.name: Oppressing Howl
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, this grants 2 applications of Oppressing Howl. Searing Breath and Mass Disintegrate can each remove one application.

children.name: Echoing Howl
children.text: When Oppressing Howl is removed from a player, echoing darkness erupts forth and inflicts Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Glittering Surge
children.text:
Sarkareth releases pure magic, inflicting Arcane damage to all players every 1 sec for 8 sec.

If Glittering Surge strikes a player with Oppressing Howl, it removes that effect and applies Dazzled.

children.name: Dazzled
children.text: The player's senses are dazzled, stunning them and inflicting Arcane damage every 1 sec for 20 sec.

children.name: Scorching Bomb
children.text: Sarkareth places several Scorching Bombs on nearby players. Each inflicts Fire damage to players nearby every 1 sec. After 12 sec, the bombs explode with a Scorching Detonation.

children.name: Scorching Detonation
children.text: A fiery blast consumes the bomb, inflicting Fire damage to all players instantly with an additional Fire damage every 1 sec for 5 sec.

children.name: Burning Ground
children.text: When a Scorching Bomb erupts, it creates a patch of Burning Ground. This ground inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec to players within.

children.name: Mass Disintegrate
children.text:
Sarkareth forms a shimmering image that marks players. After 6 sec, energy erupts from the image in a line towards its targets inflicting Arcane damage.

If Mass Disintegrate strikes a target with Oppressing Howl, it removes that effect and applies Disintegrated.

children.name: Disintegrated
children.text: The target's mind and body are heavily fractured, reducing movement speed by 25% and inflicting Arcane damage every 5 sec.

children.name: Searing Breath
children.text:
Sarkareth breathes flames in a frontal cone, inflicting Fire damage instantly with an additional Fire damage every 1 sec for 12 sec. This attack repeats times and stacks.

If Searing Breath strikes a target with Oppressing Howl, it removes that effect and applies Seared.

children.name: Seared
children.text: Searing wounds burn the player, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec.

children.name: Burning Claws
children.text:
Sarkareth slashes his current target, inflicting Physical damage with an additional Fire damage every 1 sec for 27 sec. This effect stacks.

Upon expiration, releases a Blazing Blast.

children.name: Blazing Blast
children.text: The player erupts with a burning nova, inflicting 15% of the total Fire damage taken from Burning Claws to all players as Fire damage.

abilities.name: Stage Two: A Touch of the Forbidden
abilities.text: Sarkareth draws in power from the Void to enhance his latent abilities.

children.name: Void Bomb
children.text: Sarkareth places Void Bombs on nearby players. Each inflicts Shadow damage to players nearby every 1 sec. After 20 sec, the bombs explode with a.

children.name: Void Surge
children.text: The bomb erupts with void energy, inflicting Shadow damage to all players every 1 sec for 4 sec.

children.name: Void Fracture
children.text: A player stepping into the Void Bomb causes the void energy to dissipate into the player. Upon removal, the void energy erupts with a Void Surge unless that player is within the Emptiness Between Stars.

children.name: Abyssal Breath
children.text: Sarkareth takes in a deep breath and flies to a location, inflicting Shadow damage in a line and knocking players back.

children.name: Null Glimmer
children.text: Upon casting Abyssal Breath, Sarkareth leaves behind images of himself.

children.name: Null Blast
children.text: The image releases a mighty scream, inflicting Arcane damage to all players and interrupting spellcasting.

children.name: Desolate Blossom
children.text: Sarkareth grows bulbs of void energy at player locations which pulse waves to all players and creatures within them every 0.5 sec, absorbing up to healing for 1 min.

children.name: Ebon Might
children.text: Upon casting any spell, Sarkareth empowers his allies with the might of the Black dragons. This effect increases their damage done and movement speed by 20%. Upon reaching applications, the target becomes immune to crowd controlling and interrupting effects.

children.name: Void Claws
children.text:
Sarkareth slashes his current target, inflicting Physical damage with an additional Shadow damage every 2 sec and reducing healing received by 25% for 18 sec. This effect stacks.

Upon expiration, releases a Void Blast.

children.name: Void Blast
children.text: The player erupts with a void nova, inflicting 25% of the total Shadow damage taken from Void Claws to players nearby as Shadow damage.

abilities.name: Stage Three: The Seas of Infinity
abilities.text: Eschewing his draconic abilities, Sarkareth fully embraces the Void in a final bid for power.

children.name: Void Bomb
children.text: Sarkareth places Void Bombs on nearby players. Each inflicts Shadow damage to players nearby every 1 sec. After 20 sec, the bombs explode with a.

children.name: Void Surge
children.text: The bomb erupts with void energy, inflicting Shadow damage to all players every 1 sec for 4 sec.

children.name: Void Fracture
children.text: A player stepping into the Void Bomb causes the void energy to dissipate into the player. Upon removal, the void energy erupts with a Void Surge unless that player is within the Emptiness Between Stars.

children.name: Cosmic Ascension
children.text: Sarkareth flies up through a void portal before crashing through the floor and inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby and knocking back players struck.

children.name: Astral Formations
children.text: Sarkareth pulls several asteroids out of space to crash into the ground. These formations inflict Shadow damage to nearby players every 2 sec.

children.name: Null Glimmer
children.text: Upon casting Cosmic Ascension, Sarkareth leaves behind images of himself.

children.name: Null Blast
children.text: The image releases a mighty scream, inflicting Arcane damage to all players and interrupting spellcasting.

children.name: Void Might
children.text: After ascending to the stars, Sarkareth empowers himself with Cosmic energy, increasing his damage done by 10%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Hurtling Barrage
children.text: Sarkareth tears open portals to infinity, conjuring void images of himself that rush out in a line through a player. These images inflict Shadow damage to targets struck.

children.name: Scouring Supernova
children.text: Sarkareth causes a massive supernova to grow and erupt, inflicting Shadow damage and knocking back all players not behind an Astral Formation.

children.name: Astral Eruption
children.text: Cosmic energy destabilizes Astral Formations, causing them to explode and inflict Shadow damage to players nearby and knock back players nearby.

children.name: Black Hole
children.text:
Sarkareth focuses the crushing weight of space upon a player. After 8 sec, a black hole is formed inflicting Shadow damage, split evenly among players struck.

The black hole also pulls in and absorbs nearby Astral Formations before finally erupting and inflicting Shadow damage to all players nearby.

children.name: Motes of Oblivion
children.text: Oblivion motes rain from above, inflicting Shadow damage in addition to applications of Oblivion to players near the impact.

children.name: Void Claws
children.text:
Sarkareth slashes his current target and a frontal cone, inflicting Physical damage with an additional Shadow damage every 2 sec and reducing healing received by 25% for 21 sec. This effect stacks.

Upon expiration, releases a.

children.name: Void Blast
children.text: A void nova erupts from the target, inflicting 25% of the total Shadow damage taken from Void Slash to all players as Shadow damage.
