If either lava glob fails to hit $?diff14|diff15|diff16 [at least players][]$?diff17 [a player][], it inflicts Fire damage to all players and Hellboil consumes the entire chamber.

children.name: Hellboil
children.text: Crawling magma incinerates the ground, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec to players within the effect.

abilities.name: Serpent's Fury
abilities.text: Volcoross spews surging fire from his jaws, inflicting Fire damage to all players every 0.5 sec for 5 sec. Several players combust with Coiling Flames.

children.name: Coiling Flames
children.text:
Snakelike flames swirl around the player, inflicting Fire damage to them and radiating Twisting Singe to nearby players every sec for 10 sec. The flames tighten over time, increasing their damage as they reduce in area.$?diff14|diff17|diff15 [

Upon expiration, the flames slither to another player.][]

children.name: Twisting Singe
children.text: The spiraling embers radiate fire outward, inflicting Fire damage to nearby allies. This damage increases as the Coiling Flames tighten.

abilities.name: Scorchtail Crash
abilities.text: On Heroic and Mythic difficulty, Tidal Blazes seep out from the impact of Scorchtail Crash.

children.name: Tidal Blaze
children.text: A flowing rush of lava that inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec to players within the effect.

abilities.name: Volcanic Disgorge
abilities.text: Volcoross retches chunks of searing bile at players, inflicting Fire damage near each impact and creating Hellboil.

children.name: Hellboil
children.text: Crawling magma incinerates the ground, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec to players within the effect.

abilities.name: Molten Venom
abilities.text: Volcoross's melee attacks inject sizzling venom into his current target, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec and increasing damage taken from Cataclysm Jaws by 50% for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Cataclysm Jaws
abilities.text: Volcoross's calamitous jaws ravage his current target, inflicting Physical damage and Fire damage.

abilities.name: Burning Vertebrae
abilities.text: Volcoross's igneous skeleton emanates with blistering heat, inflicting Fire damage to all players every 2 sec.

abilities.name: Serpent's Wrath
abilities.text: Volcoross unleashes the full magnifying force of the Firelands, inflicting Fire damage to all players and increasing his damage done by 10% every 0.5 sec.

abilities.name: Combusting Rage
abilities.text: If no players are within reach, Volcoross continually vents waves of flames that inflict Fire damage to all players every 2 sec.

bosses.name: Council of Dreams
bosses.description: The Council of Dreams are steadfast in their duties as defenders. Pip employs lethal trickery to confound his victims, while Urctos relies on brute strength to demolish his enemies. Aerwynn uses her wisdom and cunning to dominate the field, and guide her fellow council members.

tips.text:
•Urctos' Agonizing Claws inflicts Physical damage in a frontal cone, leaving the target vulnerable to Agonizing Claws.
•Urctos' Barreling Charge inflicts reduced damage as more players bear the load and interrupts Aerwynn's Constricting Thicket.
•Pip's Song of the Dragon applies Captivating Finale if not removed.

•Upon removal, Polymorph Bomb afflicts nearby players, but also affects Urctos during Blind Rage.
•Urctos' Barreling Charge inflicts reduced damage as more players bear the load and interrupts Aerwynn's Constricting Thicket.
•Pip's Song of the Dragon applies Captivating Finale if not removed.

•Upon removal, Polymorph Bomb afflicts nearby players, but also affects Urctos during Blind Rage.
•Pip's Song of the Dragon applies Captivating Finale if not removed.
•Urctos' Agonizing Claws inflicts high Physical damage in a frontal cone.

bosses.overview:
Players battle against the Council of Dreams: the fearsome werebear Urctos, the naturalist dryad Aerwynn and the trickster faerie dragon Pip.

At 100 energy each council member unleashes their strongest attacks, casting Blind Rage, Constricting Thicket or Song of the Dragon respectively.

Upon reaching 1 health, that council member taps into the Dream, casting Rebirth, but fail if their allies suffer the same fate.

abilities.name: Rebirth
abilities.text: Upon reaching 1 health, council members tap into the dream casting Rebirth, restoring 30% health while their allies remain conscious.

children.name: Blind Rage
children.text:
At 100 energy, Urctos becomes entranced in a wild assault for 20 sec, inflicting Physical damage to all players every 2 sec. Each slam increases his damage done by 15% for the duration of the assault.

This trance leaves Urctos susceptible to Polymorph Bomb.

children.name: Ursine Rage
children.text: If Blind Rage is not interrupted, Urctos gains 500% increased damage done for the duration of the encounter.

children.name: Barreling Charge
children.text: On Heroic difficulty, being struck by Barreling Charge leaves players vulnerable.

children.name: Thundering Impact
children.text: Urctos bellows an earth-shaking roar, inflicting Physical damage to all players reduced by the number of players struck by Barreling Charge.

children.name: Agonizing Claws
children.text: On Heroic difficulty, Agonizing Claws strikes in a frontal cone.

children.name: Constricting Thicket
children.text:
At 100 energy, Aerwynn conjures vines for 20 sec, lashing out at all players inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec and decreasing their movement speed by 10%. This effect stacks and increases in stacks every 3 sec.

This channel leaves Aerwynn susceptible to Barreling Charge.

children.name: Relentless Barrage
children.text: If Constricting Thicket is not interrupted, Aerwynn unleashes a furious bombardment for 3 sec, launching javelins at all players every 1 sec poisoning targets for Nature damage every 1.5 sec for 30 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Noxious Blossom
children.text: Aerwynn showers the ground with blossoms that emit poisonous fumes, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 3 sec until destroyed.

children.name: Corrosive Pollen
children.text: Noxious Blossoms additionally inflict Nature damage every 0.5 sec to players standing within.

children.name: Poisonous Javelin
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, the player explodes with Unstable Venom upon removal.

children.name: Song of the Dragon
children.text: At 100 energy, Pip sings a captivating song causing all players to absorb Corrosive Pollen damage.

children.name: Captivating Finale
children.text: When Song of the Dragon concludes, all players still affected by Song of the Dragon begin to dance, becoming stunned and suffering Nature damage every 1 sec for 15 sec.

children.name: Polymorph Bomb
children.text: On Heroic difficulty, Polymorph Bomb duplicates to players nearby upon removal.

children.name: Hungry
children.text:
You've got a ducky appetite and are unable to Preen. Consuming a Noxious Blossom removes one application.

Upon removal, applies Satiated.

children.name: Satiated
children.text: You've eaten your fill and cannot consume any more Noxious Blossoms.

children.name: Preen
children.text:
Requires Satiated.

Cleanse yourself removing the effects of Polymorph Bomb.

children.name: Quack!
children.text: Leap forward as a duck and gain a rush of adrenaline increasing movement speed by 100% for 6 sec. QUACK!

children.name: Slippery
children.text: As a duck harmful poisons slide right off your feathers reducing Nature damage taken by 99%.

children.name: Emerald Winds
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Pip channels Whimsical Gusts around the arena.

bosses.name: Larodar, Keeper of the Flame
bosses.description: Once a faithful protector of the grove, Larodar succumbed to the power of flame. Now the twisted guardian is bent on reducing the Dream--and any who stand in his way--to ash.

tips.text:
•Furious Charge applies Nature's Fury and inflicts less damage the further his target is.
•Smoldering Suffocation prevents all healing received but drains health from nearby allies.
•Renewed Bramble Barriers drastically reduce damage taken from Raging Inferno.

•Fiery Treants transform into Charred Treants and Scorching Brambles transform into Charred Brambles when killed.
•Renewed Bramble Barriers drastically reduce damage taken from Raging Inferno.
•Dream Blossom douses Burning Ground and Scorching Roots.

•Charred Treants transform into Renewed Treants and Charred Brambles transform into Renewed Bramble Barriers when healed to full.
•Renewed Bramble Barriers drastically reduce damage taken from Raging Inferno.
•Dream Blossom douses Burning Ground and Scorching Roots.
•Flash Fire-afflicted players become Encased in Ash if the absorb expires.

bosses.overview:
Larodar summons Fiery Treants and Scorching Roots to spread Burning Ground. Upon reaching 100 energy, Larodar envelops the arena in flame with Raging Inferno.

After 3 casts of Raging Inferno, Larodar channels Consuming Flame and transforms into the Avatar of Ash. Falling Embers fall from above as Larodar attempts to cleanse his enemies with Flash Fire.

abilities.name: Stage One: The Cycle of Flame

children.name: Seed of Life
children.text: The Seed of Life lays dormant while it has zero energy. Renewed Treants' channel Nature's Gift causing the seed to blossom.

children.name: Dream Blossom
children.text:
On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, the Seed of Life causes players who form a bond to gain Dream Fatigue.

On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, the Seed of Life causes players who form a bond to gain Dream Fatigue.

children.name: Dream Fatigue
children.text: Forming a bond with the Seed of Life causes fatigue, preventing the player from forming another bond for.

children.name: Fiery Force of Nature
children.text: Larodar summons Fiery Treants.

children.name: Fiery Treant
children.text:
Fiery Treants seek to spread flame throughout the temple and leave behind Burning Ground.

When killed, they transform into a Charred Treant.

children.name: Blistering Splinters
children.text: Fiery Treant's melee strikes break splinters off in their target, inflicting Fire damage every sec for. This effect stacks.

children.name: Fiery Flourish
children.text: Fiery Treants expel flames, inflicting Fire damage to enemies nearby.

children.name: Explosive Bark
children.text: Larodar's minions die in an explosion of fiery bark, each inflicting Fire damage to enemies nearby.

children.name: Charred Treant
children.text:
Charred Treants are inert and can be healed.

When they reach full health, they transform into a Renewed Treant.

children.name: Renewed Treant
children.text: Friendly Renewed Treants channel Nature's Gift, sacrificing their own life to empower the Seed of Life.

children.name: Nature's Gift
children.text: Renewed Treant's channel their own life force into the Seed of Life, gifting it energy but reducing their own maximum health by 3% every 1 sec.

children.name: Scorching Roots
children.text: Larodar summons Scorching Roots.

children.name: Scorching Roots
children.text:
Scorching Roots fixate on random players, pursuing them relentlessly and speed over time.

When killed, they transform into Charred Brambles.

On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, Scorched Roots remain untargetable until doused with Dream Blossom.

On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, Scorched Roots remain untargetable until doused with Dream Blossom.

children.name: Scorching Bramblethorn
children.text: Scorching Roots strangle enemies they come in contact with fiery brambles, inflicting Fire damage every 2 sec and rooting them in place for.

children.name: Charred Brambles
children.text:
Charred Brambles are inert and can be healed.

When they reach full health, they transform into a Renewed Bramble Barrier.

children.name: Renewed Bramble Barrier
children.text:
Renewed Bramble Barriers provide protection against Raging Inferno.

When destroyed, they erupt in Explosive Bark.

children.name: Nature's Bulwark
children.text: Reduces damage taken from Raging Inferno by 90%.

children.name: Explosive Bark
children.text: Larodar's minions die in an explosion of fiery bark, each inflicting Fire damage to enemies nearby.

children.name: Furious Charge
children.text:
On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, Larodar release a Furious Outburst when reaching his target.

On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, Larodar release a Furious Outburst when reaching his target.

children.name: Nature's Fury
children.text: Larodar's fury takes a heavy toll on his target, increasing Physical damage taken by 100% for. This effect begins at stacks and decreases in stacks over time.

children.name: Furious Outburst
children.text: Larodar releases a fiery outburst when reaching his target, inflicting Fire damage to all players. This damage decreases based on distance from Larodar.

children.name: Blazing Thorns
children.text:
Larodar bursts a spiral of eruptions inflicting Fire to players near each impact, knocking them back.

Upon reaching their destination the spiral returns to Larodar.

children.name: Blazing Coalescence
children.text:
The Blazing Thorns coalesce into flame orbs which move towards Larodar. Upon contact an orb inflicts Fire damage, increasing critical strike chance by 20% and inflicting Fire damage every 0.5 sec for.

Orbs that reach Larodar increase Fire damage done by 20% for. This effect stacks.

children.name: Raging Inferno
children.text:
Upon reaching 100 energy Larodar releases his unbridled rage as waves of flames, inflicting Fire damage to enemies every 2 sec for. Standing behind a reduces this damage by 90%.

Larodar gains a stack of Combusting Presence after Raging Inferno ends.

children.name: Combusting Presence
children.text:
Larodar's very presence combusts the air around him, inflicting Fire damage every 1.5 sec to all enemies and causes him to leave behind Burning Ground.

Larodar gains a stack after channeling Raging Inferno.

children.name: Burning Ground
children.text:
The temple blazes with patches of flame, inflicting Fire damage every 1.5 sec.

Larodar's Combusting Presence, his Fiery Treats and Scorching Roots, and these flame patches spread Burning Ground further.

Dream Blossoms douse the flames extinguishing these patches.

children.name: Consuming Flame
children.text:
After casts of Raging Inferno Larodar draws upon the surrounding flames for radiating Fire damage to all players every 0.5 sec, pulling players towards him. Additionally the Keeper inflicts Fire damage to players within yards.

These flames combust Larodar transforming him into the Avatar of Ash.

children.name: Falling Embers
children.text:
Larodar releases a fistful of embers that fall from the sky, inflicting Fire damage to players near the impact locations.

Embers that fail to hit a player inflict Fire damage to all players, applying a stack of Searing Ash.

children.name: Flash Fire
children.text:
Larodar attempts to purge several players in a flash of fire, causing them to absorb healing for. Each player erupts after, inflicting Fire damage to players nearby.

If the absorb is not healed before expiring, Flash Fire also applies to players hit.

children.name: Encased in Ash
children.text: Players encased in ash are stunned for.

children.name: Fire Whirl
children.text: Larodar focuses his rage into violent tornados that orbit the arena, inflicting Fire damage every 0.5 sec to players standing within, knocking them back.

children.name: Smoldering Backdraft
children.text: Larodar's ashen husk unleashes a brutal backdraft of flames inflicting Fire damage in a frontal cone, applying Smoldering Suffocation.

children.name: Smoldering Suffocation
children.text:
Suffocates a player reducing healing received by 100% and inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec for.

Additionally, this effect leeches health from allies within yards each 1 sec.

children.name: Ashen Call
children.text: Larodar calls upon the ashes of his fallen Treants.

children.name: Ashen Treant
children.text:
Ashen Treants erupt with Explosive Bark and Burning Ground when killed.

On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, Ashen Treants leave behind a trail of Burning Ground.On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, Ashen Treants create a trail of Burning Ground.

children.name: Searing Ash
children.text: Larodar radiates Searing Ash every 12 sec, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Burning Ground
children.text:
The temple blazes with patches of flame, inflicting Fire damage every 1.5 sec.

Larodar's Combusting Presence, his Fiery Treats and Scorching Roots, and these flame patches spread Burning Ground further.

Dream Blossoms douse the flames extinguishing these patches.

bosses.name: Nymue, Weaver of the Cycle
bosses.description: Nymue was placed in this verdant realm when Eonar and Freya shaped the Dream. In Wellspring Temple, they enforce and protect the ordering of the Emerald Dream, weaving its wilderness into complex patterns.

tips.text:
• Threaded Blast inflicts substantial Physical and Nature damage.
• Verdant Rend inflicts substantial Nature damage to all players when a Cycle Warden crosses Verdant Matrix.
• Weaver's Burden detonates upon removal inflicting damage to nearby players.

• Standing on Surging Growth greatly reduces its duration.
• Cycle Wardens protect Nymue with Life Ward and cast Lumbering Slam.
• Impending Loom stuns players on contact and inflicts substantial damage.

• Impending Loom stuns players on contact and inflicts substantial damage.
• Inflorescence suppresses the application of Verdant Matrix.
• Nymue radiates intense raid-wide damage during Unravel and Continuum.

bosses.overview:
Nymue's Verdant Matrix draws upon the dream to weave new life into existence, punishing those who cross its emerald threads. Each cast of Continuum alters Nymue's Verdant Matrix.

Upon reaching 100% energy Nymue casts Full Bloom and summons Cycle Wardens who protect Nymue with Life Ward.

children.name: Verdant Matrix
children.text: Nymue's Verdant Matrix draws upon the dream to weave emerald threads across the battlefield. Crossing these threads inflicts Nature damage every 0.5 sec for 2 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Continuum
children.text: Nymue alters the over 10 sec inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec.

children.name: Impending Loom
children.text:
Nymue conjures a magical loom that weaves threads of energy into complex patterns.

These threads slowly move outward from Nymue, stunning players on contact and inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec for 3 sec.

children.name: Surging Growth
children.text:
Nymue causes Surging Growths to burst from the ground, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 2 sec for 1 min.

Players who stand on a Growth stifle it, greatly reducing its duration.

children.name: Viridian Rain
children.text: Nymue conjures verdant shards that fall from above several players, inflicting Nature damage every 1.5 sec for 6 sec.

children.name: Weaver's Burden
children.text: In Heroic difficulty, Weaver's Burden applies Woven Resonance and spreads to additional players. Upon expiration, a Barrier Blossom springs to life at the target's location.

children.name: Inflorescence
children.text: The ground springs to life beneath your feet as you walk, allowing players within to pass unharmed through Verdant Matrix and increasing their movement speed by 60%. Lasts 10 sec.

children.name: Woven Resonance
children.text: Increases Nature damage taken by 100% for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Barrier Blossom
children.text: Barrier Blossoms forcefully expel players who approach them, inflicting Nature damage and knocking them away.

children.name: Threaded Blast
children.text: Nymue blasts their primary target with a woven beam inflicting Physical damage and Nature damage.

children.name: Full Bloom
children.text: In Mythic difficulty, a Manifested Dream amalgamates from the surge in life energy.

children.name: Inflorescence
children.text: The ground springs to life beneath your feet as you walk, allowing players within to pass unharmed through Verdant Matrix and increasing their movement speed by 60%. Lasts 10 sec.

children.name: Unravel
children.text: Nymue channels their immense power to unmake all players, inflicting Nature damage every 3 sec, and increasing damage taken from Unravel by 10%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Life Ward
children.text: The Cycle Wardens' abundant life energy shields Nymue, reducing damage taken by 99%.

children.name: Lumbering Slam
children.text: In Heroic difficulty, Lumbering Slam causes Surging Growths to sprout.

children.name: Surging Growth
children.text:
Nymue causes Surging Growths to burst from the ground, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 2 sec for 1 min.

Players who stand on a Growth stifle it, greatly reducing its duration.

children.name: Radial Flourish
children.text: Life energy erupts from the Cycle Warden in an intricate pattern, inflicting Nature damage to players caught in its path.

children.name: Verdant Rend
children.text: When crossing threads of the Verdant Matrix, the Cycle Warden disperses life energy inflicting Nature damage to all players. This effect increases in magnitude by 100% with every crossing.

loot.name: Dreambinder, Loom of the Great Cycle

bosses.name: Smolderon
bosses.description: As the new Firelord, Smolderon has unleashed the power of the Firelands to expand his domain and incinerate the Emerald Dream.

tips.text:
•Brand of Damnation afflicts the primary target with Searing Aftermath which explodes for less damage the further away the target is.
•Brand of Damnation marks all players struck with Cauterizing Wound which absorbs a large amount of healing.
•Devour Essence draws Living Flames out of players afflicted with Emberscar's Mark.

•Brand of Damnation marks all players struck with Cauterizing Wound which absorbs a large amount of healing.
•Devour Essence draws Living Flames out of players afflicted with Emberscar's Mark.
•Overheated inflicts damage to all players nearby the target.

•Blazing Soul causes Blistering Heat to inflict heavy damage to all players.
•Brand of Damnation marks all players struck with Cauterizing Wound which absorbs a large amount of healing.
•Devour Essence draws Living Flames out of players afflicted with Emberscar's Mark.

bosses.overview:
Smolderon showcases his worth as a Firelord by utilizing his weapon Emberscar to great effect. He marks his enemies with Brand of Damnation while also igniting them with Overheated.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Smolderon slams Emberscar into the ground. He then feasts on players' essence while overwhelming them with World In Flames.

children.name: Brand of Damnation
children.text: In Heroic difficulty, the primary target of Brand of Damnation is afflicted with Searing Aftermath.

children.name: Cauterizing Wound
children.text:
Emberscar's brand cauterizes the player, causing them to absorb healing.

Removing the absorb creates a Cauterized Explosion at the player's location sec later.

children.name: Cauterized Explosion
children.text: A fiery explosion inflicts Fire damage to all players nearby.

children.name: Searing Aftermath
children.text: The searing heat causes the primary target of the brand to explode after 6 sec, inflicting Fire damage to all players. Players farther from the target receive less damage.

children.name: Emberscar's Mark
children.text:
Emberscar brands the player, increasing damage taken from Brand of Damnation by 500%.

Being struck by Devour Essence removes the effect.

children.name: Brand of Damnation
children.text:
Smolderon decimates his primary target, inflicting Physical damage and afflicting them with Searing Aftermath. An additional Fire damage is split evenly among all players near the primary target.

All players hit by the effect are branded and afflicted with Cauterizing Wound.

If fails to hit at least players, Fire damage is inflicted to all players and Smolderon gains a stack of Heating Up.

children.name: Cauterizing Wound
children.text: In Mythic difficulty, targets afflicted with Cauterizing Wound that are hit by Flame Waves create additional Flame Waves.

children.name: Cauterized Explosion
children.text: A fiery explosion inflicts Fire damage to all players nearby.

children.name: Searing Aftermath
children.text: The searing heat causes the primary target of the brand to explode after 6 sec, inflicting Fire damage to all players. Players farther from the target receive less damage.

children.name: Emberscar's Mark
children.text:
Emberscar brands the player, increasing damage taken from Brand of Damnation by 500%.

Being struck by Devour Essence removes the effect.

children.name: Overheated
children.text: In Heroic difficulty, when Overheated expires Flame Waves spawn around the target.

children.name: Flame Waves
children.text: Flame Waves inflict Fire damage and knock back any player they come in contact with.

children.name: Flame Waves
children.text: Flame Waves inflict Fire damage and knock back any player they come in contact with.

children.name: Lava Geysers
children.text:
Smolderon stomps the ground causing plumes of lava to erupt nearby random players. These Lava Geysers inflict Fire damage and knock back any players struck.

When the lava settles, a pool of is left behind.

children.name: Smoldering Ground
children.text: Smoldering ground inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec to any player standing within.

children.name: Blistering Heat
children.text: Smolderon's body incinerates the air, inflicting Fire damage to all players every sec.

children.name: Devour Essence
children.text:
Smolderon slams Emberscar into the ground to feast on branded players' essence, knocking back all players.

Any player branded with Emberscar's Mark additionally releases s.

children.name: Living Flame
children.text:
Living Flames drift towards Smolderon when created. Collecting a Living Flame inflicts Fire damage and applies Ignited Essence to the player.

Each Living Flame that reaches Smolderon increases his damage done by 1%.

children.name: Ignited Essence
children.text: Players can collect Living Flames to increase their damage done by 20% and healing done by 10% for 20 sec. This effect stacks, but collecting additional flames does not extend the duration.

children.name: World In Flames
children.text: Smolderon channels his blazing soul into Emberscar, periodically causing bursts of fire to engulf portions of the arena. This inflicts Fire damage and applies Lingering Burn to all players caught within the blast.

children.name: Lingering Burn
children.text: World In Flames' bursts sear the player, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec over 10 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Heating Up
children.text:
Upon reaching 100 energy Smolderon ignites into flames, increasing his damage done by 10%. This effect stacks.

After Heating Up times, Smolderon gains the ability to cast Encroaching Destruction.

children.name: Encroaching Destruction
children.text: Smolderon combusts, continuously casting World In Flames until all players succumb to their demise.

children.name: Blazing Soul
children.text: In Heroic difficulty, Blazing Soul also increases the damage Blistering Heat inflicts.

children.name: Blistering Heat
children.text: Smolderon's body incinerates the air, inflicting Fire damage to all players every sec.

bosses.name: Tindral Sageswift, Seer of the Flame
bosses.description: Obsessed with restoring immortality to the Kaldorei, Tindral Sageswift agreed to work with Fyrakk. On the cusp of Fyrakk's victory, the Seer of the Flame stands against the champions of Azeroth, ready to ensure Amirdrassil is reborn in flame.

tips.text:
• Searing Wrath is applied on every melee strike and stacks.
• Blazing Mushroom inflicts high damage to all players if it fails to hit a player.
• Fire Beam inflicts Fire damage to players within.

• Supernova is interrupted when its absorb shield is depleted.
• Mass Entanglement holds players in place until the roots are destroyed.
• Fiery Growth creates Scorching Ground when dispelled.

• Fiery Growth creates Scorching Ground when dispelled.
• Suppressive Ember is used in Treant form and absorbs a substantial amount of healing.
• Tindral continuously blasts the group with Sunflame while in his Moonkin form.

bosses.overview:
As a master shapeshifter, Tindral assaults players in various Druid forms.

In his humanoid form, Tindral roots players with Mass Entanglement and bombards players with Falling Stars.

Shapeshifting into his Moonkin form, Tindral unleashes Sunflame on all players and summons Fire Beam that scorches the platform.

As the Treant of the Flame, Tindral pulses Suppressive Ember and sears players with Flaming Germination.

Becoming the Owl of the Flame leaves behind Empowered Feather, allowing players to dragonride within The Blessed Boughs.

abilities.name: Stage One: Moonkin of the Flame

children.name: Mass Entanglement
children.text: Tindral targets all players with fiery vines that erupt after 6 sec, rooting the targeted player and also inflicting Fire damage to players nearby. These roots inflict Fire damage every 1 sec until they are destroyed.

children.name: Falling Star
children.text: Tindral brings down a falling star towards the platform, inflicting Astral damage to all players and leaving behind Star Fragments.

children.name: Star Fragments
children.text: Fragments of the falling star explode, inflicting Astral damage to players near impact.

children.name: Fiery Growth
children.text:
Tindral causes flames to grow inside random players, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec for 20 sec.$?diff17[]$?diff14|diff16|diff15[

The flames erupt from players when Fiery Growth is removed]

children.name: Scorching Ground
children.text: Scorching Ground inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec to players within.

children.name: Blazing Mushroom
children.text:
Tindral creates Blazing Mushrooms around himself every sec for sec. Each mushroom erupts after 3 sec, inflicting Physical damage and Fire damage to players within the area and increases their damage taken from Blazing Mushrooms by 500% for 3 sec.

If Blazing Mushroom fails to hit a player, inflicts Fire damage to all players.

children.name: Searing Wrath
children.text: Tindral's melee attacks sears the target, inflicting Fire damage every 2 sec for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Flame Surge
children.text: Tindral blasts players on the edge of the platform with Flame Surge, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec.

children.name: Searing Moonkin Form
children.text: Tindral shapeshifts into a fiery Moonkin, periodically blasting all players with Sunflame.

children.name: Sunflame
children.text: A quick beam of solar light burns players for Fire damage.

children.name: Fire Beam
children.text:
$[!15

In Heroic difficulty and above, Tindral creates additional Fire Beams after impact.

children.name: Dream Essence
children.text:
Any player flying through the essence of the Emerald Dream empowers all players, increasing their damage done by 5% and increasing their healing and absorb effects done by 5%. This effect stacks and lasts until Supernova finishes casting or is interrupted.

The consumed essence leaves behind Emerald Gale.

children.name: Emerald Gale
children.text: Emerald winds propel the player forward for 3 sec, granting Skyriding Charge.

children.name: Empowered Feather
children.text: Empowered Feather falls from Tindral's Owl form, allowing players to dragonride within The Blessed Boughs.

children.name: Typhoon
children.text: Tindral violently flaps his wings, pushing back all players. After 2.5 sec, a typhoon erupts, inflicting Nature damage to all players.

children.name: Scorching Plume
children.text: Scorching plumes inflict Fire damage and remove Skyriding Charges from players that come into contact with it.

children.name: Supernova
children.text:
Tindral shields himself for of his maximum health and summons a dying star, inflicting Fire damage to all players every 2 sec$?diff16[ and afflicting them with Astral Heat for 3 sec.]$?diff14|diff17|diff15[.]

The star explodes after 30 sec, inflicting Fire damage to all players. This spell is interrupted if Tindral's shield is broken.

abilities.name: Stage Two: Tree of the Flame

children.name: Mass Entanglement
children.text: Tindral targets all players with fiery vines that erupt after 6 sec, rooting the targeted player and also inflicting Fire damage to players nearby. These roots inflict Fire damage every 1 sec until they are destroyed.

children.name: Falling Star
children.text: Tindral brings down a falling star towards the platform, inflicting Astral damage to all players and leaving behind Star Fragments.

children.name: Star Fragments
children.text: Fragments of the falling star explode, inflicting Astral damage to players near impact.

children.name: Fiery Growth
children.text:
Tindral causes flames to grow inside random players, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec for 20 sec.$?diff17[]$?diff14|diff16|diff15[

The flames erupt from players when Fiery Growth is removed]

children.name: Scorching Ground
children.text: Scorching Ground inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec to players within.

children.name: Blazing Mushroom
children.text:
Tindral creates Blazing Mushrooms around himself every sec for sec. Each mushroom erupts after 3 sec, inflicting Physical damage and Fire damage to players within the area and increases their damage taken from Blazing Mushrooms by 500% for 3 sec.

If Blazing Mushroom fails to hit a player, inflicts Fire damage to all players.

children.name: Searing Wrath
children.text: Tindral's melee attacks sears the target, inflicting Fire damage every 2 sec for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Flame Surge
children.text: Tindral blasts players on the edge of the platform with Flame Surge, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec.

children.name: Burning Treant Form
children.text: Tindral shapeshifts into a flaming Treant, periodically afflicting players with Suppressive Ember.

children.name: Suppressive Ember
children.text: Tindral surrounds random players with suppressive ember, absorbing the next healing. This effect stacks.

children.name: Flaming Germination
children.text: Tindral unleashes Seeds of Flame around himself and sets the platform ablaze, inflicting Fire damage to players every 1 sec for 15 sec.

children.name: Seed of Flame
children.text:
$[!15

In Heroic difficulty, stepping on a Seed of Flame makes the player take increased damage from Seed of Flame for 6 sec.

children.name: Flaming Tree
children.text: Flaming Trees sprout forth from Seed of Flame after 10 sec, inflicting Fire damage to players every sec for 10 min.

children.name: Dream Essence
children.text:
Any player flying through the essence of the Emerald Dream empowers all players, increasing their damage done by 5% and increasing their healing and absorb effects done by 5%. This effect stacks and lasts until Supernova finishes casting or is interrupted.

The consumed essence leaves behind Emerald Gale.

children.name: Emerald Gale
children.text: Emerald winds propel the player forward for 3 sec, granting Skyriding Charge.

children.name: Incarnation: Owl of the Flame
children.text: Tindral shapeshifts into a flaming owl.

children.name: Empowered Feather
children.text: Empowered Feather falls from Tindral's Owl form, allowing players to dragonride within The Blessed Boughs.

children.name: Typhoon
children.text: Tindral violently flaps his wings, pushing back all players. After 2.5 sec, a typhoon erupts, inflicting Nature damage to all players.

children.name: Scorching Plume
children.text: Scorching plumes inflict Fire damage and remove Skyriding Charges from players that come into contact with it.

children.name: Supernova
children.text:
Tindral shields himself for of his maximum health and summons a dying star, inflicting Fire damage to all players every 2 sec$?diff16[ and afflicting them with Astral Heat for 3 sec.]$?diff14|diff17|diff15[.]

The star explodes after 30 sec, inflicting Fire damage to all players. This spell is interrupted if Tindral's shield is broken.

abilities.name: Stage Three: Seer of the Flame

children.name: Supernova
children.text:
Tindral summons a dying star, inflicting Fire damage to all players every 2 sec$?diff16[ and afflicting them with Astral Heat for 3 sec.]$?diff14|diff17|diff15[.]

The star explodes after 20 sec, inflicting Fire damage to all players.

children.name: Mass Entanglement
children.text: Tindral targets all players with fiery vines that erupt after 6 sec, rooting the targeted player and also inflicting Fire damage to players nearby. These roots inflict Fire damage every 1 sec until they are destroyed.

children.name: Falling Star
children.text: Tindral brings down a falling star towards the platform, inflicting Astral damage to all players and leaving behind Star Fragments.

children.name: Star Fragments
children.text: Fragments of the falling star explode, inflicting Astral damage to players near impact.

children.name: Fiery Growth
children.text:
Tindral causes flames to grow inside random players, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec for 20 sec.$?diff17[]$?diff14|diff16|diff15[

The flames erupt from players when Fiery Growth is removed]

children.name: Scorching Ground
children.text: Scorching Ground inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec to players within.

children.name: Blazing Mushroom
children.text:
Tindral creates Blazing Mushrooms around himself every sec for sec. Each mushroom erupts after 3 sec, inflicting Physical damage and Fire damage to players within the area and increases their damage taken from Blazing Mushrooms by 500% for 3 sec.

If Blazing Mushroom fails to hit a player, inflicts Fire damage to all players.

children.name: Searing Wrath
children.text: Tindral's melee attacks sears the target, inflicting Fire damage every 2 sec for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Flame Surge
children.text: Tindral blasts players on the edge of the platform with Flame Surge, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec.

children.name: Searing Moonkin Form
children.text: Tindral shapeshifts into a fiery Moonkin, periodically blasting all players with Sunflame.

children.name: Sunflame
children.text: A quick beam of solar light burns players for Fire damage.

children.name: Fire Beam
children.text:
$[!15

In Heroic difficulty and above, Tindral creates additional Fire Beams after impact.

children.name: Burning Treant Form
children.text: Tindral shapeshifts into a flaming Treant, periodically afflicting random players with Suppressive Ember.

children.name: Suppressive Ember
children.text: Tindral surrounds random players with suppressive ember, absorbing the next healing. This effect stacks.

children.name: Flaming Germination
children.text: Tindral unleashes Seeds of Flame around himself and sets the platform ablaze, inflicting Fire damage to players every 1 sec for 15 sec.

children.name: Seed of Flame
children.text:
$[!15

In Heroic difficulty and above, stepping on a Seed of Flame makes the player take increased damage from Seed of Flame for 6 sec.

children.name: Flaming Tree
children.text: Flaming Trees sprout forth from Seed of Flame after 10 sec, inflicting Fire damage to players every sec for 10 min.

bosses.name: Fyrakk the Blazing
bosses.description: Engorged with the power of shadowflame and wielding the legendary axe Fyr'alath the Dream Render, Fyrakk now prepares to feast on the energies of Amirdrassil itself.

tips.text:
•Mark of Fyr'alath inflicts heavy Shadowflame damage each time Fyrakk attacks a player.
•Fyrakk calls down two Burning Colossi with Greater Firestorm.
•Fyrakk inflicts massive damage with Infernal Maw while in dragon form.

•Dream Rend inflicts heavy Shadowflame damage to all players while the portal is open.
•Fyrakk periodically lights players Aflame.
•Injured Spirits of the Kaldorei transfer their health to Amirdrassil upon reaching it.

•Wildfire causes Raging Flames to spread towards the Roots of Amirdrassil.
•Burning Colossi cast Exploding Core upon reaching 100 energy.
•Fyrakk leaves behind a trail of Screaming Souls with Shadowflame Devastation.

bosses.overview:
As the battle for Amirdrassil begins, Fyrakk conjures Firestorms that darken the sky. Each time Fyrakk casts Wildfire, the Raging Flames spread. Upon reaching 70% remaining health, Fyrakk attempts to Corrupt the Heart of Amirdrassil.

As Spirits of the Kaldorei emerge to defend the world tree, Fyrakk annihilates his foes with Shadowflame Devastation.

Fyrakk unleashes the full power of an Incarnate with Apocalypse Roar as the world tree begins to produce Seeds of Amirdrassil.

abilities.name: Stage One: The Dream Render
abilities.text: Fyrakk wields the burning blade, Fyr'alath the Dream Render.

children.name: Roots of Amirdrassil
children.text: The Roots of Amirdrassil nurture the world tree with the energy of the Emerald Dream. If Raging Flames reach the roots, Amirdrassil Burns.

children.name: Amirdrassil Burns
children.text: Amirdrassil burns, and Fyrakk remakes the world in flame.

children.name: Firestorm
children.text:
Fyrakk calls burning meteors down upon players, inflicting Shadowflame damage to players nearby$?diff17 []$?diff14|diff15|diff16 [ and creating Raging Flames upon impact].

Shards of each meteor also impact Amirdrassil, inflicting Shadowflame damage to players near the impact locations.

children.name: Raging Flames
children.text: A raging inferno inflicts Shadowflame damage every 1 sec to players within the area.

children.name: Wildfire
children.text:
Fyrakk bites Fyr'alath into the bark of Amirdrassil, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players.

Raging Flames spread to nearby locations and inflict Shadowflame damage to players near the impact locations.

children.name: Dream Rend
children.text:
Fyrakk rends the fabric of the Emerald Dream, inflicting Fire damage to all players and opening up a rift into the Firelands.

Searing heat pours through the rift, inflicting Fire damage to all players every sec for 8 sec and pulling players towards its location. Players farther from the rift receive less damage.

Players drawn beneath the rift are Incinerated.

children.name: Incinerated
children.text: The burning rift inflicts Shadowflame damage every 1 sec to players within it.

children.name: Blaze
children.text: Fyrakk wreathes players in flames that explode outwards after sec, inflicting Shadowflame damage to any player caught in the effect.

children.name: Burning Presence
children.text:
Fyrakk radiates a searing heat, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players every sec.

Periodically sets targets Aflame.

children.name: Aflame
children.text: Fyrakk sets players Aflame, inflicting Shadowflame damage every 1 sec and growing in intensity over time. This effect stacks.

children.name: Fyr'alath's Bite
children.text:
Fyrakk slashes his current target, inflicting Physical damage and Shadowflame damage. The target is branded with the Fyr'alath's Mark for 40 sec.

Sends forth Fyr'alath's Flame.

children.name: Fyr'alath's Mark
children.text: Fyrakk's melee attacks with Fyr'alath inflict Shadowflame damage to those who wear the mark. This effect stacks.

children.name: Fyr'alath's Flame
children.text: A fireball erupts from Fyr'alath, inflicting Shadowflame damage to enemies in its path.

children.name: Predator
children.text: Fyrakk leaps at his current target if not within reach, inflicting a melee attack wtih Fyr'alath.

abilities.name: Intermission: Amirdrassil in Peril
abilities.text: Fyrakk assaults the Heart of Amirdrassil directly with corrupting flames.

children.name: Corrupt
children.text:
Fyrakk begins to corrupt the heart of Amirdrassil with Shadowflame Breath, converting its lifeforce into a barrier of energy that absorbs damage equal to ${/100}.1% of his maximum health.

Fyrakk pulses with shadowflame while the shield holds, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players every 1 sec and increasing in intensity over time.

After 30 sec the tree is fully corrupted, and Amirdrassil Burns.

children.name: Incinerated
children.text: The burning rift inflicts Shadowflame damage every 1 sec to players within it.

children.name: Shadowflame Breath
children.text: Fyrakk exhales a torrent of flame in front of him, inflicting Shadowflame damage every 0.3 sec to players standing within it.

children.name: Amirdrassil Burns
children.text: Amirdrassil burns, and Fyrakk remakes the world in flame.

children.name: Blaze
children.text: Fyrakk wreathes players in flames that explode outwards after sec, inflicting Shadowflame damage to any player caught in the effect.

children.name: Incarnate
children.text: Fyrakk leaps into the sky above Amirdrassil and descends in dragon form, inflicting Physical damage to all players upon impact and knocking them upward.

children.name: Shadowflame Orbs
children.text:
Fyrakk draws shadowflame orbs from the Raging Flames. The orbs move towards Fyrakk and erupt when touched, inflicting Shadowflame damage.

Fyrakk devours orbs within reach, causing a Shadowflame Eruption.

children.name: Shadowflame Eruption
children.text: Fyrakk devours a shadowflame orb, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players and an additional Shadowflame damage every 1 sec for 24 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Burning Scales
children.text: Fyrakk's scales radiate a searing heat, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players every sec.

abilities.name: Stage Two: Children of the Stars
abilities.text: A power stirs within the Heart of Amirdrassil as Fyrakk manifests living shadowflame to aid him.

children.name: Heart of Amirdrassil
children.text: The Heart of Amirdrassil stands at the threshold of corruption. If the world tree loses all its health, Amirdrassil Burns.

children.name: Spirits of the Kaldorei
children.text:
Injured Spirits of the Kaldorei periodically emerge from the heart of Amirdrassil in the tree's darkest hour.

Upon reaching the heart of Amirdrassil, each spirit transfers its remaining health to the world tree.

children.name: Spirit of the Kaldorei
children.text: A spirit who perished in the fires of Teldrassil.

children.name: Lifeforce Barrier
children.text: Upon reaching full life, Spirits of the Kaldorei are protected by a Lifeforce Barrier that reduces all damage taken by 99%.

children.name: Amirdrassil Burns
children.text: Amirdrassil burns, and Fyrakk remakes the world in flame.

children.name: Greater Firestorm
children.text:
Fyrakk calls burning meteors down upon players, inflicting Shadowflame damage to players nearby and creating a $?diff14|diff15|diff17 [Burning ]$?diff16 []Colossus upon impact.

Shards of each meteor also impact Amirdrassil, inflicting Shadowflame damage to players near the impact locations.

children.name: Molten Gauntlet
children.text: The Burning Colossus smashes its fist into its current target, inflicting Physical damage and Shadowflame damage.

children.name: Pulsing Core
children.text: The Colossus pulses with dark flames, inflicting Shadowflame damage to enemies nearby every 2.5 sec.

children.name: Exploding Core
children.text: Upon gaining 100 energy the Colossus overheats and explodes, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players and an additional Shadowflame damage every 1 sec for 20 sec.

children.name: Flamefall
children.text: Fyrakk plummets from the sky onto Amirdrassil, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players upon landing. Players farther from the impact location receive less damage.

children.name: Shadowflame Devastation
children.text: Fyrakk sweeps across Amirdrassil's surface, spewing flames in a line as he travels. Inflicts Shadowflame damage instantly and an additional Shadowflame damage every 1 sec to players in its wake.

children.name: Searing Screams
children.text:
The Screaming Soul unleashes torrid screams, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players every 3 sec and increasing its Shadowflame damage done by 20%. This effect stacks.$?diff17 []$?diff14|diff15|diff16 [

Nearby Spirits of the Kaldorei despair, becoming Screaming Souls themselves.]

children.name: Burning Scales
children.text: Fyrakk's scales radiate a searing heat, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players every sec.

children.name: Blaze
children.text: Fyrakk wreathes players in flames that explode outwards after sec, inflicting Shadowflame damage to any player caught in the effect.

children.name: Burning Presence
children.text:
Fyrakk radiates a searing heat, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players every sec.

Periodically sets targets Aflame.

children.name: Aflame
children.text: Fyrakk sets players Aflame, inflicting Shadowflame damage every 1 sec and growing in intensity over time. This effect stacks.

children.name: Fyr'alath's Bite
children.text:
Fyrakk slashes his current target, inflicting Physical damage and Shadowflame damage. The target is branded with the Fyr'alath's Mark for 40 sec.

Sends forth Fyr'alath's Flame.

children.name: Fyr'alath's Mark
children.text: Fyrakk's melee attacks with Fyr'alath inflict Shadowflame damage to those who wear the mark. This effect stacks.

children.name: Fyr'alath's Flame
children.text: A fireball erupts from Fyr'alath, inflicting Shadowflame damage to enemies in its path.

children.name: Predator
children.text: Fyrakk leaps at his current target if not within reach, inflicting a melee attack wtih Fyr'alath.

abilities.name: Stage Three: Shadowflame Incarnate
abilities.text: Fyrakk unleashes the full power of an Incarnate in Amirdrassil's final hour.

children.name: Seed of Amirdrassil
children.text:
$?diff17 [As Amirdrassil begins to bloom, seeds form on its surface. Periodically the seeds surge with power and Bloom.
]$?diff14|diff15|diff16 [As Amirdrassil begins to bloom, seeds form on its surface which can be carried by players.

Periodically the seeds surge with power, allowing any player carrying a seed to begin a Bloom.

Seeds become Blazing Seeds if hit directly by shadowflame.]

children.name: Bloom
children.text: The seed blooms into a flower, instantly granting players within yards a shield that absorbs the next incoming damage for 6 sec.

children.name: Blazing Seed
children.text: The blazing seed pulses with flame, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players every 1 sec for 6 sec.

children.name: Eternal Firestorm
children.text:
Fyrakk permanently darkens the sky, periodically calling burning meteors down upon players. Each meteor inflicts Shadowflame damage to players near the impact location and creates a Swirling Firestorm.

Shards of each meteor also impact Amirdrassil, inflicting Shadowflame damage to players near the impact locations.

children.name: Swirling Firestorm
children.text: A swirling inferno of flame inflicts Shadowflame damage and knocks away players caught in its path.

children.name: Apocalypse Roar
children.text:
Fyrakk unleashes an incinerating roar, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players and pushing them away.

Players suffer an additional Shadowflame damage every 1 sec for 12 sec.

children.name: Shadowflame Breath
children.text: Fyrakk exhales a torrent of flame in front of him, inflicting Shadowflame damage every 0.3 sec to players standing within it.

children.name: Blaze
children.text: Fyrakk wreathes players in flames that explode outwards after sec, inflicting Shadowflame damage to any player caught in the effect.

children.name: Burning Scales
children.text: Fyrakk's scales radiate a searing heat, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players every sec.

children.name: Infernal Maw
children.text: Fyrakk devours his current target, inflicting Physical damage and an additional Shadowflame damage every 1 sec. This effect stacks.

loot.name: Renewed Proto-Drake: Embodiment of the Blazing

mythic.name: Amirdrassil, the Dream's Hope
mythic.description: Having been carefully nurtured within the Emerald Dream, Amirdrassil is preparing to bloom and cross into Azeroth. But the fate of the new World Tree cannot be secured until Azeroth's champions come together to face Fyrakk and his molten allies, before he devours the heart of Amirdrassil and bathes the world in flame.

bosses.name: Gnarlroot
bosses.description: Once a devoted protector of the Emerald Dream, this formerly majestic ancient has been ravaged by flame and now only seeks to destroy.

tips.text:
• Dreadfire Barrage inflicts significant damage and increases Shadowflame damage taken.
• When awakened, Tainted Lashers and Tainted Treants attack nearby players.
• Ember-Charred players can ignite Doom Roots by touching them.

• Standing near dormant Tainted Lashers and Tainted Treants when Controlled Burn expires causes them to activate.
• Ember-Charred players can ignite Doom Roots by touching them.
• Gnarlroot takes 100% increased damage when afflicted by Uprooted Agony.

• Tortured Scream inflicts significant damage to all players
• While channeling Doom Cultivation, Gnarlroot pulses increasing damage to all players.
•Gnarlroot gains a stack of Rising Mania upon removal of Uprooted Agony.

bosses.overview:
Gnarlroot tills the soil with Shadowflame, spawning corrupted allies and creating Shadow-Scorched Earth.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Gnarlroot casts Doom Cultivation, absorbing energy from the ground with Doom Roots. Gnarlroot inflicts increasing damage to all players until his roots are destroyed, sending him into a state of Uprooted Agony.

children.name: Flaming Pestilence
children.text:
Gnarlroot causes patches of earth to explode with Shadowflame, inflicting damage to players within the blast.

Some of these patches absorb the Shadowflame energy, forming dormant Tainted Lashers.

children.name: Tainted Flora
children.text:
Shadowflame from Gnarlroot's Flaming Pestilence seeps into the earth, sowing hostile vegetation.

On Mythic difficulty, the creatures spawn in a dormant state, awakening when infused by Shadow-Scorched Earth or Doom Cultivation.

On Heroic difficulty, the creatures spawn in a dormant state, awakening when infused by Shadow-Scorched Earth or Doom Cultivation.

children.name: Tainted Bloom
children.text: Upon awakening inflicts Shadowflame damage to all enemies.

children.name: <PH> Probably a bolt (thematic)
children.text: The lasher spits thorns at a player, inflicting Shadowflame damage. The thorns shred the target's armor, causing them to take 10% increased damage and bleed for Physical damage every 1 sec for 10 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Vicious Thicket
children.text:
Each activated lasher increases the haste and damage done of all other active lashers within yards by 10%. This effect stacks.

Upon reaching applications, the lasher becomes Overgrown.

children.name: Overgrown
children.text: The lasher is germinated by nearby allies, making it immune to interrupts and crowd controlling effects.

children.name: Tainted Bloom
children.text: Upon awakening inflicts Shadowflame damage to all enemies.

children.name: Blazing Pollen
children.text: The Tainted Treant releases blazing pollen, inflicting Fire damage to the five closest players and disorienting them for 3 sec.

children.name: Flaming Sap
children.text: The Tainted Treant hurls flaming sap at players, slowing them for 6 sec. While afflicted, players ignite every 2 sec, inflicting Fire damage to players nearby.

children.name: Shadow-Scorched Earth
children.text:
Gnarlroot marks players with a Shadowflame plague, inflicting Shadowflame damage to players near their location every 1 sec for.

Upon expiration, the affliction creates a patch of Shadow-Scorched Earth.

children.name: Shadow-Scorched Earth
children.text: The flaming soil inflicts Shadowflame damage every 1 sec to players standing on it.

children.name: <PH> Big Stompy
children.text: Gnarlroot bellows in agony, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players and an additional Shadowflame damage every 1 sec for 10 sec.

children.name: <PH> Shadowflame Cleave
children.text: Gnarlroot inflicts Shadowflame damage to players in a frontal cone.

children.name: Dreadfire Barrage
children.text:
Gnarlroot shoots missiles at his current target over, each inflicting Physical damage and Shadowflame damage.

Each impact also causes the target to take 16% increased Shadowflame damage for 34 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: <PH> Spawn Roots
children.text:
Gnarlroot grows Doom Roots that siphon power from earth, decreasing his damage taken by 99% and causing him pulse Shadowflame damage periodically.



This ability corrupts the soil beneath Gnarlroot, awakening dormant creatures and creating Toxic Loam.

Destroying all Doom Roots afflicts Gnarlroot with Uprooted Agony.

children.name: Doom Roots
children.text: Roots burst forth from the doomed soil, inflicting Nature damage to players up to yards and knocking them away.

children.name: Splintering Charcoal
children.text:
Chunks of flaming charcoal fly from Gnarlroot, inflicting Shadowflame damage to players near the impact locations, and making them Ember-Charred.

Each chunk of charcoal that does not hit a player erupts on contact with the ground, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players.

children.name: Ember-Charred
children.text:
Shadowflame residue inflicts Shadowflame damage every 1 sec. This effect stacks.

Touching a Doom Roots while afflicted ignites the root and removes one application of this effect.

children.name: Doom Root
children.text: Toxic soil inflicts Shadowflame damage every 1 sec to players within 6 yards of Gnarlroot and reduces movement speed by 80%. This affliction also reduces the magnitude of forced movement effects.

children.name: <PH> Vuln Aura
children.text:
Gnarlroot is immobilized by agony, increasing his damage taken by 100% and causing him to pulse Shadowflame damage to all players every 1 sec for 20 sec.

Upon expiration, Gnarlroot gains an application of Rising Mania.

children.name: Rising Mania
children.text: The pain from Uprooted Agony sends Gnarlroot into a frenzy, causing him to inflict 10% increased damage. This effect stacks.

bosses.name: Igira the Cruel
bosses.description: Driven by cruelty, Igira is able to forge devastating weapons from the screams of her enemies. Within the verdant realm of the Emerald Dream, the torturer seeks to expand her arsenal.

tips.text: •While a player is tethered to a Blistering Spear their movement is restricted.

•Heart Stopper inflicts significant damage upon expiration.
•Each application of Harvest of Screams increases Igira's damage.
•Vicious Swing causes Igira's melee attacks to also strike the next closest target.

16
On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, Heart Stopper unleashes a Vital Rupture from its target's destination when removed.

bosses.overview: Igira forges a knife to carve the hearts from her victims.

abilities.name: Vicious Swing
abilities.text:
Igira's melee attacks also strike the next closest player. If no target is found, her primary target is struck again.

Each melee strike also applies Drenched Blades.

children.name: Drenched Blades
children.text: Igira lacerates her target, inflicting Shadowflame damage every 2 sec for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Blistering Spear
abilities.text:
Igira hurls spears at players, tethering them to the ground and $?diff14|diff15|diff16|diff17 [inflicting Shadowflame damage to players near the impact.

While present, the spear radiates Blistering Torment.][]

children.name: Blistering Torment
children.text: Heat radiates from the spear, inflicting Shadowflame damage every 1 sec to players nearby until the spear is destroyed.

abilities.name: Twisting Blade
abilities.text: Igira expels swirling blades in the direction of a player, inflicting Shadowflame damage to players hit.

abilities.name: Harvest of Screams
abilities.text: Igira increases her damage done by 10% when she reaches 100 energy. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Marked for Torment
abilities.text: On Mythic difficulty, Igira forges two weapons to wield.

children.name: Gathering Torment
children.text:
Igira harvests the torment from her victims, inflicting Shadowflame damage to players within an area Marked for Torment.

$?diff15|diff16 [When applied, afflicted players suffer Flesh Mortification.][]

children.name: Flesh Mortification
children.text: Igira's torment scars the player's flesh, increasing damage inflicted by Gathering Torment 100% after 10 sec.

children.name: Searing Sparks
children.text:
Sparks fly from Igira's hammer towards players, inflicting Shadowflame damage to players nearby and knocking them back.

$?diff14|diff15|diff16 [Each swing of her hammer inflicts Shadowflame damage to all players.][]

children.name: Ruinous End
children.text: If none of Igira's areas of torment are extinguished, she smashes the ground inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players and an additional Shadowflame damage every 1 sec for 30 sec.

bosses.name: Volcoross
bosses.description: It is said that Volcoross, the lava serpent, is so vast that no creature has lived long enough to see him in his entirety. The gargantuan viper now coils himself around the Emerald Dream to devour it whole.

tips.text:
•Cataclysm Jaws inflict massive damage that Molten Venom further increases.
•Upon reaching 100 energy, Flood of the Firelands splashes two lava globs that consume his chamber if either fail to hit enough players.

•Upon reaching 100 energy, Flood of the Firelands splashes two lava globs that consume his chamber if either fail to hit enough players.
•Scorchtail Crash inflicts lethal damage to any players hit.

•Coiling Flames inflict increasing damage around players before slithering to new targets.
•Upon reaching 100 energy, Flood of the Firelands splashes two lava globs that consume his chamber if either fail to hit enough players.

bosses.overview:
Volcoross slams his surrounding ring with Scorchtail Crash as his enemies suffocate under the grip of Coiling Flames.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Volcoross splatters his chamber with a boiling Flood of the Firelands.

abilities.name: Flood of the Firelands
abilities.text:
Upon reaching 100 energy, Volcoross launches two massive globs of lava that splatter across his chamber. Each impact inflicts Fire damage split among players nearby, knocking them back, and creating Hellboil.

If either lava glob fails to hit $?diff14|diff15|diff16 [at least players][]$?diff17 [a player][], it inflicts Fire damage to all players and Hellboil consumes the entire chamber.

children.name: Hellboil
children.text: Crawling magma incinerates the ground, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec to players within the effect.

abilities.name: Serpent's Fury
abilities.text: Volcoross spews surging fire from his jaws, inflicting Fire damage to all players every 0.5 sec for 5 sec. Several players combust with Coiling Flames.

children.name: Coiling Flames
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, a Coiling Eruption is triggered upon expiration.

children.name: Coiling Eruption
children.text:
The flames fully constrict their target, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec for 4 sec.

Upon expiration, the target explodes, inflicting Fire damage split among players near the blast. The flames then slither to another player.

children.name: Eviscerating Flames
children.text: Taking damage from more than one Coiling Eruption at the same time shreds the player in a whirlwind of flames, inflicting Fire damage.

children.name: Twisting Singe
children.text: The spiraling embers radiate fire outward, inflicting Fire damage to nearby allies. This damage increases as the Coiling Flames tighten.

abilities.name: Scorchtail Crash
abilities.text: On Heroic and Mythic difficulty, Tidal Blazes seep out from the impact of Scorchtail Crash.

children.name: Tidal Blaze
children.text: A flowing rush of lava that inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec to players within the effect.

abilities.name: Volcanic Disgorge
abilities.text: Volcoross retches chunks of searing bile at players, inflicting Fire damage near each impact and creating Hellboil.

children.name: Hellboil
children.text: Crawling magma incinerates the ground, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec to players within the effect.

abilities.name: Molten Venom
abilities.text: Volcoross's melee attacks inject sizzling venom into his current target, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec and increasing damage taken from Cataclysm Jaws by 50% for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Cataclysm Jaws
abilities.text: Volcoross's calamitous jaws ravage his current target, inflicting Physical damage and Fire damage.

abilities.name: Burning Vertebrae
abilities.text: Volcoross's igneous skeleton emanates with blistering heat, inflicting Fire damage to all players every 2 sec.

abilities.name: Serpent's Wrath
abilities.text: Volcoross unleashes the full magnifying force of the Firelands, inflicting Fire damage to all players and increasing his damage done by 10% every 0.5 sec.

abilities.name: Combusting Rage
abilities.text: If no players are within reach, Volcoross continually vents waves of flames that inflict Fire damage to all players every 2 sec.

bosses.name: Council of Dreams
bosses.description: The Council of Dreams are steadfast in their duties as defenders. Pip employs lethal trickery to confound his victims, while Urctos relies on brute strength to demolish his enemies. Aerwynn uses her wisdom and cunning to dominate the field, and guide her fellow council members.

tips.text:
•Urctos' Agonizing Claws inflicts Physical damage in a frontal cone, leaving the target vulnerable to Agonizing Claws.
•Urctos' Barreling Charge inflicts reduced damage as more players bear the load and interrupts Aerwynn's Constricting Thicket.
•Pip's Song of the Dragon applies Captivating Finale if not removed.

•Upon removal, Polymorph Bomb afflicts nearby players, but also affects Urctos during Blind Rage.
•Urctos' Barreling Charge inflicts reduced damage as more players bear the load and interrupts Aerwynn's Constricting Thicket.
•Pip's Song of the Dragon applies Captivating Finale if not removed.

•Upon removal, Polymorph Bomb afflicts nearby players, but also affects Urctos during Blind Rage.
•Pip's Song of the Dragon applies Captivating Finale if not removed.
•Urctos' Agonizing Claws inflicts high Physical damage in a frontal cone.

bosses.overview:
Players battle against the Council of Dreams: the fearsome werebear Urctos, the naturalist dryad Aerwynn and the trickster faerie dragon Pip.

At 100 energy each council member unleashes their strongest attacks, casting Blind Rage, Constricting Thicket or Song of the Dragon respectively.

Upon reaching 1 health, that council member taps into the Dream, casting Rebirth, but fail if their allies suffer the same fate.

abilities.name: Rebirth
abilities.text: On Mythic difficulty, Rebirth heals the council member to full health.

abilities.name: Dream Tactics
abilities.text: The Council of Dreams' unrivaled coordination enables two members to execute their strongest attacks simultaneously.

children.name: Blind Rage
children.text:
At 100 energy, Urctos becomes entranced in a wild assault for 20 sec, inflicting Physical damage to all players every 2 sec. Each slam increases his damage done by 15% for the duration of the assault.

This trance leaves Urctos susceptible to Polymorph Bomb.

children.name: Ursine Rage
children.text: If Blind Rage is not interrupted, Urctos gains 500% increased damage done for the duration of the encounter.

children.name: Barreling Charge
children.text:
Urctos focuses upon his current target for sec then charges, inflicting Physical damage to players in his path. 

Upon reaching his target, Urctos unleashes a Thundering Impact.

children.name: Thundering Impact
children.text: Urctos bellows an earth-shaking roar, inflicting Physical damage to all players reduced by the number of players struck by Barreling Charge.

children.name: Agonizing Claws
children.text: Urctos slashes at his current target, inflicting Physical damage and increasing damage taken from Agonizing Claws by 100% for 18 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Constricting Thicket
children.text:
At 100 energy, Aerwynn conjures vines for 20 sec, lashing out at all players inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec and decreasing their movement speed by 10%. This effect stacks and increases in stacks every 3 sec.

This channel leaves Aerwynn susceptible to Barreling Charge.

children.name: Relentless Barrage
children.text: If Constricting Thicket is not interrupted, Aerwynn unleashes a furious bombardment for 3 sec, launching javelins at all players every 1 sec poisoning targets for Nature damage every 1.5 sec for 30 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Noxious Blossom
children.text: Aerwynn showers the ground with blossoms that emit poisonous fumes, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 3 sec until destroyed.

children.name: Corrosive Pollen
children.text: Noxious Blossoms additionally inflict Nature damage every 0.5 sec to players standing within.

children.name: Poisonous Javelin
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, the player explodes with Unstable Venom upon removal.

children.name: Unstable Venom
children.text: The player bursts with poison, inflicting Nature damage to other players nearby.

children.name: Song of the Dragon
children.text: At 100 energy, Pip sings a captivating song causing all players to absorb Corrosive Pollen damage.

children.name: Captivating Finale
children.text: When Song of the Dragon concludes, all players still affected by Song of the Dragon begin to dance, becoming stunned and suffering Nature damage every 1 sec for 15 sec.

children.name: Polymorph Bomb
children.text: On Heroic difficulty, Polymorph Bomb duplicates to players nearby upon removal.

children.name: Hungry
children.text:
You've got a ducky appetite and are unable to Preen. Consuming a Noxious Blossom removes one application.

Upon removal, applies Satiated.

children.name: Satiated
children.text: You've eaten your fill and cannot consume any more Noxious Blossoms.

children.name: Preen
children.text:
Requires Satiated.

Cleanse yourself removing the effects of Polymorph Bomb.

children.name: Quack!
children.text: Leap forward as a duck and gain a rush of adrenaline increasing movement speed by 100% for 6 sec. QUACK!

children.name: Slippery
children.text: As a duck harmful poisons slide right off your feathers reducing Nature damage taken by 99%.

children.name: Emerald Winds
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Pip channels Whimsical Gusts around the arena.

children.name: Whimsical Gust
children.text: Pip's emerald winds coalesce throughout the arena inflicting Nature damage and knocking back any players caught within.

bosses.name: Larodar, Keeper of the Flame
bosses.description: Once a faithful protector of the grove, Larodar succumbed to the power of flame. Now the twisted guardian is bent on reducing the Dream--and any who stand in his way--to ash.

tips.text:
•Furious Charge applies Nature's Fury and inflicts less damage the further his target is.
•Smoldering Suffocation prevents all healing received but drains health from nearby allies.
•Renewed Bramble Barriers drastically reduce damage taken from Raging Inferno.

•Fiery Treants transform into Charred Treants and Scorching Brambles transform into Charred Brambles when killed.
•Renewed Bramble Barriers drastically reduce damage taken from Raging Inferno.
•Dream Blossom douses Burning Ground and Scorching Roots.

•Charred Treants transform into Renewed Treants and Charred Brambles transform into Renewed Bramble Barriers when healed to full.
•Renewed Bramble Barriers drastically reduce damage taken from Raging Inferno.
•Dream Blossom douses Burning Ground and Scorching Roots.
•Flash Fire-afflicted players become Encased in Ash if the absorb expires.

bosses.overview:
Larodar summons Fiery Treants and Scorching Roots to spread Burning Ground. Upon reaching 100 energy, Larodar envelops the arena in flame with Raging Inferno.

After 3 casts of Raging Inferno, Larodar channels Consuming Flame and transforms into the Avatar of Ash. Falling Embers fall from above as Larodar attempts to cleanse his enemies with Flash Fire.

abilities.name: Stage One: The Cycle of Flame

children.name: Igniting Growth
children.text: Larodar twists his fiery grip on nature implanting flame inside players for, causing players to create of Burning Ground. This effect is reduced when standing next to Burning Ground.

children.name: Seed of Life
children.text: The Seed of Life lays dormant while it has zero energy. Renewed Treants' channel Nature's Gift causing the seed to blossom.

children.name: Dream Blossom
children.text:
On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, the Seed of Life causes players who form a bond to gain Dream Fatigue.

On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, the Seed of Life causes players who form a bond to gain Dream Fatigue.

children.name: Dream Fatigue
children.text: Forming a bond with the Seed of Life causes fatigue, preventing the player from forming another bond for.

children.name: Fiery Force of Nature
children.text: Larodar summons Fiery Treants.

children.name: Fiery Treant
children.text:
Fiery Treants seek to spread flame throughout the temple and leave behind Burning Ground.

When killed, they transform into a Charred Treant.

children.name: Blistering Splinters
children.text: Fiery Treant's melee strikes break splinters off in their target, inflicting Fire damage every sec for. This effect stacks.

children.name: Fiery Flourish
children.text: Fiery Treants expel flames, inflicting Fire damage to enemies nearby.

children.name: Explosive Bark
children.text: Larodar's minions die in an explosion of fiery bark, each inflicting Fire damage to enemies nearby.

children.name: Charred Treant
children.text:
Charred Treants are inert and can be healed.

When they reach full health, they transform into a Renewed Treant.

children.name: Renewed Treant
children.text: Friendly Renewed Treants channel Nature's Gift, sacrificing their own life to empower the Seed of Life.

children.name: Nature's Gift
children.text: Renewed Treant's channel their own life force into the Seed of Life, gifting it energy but reducing their own maximum health by 3% every 1 sec.

children.name: Scorching Roots
children.text: Larodar summons Scorching Roots.

children.name: Scorching Roots
children.text:
Scorching Roots fixate on random players, pursuing them relentlessly and speed over time.

When killed, they transform into Charred Brambles.

On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, Scorched Roots remain untargetable until doused with Dream Blossom.

On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, Scorched Roots remain untargetable until doused with Dream Blossom.

children.name: Scorching Bramblethorn
children.text: Scorching Roots strangle enemies they come in contact with fiery brambles, inflicting Fire damage every 2 sec and rooting them in place for.

children.name: Charred Brambles
children.text:
Charred Brambles are inert and can be healed.

When they reach full health, they transform into a Renewed Bramble Barrier.

children.name: Renewed Bramble Barrier
children.text:
Renewed Bramble Barriers provide protection against Raging Inferno.

When destroyed, they erupt in Explosive Bark.

children.name: Nature's Bulwark
children.text: Reduces damage taken from Raging Inferno by 90%.

children.name: Explosive Bark
children.text: Larodar's minions die in an explosion of fiery bark, each inflicting Fire damage to enemies nearby.

children.name: Furious Charge
children.text:
On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, Larodar release a Furious Outburst when reaching his target.

On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, Larodar release a Furious Outburst when reaching his target.

children.name: Nature's Fury
children.text: Larodar's fury takes a heavy toll on his target, increasing Physical damage taken by 100% for. This effect begins at stacks and decreases in stacks over time.

children.name: Furious Outburst
children.text: Larodar releases a fiery outburst when reaching his target, inflicting Fire damage to all players. This damage decreases based on distance from Larodar.

children.name: Blazing Thorns
children.text:
Larodar bursts a spiral of eruptions inflicting Fire to players near each impact, knocking them back.

Upon reaching their destination the spiral returns to Larodar.

children.name: Blazing Coalescence
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Blazing Coalescence applies a stack of Everlasting Blaze.

children.name: Everlasting Blaze
children.text: Increases the damage taken by Blazing Coalescence by 250%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Raging Inferno
children.text:
Upon reaching 100 energy Larodar releases his unbridled rage as waves of flames, inflicting Fire damage to enemies every 2 sec for. Standing behind a reduces this damage by 90%.

Larodar gains a stack of Combusting Presence after Raging Inferno ends.

children.name: Combusting Presence
children.text:
Larodar's very presence combusts the air around him, inflicting Fire damage every 1.5 sec to all enemies and causes him to leave behind Burning Ground.

Larodar gains a stack after channeling Raging Inferno.

children.name: Burning Ground
children.text:
The temple blazes with patches of flame, inflicting Fire damage every 1.5 sec.

Larodar's Combusting Presence, his Fiery Treats and Scorching Roots, and these flame patches spread Burning Ground further.

Dream Blossoms douse the flames extinguishing these patches.

children.name: Consuming Flame
children.text:
After casts of Raging Inferno Larodar draws upon the surrounding flames for radiating Fire damage to all players every 0.5 sec, pulling players towards him. Additionally the Keeper inflicts Fire damage to players within yards.

These flames combust Larodar transforming him into the Avatar of Ash.

children.name: Ashen Devastation
children.text: Larodar marks players with explosive ash that draws in surrounding flame, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec for. Upon expiration, it inflicts Fire damage to all players. This damage is reduced the further away the players are from the blast.

children.name: Falling Embers
children.text:
Larodar releases a fistful of embers that fall from the sky, inflicting Fire damage to players near the impact locations.

Embers that fail to hit a player inflict Fire damage to all players, applying a stack of Searing Ash.

children.name: Flash Fire
children.text:
Larodar attempts to purge several players in a flash of fire, causing them to absorb healing for. Each player erupts after, inflicting Fire damage to players nearby.

If the absorb is not healed before expiring, Flash Fire also applies to players hit.

children.name: Encased in Ash
children.text: Players encased in ash are stunned for.

children.name: Fire Whirl
children.text: Larodar focuses his rage into violent tornados that orbit the arena, inflicting Fire damage every 0.5 sec to players standing within, knocking them back.

children.name: Smoldering Backdraft
children.text: Larodar's ashen husk unleashes a brutal backdraft of flames inflicting Fire damage in a frontal cone, applying Smoldering Suffocation.

children.name: Smoldering Suffocation
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Smoldering Suffocation applies a stack of Ashen Asphyxiation.

children.name: Ashen Asphyxiation
children.text: Increases the damage taken from Smoldering Suffocation by 5% for. This effect stacks.

children.name: Ashen Call
children.text: Larodar calls upon the ashes of his fallen Treants.

children.name: Ashen Treant
children.text:
Ashen Treants erupt with Explosive Bark and Burning Ground when killed.

On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, Ashen Treants leave behind a trail of Burning Ground.On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, Ashen Treants create a trail of Burning Ground.

children.name: Searing Ash
children.text: Larodar radiates Searing Ash every 12 sec, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec. This effect stacks.
