children.name: Burning Ground
children.text:
The temple blazes with patches of flame, inflicting Fire damage every 1.5 sec.

Larodar's Combusting Presence, his Fiery Treats and Scorching Roots, and these flame patches spread Burning Ground further.

Dream Blossoms douse the flames extinguishing these patches.

bosses.name: Nymue, Weaver of the Cycle
bosses.description: Nymue was placed in this verdant realm when Eonar and Freya shaped the Dream. In Wellspring Temple, they enforce and protect the ordering of the Emerald Dream, weaving its wilderness into complex patterns.

tips.text:
• Threaded Blast inflicts substantial Physical and Nature damage.
• Verdant Rend inflicts substantial Nature damage to all players when a Cycle Warden crosses Verdant Matrix.
• Weaver's Burden detonates upon removal inflicting damage to nearby players.

• Standing on Surging Growth greatly reduces its duration.
• Cycle Wardens protect Nymue with Life Ward and cast Lumbering Slam.
• Impending Loom stuns players on contact and inflicts substantial damage.

• Impending Loom stuns players on contact and inflicts substantial damage.
• Inflorescence suppresses the application of Verdant Matrix.
• Nymue radiates intense raid-wide damage during Unravel and Continuum.

bosses.overview:
Nymue's Verdant Matrix draws upon the dream to weave new life into existence, punishing those who cross its emerald threads. Each cast of Continuum alters Nymue's Verdant Matrix.

Upon reaching 100% energy Nymue casts Full Bloom and summons Cycle Wardens who protect Nymue with Life Ward.

children.name: Verdant Matrix
children.text: Nymue's Verdant Matrix draws upon the dream to weave emerald threads across the battlefield. Crossing these threads inflicts Nature damage every 0.5 sec for 2 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Continuum
children.text: Nymue alters the over 10 sec inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec.

children.name: Impending Loom
children.text:
Nymue conjures a magical loom that weaves threads of energy into complex patterns.

These threads slowly move outward from Nymue, stunning players on contact and inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec for 3 sec.

children.name: Ephemeral Flora
children.text:
Nymue causes Ephemeral Flora to burst from the ground at a location. After 10 sec, the Flora's short existence comes to a spectacular end, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 1 sec for 30 sec.

Players who stand in the Flora stifle it, reducing its life force by ${*0.1}.2% every ${*0.1}.2 sec that they do so.

children.name: Reclamation
children.text: Sec after a Surging Growth or Ephemeral Flora expires Nymue reclaims its energy, triggering an explosion at its location that inflicts Nature damage to players nearby.

children.name: Surging Growth
children.text:
Nymue causes Surging Growths to burst from the ground, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 2 sec for 1 min.

Players who stand on a Growth stifle it, greatly reducing its duration.

children.name: Reclamation
children.text: Sec after a Surging Growth or Ephemeral Flora expires Nymue reclaims its energy, triggering an explosion at its location that inflicts Nature damage to players nearby.

children.name: Viridian Rain
children.text: Nymue conjures verdant shards that fall from above several players, inflicting Nature damage every 1.5 sec for 6 sec.

children.name: Weaver's Burden
children.text: In Heroic difficulty, Weaver's Burden applies Woven Resonance and spreads to additional players. Upon expiration, a Barrier Blossom springs to life at the target's location.

children.name: Inflorescence
children.text: The ground springs to life beneath your feet as you walk, allowing players within to pass unharmed through Verdant Matrix and increasing their movement speed by 60%. Lasts 10 sec.

children.name: Woven Resonance
children.text: Increases Nature damage taken by 100% for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Barrier Blossom
children.text: Barrier Blossoms forcefully expel players who approach them, inflicting Nature damage and knocking them away.

children.name: Threaded Blast
children.text: Nymue blasts their primary target with a woven beam inflicting Physical damage and Nature damage.

children.name: Full Bloom
children.text: In Mythic difficulty, a Manifested Dream amalgamates from the surge in life energy.

children.name: Inflorescence
children.text: The ground springs to life beneath your feet as you walk, allowing players within to pass unharmed through Verdant Matrix and increasing their movement speed by 60%. Lasts 10 sec.

children.name: Unravel
children.text: Nymue channels their immense power to unmake all players, inflicting Nature damage every 3 sec, and increasing damage taken from Unravel by 10%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Waking Decimation
children.text: The Manifested Dream gathers energy over sec then snaps all players out of the Dream, inflicting Nature damage.

children.name: Lucid Miasma
children.text:
Swirling verdant energy surrounds the Manifested Dream, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec to players within yards and marks them with Lucid Vulnerability.

Players outside of the miasma have their visibility of the Manifested Dream obscured.

children.name: Lucid Vulnerability
children.text: The victim is vulnerable to the damage of Lucid Miasma for 12 min. All Lucid Miasma damage is increased by 1000% per application.

children.name: Dream Exhaust
children.text: The Manifested Dream blasts energy in several directions inflicting Nature damage to players in a cone.

children.name: Life Ward
children.text: The Cycle Wardens' abundant life energy shields Nymue, reducing damage taken by 99%.

children.name: Lumbering Slam
children.text: In Heroic difficulty, Lumbering Slam causes Surging Growths to sprout.

children.name: Surging Growth
children.text:
Nymue causes Surging Growths to burst from the ground, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 2 sec for 1 min.

Players who stand on a Growth stifle it, greatly reducing its duration.

children.name: Reclamation
children.text: Sec after a Surging Growth or Ephemeral Flora expires Nymue reclaims its energy, triggering an explosion at its location that inflicts Nature damage to players nearby.

children.name: Radial Flourish
children.text: Life energy erupts from the Cycle Warden in an intricate pattern, inflicting Nature damage to players caught in its path.

children.name: Verdant Rend
children.text: In Mythic difficulty, Verdant Rend is also cast every sec while only 1 Cycle Warden remains alive.

loot.name: Dreambinder, Loom of the Great Cycle

bosses.name: Smolderon
bosses.description: As the new Firelord, Smolderon has unleashed the power of the Firelands to expand his domain and incinerate the Emerald Dream.

tips.text:
•Brand of Damnation afflicts the primary target with Searing Aftermath which explodes for less damage the further away the target is.
•Brand of Damnation marks all players struck with Cauterizing Wound which absorbs a large amount of healing.
•Devour Essence draws Living Flames out of players afflicted with Emberscar's Mark.

•Brand of Damnation marks all players struck with Cauterizing Wound which absorbs a large amount of healing.
•Devour Essence draws Living Flames out of players afflicted with Emberscar's Mark.
•Overheated inflicts damage to all players nearby the target.

•Blazing Soul causes Blistering Heat to inflict heavy damage to all players.
•Brand of Damnation marks all players struck with Cauterizing Wound which absorbs a large amount of healing.
•Devour Essence draws Living Flames out of players afflicted with Emberscar's Mark.

bosses.overview:
Smolderon showcases his worth as a Firelord by utilizing his weapon Emberscar to great effect. He marks his enemies with Brand of Damnation while also igniting them with Overheated.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Smolderon slams Emberscar into the ground. He then feasts on players' essence while overwhelming them with World In Flames.

children.name: Brand of Damnation
children.text: In Heroic difficulty, the primary target of Brand of Damnation is afflicted with Searing Aftermath.

children.name: Cauterizing Wound
children.text:
Emberscar's brand cauterizes the player, causing them to absorb healing.

Removing the absorb creates a Cauterized Explosion at the player's location sec later.

children.name: Cauterized Explosion
children.text: A fiery explosion inflicts Fire damage to all players nearby.

children.name: Searing Aftermath
children.text: The searing heat causes the primary target of the brand to explode after 6 sec, inflicting Fire damage to all players. Players farther from the target receive less damage.

children.name: Emberscar's Mark
children.text:
Emberscar brands the player, increasing damage taken from Brand of Damnation by 500%.

Being struck by Devour Essence removes the effect.

children.name: Brand of Damnation
children.text:
Smolderon decimates his primary target, inflicting Physical damage and afflicting them with Searing Aftermath. An additional Fire damage is split evenly among all players near the primary target.

All players hit by the effect are branded and afflicted with Cauterizing Wound.

If fails to hit at least players, Fire damage is inflicted to all players and Smolderon gains a stack of Heating Up.

children.name: Cauterizing Wound
children.text: In Mythic difficulty, targets afflicted with Cauterizing Wound that are hit by Flame Waves create additional Flame Waves.

children.name: Cauterized Explosion
children.text: A fiery explosion inflicts Fire damage to all players nearby.

children.name: Searing Aftermath
children.text: The searing heat causes the primary target of the brand to explode after 6 sec, inflicting Fire damage to all players. Players farther from the target receive less damage.

children.name: Emberscar's Mark
children.text:
Emberscar brands the player, increasing damage taken from Brand of Damnation by 500%.

Being struck by Devour Essence removes the effect.

children.name: Seeking Inferno
children.text:
Smolderon creates several Seeking Infernos that fixate upon random players. Players who touch a Seeking Inferno become afflicted with Inferno.

When one reaches its target or after sec, it explodes and inflicts Fire damage to all players. This explosion causes all players to take 2000% increased damage from Seeking Inferno for 3 sec.

children.name: Inferno
children.text: The Seeking Inferno ignites the player, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec for 4 sec.

children.name: Overheated
children.text: In Heroic difficulty, when Overheated expires Flame Waves spawn around the target.

children.name: Flame Waves
children.text: Flame Waves inflict Fire damage and knock back any player they come in contact with.

children.name: Flame Waves
children.text: Flame Waves inflict Fire damage and knock back any player they come in contact with.

children.name: Lava Geysers
children.text:
Smolderon stomps the ground causing plumes of lava to erupt nearby random players. These Lava Geysers inflict Fire damage and knock back any players struck.

When the lava settles, a pool of is left behind.

children.name: Smoldering Ground
children.text: Smoldering ground inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec to any player standing within.

children.name: Blistering Heat
children.text: Smolderon's body incinerates the air, inflicting Fire damage to all players every sec.

children.name: Devour Essence
children.text:
Smolderon slams Emberscar into the ground to feast on branded players' essence, knocking back all players.

Any player branded with Emberscar's Mark additionally releases s.

children.name: Living Flame
children.text:
Living Flames drift towards Smolderon when created. Collecting a Living Flame inflicts Fire damage and applies Ignited Essence to the player.

Each Living Flame that reaches Smolderon increases his damage done by 1%.

children.name: Ignited Essence
children.text: Players can collect Living Flames to increase their damage done by 20% and healing done by 10% for 20 sec. This effect stacks, but collecting additional flames does not extend the duration.

children.name: World In Flames
children.text: Smolderon channels his blazing soul into Emberscar, periodically causing bursts of fire to engulf portions of the arena. This inflicts Fire damage and applies Lingering Burn to all players caught within the blast.

children.name: Lingering Burn
children.text: World In Flames' bursts sear the player, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec over 10 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Heating Up
children.text:
Upon reaching 100 energy Smolderon ignites into flames, increasing his damage done by 10%. This effect stacks.

After Heating Up times, Smolderon gains the ability to cast Encroaching Destruction.

children.name: Encroaching Destruction
children.text: Smolderon combusts, continuously casting World In Flames until all players succumb to their demise.

children.name: Blazing Soul
children.text: In Heroic difficulty, Blazing Soul also increases the damage Blistering Heat inflicts.

children.name: Blistering Heat
children.text: Smolderon's body incinerates the air, inflicting Fire damage to all players every sec.

bosses.name: Tindral Sageswift, Seer of the Flame
bosses.description: Obsessed with restoring immortality to the Kaldorei, Tindral Sageswift agreed to work with Fyrakk. On the cusp of Fyrakk's victory, the Seer of the Flame stands against the champions of Azeroth, ready to ensure Amirdrassil is reborn in flame.

tips.text:
• Searing Wrath is applied on every melee strike and stacks.
• Blazing Mushroom and Poisonous Mushroom inflict high damage to all players if they fail to hit a player.
• Fire Beam inflicts Fire damage to players within its area.

• Supernova is interrupted when its absorb shield is depleted.
• Mass Entanglement holds players in place until the roots are destroyed.
• Fiery Growth creates Scorching Ground when dispelled.

• Astral Heat gradually increases damage taken from Supernova.
• Fiery Growth creates Scorching Ground when dispelled.
• Suppressive Ember is used in Treant form and absorbs a substantial amount of healing.
• Tindral continuously blasts the group with Sunflame while in his Moonkin form.

bosses.overview:
As a master shapeshifter, Tindral assaults players in various Druid forms.

In his humanoid form, Tindral roots players with Mass Entanglement and bombards players with Falling Stars.

Shapeshifting into his Moonkin form, Tindral unleashes Sunflame on all players and summons Fire Beam that scorches the platform.

As the Treant of the Flame, Tindral pulses Suppressive Ember and sears players with Flaming Germination.

Becoming the Owl of the Flame leaves behind Empowered Feather, allowing players to dragonride within The Blessed Boughs.

abilities.name: Stage One: Moonkin of the Flame

children.name: Mass Entanglement
children.text:
$[!16

In Mythic difficulty, if the fiery vine fails to root a player or if the root is removed before it is destroyed, a Scorched Treant is formed at its location.

children.name: Scorched Treant
children.text: Searing heat radiates from the Scorched Treant, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec to all players.

children.name: Falling Star
children.text: Tindral brings down a falling star towards the platform, inflicting Astral damage to all players and leaving behind Star Fragments.

children.name: Star Fragments
children.text: Fragments of the falling star explode, inflicting Astral damage to players near impact.

children.name: Fiery Growth
children.text:
$[!16

In Mythic difficulty, Lingering Cinders is applied to all players when Fiery Growth is removed.

children.name: Lingering Cinder
children.text:
Cinders from Fiery Growth's explosion linger on all players, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec for 2 sec. This effect stacks.

bosses.name: Fyrakk the Blazing
bosses.description: Engorged with the power of shadowflame and wielding the legendary axe Fyr'alath the Dream Render, Fyrakk now prepares to feast on the energies of Amirdrassil itself.

tips.text:
•Mark of Fyr'alath inflicts heavy Shadowflame damage each time Fyrakk attacks a player.
•Fyrakk calls down two Burning Colossi with Greater Firestorm.
•Fyrakk inflicts massive damage with Infernal Maw while in dragon form.

•Dream Rend inflicts heavy Shadowflame damage to all players while the portal is open.
•Fyrakk periodically lights players Aflame.
•Injured Spirits of the Kaldorei transfer their health to Amirdrassil upon reaching it.

•Wildfire causes Raging Flames to spread towards the Roots of Amirdrassil.
•Burning Colossi cast Exploding Core upon reaching 100 energy.
•Fyrakk leaves behind a trail of Screaming Souls with Shadowflame Devastation.

bosses.overview:
As the battle for Amirdrassil begins, Fyrakk conjures Firestorms that darken the sky. Each time Fyrakk casts Wildfire, the Raging Flames spread. Upon reaching 70% remaining health, Fyrakk attempts to Corrupt the Heart of Amirdrassil.

As Spirits of the Kaldorei emerge to defend the world tree, Fyrakk annihilates his foes with Shadowflame Devastation.

Fyrakk unleashes the full power of an Incarnate with Apocalypse Roar as the world tree begins to produce Seeds of Amirdrassil.

abilities.name: Stage One: The Dream Render
abilities.text: Fyrakk wields the burning blade, Fyr'alath the Dream Render.

children.name: Roots of Amirdrassil
children.text: The Roots of Amirdrassil nurture the world tree with the energy of the Emerald Dream. If Raging Flames reach the roots, Amirdrassil Burns.

children.name: Amirdrassil Burns
children.text: Amirdrassil burns, and Fyrakk remakes the world in flame.

children.name: Darkflame Shades
children.text: Fyrakk summons burning shades from within the Raging Flames.

children.name: Darkflame Cleave
children.text:
The Darkflame Shade leaps towards its target, inflicting Shadowflame damage split evenly among players nearby and increasing damage taken by Darkflame Cleave by 200% for 4 sec.

Leaves behind Raging Flames.

children.name: Raging Flames
children.text: A raging inferno inflicts Shadowflame damage every 1 sec to players within the area.

children.name: Fyr'alath's Flame
children.text: A fireball erupts from the Darkflame Shade, inflicting Shadowflame damage to enemies in its path.

children.name: Firestorm
children.text:
Fyrakk calls burning meteors down upon players, inflicting Shadowflame damage to players nearby$?diff17 []$?diff14|diff15|diff16 [ and creating Raging Flames upon impact].

Shards of each meteor also impact Amirdrassil, inflicting Shadowflame damage to players near the impact locations.

children.name: Raging Flames
children.text: A raging inferno inflicts Shadowflame damage every 1 sec to players within the area.

children.name: Wildfire
children.text:
Fyrakk bites Fyr'alath into the bark of Amirdrassil, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players.

Raging Flames spread to nearby locations and inflict Shadowflame damage to players near the impact locations.

children.name: Dream Rend
children.text:
Fyrakk rends the fabric of the Emerald Dream, inflicting Fire damage to all players and opening up a rift into the Firelands.

Searing heat pours through the rift, inflicting Fire damage to all players every sec for 8 sec and pulling players towards its location. Players farther from the rift receive less damage.

Players drawn beneath the rift are Incinerated.

children.name: Dark Embers
children.text: Escaping flames inflict Shadowflame damage to players caught in their wake.

children.name: Incinerated
children.text: The burning rift inflicts Shadowflame damage every 1 sec to players within it.

children.name: Blaze
children.text: Fyrakk wreathes players in flames that explode outwards after sec, inflicting Shadowflame damage to any player caught in the effect.

children.name: Burning Presence
children.text:
Fyrakk radiates a searing heat, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players every sec.

Periodically sets targets Aflame.

children.name: Aflame
children.text: Fyrakk sets players Aflame, inflicting Shadowflame damage every 1 sec and growing in intensity over time. This effect stacks.

children.name: Fyr'alath's Bite
children.text:
Fyrakk slashes his current target, inflicting Physical damage and Shadowflame damage. The target is branded with the Fyr'alath's Mark for 40 sec.

Sends forth Fyr'alath's Flame.

children.name: Fyr'alath's Mark
children.text: Fyrakk's melee attacks with Fyr'alath inflict Shadowflame damage to those who wear the mark. This effect stacks.

children.name: Fyr'alath's Flame
children.text: A fireball erupts from Fyr'alath, inflicting Shadowflame damage to enemies in its path.

children.name: Predator
children.text: Fyrakk leaps at his current target if not within reach, inflicting a melee attack wtih Fyr'alath.

abilities.name: Intermission: Amirdrassil in Peril
abilities.text: Fyrakk assaults the Heart of Amirdrassil directly with corrupting flames.

children.name: Corrupt
children.text:
Fyrakk begins to corrupt the heart of Amirdrassil with Shadowflame Breath, converting its lifeforce into a barrier of energy that absorbs damage equal to ${/100}.1% of his maximum health.

Fyrakk pulses with shadowflame while the shield holds, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players every 1 sec and increasing in intensity over time.

After 30 sec the tree is fully corrupted, and Amirdrassil Burns.

children.name: Incinerated
children.text: The burning rift inflicts Shadowflame damage every 1 sec to players within it.

children.name: Shadowflame Breath
children.text: Fyrakk exhales a torrent of flame in front of him, inflicting Shadowflame damage every 0.3 sec to players standing within it.

children.name: Amirdrassil Burns
children.text: Amirdrassil burns, and Fyrakk remakes the world in flame.

children.name: Blaze
children.text: Fyrakk wreathes players in flames that explode outwards after sec, inflicting Shadowflame damage to any player caught in the effect.

children.name: Incarnate
children.text: Fyrakk leaps into the sky above Amirdrassil and descends in dragon form, inflicting Physical damage to all players upon impact and knocking them upward.

children.name: Flame Orbs
children.text:
Fyrakk draws fiery orbs from the Raging Flames. The orbs move towards Fyrakk and erupt when touched, inflicting Fire damage and applying Flamebound.

Fyrakk devours orbs within reach, causing a Shadowflame Eruption.

children.name: Flamebound
children.text: Fyrakk wreathes the player in flame, increasing their damage taken from Flame Orbs by 5% and damage taken from Shadow Orbs by 800%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Shadowflame Eruption
children.text: Fyrakk devours a shadowflame orb, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players and an additional Shadowflame damage every 1 sec for 24 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Shadow Orbs
children.text:
Fyrakk draws dark orbs from the Raging Flames. The orbs move towards Fyrakk and erupt when touched, inflicting Shadow damage and applying Shadowbound.

Fyrakk devours orbs within reach, causing a Shadowflame Eruption.

children.name: Shadowbound
children.text: Fyrakk wreathes the player in shadow, increasing their damage taken from Shadow Orbs by 5% and damage taken from Flame Orbs by 800%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Shadowflame Eruption
children.text: Fyrakk devours a shadowflame orb, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players and an additional Shadowflame damage every 1 sec for 24 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Burning Scales
children.text: Fyrakk's scales radiate a searing heat, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players every sec.

abilities.name: Stage Two: Children of the Stars
abilities.text: A power stirs within the Heart of Amirdrassil as Fyrakk manifests living shadowflame to aid him.

children.name: Heart of Amirdrassil
children.text: The Heart of Amirdrassil stands at the threshold of corruption. If the world tree loses all its health, Amirdrassil Burns.

children.name: Spirits of the Kaldorei
children.text:
Injured Spirits of the Kaldorei periodically emerge from the heart of Amirdrassil in the tree's darkest hour.

Upon reaching the heart of Amirdrassil, each spirit transfers its remaining health to the world tree.

children.name: Spirit of the Kaldorei
children.text: A spirit who perished in the fires of Teldrassil.

children.name: Darnassian Ancient
children.text: An ancient tree spirit extinguished in the burning of Darnassus.

children.name: Lifeforce Barrier
children.text: Upon reaching full life, Spirits of the Kaldorei are protected by a Lifeforce Barrier that reduces all damage taken by 99%.

children.name: Amirdrassil Burns
children.text: Amirdrassil burns, and Fyrakk remakes the world in flame.

children.name: Greater Firestorm
children.text:
Fyrakk calls burning meteors down upon players, inflicting Shadowflame damage to players nearby and creating a $?diff14|diff15|diff17 [Burning ]$?diff16 []Colossus upon impact.

Shards of each meteor also impact Amirdrassil, inflicting Shadowflame damage to players near the impact locations.

children.name: Molten Gauntlet
children.text: The Burning Colossus smashes its fist into its current target, inflicting Physical damage and Shadowflame damage.

children.name: Molten Eruption
children.text:
The Burning Colossus wreathes several players in flames that erupt after 5.5 sec, inflicting Fire damage to players within yards.

Shatters Shadow Cages.

children.name: Pulsing Core
children.text: The Colossus pulses with dark flames, inflicting Shadowflame damage to enemies nearby every 2.5 sec.

children.name: Exploding Core
children.text: Upon gaining 100 energy the Colossus overheats and explodes, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players and an additional Shadowflame damage every 1 sec for 20 sec.

children.name: Shadow Gauntlet
children.text: The Dark Colossus smashes its fist into its current target, inflicting Physical damage and Shadowflame damage.

children.name: Shadow Cage
children.text:
The Dark Colossus shrouds several players in shadows that erupt after 4 sec, inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby.

Players within the eruption are stunned and suffer Shadow damage every 2 sec.

children.name: Pulsing Core
children.text: The Colossus pulses with dark flames, inflicting Shadowflame damage to enemies nearby every 2.5 sec.

children.name: Exploding Core
children.text: Upon gaining 100 energy the Colossus overheats and explodes, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players and an additional Shadowflame damage every 1 sec for 20 sec.

children.name: Flamefall
children.text: Fyrakk plummets from the sky onto Amirdrassil, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players upon landing. Players farther from the impact location receive less damage.

children.name: Shadowflame Devastation
children.text: Fyrakk sweeps across Amirdrassil's surface, spewing flames in a line as he travels. Inflicts Shadowflame damage instantly and an additional Shadowflame damage every 1 sec to players in its wake.

children.name: Searing Screams
children.text:
The Screaming Soul unleashes torrid screams, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players every 3 sec and increasing its Shadowflame damage done by 20%. This effect stacks.$?diff17 []$?diff14|diff15|diff16 [

Nearby Spirits of the Kaldorei despair, becoming Screaming Souls themselves.]

children.text: Fyrakk's scales radiate a searing heat, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players every sec.

children.name: Blaze

children.name: Burning Presence

Periodically sets targets Aflame.

Sends forth Fyr'alath's Flame.

children.name: Predator

abilities.name: Stage Three: Shadowflame Incarnate
abilities.text: Fyrakk unleashes the full power of an Incarnate in Amirdrassil's final hour.

children.name: Seed of Amirdrassil
children.text:
$?diff17 [As Amirdrassil begins to bloom, seeds form on its surface. Periodically the seeds surge with power and Bloom.
]$?diff14|diff15|diff16 [As Amirdrassil begins to bloom, seeds form on its surface which can be carried by players.

Periodically the seeds surge with power, allowing any player carrying a seed to begin a Bloom.

Seeds become Blazing Seeds if hit directly by shadowflame.]

children.name: Bloom
children.text: The seed blooms into a flower, instantly granting players within yards a shield that absorbs the next incoming damage for 6 sec.

children.name: Raging Flames
children.text: A raging inferno inflicts Shadowflame damage every 1 sec to players within the area.

children.name: Blazing Seed
children.text: The blazing seed pulses with flame, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players every 1 sec for 6 sec.

children.name: Corrupted Seed
children.text:
Amirdrassil produces corrupted seeds which apply Corruption every 1 sec while held.

Seeds pulse with flame while unattended, inflicting Shadowflame damage every 2.5 sec. This effect grows in intensity over time.

Corrupted seeds become Blazing Seeds if hit directly by shadowflame.

children.name: Corruption
children.text: Holding a Corrupted Seed inflicts Shadowflame damage every 2 sec for 30 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Blazing Seed
children.text: The blazing seed pulses with flame, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players every 1 sec for 6 sec.

children.name: Eternal Firestorm
children.text:
Fyrakk permanently darkens the sky, periodically calling burning meteors down upon players. Each meteor inflicts Shadowflame damage to players near the impact location and creates a Swirling Firestorm.

Shards of each meteor also impact Amirdrassil, inflicting Shadowflame damage to players near the impact locations.

children.name: Swirling Firestorm
children.text: A swirling inferno of flame inflicts Shadowflame damage and knocks away players caught in its path.

children.name: Apocalypse Roar
children.text:
Fyrakk unleashes an incinerating roar, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players and pushing them away.

Players suffer an additional Shadowflame damage every 1 sec for 12 sec.

children.name: Shadowflame Breath
children.text: Fyrakk exhales a torrent of flame in front of him, inflicting Shadowflame damage every 0.3 sec to players standing within it.

children.name: Blaze
children.text: Fyrakk wreathes players in flames that explode outwards after sec, inflicting Shadowflame damage to any player caught in the effect.

children.name: Burning Scales
children.text: Fyrakk's scales radiate a searing heat, inflicting Shadowflame damage to all players every sec.

children.name: Infernal Maw
children.text: Fyrakk devours his current target, inflicting Physical damage and an additional Shadowflame damage every 1 sec. This effect stacks.

loot.name: Renewed Proto-Drake: Embodiment of the Blazing

lfr.name: Nerub-ar Palace
lfr.description: Deep within the kingdom of Azj-Kahet lies Nerub-ar Palace, Queen Ansurek's seat of power. From this shadowed throne Queen Ansurek has tightened her grip on her Sureki followers, leading them along a dark path to a new future. As her paranoia grows, the members of the conspiratorial Severed Threads launch their final gambit against Ansurek's rule.

bosses.name: Ulgrax the Devourer
bosses.description: Queen Ansurek's evolutionary experimentation created a number of monstrous guardians for her throne, none more voracious than Ulgrax the Devourer. Driven mad by endless hunger, Ulgrax is now the ravenous protector of Queen Ansurek's court.

tips.text:
• Stalker's Webbing will root players on contact.
•Ravenous Spawn continually Disembowel a player.

•Digestive Acid inflicts significant damage to nearby allies when removed.
•Each application of Insatiable Rage increases Ulgrax's damage.

•Ravenous Spawn continually place applications of Disembowel on a player.
•Excessively Tenderized players will become unable to be healed.

bosses.overview:
Ulgrax attempts to devour players by engaging in a Carnivorous Contest and places globs of Stalker's Webbing throughout the arena.

At zero energy, Ulgrax goes mad with hunger, attacking players with Juggernaut Charge. Ulgrax then demands to be fed, unleashing Hungering Bellows until his energy is brought to full.

children.name: Carnivorous Contest
children.text: In Mythic difficulty, bound players will emerge from the Contest Battered and Bruised. Ulgrax will enter a Contemptful Rage if fewer than players participate in the Contest.

children.name: Devour
children.text: Ulgrax devours the player inflicting Physical damage every 1 sec.

children.name: Stalker's Webbing
children.text: Ulgrax shoots webs over random destinations, inflicting Nature damage to players near impact and leaving behind Stalker's Netting.

children.name: Stalker's Netting
children.text: Ulgrax traps players, rooting them for 8 sec. Players trapped suffer Nature damage every 2 sec.

children.name: Digestive Acid
children.text:
Ulgrax belches Digestive Acid at several players, inflicting Nature damage every 2 sec for 6 sec.

Once removed venom erupts the victim's skin, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby and dissolving any webbing left behind by Stalker's Webbing.

children.name: Venomous Lash
children.text: Ulgrax flings poison at all players, inflicting Nature damage on impact and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 6 sec.

children.name: Brutal Crush
children.text: Ulgrax crushes the current threat target, inflicting Physical damage and applications of Tenderized.

children.name: Tenderized
children.text: Reduces healing taken by 10%. This effect stacks, but loses an application every 1 sec.

children.name: Hulking Crash
children.text: Ulgrax leaps to the center of the arena and smashes the ground, inflicting Physical damage and knocking back all players. Players farther from the target receive less damage.

children.name: Ready to Feed
children.text: Ulgrax refuses to move until fed, meanwile damage taken from all sources is reduced by 99%.

children.name: Hungering Bellows
children.text:
Ulgrax screams for food, inflicting Physical damage to all players on impact and an additional Physical damage every 1 sec for 3 sec.

Ulgrax's Insatiable Rage builds with each Bellow.

children.name: Insatiable Rage
children.text: Ulgrax increases his Physical damage done by 10% for 20 sec.

children.name: Juggernaut Charge
children.text:
Ulgrax emerges from the Swallowing Darkness and charges across the arena, inflicting Shadow damage to players caught in his path.

Ulgrax re-enters the Darkness on the opposite side of the arena, inflicting Shadow damage instantly and Shadow damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

children.name: Ravenous Spawn
children.text: Ulgrax spawns a host of delectible insects.

children.name: Disembowel
children.text: Bites at the player's guts, inflicting Physical damage and an additional Physical damage every 2 sec for 10 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Chunky Viscera
children.text: On death, the beetles innards spill across the floor creating a tempting treat for Ulgrax.

children.name: Feed
children.text: Hurl viscera into Ulgrax's gullet to sate his hunger.

children.name: Stalker's Webbing
children.text: Ulgrax shoots webs over random destinations, inflicting Nature damage to players near impact and leaving behind Stalker's Netting.

children.name: Stalker's Netting
children.text: Ulgrax traps players, rooting them for 8 sec. Players trapped suffer Nature damage every 2 sec.

children.name: Swallowing Darkness
children.text: Ulgrax emerges from the Swallowing Darkness rift to sate his hunger. The Darkness inflicts Shadow damage to players in the area and destroys.

bosses.name: The Bloodbound Horror
bosses.description: In the dark pits below Nerub-ar Palace, the blood of the Old Gods congeals in foul, black pools. The Bloodbound Horror rises from this vile ooze - drawing everything in its path into The Unseeming.

tips.text:
•Gruesome Disgorge sends players in front of The Bloodbound Horror into The Unseeming.
•Forgotten Harbingers Manifest Horrors until defeated.
•Grasp From Beyond forms underneath random players.

•Gruesome Disgorge sends players in front of The Bloodbound Horror into The Unseeming.

•Lost Watcher's Spectral Slam inflicts heavy Physical damage.

•Gruesome Disgorge sends players in front of The Bloodbound Horror into The Unseeming.
•Crimson Rain absorbs a large amount of healing.
•Goresplatter inflicts heavy magical damage over time.

bosses.overview:
The Bloodbound Horror periodically manifests creatures into The Unseeming to aid its assault. When splattered by Gruesome Disgorge players enter The Unseeming and can attack the creatures directly.

Upon reaching 100 energy, The Bloodbound Horror assails players with Goresplatter, inflicting deadly damage to those caught within.

abilities.name: Gruesome Disgorge
abilities.text: The Bloodbound Horror vomits Black Blood in a cone in front of itself, inflicting Shadow damage and an additional Shadow damage every 2 sec for 40 sec. Players under this effect briefly peer into The Unseeming.

children.name: The Unseeming
children.text: A shadowy realm below reality where true horrors lurk.

children.name: Black Bulwark
children.text: The Lost Watcher channels the essence of The Unseeming into The Bloodbound Horror, causing it to absorb damage, increasing every 1 sec for 10 sec.

children.name: Spectral Slam
children.text: The Lost Watcher slams their current target, inflicting Physical damage.

children.name: Manifest Horror
children.text: The Forgotten Harbinger manifests a Blood Horror out of The Unseeming that slowly moves toward The Bloodbound Horror.

children.name: Blood Pact
children.text: Blood Horrors that reach The Bloodbound Horror explode, inflicting Shadow damage to all players.

abilities.name: Goresplatter
abilities.text:
The Bloodbound Horror siphons Black Blood from the surrounding pool granting itself a Seeping Transfusion. It then unleashes a torrent of Black Blood that washes over all players nearby, inflicting Shadow damage.

Residue sticks to remaining players, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec for 10 sec.

children.name: Seeping Transfusion
children.text: The Bloodbound Horror transfuses the Black Blood into its body, increasing its damage done by 10%. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Crimson Rain
abilities.text: The Bloodbound Horror coats each player in vile blood, causing them to absorb ${*} healing.

abilities.name: Grasp From Beyond
abilities.text:
The Bloodbound Horror focuses The Unseeming on to multiple players, manifesting tentacles at their location every 1 sec for 12 sec.

After sec each tentacle erupts, inflicting Shadow damage to all players nearby.

abilities.name: Black Sepsis
abilities.text: If no players are within reach, The Bloodbound Horror continually expels contaminated blood that inflicts Shadow damage to all players every 2 sec.

bosses.name: Sikran, Captain of the Sureki
bosses.description: Sikran established himself as an arrogant duelist within Queen Ansurek's court. Never knowing the cut of an enemy's blade, Sikran dispatched his rivals one-by-one and was proclaimed Captain of the Sureki by the queen herself. This indomitable fighter now ensures that any who threaten his queen fall before the throne's might.

tips.text:
• Cosmic Simulacrums inflict light damage to all players while active.

• Upon destruction,Cosmic Simulacrums apply Cosmic Shards to all players.

• Phase Blades inflicts heavy damage over time to all players hit and reduces healing taken.

• Phase Blades leave behind Cosmic Simulacrums for every player hit.

• Cosmic Simulacrums are destroyed after being hit by Decimate and Shattering Sweep.

• Captain's Flourish inflicts light damage with Expose then finishes with Phase Lunge.

• Phase Lunge inflcts heavy Physical and Shadow damage, and increases damage taken by Phase Lunge.

• Decimate expels cosmic spears from the boss location and breaks all Cosmic Simulacrums hit.

bosses.overview:
Sikran's Phase Blade rips through the cosmos, and leaves behind a Cosmic Simulacrum which can then be destroyed by Decimate.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Sikran casts Shattering Sweep, destroying all remaining Cosmic Simulacrums

abilities.name: Phase Blades
abilities.text: On Heroic and Mythic difficulties all players hit with Phase Blades will leave behind a Cosmic Simulacrum.

children.name: Cosmic Simulacrum
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Cosmic Simulcrums explode in a Collapsing Nova if placed within yards of each other.

children.name: Cosmic Shards
children.text:
Upon being destroyed the Cosmic Simulacrum erupts, inflicting Shadow damage to all players, and an additional Shadow damage every 1.5 sec for 6 sec. This effect stacks.

In addition, the eruption leaves behind a pool of Cosmic Residue.

children.name: Cosmic Residue
children.text: On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, Cosmic Residue will persist throughout the fight.

abilities.name: Decimate
abilities.text:
Sikran unleashes a barrage of cosmic eruptions from his polearm, inflicting Shadow damage to all players between himself and his targets.

Cosmic Simulacrum's that are hit by this effect are destroyed.

abilities.name: Shattering Sweep
abilities.text:
At 100 energy, Sikran swings his polearm in a deadly arc, inflicting Shadow damage to all enemies. This damage is decreased based on distance.

All remaining Cosmic Simulacrum are destroyed by this effect, and damage from Cosmic Shards is increased by 25% for each Simulacrum destroyed for 10 sec.

Additionally, players nearby are knocked back and have their damage taken increased by 25% for 20 sec.

abilities.name: Captain's Flourish
abilities.text: Sikran unleashes a barrage of maneuvers, executing two Exposes before ending with a Phase Lunge.

children.name: Expose
children.text: Sikran slashes at his target, inflicting Physical damage and exposing a weakness, increasing Physical damage taken by 100% for 6 sec.

children.name: Phase Lunge
children.text:
Sikran pierces his primary target, inflicting Shadow damage, Physical damage.

In addition, the target takes 100% increased damage from Phase Lunge for 30 sec.

abilities.name: Rain of Arrows
abilities.text: Sikran fires a volley of arrows into the air, falling throughout the area, inflicting Shadow damage to players within yds of impact.

bosses.name: Rasha'nan
bosses.description: Twisted by Queen Ansurek's experiments, Rasha'nan was transformed from a proud nerubian into a monstrous, winged horror. Trapped within her new form, shattered memories of her former self drive Rasha'nan into an unquenchable rage.

tips.text: •Waves of Rolling Acid move in the indicated direction and corrode any Sticky Webs into Acid Pools.

•Waves of Rolling Acid move in the indicated direction and corrode any Sticky Webs into Acid Pools.
•Infested Spawn roam freely after casting Infested Bite at their original target.
•Unmitigated damage from Savage Assault stacks as Savage Wound.

•Waves of Rolling Acid move in the indicated direction and corrode any Sticky Webs into Acid Pools.

•Infested Spawn-targeted players birth new enemies that rampage, castingInfested Bite repeatedly.

bosses.overview:
Wounded during the events of the Dawnbreaker, Rasha'nan begins the encounter Wounded in Battle at 60% health.

As the encounter progresses, she repositions around the arena casting Acidic Eruption and pelting players with Caustic Hail.

abilities.name: Rolling Acid
abilities.text:
Rasha'nan expels a poisonous concoction at marked targets which sloshes off in waves in the indicated direction from the target.

Players splashed by the initial corrosive eruption are caught in an Acidic Stupor.

Any player that touches a wave has their movement speed reduced by 50% and gains Corrosion every sec.

The waves incinerate Sticky Webs inflicting Nature damage to players nearby and creates Acid Pools.

children.name: Corrosion
children.text: Vile acid corrodes the target for, suffering Nature damage every sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Acidic Stupor
children.text: The propulsive expulsion of Rolling Acid inflicts Nature damage and stuns for.

children.name: Acid Pools
children.text: Erosive Spray, Caustic Hail, and Rolling Acid can form caustic zones for. Contact with this zone inflicts Nature damage every sec.

abilities.name: Spinneret's Strands
abilities.text: On this difficulty, Spinneret's Strands tether affects all players in the damage radius.

children.name: Spinneret's Websnap
children.text: Spinneret's Strands snap inflicting Nature damage to all players.

children.name: Sticky Webs
children.text: Spinneret's Strands' silken adhesive coats the arena inflicting Nature damage every sec and reducing movement speed by 10%.

abilities.name: Infested Spawn
abilities.text: On this difficulty, Infested Spawn's initial damage affects players in a radius around the marked target.

children.name: Infested Bite
children.text: On this difficulty, Infested Bite additionally reduces movement speed.

abilities.name: Savage Assault
abilities.text: Rasha'nan smashes her current target inflicting Physical damage and Nature damage. Additionally 60% of unmitigated damage is inflicted as a.

children.name: Savage Wound
children.text: Inflicts the unmitigated damage from Savage Assault as Physical and Nature damage every sec for. This effect stacks, adding to the effects of previous Savage Wounds.

abilities.name: Erosive Spray
abilities.text: Rasha'nan spews acid for inflicting Nature damage to all players plus an additional every sec, periodically applying Lingering Erosion.

children.name: Lingering Erosion
children.text: Erosive Spray jettisons globs of acid at players inflicting Nature damage every sec for. This effect stacks.

children.name: Acid Pools
children.text: Erosive Spray, Caustic Hail, and Rolling Acid can form caustic zones for. Contact with this zone inflicts Nature damage every sec.

abilities.name: Acidic Eruption
abilities.text: Until interrupted Rasha'nan thrashes about inflicting Nature damage to all players and increases Acidic Eruption damage by 100% for. This effect stacks.

children.name: Acidic Carapace
children.text: Successful Acidic Eruption casts form a temporay shell, granting Rasha'nan immunity from damage for.

abilities.name: Caustic Hail
abilities.text: Rasha'nan rains acid inflicting Nature damage to players near impact locations, occasionally creating Acid Pools.

children.name: Acid Pools
children.text: Erosive Spray, Caustic Hail, and Rolling Acid can form caustic zones for. Contact with this zone inflicts Nature damage every sec.

abilities.name: Tacky Burst
abilities.text: Rasha'nan violently expels webs while no players are in melee range, inflicting Nature damage plus an additional Nature damage every sec for. This effect stacks.

bosses.name: Broodtwister Ovi'nax
bosses.description: Deep within the bowels of the queen's palace, Broodtwister Ovi'nax conducts abominable experiments with the black blood found in Azj-kahet. This corpulent horror lumbers through the palace's cavernous depths, regurgitating inky sludge onto hatchlings to observe its gruesome effects.

tips.text:
• Volatile Concoction inflicts damage to all players based on how much health the target is missing when it is removed.
• Sanguine Overflow mutates any creatures it comes into contact with.
• Colossal Spiders inflict increasing damage with Vicious Bite.

• Experimental Dosage causes nearby eggs to hatch, unleashing the horrific experiments incubating within.
• Sticky Web immobilizes nearby players when removed.
• Blood Parasites Infest their target upon reaching them.

• Experimental Dosage causes nearby eggs to hatch, unleashing the horrific experiments incubating within.
• Broodtwister Ovi'nax inflicts increasing Shadow damage and healing absorbs as he receives more Unstable Infusions.
• Volatile Concoction inflicts damage to all players based on how much health the target is missing when it is removed.

bosses.overview:
Broodtwister Ovi'nax injects players with Experimental Dosage which causes nearby eggs to hatch upon expiration, unleashing the horrors within.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Broodtwister Ovi'nax will Ingest Black Blood, growing in power and causing the room to slowly fill with Sanguine Overflow

abilities.name: Experimental Dosage
abilities.text:
Broodtwister Ovi'nax injects a reactive catalyst into several players causing them to erupt after 8 sec, inflicting Shadow damage and absorbing healing to all players nearby.

Experimental Eggs caught in this effect are hatched.

children.name: Mutation: Necrotic
children.text: Coming into contact with mutates Colossal Spiders, increasing their health by 100% and empowering Vicious Bite to inflict Necrotic Wounds.

children.name: Vicious Bite
children.text:
The Colossal Spider bites its current target, inflicting Nature damage.

In addition, frenzy overtakes the spider, increasing its damage done by 25% until it is slain. This effect stacks.

children.name: Necrotic Wound
children.text: While empowered by Mutation: Necrotic, Vicious Bite also reduces healing done to the target by 10% for 15 sec.

children.name: Mutation: Ravenous
children.text: Coming into contact with mutates Voracious Worms, increasing their health by 100% and increases casting speed by 100%.

children.name: Poison Burst
children.text: The Voracious Worm unleashes a blast of toxic slime that inflicts Nature damage to all players.

children.name: Mutation: Accelerated
children.text:
Coming into contact with mutates Blood Parasites, increasing their health by 100%.

In addition, their inexorable desire to consume increases their movement speed by 10% every 1 sec until they are slain.

children.name: Fixate
children.text: Consuming hunger drives the Blood Parasite to fixate upon their prey and attempt to Infest it.

children.name: Infest
children.text:
Blood Parasite burrows into its target, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec for 10 sec.

Upon expiration, Blood Parasites erupt from the player and seek new prey.

abilities.name: Ingest Black Blood
abilities.text: Upon reaching full energy Broodtwister Ovi'nax charges towards a full canister of Black Blood and begins devouring it. Feasting upon the canisters contents unleashes torrents of Vile Discharge every 5 sec and inflicts Shadow damage that absorbs the next healing to all players. Upon finishing the canister, Broodtwister Ovi'nax gains Unstable Infusion.

children.name: Unstable Infusion
children.text: Waves of shadowy energy emanate from the Black Blood infused Broodtwister, inflicting Shadow damage and absorbing the next healing done to all players every 7.5 sec. In addition, waves of Vile Discharge are released every 7.5 sec.

children.name: Vile Discharge
children.text: Black Blood overloads Broodtwister Ovi'nax's system, unleashing a torrent of Vile Discharge inflicting Shadow damage on impact to players in the area.

abilities.name: Sanguine Overflow
abilities.text:
The canister of Black Blood leaks its contents across the floor of the chamber, slowly growing in size. This pool inflicts Shadow damage and absorbs the next healing received every 0.5 sec from players within the effect.

Experimental Eggs that come in contact with the pool trigger a Caustic Reaction.

children.name: Caustic Reaction
children.text: Black Blood causes the rapid incubation of any Experimental Eggs it touches, causing it to hatch and inflict Shadow damage to all players every 2 sec for 30 sec.

abilities.name: Volatile Concoction
abilities.text:
Broodtwister Ovi'nax injects a cocktail of unstable substances into his target, inflicting Nature damage and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

Upon expiration the chemicals react, inflicting additional Nature damage based on the target's missing health. This damage is reduced the healthier the target is.

bosses.name: Nexus-Princess Ky'veza
bosses.description: Nexus-Princess Ky'veza arrived at Nerub-ar Palace only recently, quickly establishing herself as a confidante of Queen Ansurek. However, rumors abound within the inner court that she may harbor a dark and deadly secret. If discovered, the princess is prepared to dispatch all witnesses without mercy...

tips.text:
•Chasmal Gash increases damage taken from each strike of Void Shredders.
•Players pulled into a Nether Rift become Atomized.
•Reaper attemps to execute players that are low health.

•Assassination creates Nether Phantoms that mirror some of Ky'veza's abilities.
•Players pulled into a Nether Rift become Atomized.
•Reaper attemps to execute players that are low health.

•Reaper attemps to execute players that are low health.
•Starless Night and Regicide inflict heavy damage across the raid.
•Players pulled into a Nether Rift become Atomized.

bosses.overview:
Ky'veza marks targets for their Assassination while haunting Nether Phantoms emerge from her shadow to mirror the massacre.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Ky'veza invokes a Starless Night as phantoms slaughter her enemies in the darkness.

children.name: Assassination
children.text:
Ky'veza marks several players for assassination. After sec, she shadowsteps to each target, inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby and applying Queensbane.

Creates a at each location.

children.name: Queensbane
children.text:
A dark venom fit for royalty. Inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec for 9 sec. This effect stacks.

Upon expiration, the void infection bursts inflicting Shadow damage.

children.name: Nether Phantom
children.text: A spectral image of Ky'veza that mirrors some of her attacks.

children.name: Nether Rift
children.text:
Ky'veza tears open a rift to the Twisting Nether, inflicting Shadow damage to players within yards.

The rift inflicts Shadow damage to all players every sec for 6 sec and pulls players towards its center.

children.name: Atomized
children.text: The Nether Rift vaporizes players pulled inside, inflicting Shadow damage every 0.25 sec.

children.name: Nexus Daggers
children.text: Ky'veza flings regal knives in multiple directions, inflicting Shadow damage to any player struck.

children.name: Stalking Shadows
children.text: The phantom's haunting presence inflicts Shadow damage to all players every 2 sec.

children.name: Twilight Massacre
children.text: Ky'veza commands each Nether Phantom to focus a target player. After sec, each phantom dashes towards their target, inflicting Shadow damage and applying Queensbane to any player in their path.

children.name: Queensbane
children.text:
A dark venom fit for royalty. Inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec for 9 sec. This effect stacks.

Upon expiration, the void infection bursts inflicting Shadow damage.

children.name: Nether Rift
children.text:
Ky'veza tears open a rift to the Twisting Nether, inflicting Shadow damage to players within yards.

The rift inflicts Shadow damage to all players every sec for 6 sec and pulls players towards its center.

children.name: Atomized
children.text: The Nether Rift vaporizes players pulled inside, inflicting Shadow damage every 0.25 sec.

children.name: Nexus Daggers
children.text: Ky'veza flings regal knives in multiple directions, inflicting Shadow damage to any player struck.

children.name: Reaper
children.text: When any player drops below 10% health, a shadow of Ky'veza emerges behind the target and attempts to execute them, inflicting Shadow damage.

children.name: Void Shredders
children.text: Ky'veza carves a series of deep lacerations into her current target. Each strike inflicts Physical damage and Shadow damage and leaves behind a Chasmal Gash.

children.name: Chasmal Gash
children.text: A gaping wound that inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec and increases damage taken from Void Shredder strikes by 25% for 35 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Starless Night
children.text: Upon reaching 100 energy, Ky'veza lifts into the air and pulses with darkness, inflicting Shadow damage to all players every 1 sec for 24 sec.

children.name: Eternal Night
children.text: The third Starless Night has no end, shrouding the chamber in an eternal darkness.

children.name: Regicide
children.text: Nether Phantoms dive through the shadows at targeted players, inflicting Shadow damage to players in their path.

children.name: Reaper
children.text: When any player drops below 10% health, a shadow of Ky'veza emerges behind the target and attempts to execute them, inflicting Shadow damage.

bosses.name: The Silken Court
bosses.description: Scarab Lord Anub'arash and Skeinspinner Takazj are Queen Ansurek's most trusted advisors, yet these two powerful nerubians harbor a hatred for each other even more powerful than their loyalty to the throne. While unleashing their considerable strength onto their enemies, each also fights to ensure their counterpart doesn't survive.

tips.text:
• Shatter Existence and Spike Storm apply heavy absorb shields to their casters.
• Players who are Impaled are stunned until their impaling spike is destroyed.
• Anub'arash summons scarabs into the chamber with Call of the Swarm.

• Stinging Swarm transfers to the nearest player or Takazj upon removal.
• Anub'arash becomes Entangled if he charges through Binding Webs.
• Burrowing Eruption and Unleashed Swarm inflict heavy raid damage.

• Anub'arash's Piercing Strike inflicts heavy Physical damage.
• Takazj moves throughout the chamber using Skittering Leap and Void Step.
• The fates of Anub'arash and Skeinspinner Takazj are linked through Queen's Proclamation.

bosses.overview:
The lords of the Silken Court fight as rivals for the queen's favor, alternatingly assaulting their enemies with Web Bomb and Reckless Charge.

Upon reaching 100 void energy, Takazj ascends into void form and begins to Shatter Existence.

After rejoining the battle, Anub'arash begins to summon Stinging Swarms as Takazj evokes Cataclysmic Entropy.

Upon reaching 100 anger, Anub'arash enters a raging fury and unleashes a Spike Storm.

Now with both members of the court at their full power, Anub'arash storms across the chamber with Reckless Charge as Takazj conjures Cataclysmic Entropy.

abilities.name: Queen's Proclamation
abilities.text: Anub'arash and Skeinspinner Takazj are bound to each other by the will of Queen Ansurek, sharing health

children.name: Reckless Charge
children.text:
Anub'arash charges forward, inflicting Nature damage to any player in his path and knocking them away. 

Upon colliding with a wall, Anub'arash releases a deadly shockwave that inflicts Nature damage to all players.

children.name: Burrowed Eruption
children.text: Anub'arash burrows into the ground then erupts from a nearby location, inflicting Nature damage and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec to all players for 12 sec.

children.name: Call of the Swarm
children.text: Anub'arash summons several Shattershell Scarabs that fixate upon players.

children.name: Scarab Lord's Perseverance
children.text: Upon reaching 100 energy, the Shattershell Scarab increases its movement speed by 25% and becomes immune to crowd control effects.

children.name: Impaling Eruption
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, players hit by a spike create a Mote of Unrelenting Rage or a Mote of Overwrought Paranoia.

children.name: Impaled
children.text: The spike impales the player, stunning them and inflicting Physical damage every 1 sec until destroyed.

children.name: Piercing Strike
children.text: Anub'arash pierces his current target, inflicting Physical damage and increasing damage inflicted by Piercing Strike by 100% for 35 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Web Bomb
children.text:
Takazj flings sticky knots of webbing throughout the chamber, slowing players’ movement speed by 20% and and inflicting Physical damage every 1 sec while within the area.

The central knot erupts when touched, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby and binding two players together in Binding Webs.

If Anub'arash charges through strands of Binding Webs, he becomes Entangled.

children.name: Binding Webs
children.text:
Sticky strands bind targets together, inflicting Physical damage every 0.5 sec and reducing movement speed by 20%.

Moving yards apart snaps the strands.

children.name: Entangled
children.text:
On Heroic difficulty, Anub'arash needs to charge through 2 Binding Web strands to be entangled.

On Mythic difficulty, Anub'arash needs to charge through 3 Binding Web strands to be entangled.

children.name: Venomous Rain
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, players hit create a Mote of Unrelenting Rage or a Mote of Overwrought Paranoia.

children.name: Skittering Leap

The webs periodically explode, knocking players back while inflicting Shadow damage and an additional Shadow damage every 3 sec for 12 sec.

children.name: Scarab Lord's Perseverance

children.name: Piercing Strike
