bosses.name: Queen Ansurek
bosses.description: After a revelation of traitors in her court, Queen Ansurek decides she must eradicate the palace's invaders herself. However, paranoia over whom she can trust gnaws at her psyche. With her allies dwindling, Queen Ansurek may delve into dark powers to attain victory, even if that means her most loyal soldiers become her next meal...

abilities.name: Stage One: A Queen's Venom
abilities.text: Ansurek battles with poison and web to show her mastery of traditional Nerubian power.

children.name: Reactive Toxin
children.text:
Ansurek afflicts players with a toxin, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec for 6 sec to players nearby.

Upon expiration, the toxin forms into Reactive Froth, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby and knocking them away.

children.name: Reactive Froth
children.text:
When a player touches the froth, it bursts, afflicting them with.

This burst launches players nearby into the air and inflicts Nature damage to all players A glob of venom also launches, splattering into Toxic Waves.

Venom Nova disperses burst froth into a pool of Acid.

children.name: Acid
children.text: Ansurek's acid inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec to players within it.

children.name: Toxic Waves
children.text:
A toxic splatter inflicts Nature damage to players near the impact.

Waves of poison roll outward, inflicting Nature damage to players in their paths and knocking them away.

children.name: Venom Nova
children.text:
Ansurek unleashes a ring of venom, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby.

The ring expands, inflicting Nature damage every 0.5 sec for 8 sec to players that touch it and slowing them by 50%.

 Occurs if the ring touches Reactive Froth.

children.name: Silken Tomb
children.text:
Ansurek roots all players in webbing, inflicting Nature damage to players near the webbing's impact. This webbing inflicts Nature damage to its victims every 1 sec until destroyed.

Upon destruction, the webbing leaves behind.

children.name: [PH]
children.text:
Ansurek injects her current target with digestive juices, inflicting Nature damage and Physical damage.

This injection inflicts an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 30 sec and causes the victim to take 200% increased Physical damage.

Poison overflows from Ansurek when she injects her target, causing an Acid Explosion.

children.name: Acid Explosion
children.text:
Acidic venom explodes outward from Ansurek, forming a large pool of Acid underneath her.

Globs of her venom launch towards players, inflicting Nature damage to players near the impacts and forming Acid.

children.name: Acid
children.text: Ansurek's acid inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec to players within it.

children.name: Feast
children.text:
Ansurek feasts on a chunk of her current target's flesh, inflicting Physical damage and causing absorption of the next healing.

This wound absorbs additional healing equal to of the Physical damage done.

children.name: Web Blades
children.text: Silk strands pull bladed webbing towards players, inflicting Nature damage to players struck and slowing them by 95% for 3 sec.

children.name: Acrid Presence
children.text: Ansurek radiates acidic fumes, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 2 sec.

abilities.name: Intermission: The Spider's Web
abilities.text: Ansurek shrouds herself in webbing and feeds on her weakened enemies.

children.name: Predation
children.text:
Ansurek attaches Predation Threads to all players and gains a web shield that absorbs damage.

While shielded, she assaults players with Paralyzing Venom and occasionally yanks players towards her, devouring any that get within yards.

children.name: Predation Threads
children.text: Ansurek's web threads inflict Nature damage every 1.5 sec to players near each victim.

children.name: Paralyzing Venom
children.text:
Ansurek splashes venom, slowing all players by 4% and increasing damage taken from Wrest by 20%. This effect stacks.

Additionally, each splash ejects.

children.name: Paralyzing Waves
children.text: Rolling waves of poison inflict Nature damage to players in their paths, knocking them away and applying Paralyzing Venom.

children.name: Wrest
children.text: Ansurek violently yanks all players towards her, inflicting Nature damage.

children.name: Devour
children.text: Ansurek devours her victim, inflicting Physical damage.

abilities.name: Stage Two: Royal Ascension
abilities.text: Ansurek calls reinforcements to her aid as she ascends to her private chamber.

children.name: [PH]
children.text: Ansurek shoots acid at players, inflicting Nature damage and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 30 sec.

children.name: Wrest
children.text: Ansurek connects Predation Threads to players and violently yanks them towards her, inflicting Nature damage.

children.name: Predation Threads
children.text: Ansurek's web threads inflict Nature damage every 1.5 sec to players near each victim.

children.name: Acidic Apocalypse
children.text: Ansurek eradicates players with burning acid, inflicting Nature damage to all players and an additional Nature damage every 2 sec.

children.name: Shadowblast
children.text: The Ascended Voidspeaker annihilates a player with shadowy energy, inflicting Shadow damage.

children.name: Radiating Gloom
children.text:
The Ascended Voidspeaker inflicts Shadow damage every 3 sec to players nearby and periodically forms.

The orbs eject after a short delay, inflicting Shadow damage to players near the ejection's epicenter.

Upon the Ascended Voidspeaker's death, Gloom Eruption occurs.

children.name: Gloom Eruption
children.text:
The Ascended Voidspeaker's essence destabilizes shortly after death, inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby and knocking them away.

This explosion causes Gloom to expand rapidly from the epicenter.

children.name: Gloom
children.text: Darkness clings to the ground, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec to players within it.

children.name: Echoing Connection
children.text:
The caster shares a dark connection with others of its type, echoing 100% of damage taken to the others.

If close together, these creatures resonate, becoming immune to all damage and pulsing Shadow damage to all players every 1.5 sec. This damage increases by 100% with each pulse.

children.name: Gloom Touch
children.text:
The Devoted Worshipper periodically afflicts players with dark energy, inflicting Shadow damage every 1.5 sec to the victims for 12 sec.

Upon removal, a occurs

children.name: Worshipper's Protection
children.text: The Devoted Worshipper exchanges its health for an absorption shield and protects Ansurek from all damage.

children.name: Cosmic Apocalypse
children.text:
The Devoted Worshipper unleashes lethal cosmic power, inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby and an additional Shadow damage every 2 sec.

The explosion forms Gloom.

children.name: Gloom
children.text: Darkness clings to the ground, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec to players within it.

children.name: Oust
children.text:
The Chamber Guardian inflicts Physical damage and Shadow damage to its target, knocking them away.

This ability ejects Ousting Fragments.

children.name: Ousting Fragments
children.text: Dark fragments of energy inflict Shadow damage to players near the impacts, knocking them away.

children.name: Echoing Connection
children.text:
The caster shares a dark connection with others of its type, echoing 100% of damage taken to the others.

If close together, these creatures resonate, becoming immune to all damage and pulsing Shadow damage to all players every 1.5 sec. This damage increases by 100% with each pulse.

children.name: Expulsion Beam
children.text: The Chamber Expeller teleports away and then fires a cosmic beam towards a player, inflicting Shadow damage to players hit and knocking them away.

children.name: Echoing Connection
children.text:
The caster shares a dark connection with others of its type, echoing 100% of damage taken to the others.

If close together, these creatures resonate, becoming immune to all damage and pulsing Shadow damage to all players every 1.5 sec. This damage increases by 100% with each pulse.

children.name: Caustic Skitterer
children.text: Caustic Skitterers land and attack nearby players.

abilities.name: Stage Three: Paranoia's Feast
abilities.text: Ansurek embraces a dark power as paranoia takes hold.

children.name: Abyssal Infusion
children.text:
Ansurek afflicts players with dark energy, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec for 6 sec to players nearby.

Upon expiration, the energy ruptures into an Abyssal Conduit, inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby and knocking them away.

children.name: Abyssal Conduit
children.text:
Void conduits tear open, inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby and launching Conduit Ejections.

The conduits teleport players between them when touched, inflicting Shadow damage.

When these conduits destabilize, a Conduit Collapse occurs.

children.name: Conduit Collapse
children.text:
The conduit collapses, inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby.

This destabilization launches Conduit Ejections and forms Gloom.

children.name: Conduit Ejections
children.text: Abyssal fragments inflict Shadow damage to players in their paths, knocking them away.

children.name: Gloom
children.text: Darkness clings to the ground, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec to players within it.

children.name: Frothing Gluttony
children.text:
Ansurek draws in a ring of cosmic energy, inflicting Shadow damage every 0.5 sec for 8 sec to players that touch it and slowing them by 50%. She pulls players towards her with Glutton Threads, consuming victims within yards.

Ansurek also consumes living Summoned Acolytes upon casting this ability, causing Froth Vapor.

children.name: Glutton Threads
children.text: Ansurek's web threads grip all players, pulling them towards her frothing maw. This pull force increases over time.

children.name: Froth Vapor
children.text:
The essence of Ansurek's acolyte vaporizes, inflicting Shadow damage to all players and slowing their movement speed by 40% for 10 sec. This effect stacks.

Ansurek consumes this vapor, increasing her damage done by 100% for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Consume
children.text: Ansurek consumes the essence of her victim, inflicting Shadow damage.

children.name: Queen's Summons
children.text:
Ansurek lets forth a ghastly shriek, inflicting Shadow damage to all players and calling Summoned Acolytes to her aid.

Upon death, they become.

children.name: Dark Barrier
children.text: The Summoned Acolyte's shadowy barrier absorbs damage and prevents crowd controlling effects.

children.name: Null Detonation
children.text: The Summoned Acolyte inflicts Shadow damage to all players. Each successful cast increases its damage done by 50%.

children.name: Royal Condemnation
children.text:
Ansurek forms silken spikes that drop onto marked players, inflicting Nature damage to all players, reduced with distance.

The impacts form.

children.name: Infest
children.text:
Ansurek injects her current target with shadow-infused egg sacs, inflicting Shadow damage and Physical damage. Additionally, the victims suffer Shadow damage every 1 sec for 5 sec.

Upon expiration, the sacs erupt in an Infested Gloomburst.

children.name: Infested Gloomburst
children.text: Gloom Hatchlings burst from the infested victim, inflicting Shadow damage to all players nearby.

children.name: Gloom Hatchling
children.text:
Shadowy spiderlings rush towards Ansurek. If they reach her, she devours them, inflicting Shadow damage to all players and increasing her damage done by 20% for 20 sec.

Upon death, these spiderlings leak Gloom.

children.name: [PH]
children.text:
Ansurek tears ravenously into her current target every 0.5 sec for 2.5 sec, inflicting Physical damage with each strike and increasing Physical damage taken for 45 sec. This effect stacks.

These strikes cause Gloom Splatter and inflict Shadow damage to all players. An additional 7% of their Physical damage also occurs as Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Gloom Splatter
children.text: Shadowy globs launch towards players, inflicting Shadow damage to players near the impacts and forming.

children.name: Web Blades
children.text: Silk strands pull bladed webbing towards players, inflicting Nature damage to players struck and slowing them by 95% for 3 sec.

children.name: Dreadful Presence
children.text:
Ansurek radiates dreadful energy, inflicting Shadow damage every 2 sec to all players. This damage permanently increases by ~1% whenever open.

If she casts Frothing Gluttony with ~2 applications of this effect, her cosmic energy overflows, granting her Cataclysmic Evolution.

children.name: Cataclysmic Evolution
children.text: All Gloom rapidly expands and Ansurek recasts Frothing Gluttony indefinitely.

loot.name: Formula: Enchant Weapon - Authority of the Depths

normal.name: Nerub-ar Palace
normal.description: Deep within the kingdom of Azj-Kahet lies Nerub-ar Palace, Queen Ansurek's seat of power. From this shadowed throne Queen Ansurek has tightened her grip on her Sureki followers, leading them along a dark path to a new future. As her paranoia grows, the members of the conspiratorial Severed Threads launch their final gambit against Ansurek's rule.

bosses.name: Ulgrax the Devourer
bosses.description: Queen Ansurek's evolutionary experimentation created a number of monstrous guardians for her throne, none more voracious than Ulgrax the Devourer. Driven mad by endless hunger, Ulgrax is now the ravenous protector of Queen Ansurek's court.

tips.text:
• Stalker's Webbing will root players on contact.
•Ravenous Spawn continually Disembowel a player.

•Digestive Acid inflicts significant damage to nearby allies when removed.
•Each application of Insatiable Rage increases Ulgrax's damage.

•Ravenous Spawn continually place applications of Disembowel on a player.
•Excessively Tenderized players will become unable to be healed.

bosses.overview:
Ulgrax attempts to devour players by engaging in a Carnivorous Contest and places globs of Stalker's Webbing throughout the arena.

At zero energy, Ulgrax goes mad with hunger, attacking players with Juggernaut Charge. Ulgrax then demands to be fed, unleashing Hungering Bellows until his energy is brought to full.

children.name: Carnivorous Contest
children.text: In Mythic difficulty, bound players will emerge from the Contest Battered and Bruised. Ulgrax will enter a Contemptful Rage if fewer than players participate in the Contest.

children.name: Devour
children.text: Ulgrax devours the player inflicting Physical damage every 1 sec.

children.name: Stalker's Webbing
children.text: Ulgrax shoots webs over random destinations, inflicting Nature damage to players near impact and leaving behind Stalker's Netting.

children.name: Stalker's Netting
children.text: Ulgrax traps players, rooting them for 8 sec. Players trapped suffer Nature damage every 2 sec.

children.name: Digestive Acid
children.text:
Ulgrax belches Digestive Acid at several players, inflicting Nature damage every 2 sec for 6 sec.

Once removed venom erupts the victim's skin, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby and dissolving any webbing left behind by Stalker's Webbing.

children.name: Venomous Lash
children.text: Ulgrax flings poison at all players, inflicting Nature damage on impact and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 6 sec.

children.name: Brutal Crush
children.text: Ulgrax crushes the current threat target, inflicting Physical damage and applications of Tenderized.

children.name: Tenderized
children.text: Reduces healing taken by 10%. This effect stacks, but loses an application every 1 sec.

children.name: Hulking Crash
children.text: Ulgrax leaps to the center of the arena and smashes the ground, inflicting Physical damage and knocking back all players. Players farther from the target receive less damage.

children.name: Ready to Feed
children.text: Ulgrax refuses to move until fed, meanwile damage taken from all sources is reduced by 99%.

children.name: Hungering Bellows
children.text:
Ulgrax screams for food, inflicting Physical damage to all players on impact and an additional Physical damage every 1 sec for 3 sec.

Ulgrax's Insatiable Rage builds with each Bellow.

children.name: Insatiable Rage
children.text: Ulgrax increases his Physical damage done by 10% for 20 sec.

children.name: Juggernaut Charge
children.text:
Ulgrax emerges from the Swallowing Darkness and charges across the arena, inflicting Shadow damage to players caught in his path.

Ulgrax re-enters the Darkness on the opposite side of the arena, inflicting Shadow damage instantly and Shadow damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

children.name: Ravenous Spawn
children.text: Ulgrax spawns a host of delectible insects.

children.name: Disembowel
children.text: Bites at the player's guts, inflicting Physical damage and an additional Physical damage every 2 sec for 10 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Chunky Viscera
children.text: On death, the beetles innards spill across the floor creating a tempting treat for Ulgrax.

children.name: Feed
children.text: Hurl viscera into Ulgrax's gullet to sate his hunger.

children.name: Stalker's Webbing
children.text: Ulgrax shoots webs over random destinations, inflicting Nature damage to players near impact and leaving behind Stalker's Netting.

children.name: Stalker's Netting
children.text: Ulgrax traps players, rooting them for 8 sec. Players trapped suffer Nature damage every 2 sec.

children.name: Swallowing Darkness
children.text: Ulgrax emerges from the Swallowing Darkness rift to sate his hunger. The Darkness inflicts Shadow damage to players in the area and destroys.

bosses.name: The Bloodbound Horror
bosses.description: In the dark pits below Nerub-ar Palace, the blood of the Old Gods congeals in foul, black pools. The Bloodbound Horror rises from this vile ooze - drawing everything in its path into The Unseeming.

tips.text:
•Gruesome Disgorge sends players in front of The Bloodbound Horror into The Unseeming.
•Forgotten Harbingers Manifest Horrors until defeated.
•Grasp From Beyond forms underneath random players.

•Gruesome Disgorge sends players in front of The Bloodbound Horror into The Unseeming.

•Lost Watcher's Spectral Slam inflicts heavy Physical damage.

•Gruesome Disgorge sends players in front of The Bloodbound Horror into The Unseeming.
•Crimson Rain absorbs a large amount of healing.
•Goresplatter inflicts heavy magical damage over time.

bosses.overview:
The Bloodbound Horror periodically manifests creatures into The Unseeming to aid its assault. When splattered by Gruesome Disgorge players enter The Unseeming and can attack the creatures directly.

Upon reaching 100 energy, The Bloodbound Horror assails players with Goresplatter, inflicting deadly damage to those caught within.

abilities.name: Gruesome Disgorge
abilities.text: The Bloodbound Horror vomits Black Blood in a cone in front of itself, inflicting Shadow damage and an additional Shadow damage every 2 sec for 40 sec. Players under this effect briefly peer into The Unseeming.

children.name: The Unseeming
children.text: A shadowy realm below reality where true horrors lurk.

children.name: Black Bulwark
children.text: The Lost Watcher channels the essence of The Unseeming into The Bloodbound Horror, causing it to absorb damage, increasing every 1 sec for 10 sec.

children.name: Spectral Slam
children.text: The Lost Watcher slams their current target, inflicting Physical damage.

children.name: Manifest Horror
children.text: The Forgotten Harbinger manifests a Blood Horror out of The Unseeming that slowly moves toward The Bloodbound Horror.

children.name: Blood Pact
children.text: Blood Horrors that reach The Bloodbound Horror explode, inflicting Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Unseeming Blight
children.text: The return to reality scars the player, increasing damage taken from Gruesome Disgorge by 500% for 1 min.

abilities.name: Goresplatter
abilities.text:
The Bloodbound Horror siphons Black Blood from the surrounding pool granting itself a Seeping Transfusion. It then unleashes a torrent of Black Blood that washes over all players nearby, inflicting Shadow damage.

Residue sticks to remaining players, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec for 10 sec.

children.name: Seeping Transfusion
children.text: The Bloodbound Horror transfuses the Black Blood into its body, increasing its damage done by 10%. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Crimson Rain
abilities.text: The Bloodbound Horror coats each player in vile blood, causing them to absorb ${*} healing.

abilities.name: Grasp From Beyond
abilities.text:
The Bloodbound Horror focuses The Unseeming on to multiple players, manifesting tentacles at their location every 1 sec for 12 sec.

After sec each tentacle erupts, inflicting Shadow damage to all players nearby.

abilities.name: Black Sepsis
abilities.text: If no players are within reach, The Bloodbound Horror continually expels contaminated blood that inflicts Shadow damage to all players every 2 sec.

bosses.name: Sikran, Captain of the Sureki
bosses.description: Sikran established himself as an arrogant duelist within Queen Ansurek's court. Never knowing the cut of an enemy's blade, Sikran dispatched his rivals one-by-one and was proclaimed Captain of the Sureki by the queen herself. This indomitable fighter now ensures that any who threaten his queen fall before the throne's might.

tips.text:
• Cosmic Simulacrums inflict light damage to all players while active.

• Upon destruction,Cosmic Simulacrums apply Cosmic Shards to all players.

• Phase Blades inflicts heavy damage over time to all players hit and reduces healing taken.

• Phase Blades leave behind Cosmic Simulacrums for every player hit.

• Cosmic Simulacrums are destroyed after being hit by Decimate and Shattering Sweep.

• Captain's Flourish inflicts light damage with Expose then finishes with Phase Lunge.

• Phase Lunge inflcts heavy Physical and Shadow damage, and increases damage taken by Phase Lunge.

• Decimate expels cosmic spears from the boss location and breaks all Cosmic Simulacrums hit.

bosses.overview:
Sikran's Phase Blade rips through the cosmos, and leaves behind a Cosmic Simulacrum which can then be destroyed by Decimate.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Sikran casts Shattering Sweep, destroying all remaining Cosmic Simulacrums

abilities.name: Phase Blades
abilities.text: On Heroic and Mythic difficulties all players hit with Phase Blades will leave behind a Cosmic Simulacrum.

children.name: Cosmic Simulacrum
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Cosmic Simulcrums explode in a Collapsing Nova if placed within yards of each other.

children.name: Cosmic Shards
children.text:
Upon being destroyed the Cosmic Simulacrum erupts, inflicting Shadow damage to all players, and an additional Shadow damage every 1.5 sec for 6 sec. This effect stacks.

In addition, the eruption leaves behind a pool of Cosmic Residue.

children.name: Cosmic Residue
children.text: On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, Cosmic Residue will persist throughout the fight.

abilities.name: Decimate
abilities.text:
Sikran unleashes a barrage of cosmic eruptions from his polearm, inflicting Shadow damage to all players between himself and his targets.

Cosmic Simulacrum's that are hit by this effect are destroyed.

abilities.name: Shattering Sweep
abilities.text:
At 100 energy, Sikran swings his polearm in a deadly arc, inflicting Shadow damage to all enemies. This damage is decreased based on distance.

All remaining Cosmic Simulacrum are destroyed by this effect, and damage from Cosmic Shards is increased by 25% for each Simulacrum destroyed for 10 sec.

Additionally, players nearby are knocked back and have their damage taken increased by 25% for 20 sec.

abilities.name: Captain's Flourish
abilities.text: Sikran unleashes a barrage of maneuvers, executing two Exposes before ending with a Phase Lunge.

children.name: Expose
children.text: Sikran slashes at his target, inflicting Physical damage and exposing a weakness, increasing Physical damage taken by 100% for 6 sec.

children.name: Phase Lunge
children.text:
Sikran pierces his primary target, inflicting Shadow damage, Physical damage.

In addition, the target takes 100% increased damage from Phase Lunge for 30 sec.

abilities.name: Rain of Arrows
abilities.text: Sikran fires a volley of arrows into the air, falling throughout the area, inflicting Shadow damage to players within yds of impact.

bosses.name: Rasha'nan
bosses.description: Twisted by Queen Ansurek's experiments, Rasha'nan was transformed from a proud nerubian into a monstrous, winged horror. Trapped within her new form, shattered memories of her former self drive Rasha'nan into an unquenchable rage.

tips.text: •Waves of Rolling Acid move in the indicated direction and corrode any Sticky Webs into Acid Pools.

•Waves of Rolling Acid move in the indicated direction and corrode any Sticky Webs into Acid Pools.
•Infested Spawn roam freely after casting Infested Bite at their original target.
•Unmitigated damage from Savage Assault stacks as Savage Wound.

•Waves of Rolling Acid move in the indicated direction and corrode any Sticky Webs into Acid Pools.

•Infested Spawn-targeted players birth new enemies that rampage, castingInfested Bite repeatedly.

bosses.overview:
Wounded during the events of the Dawnbreaker, Rasha'nan begins the encounter Wounded in Battle at 60% health.

As the encounter progresses, she repositions around the arena casting Acidic Eruption and pelting players with Caustic Hail.

abilities.name: Rolling Acid
abilities.text:
Rasha'nan expels a poisonous concoction at marked targets which sloshes off in waves in the indicated direction from the target.

Players splashed by the initial corrosive eruption are caught in an Acidic Stupor.

Any player that touches a wave has their movement speed reduced by 50% and gains Corrosion every sec.

The waves incinerate Sticky Webs inflicting Nature damage to players nearby and creates Acid Pools.

children.name: Corrosion
children.text: Vile acid corrodes the target for, suffering Nature damage every sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Acidic Stupor
children.text: The propulsive expulsion of Rolling Acid inflicts Nature damage and stuns for.

children.name: Acid Pools
children.text: Erosive Spray, Caustic Hail, and Rolling Acid can form caustic zones for. Contact with this zone inflicts Nature damage every sec.

abilities.name: Spinneret's Strands
abilities.text: On this difficulty, Spinneret's Strands tether affects all players in the damage radius.

children.name: Spinneret's Websnap
children.text: Spinneret's Strands snap inflicting Nature damage to all players.

children.name: Sticky Webs
children.text: Spinneret's Strands' silken adhesive coats the arena inflicting Nature damage every sec and reducing movement speed by 10%.

abilities.name: Infested Spawn
abilities.text: On this difficulty, Infested Spawn's initial damage affects players in a radius around the marked target.

children.name: Infested Bite
children.text: On this difficulty, Infested Bite additionally reduces movement speed.

abilities.name: Savage Assault
abilities.text: Rasha'nan smashes her current target inflicting Physical damage and Nature damage. Additionally 60% of unmitigated damage is inflicted as a.

children.name: Savage Wound
children.text: Inflicts the unmitigated damage from Savage Assault as Physical and Nature damage every sec for. This effect stacks, adding to the effects of previous Savage Wounds.

abilities.name: Erosive Spray
abilities.text: Rasha'nan spews acid for inflicting Nature damage to all players plus an additional every sec, periodically applying Lingering Erosion.

children.name: Lingering Erosion
children.text: Erosive Spray jettisons globs of acid at players inflicting Nature damage every sec for. This effect stacks.

children.name: Acid Pools
children.text: Erosive Spray, Caustic Hail, and Rolling Acid can form caustic zones for. Contact with this zone inflicts Nature damage every sec.

abilities.name: Acidic Eruption
abilities.text: Until interrupted Rasha'nan thrashes about inflicting Nature damage to all players and increases Acidic Eruption damage by 100% for. This effect stacks.

children.name: Acidic Carapace
children.text: Successful Acidic Eruption casts form a temporay shell, granting Rasha'nan immunity from damage for.

abilities.name: Caustic Hail
abilities.text: Rasha'nan rains acid inflicting Nature damage to players near impact locations, occasionally creating Acid Pools.

children.name: Acid Pools
children.text: Erosive Spray, Caustic Hail, and Rolling Acid can form caustic zones for. Contact with this zone inflicts Nature damage every sec.

abilities.name: Tacky Burst
abilities.text: Rasha'nan violently expels webs while no players are in melee range, inflicting Nature damage plus an additional Nature damage every sec for. This effect stacks.

bosses.name: Broodtwister Ovi'nax
bosses.description: Deep within the bowels of the queen's palace, Broodtwister Ovi'nax conducts abominable experiments with the black blood found in Azj-kahet. This corpulent horror lumbers through the palace's cavernous depths, regurgitating inky sludge onto hatchlings to observe its gruesome effects.

tips.text:
• Volatile Concoction inflicts damage to all players based on how much health the target is missing when it is removed.
• Sanguine Overflow mutates any creatures it comes into contact with.
• Colossal Spiders inflict increasing damage with Vicious Bite.

• Experimental Dosage causes nearby eggs to hatch, unleashing the horrific experiments incubating within.
• Sticky Web immobilizes nearby players when removed.
• Blood Parasites Infest their target upon reaching them.

• Experimental Dosage causes nearby eggs to hatch, unleashing the horrific experiments incubating within.
• Broodtwister Ovi'nax inflicts increasing Shadow damage and healing absorbs as he receives more Unstable Infusions.

bosses.overview:
Broodtwister Ovi'nax injects players with Experimental Dosage which causes nearby eggs to hatch upon expiration, unleashing the horrors within.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Broodtwister Ovi'nax will Ingest Black Blood, growing in power and causing the room to slowly fill with Sanguine Overflow

abilities.name: Experimental Dosage
abilities.text:
Broodtwister Ovi'nax injects a reactive catalyst into several players causing them to erupt after 8 sec, inflicting Shadow damage and absorbing healing to all players nearby.

Experimental Eggs caught in this effect are hatched.

children.name: Mutation: Necrotic
children.text: Coming into contact with mutates Colossal Spiders, increasing their health by 100% and empowering Vicious Bite to inflict Necrotic Wounds.

children.name: Vicious Bite
children.text:
The Colossal Spider bites its current target, inflicting Nature damage.

In addition, frenzy overtakes the spider, increasing its damage done by 25% until it is slain. This effect stacks.

children.name: Necrotic Wound
children.text: While empowered by Mutation: Necrotic, Vicious Bite also reduces healing done to the target by 10% for 15 sec.

children.name: Mutation: Ravenous
children.text: Coming into contact with mutates Voracious Worms, increasing their health by 100% and increases casting speed by 100%.

children.name: Poison Burst
children.text: The Voracious Worm unleashes a blast of toxic slime that inflicts Nature damage to all players.

children.name: Mutation: Accelerated
children.text:
Coming into contact with mutates Blood Parasites, increasing their health by 100%.

In addition, their inexorable desire to consume increases their movement speed by 10% every 1 sec until they are slain.

children.name: Fixate
children.text: Consuming hunger drives the Blood Parasite to fixate upon their prey and attempt to Infest it.

children.name: Infest
children.text:
Blood Parasite burrows into its target, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec for 10 sec.

Upon expiration, Blood Parasites erupt from the player and seek new prey.

abilities.name: Ingest Black Blood
abilities.text: Upon reaching full energy Broodtwister Ovi'nax charges towards a full canister of Black Blood and begins devouring it. Feasting upon the canisters contents unleashes torrents of Vile Discharge every 5 sec and inflicts Shadow damage that absorbs the next healing to all players. Upon finishing the canister, Broodtwister Ovi'nax gains Unstable Infusion.

children.name: Unstable Infusion
children.text: Waves of shadowy energy emanate from the Black Blood infused Broodtwister, inflicting Shadow damage and absorbing the next healing done to all players every 7.5 sec. In addition, waves of Vile Discharge are released every 7.5 sec.

children.name: Vile Discharge
children.text: Black Blood overloads Broodtwister Ovi'nax's system, unleashing a torrent of Vile Discharge inflicting Shadow damage on impact to players in the area.

abilities.name: Sanguine Overflow
abilities.text:
The canister of Black Blood leaks its contents across the floor of the chamber, slowly growing in size. This pool inflicts Shadow damage and absorbs the next healing received every 0.5 sec from players within the effect.

Experimental Eggs that come in contact with the pool trigger a Caustic Reaction.

children.name: Caustic Reaction
children.text: Black Blood causes the rapid incubation of any Experimental Eggs it touches, causing it to hatch and inflict Shadow damage to all players every 2 sec for 30 sec.

abilities.name: Volatile Concoction
abilities.text:
Broodtwister Ovi'nax injects a cocktail of unstable substances into his target, inflicting Nature damage and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

Upon expiration the chemicals react, inflicting additional Nature damage based on the target's missing health. This damage is reduced the healthier the target is.

bosses.name: Nexus-Princess Ky'veza
bosses.description: Nexus-Princess Ky'veza arrived at Nerub-ar Palace only recently, quickly establishing herself as a confidante of Queen Ansurek. However, rumors abound within the inner court that she may harbor a dark and deadly secret. If discovered, the princess is prepared to dispatch all witnesses without mercy...

tips.text:
•Chasmal Gash increases damage taken from each strike of Void Shredders.
•Players pulled into a Nether Rift become Atomized.
•Reaper attemps to execute players that are low health.

•Assassination creates Nether Phantoms that mirror some of Ky'veza's abilities.
•Players pulled into a Nether Rift become Atomized.
•Reaper attemps to execute players that are low health.

bosses.overview:
Ky'veza marks targets for their Assassination while haunting Nether Phantoms emerge from her shadow to mirror the massacre.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Ky'veza invokes a Starless Night as phantoms slaughter her enemies in the darkness.

children.name: Assassination
children.text:
Ky'veza marks several players for assassination. After sec, she shadowsteps to each target, inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby and applying Queensbane.

Creates a at each location.

children.name: Queensbane
children.text:
A dark venom fit for royalty. Inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec for 9 sec. This effect stacks.

Upon expiration, the void infection bursts inflicting Shadow damage.

children.name: Nether Phantom
children.text: A spectral image of Ky'veza that mirrors some of her attacks.

children.name: Nether Rift
children.text:
Ky'veza tears open a rift to the Twisting Nether, inflicting Shadow damage to players within yards.

The rift inflicts Shadow damage to all players every sec for 6 sec and pulls players towards its center.

children.name: Atomized
children.text: The Nether Rift vaporizes players pulled inside, inflicting Shadow damage every 0.25 sec.

children.name: Nexus Daggers
children.text: Ky'veza flings regal knives in multiple directions, inflicting Shadow damage to any player struck.

children.name: Stalking Shadows
children.text: The phantom's haunting presence inflicts Shadow damage to all players every 2 sec.

children.name: Twilight Massacre
children.text: Ky'veza commands each Nether Phantom to focus a target player. After sec, each phantom dashes towards their target, inflicting Shadow damage and applying Queensbane to any player in their path.

children.name: Queensbane

Upon expiration, the void infection bursts inflicting Shadow damage.

The rift inflicts Shadow damage to all players every sec for 6 sec and pulls players towards its center.

children.text: Ky'veza flings regal knives in multiple directions, inflicting Shadow damage to any player struck.

children.name: Reaper
children.text: When any player drops below 10% health, a shadow of Ky'veza emerges behind the target and attempts to execute them, inflicting Shadow damage.

children.name: Void Shredders
children.text: Ky'veza carves a series of deep lacerations into her current target. Each strike inflicts Physical damage and Shadow damage and leaves behind a Chasmal Gash.

children.name: Chasmal Gash
children.text: A gaping wound that inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec and increases damage taken from Void Shredder strikes by 25% for 35 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Starless Night
children.text: Upon reaching 100 energy, Ky'veza lifts into the air and pulses with darkness, inflicting Shadow damage to all players every 1 sec for 24 sec.

children.name: Eternal Night
children.text: The third Starless Night has no end, shrouding the chamber in an eternal darkness.

children.name: Regicide
children.text: Nether Phantoms dive through the shadows at targeted players, inflicting Shadow damage to players in their path.

children.name: Reaper
children.text: When any player drops below 10% health, a shadow of Ky'veza emerges behind the target and attempts to execute them, inflicting Shadow damage.

bosses.name: The Silken Court
bosses.description: Scarab Lord Anub'arash and Skeinspinner Takazj are Queen Ansurek's most trusted advisors, yet these two powerful nerubians harbor a hatred for each other even more powerful than their loyalty to the throne. While unleashing their considerable strength onto their enemies, each also fights to ensure their counterpart doesn't survive.

tips.text:
• Shatter Existence and Spike Storm apply heavy absorb shields to their casters.
• Players who are Impaled are stunned until their impaling spike is destroyed.
• Anub'arash summons scarabs into the chamber with Call of the Swarm.

• Stinging Swarm transfers to the nearest player or Takazj upon removal.
• Anub'arash becomes Entangled if he charges through Binding Webs.
• Burrowing Eruption and Unleashed Swarm inflict heavy raid damage.

• Anub'arash's Piercing Strike inflicts heavy Physical damage.
• Takazj moves throughout the chamber using Skittering Leap and Void Step.
• The fates of Anub'arash and Skeinspinner Takazj are linked through Queen's Proclamation.

bosses.overview:
The lords of the Silken Court fight as rivals for the queen's favor, alternatingly assaulting their enemies with Web Bomb and Reckless Charge.

Upon reaching 100 void energy, Takazj ascends into void form and begins to Shatter Existence.

After rejoining the battle, Anub'arash begins to summon Stinging Swarms as Takazj evokes Cataclysmic Entropy.

Upon reaching 100 anger, Anub'arash enters a raging fury and unleashes a Spike Storm.

Now with both members of the court at their full power, Anub'arash storms across the chamber with Reckless Charge as Takazj conjures Cataclysmic Entropy.

children.name: Piercing Strike

children.name: Web Bomb

Takazj flings sticky knots of webbing throughout the chamber, slowing players’ movement speed by 20% and and inflicting Physical damage every 1 sec while within the area.

The central knot erupts when touched, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby and binding two players together in Binding Webs.

If Anub'arash charges through strands of Binding Webs, he becomes Entangled.

Moving yards apart snaps the strands.

While the shield holds, Takazj unleashes an Entropic Barrage every 16 sec and spins cones of webs throughout the chamber. These webs decrease player movement by 20% and inflict Shadow damage every 1 sec to players within the area.

The webs periodically explode, knocking players back while inflicting Shadow damage and an additional Shadow damage every 3 sec for 12 sec.

bosses.name: Queen Ansurek
bosses.description: After a revelation of traitors in her court, Queen Ansurek decides she must eradicate the palace's invaders herself. However, paranoia over whom she can trust gnaws at her psyche. With her allies dwindling, Queen Ansurek may delve into dark powers to attain victory, even if that means her most loyal soldiers become her next meal...

tips.text:
•Devoted Worshippers cast Cosmic Apocalypse if not defeated.
•Gloom Hatchlings cause lethal damage if they reach Ansurek.
•Froth Vapor occurs if Frothing Gluttony absorbs Queen's Summons.
•Reation Vapor occurs if Venom Nova detonates Reactive Froth.

•Feast absorbs significant healing.
•Gloom Touch inflicts significant damage unless dispelled.
•Paralyzing Venom increases damage from Wrest.
•Royal Condemnation inflicts significant damage to all players.

•Liquefied players are highly vulnerable to Feast.
•Feast absorbs a signficant amount of healing.
•Infest creates Gloom Hatchlings that cause lethal damage if they reach Ansurek.
•Gorge causes an increasing amount of damage with each strike.

abilities.name: Stage One: A Queen's Venom
abilities.text: Ansurek battles with poison and web to show her mastery of traditional Nerubian power.

children.name: Reactive Toxin
children.text:
Ansurek afflicts players with a toxin, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec for 6 sec to players nearby.

Upon expiration, the toxin forms into Reactive Froth, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby and knocking them away.

children.name: Reactive Froth
children.text:
When a player touches the froth, it bursts, afflicting them with Concentrated Toxin.

This burst launches players nearby into the air and inflicts Nature damage to all players A glob of venom also launches, splattering into Toxic Waves.

Venom Nova disperses burst froth into a pool of Acid.

children.name: Concentrated Toxin
children.text:
Ansurek's volatile acid absorbs into the victim, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec for 6 sec.

Upon expiration, the toxin detonates, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby.

children.name: Toxic Waves
children.text:
A toxic splatter inflicts Nature damage to players near the impact.

Waves of poison roll outward, inflicting Nature damage to players in their paths and knocking them away.

children.name: Acid

children.name: Venom Nova
