mythic.name: Nerub-ar Palace
mythic.description: Deep within the kingdom of Azj-Kahet lies Nerub-ar Palace, Queen Ansurek's seat of power. From this shadowed throne Queen Ansurek has tightened her grip on her Sureki followers, leading them along a dark path to a new future. As her paranoia grows, the members of the conspiratorial Severed Threads launch their final gambit against Ansurek's rule.

bosses.name: Ulgrax the Devourer
bosses.description: Queen Ansurek's evolutionary experimentation created a number of monstrous guardians for her throne, none more voracious than Ulgrax the Devourer. Driven mad by endless hunger, Ulgrax is now the ravenous protector of Queen Ansurek's court.

tips.text:
• Stalker's Webbing will trap players and nearby allies in Hardened Netting on contact.
•Ravenous Spawn continually Disembowel a player.

•Digestive Acid inflicts significant damage to nearby allies when removed.
•Each application of Insatiable Rage increases Ulgrax's damage.

•Ravenous Spawn continually place applications of Disembowel on a player.
•Excessively Tenderized players will become unable to be healed.

bosses.overview:
Ulgrax attempts to devour players by engaging in a Carnivorous Contest and places globs of Stalker's Webbing throughout the arena.

At zero energy, Ulgrax goes mad with hunger, attacking players with Juggernaut Charge. Ulgrax then demands to be fed, unleashing Hungering Bellows until his energy is brought to full.

children.name: Carnivorous Contest
children.text: In Mythic difficulty, bound players will emerge from the Contest Battered and Bruised. Ulgrax will enter a Contemptful Rage if fewer than players participate in the Contest.

children.name: Devour
children.text: Ulgrax devours the player inflicting Physical damage every 1 sec.

children.name: Battered and Bruised
children.text: Damage taken from Carnivorous Contest increased by 500%.

children.name: Contemptful Rage
children.text: Insulted by players' unwillingness to take the Carnivorous Contest seriously, Ulgrax flies into a rage, increasing damage inflicted by 250%.

children.name: Stalker's Webbing
children.text: Ulgrax shoots webs over random destinations, inflicting Nature damage to players near impact and leaving behind.

children.name: Hardened Netting
children.text: Ulgrax traps players in webs, stunning them for 30 sec. The webs inflict damage every 2 sec to the trapped player while intact.

children.name: Digestive Acid
children.text:
Ulgrax belches Digestive Acid at several players, inflicting Nature damage every 2 sec for 6 sec.

Once removed venom erupts the victim's skin, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby and dissolving any webbing left behind by Stalker's Webbing.

children.name: Venomous Lash
children.text: Ulgrax flings poison at all players, inflicting Nature damage on impact and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 6 sec.

children.name: Brutal Crush
children.text: Ulgrax crushes the current threat target, inflicting Physical damage and applications of Tenderized.

children.name: Tenderized
children.text: Reduces healing taken by 10%. This effect stacks, but loses an application every 1 sec.

children.name: Hulking Crash
children.text: Ulgrax leaps to the center of the arena and smashes the ground, inflicting Physical damage and knocking back all players. Players farther from the target receive less damage.

children.name: Ready to Feed
children.text: Ulgrax refuses to move until fed, meanwile damage taken from all sources is reduced by 99%.

children.name: Hungering Bellows
children.text:
Ulgrax screams for food, inflicting Physical damage to all players on impact and an additional Physical damage every 1 sec for 3 sec.

Ulgrax's Insatiable Rage builds with each Bellow.

children.name: Insatiable Rage
children.text: Ulgrax increases his Physical damage done by 10% for 20 sec.

children.name: Juggernaut Charge
children.text:
Ulgrax emerges from the Swallowing Darkness and charges across the arena, inflicting Shadow damage to players caught in his path.

Ulgrax re-enters the Darkness on the opposite side of the arena, inflicting Shadow damage instantly and Shadow damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

children.name: Ravenous Spawn
children.text: Ulgrax spawns a host of delectible insects.

children.name: Disembowel
children.text: Bites at the player's guts, inflicting Physical damage and an additional Physical damage every 2 sec for 10 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Chunky Viscera
children.text: On death, the beetles innards spill across the floor creating a tempting treat for Ulgrax.

children.name: Feed
children.text: Hurl viscera into Ulgrax's gullet to sate his hunger.

children.name: Bioactive Spines
children.text: Inflicts Nature damage to up to enemies nearby and adapts the caster's bile glands to inflict 10% additional Nature damage per successful volley of Bioactive Spines.

children.name: Disembowel
children.text: Bites at the player's guts, inflicting Physical damage and an additional Physical damage every 2 sec for 10 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Chunky Viscera
children.text: On death, the beetles innards spill across the floor creating a tempting treat for Ulgrax.

children.name: Feed
children.text: Hurl viscera into Ulgrax's gullet to sate his hunger.

children.name: Stalker's Webbing
children.text: Ulgrax shoots webs over random destinations, inflicting Nature damage to players near impact and leaving behind.

children.name: Hardened Netting
children.text: Ulgrax traps players in webs, stunning them for 30 sec. The webs inflict damage every 2 sec to the trapped player while intact.

children.name: Swallowing Darkness
children.text: Ulgrax emerges from the Swallowing Darkness rift to sate his hunger. The Darkness inflicts Shadow damage to players in the area and destroys.

bosses.name: The Bloodbound Horror
bosses.description: In the dark pits below Nerub-ar Palace, the blood of the Old Gods congeals in foul, black pools. The Bloodbound Horror rises from this vile ooze - drawing everything in its path into The Unseeming.

tips.text:
•Gruesome Disgorge sends players in front of The Bloodbound Horror into The Unseeming.
•Forgotten Harbingers Manifest Horrors until defeated.
•Grasp From Beyond forms underneath random players.

•Gruesome Disgorge sends players in front of The Bloodbound Horror into The Unseeming.

•Lost Watcher's Spectral Slam inflicts heavy Physical damage.

•Gruesome Disgorge sends players in front of The Bloodbound Horror into The Unseeming.
•Crimson Rain absorbs a large amount of healing.
•Goresplatter inflicts heavy magical damage over time.

bosses.overview:
The Bloodbound Horror periodically manifests creatures into The Unseeming to aid its assault. When splattered by Gruesome Disgorge players enter The Unseeming and can attack the creatures directly.

Upon reaching 100 energy, The Bloodbound Horror assails players with Goresplatter, inflicting deadly damage to those caught within.

abilities.name: Gruesome Disgorge
abilities.text: The Bloodbound Horror vomits Black Blood in a cone in front of itself, inflicting Shadow damage and an additional Shadow damage every 2 sec for 40 sec. Players under this effect briefly peer into The Unseeming.

children.name: The Unseeming
children.text: A shadowy realm below reality where true horrors lurk.

children.name: Black Bulwark
children.text: The Lost Watcher channels the essence of The Unseeming into The Bloodbound Horror, causing it to absorb damage, increasing every 1 sec for 10 sec.

children.name: Spectral Slam
children.text: The Lost Watcher slams their current target, inflicting Physical damage.

children.name: Manifest Horror
children.text: The Forgotten Harbinger manifests a Blood Horror out of The Unseeming that slowly moves toward The Bloodbound Horror.

children.name: Blood Pact
children.text: Blood Horrors that reach The Bloodbound Horror explode, inflicting Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Unseeming Blight
children.text: The return to reality scars the player, increasing damage taken from Gruesome Disgorge by 500% for 1 min.

abilities.name: Bloodcurdle
abilities.text: The Bloodbound Horror transfuses Black Blood into each player that causes them to erupt after 5 sec, inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby.

abilities.name: Spewing Hemorrhage
abilities.text: The Bloodbound Horror forms two geysers of Black Blood on each side that slowly rotate around itself for sec. Standing within a geyser inflicts Shadow damage every ${0.3}.2 sec.

abilities.name: Goresplatter
abilities.text:
The Bloodbound Horror siphons Black Blood from the surrounding pool granting itself a Seeping Transfusion. It then unleashes a torrent of Black Blood that washes over all players nearby, inflicting Shadow damage.

Residue sticks to remaining players, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec for 10 sec.

children.name: Seeping Transfusion
children.text: The Bloodbound Horror transfuses the Black Blood into its body, increasing its damage done by 10%. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Crimson Rain
abilities.text: The Bloodbound Horror coats each player in vile blood, causing them to absorb ${*} healing.

abilities.name: Grasp From Beyond
abilities.text:
The Bloodbound Horror focuses The Unseeming on to multiple players, manifesting tentacles at their location every 1 sec for 12 sec.

After sec each tentacle erupts, inflicting Shadow damage to all players nearby.

abilities.name: Black Sepsis
abilities.text: If no players are within reach, The Bloodbound Horror continually expels contaminated blood that inflicts Shadow damage to all players every 2 sec.

bosses.name: Sikran, Captain of the Sureki
bosses.description: Sikran established himself as an arrogant duelist within Queen Ansurek's court. Never knowing the cut of an enemy's blade, Sikran dispatched his rivals one-by-one and was proclaimed Captain of the Sureki by the queen herself. This indomitable fighter now ensures that any who threaten his queen fall before the throne's might.

tips.text:
• Cosmic Simulacrums inflict light damage to all players while active.

• Upon destruction,Cosmic Simulacrums apply Cosmic Shards to all players.

• Phase Blades inflicts heavy damage over time to all players hit and reduces healing taken.

• Phase Blades leave behind Cosmic Simulacrums for every player hit.

• Cosmic Simulacrums are destroyed after being hit by Decimate and Shattering Sweep.

• Captain's Flourish inflicts light damage with Expose then finishes with Phase Lunge.

• Phase Lunge inflcts heavy Physical and Shadow damage, and increases damage taken by Phase Lunge.

• Decimate expels cosmic spears from the boss location and breaks all Cosmic Simulacrums hit.

bosses.overview:
Sikran's Phase Blade rips through the cosmos, and leaves behind a Cosmic Simulacrum which can then be destroyed by Decimate.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Sikran casts Shattering Sweep, destroying all remaining Cosmic Simulacrums

abilities.name: Phase Blades
abilities.text: On Heroic and Mythic difficulties all players hit with Phase Blades will leave behind a Cosmic Simulacrum.

children.name: Cosmic Simulacrum
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Cosmic Simulcrums explode in a Collapsing Nova if placed within yards of each other.

children.name: Cosmic Shards
children.text:
Upon being destroyed the Cosmic Simulacrum erupts, inflicting Shadow damage to all players, and an additional Shadow damage every 1.5 sec for 6 sec. This effect stacks.

In addition, the eruption leaves behind a pool of Cosmic Residue.

children.name: Cosmic Residue
children.text: On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, Cosmic Residue will persist throughout the fight.

children.name: Collapsing Nova
children.text: Cosmic Simulacrums react to each other and combust, inflicting Shadow damage to all players if another Simulacrum is within yards.

abilities.name: Decimate
abilities.text:
Sikran unleashes a barrage of cosmic eruptions from his polearm, inflicting Shadow damage to all players between himself and his targets.

Cosmic Simulacrum's that are hit by this effect are destroyed.

abilities.name: Shattering Sweep
abilities.text:
At 100 energy, Sikran swings his polearm in a deadly arc, inflicting Shadow damage to all enemies. This damage is decreased based on distance.

All remaining Cosmic Simulacrum are destroyed by this effect, and damage from Cosmic Shards is increased by 25% for each Simulacrum destroyed for 10 sec.

Additionally, players nearby are knocked back and have their damage taken increased by 25% for 20 sec.

abilities.name: Captain's Flourish
abilities.text: Sikran unleashes a barrage of maneuvers, executing two Exposes before ending with a Phase Lunge.

children.name: Expose
children.text: Sikran slashes at his target, inflicting Physical damage and exposing a weakness, increasing Physical damage taken by 100% for 6 sec.

children.name: Phase Lunge
children.text:
Sikran pierces his primary target, inflicting Shadow damage, Physical damage.

In addition, the target takes 100% increased damage from Phase Lunge for 30 sec.

abilities.name: Rain of Arrows
abilities.text: Sikran fires a volley of arrows into the air, falling throughout the area, inflicting Shadow damage to players within yds of impact.

bosses.name: Rasha'nan
bosses.description: Twisted by Queen Ansurek's experiments, Rasha'nan was transformed from a proud nerubian into a monstrous, winged horror. Trapped within her new form, shattered memories of her former self drive Rasha'nan into an unquenchable rage.

tips.text: •Waves of Rolling Acid move in the indicated direction and corrode any Sticky Webs into Acid Pools.

•Waves of Rolling Acid move in the indicated direction and corrode any Sticky Webs into Acid Pools.
•Infested Spawn roam freely after casting Infested Bite at their original target.
•Unmitigated damage from Savage Assault stacks as Savage Wound.

•Waves of Rolling Acid move in the indicated direction and corrode any Sticky Webs into Acid Pools.

•Infested Spawn-targeted players birth new enemies that rampage, castingInfested Bite repeatedly.

bosses.overview:
Wounded during the events of the Dawnbreaker, Rasha'nan begins the encounter Wounded in Battle at 60% health.

As the encounter progresses, she repositions around the arena casting Acidic Eruption and pelting players with Caustic Hail.

abilities.name: Rolling Acid
abilities.text:
Rasha'nan expels a poisonous concoction at marked targets which sloshes off in waves in the indicated direction from the target.

Players splashed by the initial corrosive eruption are caught in an Acidic Stupor.

Any player that touches a wave has their movement speed reduced by 50% and gains Corrosion every sec.

The waves incinerate Sticky Webs inflicting Nature damage to players nearby and creates Acid Pools.

children.name: Corrosion
children.text: Vile acid corrodes the target for, suffering Nature damage every sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Acidic Stupor
children.text: The propulsive expulsion of Rolling Acid inflicts Nature damage and stuns for.

children.name: Acid Pools
children.text: Erosive Spray, Caustic Hail, and Rolling Acid can form caustic zones for. Contact with this zone inflicts Nature damage every sec.

abilities.name: Spinneret's Strands
abilities.text: On this difficulty, Spinneret's Strands tether affects all players in the damage radius.

children.name: Spinneret's Websnap
children.text: Spinneret's Strands snap inflicting Nature damage to all players.

children.name: Tacky Threads
children.text: On this difficulty, the first player to unleash a Spinneret's Websnap triggers Tacky Threads.

children.name: Sticky Webs
children.text: Spinneret's Strands' silken adhesive coats the arena inflicting Nature damage every sec and reducing movement speed by 10%.

abilities.name: Infested Spawn
abilities.text: On this difficulty, Infested Spawn's initial damage affects players in a radius around the marked target.

children.name: Infested Bite
children.text: On this difficulty, Infested Bite additionally reduces movement speed.

abilities.name: Enveloping Webs
abilities.text:
Rasha'nan ejects torrents of sticky web that inflict Nature damage to players near impact.

This effect entombs players in webbing stunning them for. Destroying these webs removes the effect.

abilities.name: Savage Assault
abilities.text: Rasha'nan smashes her current target inflicting Physical damage and Nature damage. Additionally 60% of unmitigated damage is inflicted as a.

children.name: Savage Wound
children.text: Inflicts the unmitigated damage from Savage Assault as Physical and Nature damage every sec for. This effect stacks, adding to the effects of previous Savage Wounds.

abilities.name: Web Reave
abilities.text:
Rasha'nan's rakes the targeted area inflicting Nature damage and pulling players towards her. These effects split evenly among players near the impact.

If Web Reave fails to hit at least targets all players suffer the full effect.

abilities.name: Erosive Spray
abilities.text: Rasha'nan spews acid for inflicting Nature damage to all players plus an additional every sec, periodically applying Lingering Erosion.

children.name: Lingering Erosion
children.text: Erosive Spray jettisons globs of acid at players inflicting Nature damage every sec for. This effect stacks.

children.name: Acid Pools
children.text: Erosive Spray, Caustic Hail, and Rolling Acid can form caustic zones for. Contact with this zone inflicts Nature damage every sec.

abilities.name: Acidic Eruption
abilities.text: Until interrupted Rasha'nan thrashes about inflicting Nature damage to all players and increases Acidic Eruption damage by 100% for. This effect stacks.

children.name: Acidic Carapace
children.text: Successful Acidic Eruption casts form a temporay shell, granting Rasha'nan immunity from damage for.

abilities.name: Caustic Hail
abilities.text: Rasha'nan rains acid inflicting Nature damage to players near impact locations, occasionally creating Acid Pools.

children.name: Acid Pools
children.text: Erosive Spray, Caustic Hail, and Rolling Acid can form caustic zones for. Contact with this zone inflicts Nature damage every sec.

abilities.name: Tacky Burst
abilities.text: Rasha'nan violently expels webs while no players are in melee range, inflicting Nature damage plus an additional Nature damage every sec for. This effect stacks.

bosses.name: Broodtwister Ovi'nax
bosses.description: Deep within the bowels of the queen's palace, Broodtwister Ovi'nax conducts abominable experiments with the black blood found in Azj-kahet. This corpulent horror lumbers through the palace's cavernous depths, regurgitating inky sludge onto hatchlings to observe its gruesome effects.

tips.text:
• Volatile Concoction inflicts damage to all players based on how much health the target is missing when it is removed.
• Sanguine Overflow mutates any creatures it comes into contact with.
• Colossal Spiders inflict increasing damage with Vicious Bite.

• Experimental Dosage causes nearby eggs to hatch, unleashing the horrific experiments incubating within.
• Sticky Web immobilizes nearby players when removed.
• Blood Parasites Infest their target upon reaching them.

• Experimental Dosage causes nearby eggs to hatch, unleashing the horrific experiments incubating within.
• Broodtwister Ovi'nax inflicts increasing Shadow damage and healing absorbs as he receives more Unstable Infusions.
• Volatile Concoction inflicts damage to all players based on how much health the target is missing when it is removed.

bosses.overview:
Broodtwister Ovi'nax injects players with Experimental Dosage which causes nearby eggs to hatch upon expiration, unleashing the horrors within.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Broodtwister Ovi'nax will Ingest Black Blood, growing in power and causing the room to slowly fill with Sanguine Overflow

abilities.name: Experimental Dosage
abilities.text: On Mythic difficulty, 2 simultaneous Experimental Dosage are required to cause a nearby egg to hatch.

children.name: Mutation: Necrotic
children.text: Coming into contact with mutates Colossal Spiders, increasing their health by 100% and empowering Vicious Bite to inflict Necrotic Wounds.

children.name: Vicious Bite
children.text:
The Colossal Spider bites its current target, inflicting Nature damage.

In addition, frenzy overtakes the spider, increasing its damage done by 25% until it is slain. This effect stacks.

children.name: Necrotic Wound
children.text: While empowered by Mutation: Necrotic, Vicious Bite also reduces healing done to the target by 10% for 15 sec.

children.name: Mutation: Ravenous
children.text: Coming into contact with mutates Voracious Worms, increasing their health by 100% and increases casting speed by 100%.

children.name: Poison Burst
children.text: The Voracious Worm unleashes a blast of toxic slime that inflicts Nature damage to all players.

children.name: Mutation: Accelerated
children.text:
Coming into contact with mutates Blood Parasites, increasing their health by 100%.

In addition, their inexorable desire to consume increases their movement speed by 10% every 1 sec until they are slain.

children.name: Fixate
children.text: Consuming hunger drives the Blood Parasite to fixate upon their prey and attempt to Infest it.

children.name: Infest
children.text:
Blood Parasite burrows into its target, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec for 10 sec.

Upon expiration, Blood Parasites erupt from the player and seek new prey.

abilities.name: Ingest Black Blood
abilities.text: Upon reaching full energy Broodtwister Ovi'nax charges towards a full canister of Black Blood and begins devouring it. Feasting upon the canisters contents unleashes torrents of Vile Discharge every 5 sec and inflicts Shadow damage that absorbs the next healing to all players. Upon finishing the canister, Broodtwister Ovi'nax gains Unstable Infusion.

children.name: Unstable Infusion
children.text: Waves of shadowy energy emanate from the Black Blood infused Broodtwister, inflicting Shadow damage and absorbing the next healing done to all players every 7.5 sec. In addition, waves of Vile Discharge are released every 7.5 sec.

children.name: Vile Discharge
children.text: Black Blood overloads Broodtwister Ovi'nax's system, unleashing a torrent of Vile Discharge inflicting Shadow damage on impact to players in the area.

children.name: Catalyze Mutation
children.text:
Broodtwister Ovi'nax injects Black Blood into its Experimental Eggs, mutating the creatures growing within.

Broodtwister Ovi'nax injects all eggs matching the egg associated with each Black Blood canister.

children.name: Mutation: Accelerated
children.text:
Coming into contact with mutates Blood Parasites, increasing their health by 100%.

In addition, their inexorable desire to consume increases their movement speed by 10% every 1 sec until they are slain.

children.name: Mutation: Necrotic
children.text: Coming into contact with mutates Colossal Spiders, increasing their health by 100% and empowering Vicious Bite to inflict Necrotic Wounds.

children.name: Mutation: Ravenous
children.text: Coming into contact with mutates Voracious Worms, increasing their health by 100% and increases casting speed by 100%.

abilities.name: Sanguine Overflow
abilities.text:
The canister of Black Blood leaks its contents across the floor of the chamber, slowly growing in size. This pool inflicts Shadow damage and absorbs the next healing received every 0.5 sec from players within the effect.

Experimental Eggs that come in contact with the pool trigger a Caustic Reaction.

children.name: Caustic Reaction
children.text: Black Blood causes the rapid incubation of any Experimental Eggs it touches, causing it to hatch and inflict Shadow damage to all players every 2 sec for 30 sec.

abilities.name: Sticky Web
abilities.text:
Broodtwister Ovi'nax covers several players with sticky webbing, inflicting Nature damage every 0.5 sec and reducing movement speed by 70% until it is dispelled.

Upon removal a Web Eruption is triggered.

children.name: Web Eruption
children.text: Sticky webbing erupts from the target, inflicting Nature damage and rooting players nearby for 8 sec.

abilities.name: Volatile Concoction
abilities.text:
Broodtwister Ovi'nax injects a cocktail of unstable substances into his target, inflicting Nature damage and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

Upon expiration the chemicals react, inflicting additional Nature damage based on the target's missing health. This damage is reduced the healthier the target is.

bosses.name: Nexus-Princess Ky'veza
bosses.description: Nexus-Princess Ky'veza arrived at Nerub-ar Palace only recently, quickly establishing herself as a confidante of Queen Ansurek. However, rumors abound within the inner court that she may harbor a dark and deadly secret. If discovered, the princess is prepared to dispatch all witnesses without mercy...

tips.text:
•Chasmal Gash increases damage taken from each strike of Void Shredders.
•Players pulled into a Nether Rift become Atomized.
•Reaper attemps to execute players that are low health.

•Assassination creates Nether Phantoms that mirror some of Ky'veza's abilities.
•Players pulled into a Nether Rift become Atomized.
•Reaper attemps to execute players that are low health.

•Reaper attemps to execute players that are low health.
•Starless Night and Regicide inflict heavy damage across the raid.
•Players pulled into a Nether Rift become Atomized.

bosses.overview:
Ky'veza marks targets for their Assassination while haunting Nether Phantoms emerge from her shadow to mirror the massacre.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Ky'veza invokes a Starless Night as phantoms slaughter her enemies in the darkness.

children.name: Assassination
children.text:

bosses.name: The Silken Court
bosses.description: Scarab Lord Anub'arash and Skeinspinner Takazj are Queen Ansurek's most trusted advisors, yet these two powerful nerubians harbor a hatred for each other even more powerful than their loyalty to the throne. While unleashing their considerable strength onto their enemies, each also fights to ensure their counterpart doesn't survive.

tips.text:
• Shatter Existence and Spike Storm apply heavy absorb shields to their casters.
• Players who are Impaled are stunned until their impaling spike is destroyed.
• Anub'arash summons scarabs into the chamber with Call of the Swarm.

• Stinging Swarm transfers to the nearest player or Takazj upon removal.
• Anub'arash becomes Entangled if he charges through Binding Webs.
• Burrowing Eruption and Unleashed Swarm inflict heavy raid damage.

• Anub'arash's Piercing Strike inflicts heavy Physical damage.
• Takazj moves throughout the chamber using Skittering Leap and Void Step.
• The fates of Anub'arash and Skeinspinner Takazj are linked through Queen's Proclamation.

bosses.overview:
The lords of the Silken Court fight as rivals for the queen's favor, alternatingly assaulting their enemies with Web Bomb and Reckless Charge.

Upon reaching 100 void energy, Takazj ascends into void form and begins to Shatter Existence.

After rejoining the battle, Anub'arash begins to summon Stinging Swarms as Takazj evokes Cataclysmic Entropy.

Upon reaching 100 anger, Anub'arash enters a raging fury and unleashes a Spike Storm.

Now with both members of the court at their full power, Anub'arash storms across the chamber with Reckless Charge as Takazj conjures Cataclysmic Entropy.

abilities.name: Whispers of The Silken Court

Players who do not gain a mark gain Mark of Death.

Players with the Mark of Rage who touch an essence consume it and gain Void Degeneration.

At stacks, Chaos damage is inflicted on the affected player.

bosses.name: Queen Ansurek
bosses.description: After a revelation of traitors in her court, Queen Ansurek decides she must eradicate the palace's invaders herself. However, paranoia over whom she can trust gnaws at her psyche. With her allies dwindling, Queen Ansurek may delve into dark powers to attain victory, even if that means her most loyal soldiers become her next meal...

tips.text:
•Devoted Worshippers cast Cosmic Apocalypse if not defeated.
•Gloom Hatchlings cause lethal damage if they reach Ansurek.
•Froth Vapor occurs if Frothing Gluttony absorbs Acolyte's Essence.
•Reation Vapor occurs if Venom Nova detonates Reactive Froth.

•Feast absorbs significant healing.
•Gloom Touch inflicts significant damage unless dispelled.
•Paralyzing Venom increases damage from Wrest.
•Royal Condemnation inflicts significant damage to all players.

•Liquefied players are highly vulnerable to Feast.
•Feast absorbs a signficant amount of healing.
•Infest creates Gloom Hatchlings that cause lethal damage if they reach Ansurek.
•Gorge causes several bursts of damage to all players that mitigation reduces.

abilities.name: Stage One: A Queen's Venom
abilities.text: Ansurek battles with poison and web to show her mastery of traditional Nerubian power.

children.name: Reactive Toxin
children.text:
Ansurek afflicts players with a toxin, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec for 6 sec to players nearby.

Upon expiration, the toxin forms into Reactive Froth, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby and knocking them away.

children.name: Reactive Froth
children.text:
When a player touches the froth, it bursts, afflicting them with Concentrated Toxin.

This burst launches players nearby into the air and inflicts Nature damage to all players A glob of venom also launches, splattering into Toxic Waves.

Venom Nova disperses burst froth into a pool of Acid.

children.name: Concentrated Toxin
children.text:
Ansurek's volatile acid absorbs into the victim, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec for 6 sec.

Upon expiration, the toxin detonates, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby.

children.name: Reaction Trauma
children.text: The victim's organs corrode, increasing damage taken from Concentrated Toxin by 1000% for 3 min.

children.name: Frothy Toxin
children.text:
A viscous froth covers the player for 9 sec and then detonates, causing them to suffer Nature damage. This effect stacks.

Each player near a bursting Reactive Froth reduces this affliction's applications.

children.name: Lingering Toxin
children.text: Ansurek's diluted toxin inflicts Nature damage every 2 sec for 10 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Toxic Reaction
children.text: Toxic particles cling to all players, increasing damage taken from Reactive Froth by 2000% for 1 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Toxic Waves
children.text:
A toxic splatter inflicts Nature damage to players near the impact.

Waves of poison roll outward, inflicting Nature damage to players in their paths and knocking them away.

children.name: Acid
children.text: Ansurek's acid inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec to players within it.

children.name: Venom Nova
children.text:
Ansurek unleashes a ring of venom, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby.

The ring expands, inflicting Nature damage every 0.5 sec for 8 sec to players that touch it and slowing them by 50%.

Reaction Vapor occurs if the ring touches Reactive Froth.

children.name: Reaction Vapor
children.text: Reactive Froth vaporizes, inflicting Nature damage to all players and an additional Nature damage every 2 sec for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Silken Tomb
children.text:
Ansurek roots all players in webbing, inflicting Nature damage to players near the webbing's impact. This webbing inflicts Nature damage to its victims every 1 sec until destroyed.

Upon destruction, the webbing leaves behind Grasping Silk.

children.name: Grasping Silk
children.text: Sticky webbing reduces movement speed by 25% and inflicts Nature damage every 0.5 sec to players within it.

children.name: [PH]
children.text:
Ansurek injects her current target with digestive juices, inflicting Nature damage and Physical damage.

This injection inflicts an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 30 sec and causes the victim to take 200% increased Physical damage.

Poison overflows from Ansurek when she injects her target, causing an Acid Explosion.

children.name: Acid Explosion
children.text:
In Heroic difficulty and above, the explosion inflicts damage to all players and Ansurek's globs of venom form Acid.

In Heroic difficulty and above, the explosion inflicts damage to all players and Ansurek's globs of venom form Acid.

In Heroic difficulty and above, the healing absorbed increases based on this ability's inflicted damage.

children.name: Acrid Presence

abilities.name: Intermission: The Spider's Web
abilities.text: Ansurek shrouds herself in webbing and feeds on her weakened enemies.

children.text:
Ansurek attaches Predation Threads to all players and gains a web shield that absorbs damage.

While shielded, she assaults players with Paralyzing Venom and occasionally yanks players towards her, devouring any that get within yards.

children.text:

Traveling through a gateway disrupts the explosion, but inflicts Shadow damage to the traveler and afflicts them with both Gloom Touch and Shadowy Distortion.

If close together, these creatures resonate, becoming immune to all damage and pulsing Shadow damage to all players every 1.5 sec. This damage increases by 100% with each pulse.

children.name: Expulsion Beam
children.text: The Chamber Expeller teleports away and then fires a cosmic beam towards a player, inflicting Shadow damage to players hit and knocking them away.

children.name: Echoing Connection
children.text:
The caster shares a dark connection with others of its type, echoing 100% of damage taken to the others.

If close together, these creatures resonate, becoming immune to all damage and pulsing Shadow damage to all players every 1.5 sec. This damage increases by 100% with each pulse.

children.name: Dark Detonation
children.text: The Chamber Acolyte inflicts Shadow damage to players nearby.

children.name: Caustic Fangs
children.text: The Caustic Skitterer's attacks corrode the target, increasing damage taken by 2% for 3 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Stage Three: Paranoia's Feast
abilities.text: Ansurek embraces a dark power as paranoia takes hold.

children.name: Abyssal Infusion
children.text:
Ansurek afflicts players with dark energy, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec for 6 sec to players nearby.

Upon expiration, the energy ruptures into an Abyssal Conduit, inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby and knocking them away.

children.name: Abyssal Conduit
children.text:
Void conduits tear open, inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby and launching Conduit Ejections.

The conduits teleport players between them when touched, inflicting Shadow damage.

When these conduits destabilize, a Conduit Collapse occurs.

children.name: Abyssal Reverberation
children.text: Abyssal energy explodes after 5 sec, inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby.

children.name: Conduit Ejections
children.text: Abyssal fragments inflict Shadow damage to players in their paths, knocking them away.

children.name: Conduit Collapse
children.text:
The conduit collapses, inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby.

This destabilization launches Conduit Ejections and forms Gloom.

children.name: Conduit Ejections
children.text: Abyssal fragments inflict Shadow damage to players in their paths, knocking them away.

children.name: Gloom
children.text: Darkness clings to the ground, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec to players within it.

children.name: Frothing Gluttony
children.text:
Ansurek draws in a ring of cosmic energy, inflicting Shadow damage every 0.5 sec for 8 sec to players that touch it and slowing them by 50%. She pulls players towards her with Glutton Threads, consuming victims within yards.

Ansurek also consumes living Summoned Acolytes upon casting this ability, causing Froth Vapor.

children.name: Glutton Threads
children.text: Ansurek's web threads grip all players, pulling them towards her frothing maw. This pull force increases over time.

children.name: Froth Vapor
children.text:
In Heroic difficulty and above, this effect also occurs if Frothing Gluttony touches Acolyte's Essence.

In Heroic difficulty and above, this effect also occurs if Frothing Gluttony touches Acolyte's Essence.$]

children.name: Consume
children.text: Ansurek consumes the essence of her victim, inflicting Shadow damage.

children.name: Queen's Summons
children.text:
Ansurek lets forth a ghastly shriek, inflicting Shadow damage to all players and calling Summoned Acolytes to her aid.

Upon death, they become Acolyte's Essence.

children.name: Acolyte's Essence
children.text: In Mythic difficulty, Abyssal Conduits do not consume Acolyte's Essence.

children.name: Essence Scarred
children.text: The acolyte's essence melds with the player, increasing damage taken from Acolyte's Essence by 500% for 4 min.

children.name: Dark Barrier
children.text: The Summoned Acolyte's shadowy barrier absorbs damage and prevents crowd controlling effects.

children.name: Null Detonation
children.text: The Summoned Acolyte inflicts Shadow damage to all players. Each successful cast increases its damage done by 50%.

children.name: Royal Condemnation
children.text:
Ansurek forms silken spikes that drop onto marked players, inflicting Nature damage to all players, reduced with distance.

The impacts form Royal Shackles.

children.name: Royal Shackles
children.text:
Web shackles connect to players, slowing them by 10% and inflicting Nature damage every 3 sec until the shackles are destroyed. The strength of this effect increases over time.

The shackles trap any player they touch in a Royal Cocoon. Destroying a shackle frees its cocooned players.

children.name: Royal Cocoon
children.text: A cocoon fully envelops the victim, stunning them.

children.name: Infest
children.text:
Ansurek injects her current target with shadow-infused egg sacs, inflicting Shadow damage and Physical damage. Additionally, the victims suffer Shadow damage every 1 sec for 5 sec.

Upon expiration, the sacs erupt in an Infested Gloomburst.

children.name: Infested Gloomburst
children.text: Gloom Hatchlings burst from the infested victim, inflicting Shadow damage to all players nearby.

children.name: Gloom Hatchling
children.text:
Shadowy spiderlings rush towards Ansurek. If they reach her, she devours them, inflicting Shadow damage to all players and increasing her damage done by 20% for 20 sec.

Upon death, these spiderlings leak Gloom.

children.name: Gloom
children.text: Darkness clings to the ground, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec to players within it.

children.name: [PH]
children.text:
In Heroic difficulty and above, this ability inflicts additional Shadow damage based on the amount of Physical damage done.

In Heroic difficulty and above, this ability inflicts additional Shadow damage based on the amount of Physical damage done.

children.name: Gloom Splatter
children.text: Shadowy globs launch towards players, inflicting Shadow damage to players near the impacts and forming.

children.name: Gloom
children.text: Darkness clings to the ground, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec to players within it.

children.name: Web Blades
children.text: Silk strands pull bladed webbing towards players, inflicting Nature damage to players struck and slowing them by 95% for 3 sec.

children.name: Dreadful Presence
children.text:
Ansurek radiates dreadful energy, inflicting Shadow damage every 2 sec to all players. This damage permanently increases by ~1% whenever open.

If she casts Frothing Gluttony with ~2 applications of this effect, her cosmic energy overflows, granting her Cataclysmic Evolution.

children.name: Cataclysmic Evolution
children.text: All Gloom rapidly expands and Ansurek recasts Frothing Gluttony indefinitely.

loot.name: Formula: Enchant Weapon - Authority of the Depths

normal.name: Blackrock Depths
normal.description: The smoldering Blackrock Depths are home to the Dark Iron dwarves and their emperor, Dagran Thaurissan. Like his predecessors, he serves under the iron rule of Ragnaros the Firelord, a merciless being summoned into the world centuries ago. The presence of chaotic elementals has attracted Twilight's Hammer cultists to the mountain domain. Along with Ragnaros' servants, they have pushed the dwarves toward increasingly destructive ends that could soon spell doom for all of Azeroth.

bosses.name: Lord Roccor
bosses.description: Lord Roccor loathes the scheming and backstabbing of his fellow fire elementals. To avoid serving alongside his kind in the Molten Core, the mighty being purposefully angered the Firelord. Roccor's risky gambit paid off: he was expelled from the core and forced to guard Blackrock Depths in isolation.

tips.text:
• Roiling Magma is cast on Lord Roccor's primary target and inflicts Fire damage to enemies in the area.
• Stepping on a Living Magma will destroy it and inflict damage over time to the player.
• When crystallized, Obsidian Elementals attack nearby players.
• Volcanic Upheaval inflicts significant damage to all players.

• Stepping on a Living Magma will destroy it and inflict damage over time to the player.
• When crystallized, Obsidian Elementals attack nearby players.
• Volcanic Upheaval inflicts significant damage to all players.

• Roiling Magma is cast on Lord Roccor's primary target and inflicts Fire damage to enemies in the area.
• Stepping on a Living Magma will destroy it and inflict damage over time to the player.
• Volcanic Upheaval inflicts significant damage to all players.

bosses.overview:
Lord Roccor casts Roiling Magma on his target, inflicting damage and providing the raw material to Crystallize his obsidian progeny.

When Lord Roccor reaches 95% health and every 20% damage suffered thereafter, he will cast Eruption, filling the room with Roiling Magma. Each Living Magma that reaches its destination will increase the power of the elemental created by Igneous Crystallization.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Roccor casts Volcanic Upheaval, inflicting huge damage to all players.

abilities.name: Roiling Magma
abilities.text: Lord Roccor creates a pool of roiling magma inflicting Volcanic damage every 1 sec to enemies in the area.

abilities.name: Crystallize
abilities.text: Lord Roccor transforms a pool of roiling magma into a Son of Roccor.

children.name: Slag Armor
children.text:
Inflicts Volcanic damage to an enemy every 3 sec for 15 sec.

Causes an enemy to take 20% increased damage for 15 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Eruption
abilities.text: Lord Roccor erupts inflicting Volcanic damage to enemies in the area and creating a pool of roiling magma. Roiling magma created by Eruption splashes into Living Magmas that will attempt to return to their pool. Each Living Magma that reaches their pool will increase its size.

children.name: Living Magma
children.text: Stepping into a Living Magma will destroy it but inflicts Volcanic damage every 3 sec for 15 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Igneous Crystallization
children.text: Lord Roccor transforms all roiling magma into Obsidian Elementals whose power increases with the size of the pool.

children.name: Slag Armor
children.text:
Inflicts Volcanic damage to an enemy every 3 sec for 15 sec.

Causes an enemy to take 20% increased damage for 15 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Slag Armor
children.text:
Inflicts Volcanic damage to an enemy every 3 sec for 15 sec.

Causes an enemy to take 20% increased damage for 15 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Volcanic Upheaval
abilities.text: Lord Roccor slams the ground inflicting Volcanic damage to all enemies every 1 sec for 7 sec.

bosses.name: Bael'Gar
bosses.description: The monstrous molten giant Bael'Gar lumbers across the Dark Iron Highway, a stunning feat of dwarven engineering carved into Blackrock Depths. Ragnaros pulled the giant from the heart of the Firelands to guard a massive sealed door at one end of the highway. According to legend, only the Firelord and the Dark Iron clan's highest-ranking members know what lies beyond the mysterious gate.

tips.text:
• Tanks will need to split the damage of Giant Strike in order to survive.
• The large boulders created by Rockfall inflict higher damage the nearer players are to the point of impact.
• Any boulders that remain when Bael'Gar casts Shatter have the potential to make its damage lethal.
• When a boulder is destroyed several Spawns of Bael'Gar will be created and attack nearby players.

• The large boulders created by Rockfall inflict higher damage the nearer players are to the point of impact.
• Molten Furnace inflicts lethal damage to players that are not behind cover.
• Any boulders that remain when Bael'Gar casts Shatter have the potential to make its damage lethal.
• When a boulder is destroyed several Spawns of Bael'Gar will be created and attack nearby players.

• Tanks will need to split the damage of Giant Strike in order to survive.
• The large boulders created by Rockfall inflict higher damage the nearer players are to the point of impact.
• Molten Furnace inflicts lethal damage to players that are not behind cover.
• Any boulders that remain when Bael'Gar casts Shatter have the potential to make its damage lethal.
• When Spawns of Bael'Gar are killed they will deal damage over time to a random player with Molten Heart.

bosses.overview:
Bael'Gar's Giant Strike inflicts enormous damage in a cone in front of him with every swing. Damage is split between players struck.

Rockfall causes large boulders and small rocks to fall from the ceiling that players must avoid. Players will need to seek cover when Bael'Gar casts Molten Furnace. Any boulders that remain when Bael'Gar casts Shatter will inflict significant additional damage to the entire raid.

Whenever a boulder is destroyed, several Spawns of Bael'Gar are created. When a Spawn of Bael'Gar is killed, its Molten Heart inflicts damage over time to a random player.

abilities.name: Giant Strike
abilities.text: Inflicts heavy Physical damage to enemies in front of Bael'Gar, split between enemies struck.

abilities.name: Rockfall
abilities.text:
Bael'Gar causes the ceiling to crumble, pummeling the area with rocks and inflicting Physical damage every 1 sec for 12 sec to all players.

Boulders inflict Physical damage to players, decreasing the farther away the player is from the impact point.

children.name: Boulder
children.text: Boulders can be used to hide from Molten Furnace and release Spawns of Bael'Gar when destroyed.

children.name: Molten Heart
children.text: Upon dying, the molten heart of a Spawn of Bael'Gar inflicts Fire damage to a random player every 3 sec for 36 sec.

children.name: Crumbling Ceiling
children.text: Crumbling Ceiling inflicts Physical damage to players in the area.

abilities.name: Molten Furnace
abilities.text: Bael'Gar inflicts Volcanic damage to players that are not hiding behind a boulder.

abilities.name: Shatter
abilities.text: Bael'Gar delivers a powerful stomp inflicting Physical damage to all enemies and shattering any remaining boulders. Shattered boulders inflict an additional Physical damage to all enemies.

bosses.name: Lord Incendius
bosses.description: Baron Geddon taught Incendius to harness his destructive powers, but the baron never expected his protege to grow so lethally efficient. Increasingly wary that Incendius might usurp him, Geddon sent the blazing elemental out of the Molten Core to guard the Dark Iron dwarves' fabled Black Anvil.

tips.text:
• Flame Geysers become more deadly the longer they are left alive. Each cast of Blaze becomes successively faster.
• When a Flame Geyser is defeated, players must split the damage caused by Dying Flare.
• Taunt Lord Incendius to prevent the other tank from being pushed off the bridge by Blowback.
• Be wary of being pushed off the bridge by Dying Flare or Scorching Wind.

• Flame Geysers become more deadly the longer they are left alive. Each cast of Blaze becomes successively faster.
• When a Flame Geyser is defeated, players must split the damage caused by Dying Flare.
• Be wary of being pushed off the bridge by Dying Flare or Scorching Wind.

• Consumptive Flames inflicts a short burst of high damage.
• Flame Geysers have the potential to inflict high damage to the entire raid until they are brought under control and defeated.
• It will be difficult to stop and cast during Scorching Wind.
• Be wary of being pushed off the bridge by Dying Flare or Scorching Wind.

bosses.overview:
Lord Incendius summons powerful Flame Geysers that will inflict deadly damage until they are brought under control. Even in defeat, a Flame Geyser casts Dying Flare which can hurl players off the bridge and inflict high damage.

Lord Incendius will attempt to force players off the bridge with Scorching Wind. Tanks will need to work together to prevent Blowback from throwing them off the bridge.

Flame Geysers that remain when Lord Incendius casts Scorching Wind may become extremely deadly.

abilities.name: Firewall
abilities.text: Lord Incendius sets fire to portions of the bridge every 8 sec, inflicting Fire damage to players in the area every 1 sec.

abilities.name: Consumptive Flames
abilities.text: Lord Incendius wreathes players in consumptive flames inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec for 12 sec.

abilities.name: Summon Flame Geyser
abilities.text: Lord Incendius hurls fire inflicting Fire damage to players in the area and summoning a Flame Geyser.

children.name: Blaze
children.text: Flame Geysers cast Blaze inflicting Fire damage to all players. Successive casts of Blaze gain 15% haste.

children.name: Dying Flare
children.text: Before dying, Flame Geysers cast Dying Flare, knocking back and inflicting Fire damage to players nearby. Damage is split between players struck. If no player is struck by Dying Flare, all players suffer Fire damage.

abilities.name: Scorching Wind
abilities.text: Lord Incendius creates a powerful scorching wind, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec and pushing all players towards the edge of the bridge for 20 sec.

children.name: Blowback
children.text: Lord Incendius amplifies the force of scorching wind against his current target and inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec. Taunting Lord Incendius forces him to switch targets.

bosses.name: Golem Lord Argelmach
bosses.description: Argelmach's lifelong obsession with immortality drove him to forge enchanted constructs in his own image. Rumor has it that he has also dabbled in some form of black magic that would allow the golem lord's new creations to act as vessels for his spirit should his flesh-and-blood body be destroyed.

tips.text:
• Each time Arcanotron's Arcane Overcharge is caught, the explosion that occurs when it hits the ground will be reduced.
• Magmatron's Flamethrower can be used to burn away Chemical Bombs before Incineration combusts all of them at once.
• Moving golems too close together will activate Golem Overdrive.

• Power Generator will empower golems or players that intercept the energy orbs moving towards Arcanotron.
• Poison-Soaked must be burned away from players with Magmatron's Flamethrower.
• Players afflicted by Livewire will emit an Electrical Discharge when it is dispelled or expires.
• Players paired by Lethal Attraction must stand together or suffer lethal damage.

• Incineration and Poison Mist will inflict heavy damage to the entire raid.
• Poison-Soaked must be burned away from players with Magmatron's Flamethrower.
• Players afflicted by Livewire will emit an Electrical Discharge when it is dispelled or expires.
• Players paired by Lethal Attraction must stand together or suffer lethal damage.

bosses.overview:
When Golem Lord Argelmach's spirit is released from his mortal coil, he will possess the golems around the Mold Foundry. The golem that is Possessed will gain energy over time. At maximum energy, it will unleash a powerful ability.

Toxitron and Electron are stationary casters, while Magmatron and Arcanatron are powerful melee combatants. Moving the golems too close together will active Golem Overdrive, increasing their combat prowess.

children.name: Chain Lightning
children.text: Strikes an enemy with a lightning bolt that arcs to up to nearby players inflicting Nature damage.

children.name: Possessed
children.text: Golem Lord Argelmach's freed soul possesses a golem, granting it energy every 0.8 sec.

children.name: Arcane Overcharge
children.text:
Arcanotron launches an arcane bomb at a nearby location. If the bomb strikes the ground, it explodes, inflicting Arcane damage to all players.

If the bomb strikes a player it inflicts Arcane damage, increases the player's arcane damage taken by 10% for 40 sec, and Arcanotron launches another bomb that will strike the ground more quickly.

Arcane Overcharge will inflict less damage to the raid for each bomb that was caught.

children.name: Power Generator
children.text: Potent arcane energy coalesces around golems and slowly moves towards Arcanotron. Any target that touches the arcane energy will gain 12% increased damage for 30 sec, stacking up to times.

children.name: Flamethrower
children.text:
Inflicts Fire damage and applies Melt Armor to players in a yard cone every 0.5 sec for 10 sec.

Burns away Poison-Soaked and explodes Chemical Pools.

children.name: Melt Armor
children.text: Causes a player to take 1% increased Physical damage for 40 sec.

children.name: Incineration
children.text: Inflicts Fire damage to all players and combusts all Chemical Pools.

children.name: Chemical Bomb
children.text: Fires Chemical Bombs, inflicting Nature damage on impact and creating a pool of flammable poison.

children.name: Chemical Pool
children.text: A pool of flammable chemicals inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec to enemies in the area.

children.name: Chemical Explosion
children.text: Flamethrower and Incineration combust Chemical Pools inflicting Nature damage to all players.

children.name: Poison Mist
children.text: Toxitron fills the room with poison inflicting Nature damage to all players every 1 sec for 10 sec and inflicting Poison-Soaked.

children.name: Poison-Soaked
children.text: Poison-Soaked inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec. Poison-Soaked is burned away from players who suffer damage from Flamethrower.

children.name: Chain Lightning
children.text: Strikes an enemy with a lightning bolt that arcs to up to nearby players inflicting Nature damage.

children.name: Livewire
children.text: Afflicts players with Livewire. Livewires inflict Nature damage to players nearby every 1 sec for 10 sec.

children.name: Electrical Discharge
children.text: When Livewire is removed, a violent Electrical Discharge inflicts Nature damage to players nearby.

children.name: Lethal Attraction
children.text: Links pairs of players together. If linked players are farther than yards apart after 10 sec, they suffer Nature damage.

abilities.name: Golem Overdrive
abilities.text: Golems within yards have their damage increased by 75% and attack speed increased by 50%. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Shared Health
abilities.text: Golem Lord Argelmach's golems share health.

bosses.name: The Seven
bosses.description: Centuries ago, sorcerer-thane Thaurissan and seven of his most powerful Dark Iron allies accidentally summoned Ragnaros into Azeroth and damned their entire clan to enslavement. Although the Seven perished during the ritual, their restless spirits still linger in Blackrock Depths, cursed to serve their elemental master and the current Dark Iron ruler.

tips.text:
• Gloom'rel and Anger'rel will remain Corporeal through the entire encounter.
• Anger'rel will charge a distant player and use Bladestorm when he reaches full energy.
• Gloom'rel will use Recklessness when he reaches full energy.
• Each of the Seven have a deadly ultimate ability they will use when they reach maximum energy. The entire raid must respond to these moments in order to defeat the Seven.

• Three of the Seven will be Corporeal at a time and suffer full damage.
• Seeth'rel's Blizzard creates a deadly hazard targeting a random player.
• Vile'rel's Power Word: Respite creates an absorb that heals its target while it persists.
• Each of the Seven have a deadly ultimate ability they will use when they reach maximum energy. The entire raid must respond to these moments in order to defeat the Seven.

• Doom'rel will Banish a random player when he is Corporeal.
• Dope'rel's Smoke Bomb will reduce spell range while it persists.
• Hate'rel's Magma Burn will become deadly if it stacks too high.
• Each of the Seven have a deadly ultimate ability they will use when they reach maximum energy. The entire raid must respond to these moments in order to defeat the Seven.

bosses.overview: The Seven alternate between manifesting fully in the physical realm and returning to their ghostly state becoming Corporeal or Incorporeal. While Corporeal, each member of the Seven inflicts and suffers full damage and has access to more powerful abilities. Anger'rel and Gloom'rel will remain Corporeal through the entire encounter while the third Corporeal member of the Seven changes as the encounter progresses. When a member of the Seven reaches full energy, they will use their most powerful ability.

children.name: Sunder Armor
children.text: Inflicts Physical damage and increases Physical damage taken by 9% for 20 sec.

children.name: Mortal Strike
children.text: Inflicts Physical damage and reduces healing taken by 35% for 6 sec.

children.name: Bladestorm
children.text: Charges to an enemy and becomes an unstoppable storm of destructive force, inflicting Physical damage every 1 sec for 8 sec to players nearby.

children.name: Rampage
children.text: Unleashes a series of brutal strikes, each inflicting Physical damage.

children.name: Recklessness
children.text: Gloom'rel flies into a frenzy, inflicting 75% increased damage for 15 sec.

children.name: Corporeal
children.text: While corporeal, the Seven gain energy over time and are able to use powerful abilities.

children.name: Banish
children.text: Banishes an enemy, preventing any action for 30 sec. Reduces damage received by 100% and healing received by 100%.

children.name: Summon Felguard
children.text: Summons a Felguard; a powerful melee combatant.

children.name: Corporeal
children.text: While corporeal, the Seven gain energy over time and are able to use powerful abilities.

children.name: Fan of Knives
children.text: Sprays knives at all enemies nearby, inflicting Physical damage.

children.name: Smoke Bomb
children.text: Fills the room with clouds of thick smoke for 6 sec. Player range is reduced by 100% while the smoke persists.

children.name: Magma Bolt
children.text: Hate'rel hurls magma at a player. While Hate'rel is corporeal Magma Bolt applies Magma Burn

children.name: Corporeal
children.text: While corporeal, the Seven gain energy over time and are able to use powerful abilities.

children.name: Summon Fire Elemental
children.text: Summons a powerful fire elemental. While the fire elemental is alive, Hate'rel's Magma Bolt targets all players.

children.name: Fire Nova
children.text: Inflicts Fire damage and applies Magma Burn to all players.

children.name: Blizzard
children.text: Ice shards pelt the target area, inflicting Frost damage every 1 sec for 15 sec and reducing movement speed by 30%.

children.name: Corporeal
children.text: While corporeal, the Seven gain energy over time and are able to use powerful abilities.

children.name: Bitter Cold
children.text: Wreathes all players in rime. After 5 sec, players erupt inflicting Frost damage to players nearby and rooting them for 3 sec.

children.name: Power Word: Respite
children.text: Grants a shield absorbing damage. While this shield persists it restores health every 1 sec for 30 sec.

children.name: Terrify
children.text: Fears and inflicts Shadow damage to all players near the impact every 1 sec for 6 sec.

children.name: Corporeal
children.text: While corporeal, the Seven gain energy over time and are able to use powerful abilities.

children.name: Mind Torrent
children.text: Vile'rel assaults the mind of a player, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec for 10 sec. Damage is split between players near the target.

abilities.name: Incorporeal
abilities.text: While incorporeal the Seven inflict 50% reduced damage, suffer 100% reduced damage, and are immune to interrupts.

abilities.name: Shared Health
abilities.text: The Seven share health.

bosses.name: General Angerforge
bosses.description: Through a lifetime of study, General Angerforge has become an expert on dwarven military history and tactics. He recently incurred Emperor Dagran Thaurissan's fury by writing a scathing treatise on his clan's failures in past conflicts. This political blunder aside, Angerforge is a Dark Iron to his core. He will bleed--and die, if necessary--to protect his people and his emperor.

tips.text:
• The Commanding Aura of General Angerforge and Anvilrage Officers drastically increases the combat prowess of nearby Dark Iron.
• General Angerforge and Anvilrage Officers cast Shatter Armor. It will not be removed until the end of the encounter.
• Your allies will need to be protected from many different Dark Iron soldiers in order to succeed.

• Anvilrage Medics will attempt to Heal their allies.
• Anvilrage Rogues Fixate a player until death.
• Anvilrage Sappers will Detonate upon reaching a player, inflicting high Physical damage.
• General Angerforge's Fireburst Grenade can be avoided by taking cover behind a column.

• World In Flames will continue to deal increasing Fire damage. Defeating a Harbinger of Flames will slow incoming damage.
• Anvilrage Rogues Fixate a player until death.
• Anvilrage Sappers will Detonate upon reaching a player, inflicting high Physical damage.
• The pillars within the Lyceum can be used to avoid Firing Lines and Fireburst Grenade, but will also make it challenging to heal players who move on their own.

bosses.overview:
General Angerforge commands an army within the Lyceum in defense of the Imperial Throne. Players will need to overcome an array of firepower in order to reach the general.

Harbingers of Flame channel World In Flames, wreathing all players within the Lyceum in intensifying Fire damage. The Harbingers of Flame cannot be damage until the Shadowforge Braziers are lit using the Shadowforge Torches carried by the Shadowforge Flame Keepers.

After both Shadowforge Braziers are lit, the burning barriers protecting General Angerforge will fall, opening the general up to attack directly.

children.name: Commanding Aura
children.text: Increases the damage of allies within yards by 50%, reduces damage taken by 50%, and grants immunity to interrupts.

children.name: Shatter Armor
children.text: Shatters a player's armor, inflicting Physical damage and increasing Physical damage taken by 5% until the end of the encounter.

children.name: Dark Iron Bombs
children.text: General Angerforge throws dark iron bombs at up to players, inflicting Fire damage to players in the area. Stepping into a Dark Iron Bomb inflicts Fire damage to players nearby.

children.name: Fireburst Grenade
children.text: General Angerforge tosses a grenade into the air that explodes inflicting Fire damage to all players that are not hiding behind cover.

children.name: Deploy Mole Machine
children.text: Deploys a soldier to attack the players. Players standing on the Mole Machine's arrival point suffer Physical damage and are knocked back.

children.name: World in Flames
children.text:
The Harbingers of Flame wreathe the Lyceum in intensifying flames, inflicting Fire damage every 10 sec. This damage is increased by 10% every 20 sec until players are incinerated.

Harbingers of Flame are immune to damage until a Shadowforge Torch consumes their fiery essence.

children.name: Rings of Fire
children.text: Summons expanding rings of fire around the caster inflicting Fire damage to players in the area when they erupt.

children.name: Commanding Aura
children.text: Increases the damage of allies within yards by 50%, reduces damage taken by 50%, and grants immunity to interrupts.

children.name: Shatter Armor
children.text: Shatters a player's armor, inflicting Physical damage and increasing Physical damage taken by 5% until the end of the encounter.

children.name: Heal
children.text: Restores health to an ally.

children.name: Stealth
children.text: Conceals the caster from sight. This effect is removed when entering combat.

children.name: Sinister Strike
children.text: Inflicts Physical damage to a player. The duration of the caster's next Crippling Poison increases sec. This effect stacks up to times.

children.name: Shadowstep
children.text: The caster steps through the shadows, appearing behind their target.

children.name: Fixate
children.text: Fixates an enemy, ignoring all others.

children.name: Detonate
children.text: Anvilrage Sappers denote when they reach a player, inflicting Physical damage to players nearby.

children.name: Artillery Barrage
children.text: Anvilrage Artillerists unleash a barrage of artillery fire every 4 sec, inflicting Physical damage to enemies in the area.

children.name: Mortar
children.text: Fires a mortar at a player, inflicting Physical damage to players in the area.

children.name: Firing Line
children.text: Anvilrage Dragoons fire in coordinated volleys. Each shot inflicts Physical damage and knocks players back.

bosses.name: Ambassador Flamelash
bosses.description: For his unwavering service to Ragnaros, Flamelash ascended to the rank of ambassador to the Dark Iron clan. This depraved being initially despised his dwarven allies, but he has come to respect their penchant for destruction.

tips.text:
• Tanks will need to split the damage of Cremate in order to survive, and the Flamelash it leaves behind makes a player more susceptible to Fire damage until it fades.
• Firestarter's Explosive Impact inflicts heavy Physical damage.
• Flamewalkers are a powerful melee combatant that is also capable of casting Magma Infusion.

• Firestarters should be lured away from the raid. The explosion from Torch is large and inflicts high damage.
• Flamewalkers cast Magma Infusion until they are defeated, making it more difficult to navigate the Iron Hall.
• Players should destroy portal anchors as quickly as possible while ensuring Burning Spirits do not successfully cast Fury of the Firelands.

• Healers should quickly dispel Cremation from players that split the damage of Cremate.
• Tanks afflicted by Flamelash will suffer increased Fire damage.
• When a Flamewalker is killed, it will depart with an Explosive Demise.
• Incoming damage can quickly become overwhelming during Open Firelands Portals unless the raid manages every threat successfully.

bosses.overview:
Ambassador Flamelash calls upon the denizens of the Firelands to incinerate his foes. When Ambassador Flamelash casts Open Firelands Portals, players must quickly spread in order to defeat Burning Spirits and destroy portal anchors. If too many spirits successfully cast Fury of the Firelands, the damage from Ambassador Flamelash will become overwhelming. Until all portal anchors are destroyed, Unstable Portal will continue to inflict damage to the entire raid.

When Ambassador Flamelash reaches maximum energy, he casts Cremate, which must be split between multiple players. The Cremation left behind by Cremate should be quickly dispelled or will overwhelm the raid.

abilities.name: Cremate
abilities.text:
Ambassador Flamelash channels his full fury into his target, inflicting Fire damage to players nearby every 1 sec, split between enemies struck.

If Ambassador Flamelash's target is killed, his energy is refilled.

Ambassador Flamelash's target is afflicted with Flamelash.

children.name: Flamelash
children.text: Causes a player to suffer 50% increased Fire damage for 75 sec.

abilities.name: Magma Infusion
abilities.text: Roots in place and begins casting Magma Sweep, up to times.

children.name: Magma Sweep
children.text: Inflicts Fire damage in a yard cone in front of the caster.

abilities.name: Summon Firestarters
abilities.text: Flamelash summons Firestarters, inflicting Fire damage to players in the area.

children.name: Fixate
children.text: Fixates a player, ignoring all others.

children.name: Explosive Impact
children.text: When any player comes within yards, the Firestarter combusts, inflicting Physical damage to players nearby and begins casting Torch.

children.name: Torch
children.text: The Firestarter explodes, inflicting Fire damage to players nearby.

abilities.name: Summon Flamewalker
abilities.text: Ambassador Flamelash summons a powerful Flamewalker.

children.name: Magma Infusion
children.text: Roots in place and begins casting Magma Sweep, up to times.

children.name: Magma Sweep
children.text: Inflicts Fire damage in a yard cone in front of the caster.

children.name: Explosive Demise
children.text: Upon dying, casts Explosive Demise, inflicting Fire damage to all players.

children.name: Superheat
children.text: Inflicts Fire damage to enemies nearby. Damage is reduced to enemies further from the caster.

abilities.name: Burning Spirit
abilities.text: Flamelash opens portals to the Firelands. Burning Spirits arrive from the Firelands every 15 sec until two nearby portal anchors are destroyed.

children.name: Unstable Portal
children.text: When a portal's nearby anchors are destroyed it becomes unstable, inflicting Fire damage to all players every 3 sec until all portal anchors are destroyed.

children.name: Fury of the Firelands
children.text: A Burning Spirit sacrifices itself to infuse Ambassador Flamelash with fiery vigor, causing him to inflict Fire damage to all players every 2 sec until all stacks are consumed.

bosses.name: Emperor Dagran Thaurissan
bosses.description: Emperor Dagran Thaurissan rules alongside Princess Moira of the rival Bronzebeard clan. Debate rages over whether the emperor ensorcelled his bride or she willingly joined him. Whatever the truth, Thaurissan's continued presence bodes ill for the future of his clan. So long as he lives, the Dark Irons will remain pawns of Ragnaros, and a dire threat to kingdoms throughout Azeroth.

tips.text:
• Moira and Dagran's abilities are more difficult to avoid if they are near one another.
• Imperial Guards will arrive in mole machines on both ends of the room.
• Ironfoe's multiattack inflicts bursts of physical damage to Dagran's tank.
• Iron Brand will become lethal if it stacks too high.
• Fireguard Destroyers summoned by the Avatar of Ragnaros are powerful melee combatants in addition to inflicting high Fire damage to the entire raid.

• If Moira is not defeated quickly, Shadow Word: Nemesis and Shadow Word: Necrosis will overwhelm the raid.
• Twilight's Hammer Ambassadors inflict high damage with Pyroblast and they must be killed before they finish casting Moment of Twilight.
• Dagran's abilities will be more difficult to avoid and inflict higher damage when he becomes an Avatar of Flame.
• The damage of Avatar of Ragnaros' Volcanic Blast must be split and it will create Volcanic Stone beneath the target's feet.
• When a Fireguard Destroyer is destroyed, it will erupt in a Fiery Demise.

• If Shadow Word: Nemesis is dispelled, it will jump to two players. Try to delay removal as long as possible.
• When Shadow Word: Necrosis is passed, it will inflict raid wide damage, but target's cannot be healed while they suffer from it.
• Dagran's tank will suffer frequent burst of high damage.
• Once the Avatar of Ragnaros is summoned, the damage to the raid will spike significantly. All of his abilities inflict raid wide damage.

bosses.overview:
Emperor Dagran Thaurissan and Princess Moira Bronzebeard are both formidable combatants. Moira's Shadow Word: Nemesis and Shadow Word: Necrosis must be managed carefully or they will overwhelm the raid. Moira will attempt to heal Dagran with Radiant Infusion.

Dagran is a dangerous melee combatant that will Call Imperial Guard and Call Twilight's Hammer Ambassadors to repel the invaders. When Moira is defeated, Dagran will transform into a powerful Avatar of Flame, empowering all his abilities.

When he becomes desperate, Dagran willl Beseech The Firelord to save him. The Avatar of Ragnaros unleashes devastation that will slowly consume the entire room in molten fire until Dagran is defeated. Dagran will no longer call Imperial Guard or Twilight's Hammer Ambassadors to his side once Ragnaros joins the battle.

children.name: Ironfoe
children.text: Every autoattacks, Emperor Thaurissan strikes additional times.

children.name: Hand of Thaurissan
children.text: Hurls flaming hammers at players inflicting Fire damage and knocking players back.

children.name: Magma Clap
children.text: Slams the ground inflicting Fire damage to players nearby and causing violent explosions beneath distant players inflicting Fire damage.

children.name: Avatar of Flame
children.text: When Moira is defeated or Dagran falls below 70% health, Dagran transforms into a powerful Avatar of Flame, empowering his abilities.

children.name: Iron Brand
children.text: Ironfoe leaves behind Iron Brand inflicting Fire damage every 3 sec for 30 sec.

children.name: Molten Hand
children.text: Hands of Thaurissan emit spheres of magma along their path, inflicting Fire damage.

children.name: Magma Shock
children.text: Magma Clap applies Magma Shock, inflicting Fire damage every 3 sec for 15 sec.

children.name: Magma Shower
children.text: Magma Clap's explosions erupt in a shower of lava, inflicting Fire damage to players in the area.

children.name: Call Imperial Guard
children.text: A Dark Iron Imperial Guard arrives in a mole machine to assist the Emperor. The mole machine inflicts Physical damage and knocks players back.

children.name: Shrapnel Blast
children.text: Inflicts Physical damage to players in front of the caster every 3 sec for 30 sec.

children.name: Call Twilight's Hammer Ambassador
children.text: Twilight's Hammer Ambassadors arrive to defend Emperor Thaurissan.

children.name: Pyroblast
children.text: A fiery boulder Inflicts Fire damage and Fire damage every 3 sec for 15 sec.

children.name: Moment of Twilight
children.text: Embraces oblivion, inflicting Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Beseech the Firelord
children.text:
When Dagran falls below 70% health, he beseeches the Firelord for aid, gaining a shield that absorbs damage.

An Avatar of Ragnaros joins the battle inflicting Fire damage to all players. The damage is decreased farther from the impact point.

children.name: Mind Blast
children.text: A powerful psychic blast inflicts Shadow damage.

children.name: Shadow Word: Nemesis
children.text: Inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec until Moira is defeated. Every sec, Shadow Word: Nemesis gains a stack. Dispelling Shadow Word: Nemesis causes it to jump to other players.

children.name: Shadow Word: Necrosis
children.text: Afflicts a player with a shadowy contagion reducing healing taken by 70%. Standing within yards of another player for sec causes the contagion to pass to the nearby player and unleashes a Necrotic Blast.

children.name: Necrotic Blast
children.text: Inflicts Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Lingering Necrosis
children.text: After a player passes Shadow Word: Necrosis, they are afflicted with Lingering Necrosis.

children.name: Festering Necrosis
children.text: A player suffering from Lingering Necrosis attempting to receive Shadow Word: Necrosis will instead lose 99% health as Shadow damage.

children.name: Mind Shattering Screams
children.text: Moira unleashes a series of psychic waves every 2 sec for 12 sec, inflicting Shadow damage to players in the area.

children.name: Radiant Infusion
children.text: Moira channels a beam of holy fire into Dagran, restoring 1% health to Moira and Dagran every 0.5 sec for 10 sec. Players intercepting the beam suffer Radiant Burn every 0.5 sec and prevent the healing.

children.name: Radiant Burn
children.text: Inflicts Radiant damage every 1 sec for 10 sec.

children.name: Volcanic Blast
children.text: Ragnaros hurls a massive boulder of magma inflicting Fire damage split between players in the area and shattering the ground into Volcanic Stone. This damage pierces immunities.

children.name: Volcanic Stone
children.text: Inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec to players in the area.

children.name: Volcanic Volley
children.text: Ragnaros rains lava from above, inflicting Fire damage to players every ${1}.2 sec for 10 sec.

children.name: Summon Fireguard Destroyer
children.text: Ragnaros summons a Fireguard Destroyer. The summoning inflicts Fire damage to all enemies. Damage is reduced farther from the impact point.

children.name: Fire Nova
children.text: Inflicts Fire damage to all players.

children.name: Fiery Demise
children.text: Fireguard Destroyers erupt in a shower of flames inflicting Fire damage to players in the area and summoning Firelings. If no player is struck then all players suffer Fire damage.

heroic.name: Blackrock Depths
heroic.description: The smoldering Blackrock Depths are home to the Dark Iron dwarves and their emperor, Dagran Thaurissan. Like his predecessors, he serves under the iron rule of Ragnaros the Firelord, a merciless being summoned into the world centuries ago. The presence of chaotic elementals has attracted Twilight's Hammer cultists to the mountain domain. Along with Ragnaros' servants, they have pushed the dwarves toward increasingly destructive ends that could soon spell doom for all of Azeroth.

bosses.name: Lord Roccor
bosses.description: Lord Roccor loathes the scheming and backstabbing of his fellow fire elementals. To avoid serving alongside his kind in the Molten Core, the mighty being purposefully angered the Firelord. Roccor's risky gambit paid off: he was expelled from the core and forced to guard Blackrock Depths in isolation.

tips.text:
• Roiling Magma is cast on Lord Roccor's primary target and inflicts Fire damage to enemies in the area.
• Stepping on a Living Magma will destroy it and inflict damage over time to the player.
• When crystallized, Obsidian Elementals attack nearby players.
• Volcanic Upheaval inflicts significant damage to all players.

• Stepping on a Living Magma will destroy it and inflict damage over time to the player.
• When crystallized, Obsidian Elementals attack nearby players.
• Volcanic Upheaval inflicts significant damage to all players.

• Roiling Magma is cast on Lord Roccor's primary target and inflicts Fire damage to enemies in the area.
• Stepping on a Living Magma will destroy it and inflict damage over time to the player.
• Volcanic Upheaval inflicts significant damage to all players.

bosses.overview:
Lord Roccor casts Roiling Magma on his target, inflicting damage and providing the raw material to Crystallize his obsidian progeny.

When Lord Roccor reaches 95% health and every 20% damage suffered thereafter, he will cast Eruption, filling the room with Roiling Magma. Each Living Magma that reaches its destination will increase the power of the elemental created by Igneous Crystallization.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Roccor casts Volcanic Upheaval, inflicting huge damage to all players.

abilities.name: Roiling Magma
abilities.text: Lord Roccor creates a pool of roiling magma inflicting Volcanic damage every 1 sec to enemies in the area.

abilities.name: Crystallize
abilities.text: Lord Roccor transforms a pool of roiling magma into a Son of Roccor.

children.name: Slag Armor
children.text:
Inflicts Volcanic damage to an enemy every 3 sec for 15 sec.

Causes an enemy to take 20% increased damage for 15 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Eruption
