mythic.name: Liberation of Undermine
mythic.description: Despite the best efforts of the united cartels, Jastor Gallywix has holed himself away in The Gallagio and called in every favor ever owed to him... leaving a mountain of would-be oppressors between the goblins of Undermine and the Chrome King. Gazlowe and the rest of goblinkind will need to find their way into the casino to rid themselves of Gallywix for good.

bosses.name: Vexie and the Geargrinders
bosses.description: Vexie Fullthrottle has been paving a path of terror through the hearts of anyone her gang encounters. Answering Gallywix's call for aid, she and her crew are here to repay an old favor, and add a few new grease stains to Undermine's streets.

tips.text:
•Defeated Geargrinder Bikers surrender their bikes, allowing for Blaze of Glory.
•Tank Buster leaves an Oil Slick at the caster's location.
•Vexie's Tune-Up and Pit Mechanics' Repair the Geargrinder's Protective Plating.

•Defeated Geargrinder Bikers surrender their bikes, allowing for Blaze of Glory.
•Vexie's Tune-Up and Pit Mechanics' Repair the Geargrinder's Protective Plating.
•Mechanical Breakdown causes the Geargrinder to take increased damage.

•Defeated Geargrinder Bikers surrender their bikes, allowing for Blaze of Glory.
•Spew Oil inflicts moderate damage to afflicted players.
•While the Geargrinder suffers from a Mechanical Breakdown all players take damage from Backfire.
•Mechanical Breakdown causes the Geargrinder to take increased damage.

bosses.overview:
The Geargrinder begins the encounter encased in Protective Plating, slowly generating energy in preparation for Unrelenting CAR-nage. While atop her war-tank, Vexie calls in Geargrinder Bikers to assist her. When a biker is defeated they surrender their ride, allowing players to unleash a Blaze of Glory and removing an application of Protective Plating. Once all Protective Plating is removed, the Geargrinder suffers a Mechanical Breakdown.

While broken down, Vexie begins to Tune-Up the war-tank and calls Pit Mechanics to Repair the Geargrinder. Once fully repaired Vexie commands the Geargrinder to continue its assault!

children.name: Durability
children.text:
Durable plating protects the Geargrinder, allowing it to slowly gain energy.

When all applications of Protective Plating are removed, the Geargrinder enters a Mechanical Breakdown.

children.name: Unrelenting CAR-nage
children.text: Upon reaching 100 energy, The Geargrinder's engine goes into overdrive for 30 sec launching shrapnel at all players every 2 sec inflicting Fire damage and an additional Fire damage every 1 sec for 8 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Call Bikers
children.text: The Geargrinder calls in Geargrinder Bikers to aid it in battle.

children.name: Oil Canister
children.text:
Upon defeat, the bike explodes and sends canisters of oil flying through the air. A player can catch the oil canister, suffering Nature damage and becoming Soaked in Oil for 1 min.

Each canister that fails to hit a player explodes, leaving an Oil Slick behind.

children.name: Soaked in Oil
children.text: The player who catches an Oil Canister becomes soaked in oil, increasing damage taken from Oil Canister for 1 min.

children.name: Oil Slick
children.text:
The Geargrinder creates a pool of noxious oil that lasts for up to 5 min. Players within the pool suffer Nature damage every 1 sec and have their movement speed reduced by 30%. Additionally, players within the effect slip and slide along the ground.

Geargrinder Bikes passing over the Oil Slick spin out, stunning the rider for 5 sec.

children.name: Blaze of Glory
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Geargrinder bikes must be fueled oil canisters before being able to use Blaze of Glory.

children.name: Burning Shrapnel
children.text: The Geargrinder's protective plating shatters into multiple burning pieces of shrapnel, each inflicting Fire damage to players near the impact.

children.name: Hot Wheels
children.text: The Geargrinder Biker charges towards a player's location, inflicting Fire damage to players in their path and knocking them back.

children.name: Spew Oil
children.text: In Heroic and Mythic difficulties, Spew Oil leaves behind an Oil Slick.

children.name: Oil Slick
children.text:
The Geargrinder creates a pool of noxious oil that lasts for up to 5 min. Players within the pool suffer Nature damage every 1 sec and have their movement speed reduced by 30%. Additionally, players within the effect slip and slide along the ground.

Geargrinder Bikes passing over the Oil Slick spin out, stunning the rider for 5 sec.

children.name: Incendiary Fire
children.text: The Geargrinder focuses fire at several players for 6 sec, launching blazing shells at their location every 0.5 sec. Each shell inflicts Fire damage to players nearby.

children.name: Bomb Voyage!
children.text: Geargrinder bombers lob bombs at players, inflicting Fire damage on impact and causing the target to burn for Fire damage every 1.5 sec for 9 sec.

children.name: Tank Buster
children.text: In Heroic and Mythic difficulties, Tank Buster leaves behind an Oil Slick.

children.name: Exhaust Fumes
children.text: The Geargrinder releases smog that suffocates all players for 6 sec, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec. This increases in intensity by 25% with every cast.

children.name: Oil Slick
children.text:
The Geargrinder creates a pool of noxious oil that lasts for up to 5 min. Players within the pool suffer Nature damage every 1 sec and have their movement speed reduced by 30%. Additionally, players within the effect slip and slide along the ground.

Geargrinder Bikes passing over the Oil Slick spin out, stunning the rider for 5 sec.

children.name: Mechanical Breakdown
children.text:
With its removed, the Geargrinder breaks down causing it to suffer 100% increased damage taken until is restored.

In addition, the engine periodically Backfires sending into the arena.

children.name: Backfire
children.text: The Geargrinder's engine backfires, inflicting Fire damage every 2 sec to all players.

children.name: Burning Shrapnel
children.text: The Geargrinder's protective plating shatters into multiple burning pieces of shrapnel, each inflicting Fire damage to players near the impact.

children.name: Durability
children.text: Vexie orders emergency repairs to the Geargrinder causing it to repair its Protective Plating over 45 sec. Vexie also calls in a crew to assist with the repairs.

children.name: High Maintenance
children.text: The Support Rig inspires efficiency in nearby pit crew members, making Pit Mechanics within yards immune to crowd control effects.

children.name: Repair
children.text: The Pit Mechanic repairs 2% of the Geargrinder's every 2 sec until the plating is restored.

bosses.name: Cauldron of Carnage
bosses.description: Throughout history there have been many epic wars, but none more explosive than the rivalry between the galvanic gorilla Torq the Tempest, and the molten mechasaur Flarendo the Furious. Tonight, all bets are off when these two champions clash in the cauldron for a showdown that threatens to tear Undermine in two! Witness the carnage or be the shame of goblin kind.

tips.text:
•Blistering Spite and Galvanized Spite increase over time as players fight Flarendo and Torq.
• Eruption Stomp and Overload Burst inflict heavy damage.
• Flarendo and Torq take reduced damage while affected by Raised Guard.

•Blistering Spite and Galvanized Spite increase over time as players fight Flarendo and Torq.
• Static Charge erupts into a Static Discharge once it builds to maximum charge.
• Scrapbomb will inflict massive damage to the raid if no player is hit.

•Blistering Spite and Galvanized Spite increase over time as players fight Flarendo and Torq.
• Scrapbomb inflicts damage split evenly among players in its explosion radius.
• Colossal Clash inflicts heavy damage to all players

bosses.overview:
Flarendo and Torq put on a show for the audience, throwing Scrapbombs and afflicting arena combatants with Static Charge.
Upon reaching 100 energy, Flarendo and Torq come together in a Colossal Clash!

abilities.name: Colossal Clash
abilities.text:
Upon reaching 100 Energy, Flarendo and Torq clash in the middle of the arena for 20 sec. Their battle inflicts Fire and Nature damage to all players every sec and causes Zapbolts and Fiery Waves to erupt from them.

Each clash increases the damage of Colossal Clash by 15%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Collateral Damage
children.text: Torq calls down lightning strikes that inflict Nature damage to players near the impact locations.

children.name: Collateral Damage
children.text: Flarendo unleashes explosion-propelled flames that inflict Fire damage to players hit.

abilities.name: Fan Merch
abilities.text:
Fans periodically throw toys resembling Flarendo and Torq into the arena. Toys charge towards a rival toy within yards, destroying both in the process and inflicting Fire and Nature damage to all players every 1 sec for 3 sec. This effect stacks. During Colossal Clash, all toys charge their closest rival regardless of range, inflicting 500% increased damage.

Toys can be kicked by running into them.

abilities.name: Raised Guard
abilities.text: Flarendo and Torq bolster their defenses while within yards of each other reducing their damage taken by 99%. This effect does not occur during Colossal Clash.

abilities.name: Victory Lap
abilities.text: The last beast standing becomes the King of Carnage, increasing its damage by 50% every 5 sec and vastly increasing the range of some abilities.

children.name: Molten Spite
children.text: Flarendo radiates flame, applying Blistering Spite to all players nearby every 5 sec. Inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec for 15 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Scrapbomb
children.text: On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, Scrapbombs leaves behind a Molten Pool after exploding.

children.name: Molten Pool
children.text: Molten metal spreads across the ground, sending s in multiple directions and inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec to players touching it.

children.name: Fiery Wave
children.text: Flarendo unleashes explosion-propelled flames that inflict Fire damage to players hit.

children.name: Molten Phlegm
children.text: Flarendo coats a player in molten metal, inflicting Fire damage to all players with yards every 1 sec for 10 sec.

children.name: Blastburn Roarcannon
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Blastburn Roarcannon fires three beams in a cone.

children.name: Incandescent Jaws
children.text: Flarendo runs several calculations then stomps triggering an eruption beneath their current target that inflicts Fire damage and launches them high into the air, releasing Fiery Waves in multiple directions.

children.name: Galvanized Spite
children.text: Torq bristles with electricity, applying Galvanized Spite to all players nearby every 5 seconds. Inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec for 15 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Tempest Unleashed
children.text: Torq's suit has been overclocked, causing him to periodically call down.Zapbolts throughout the arena.

children.name: Static Charge
children.text: Torq's suit amplifies the electrical charges generated within yards. Until the next Colossal Clash, an electric charge courses through players that enter into range, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec. Additionally, while in range, the charge grows when the target moves and depletes when they are stationary. At max charge, it erupts into a Static Discharge.

children.name: Static Discharge
children.text: A maximum buildup of Static Charge stuns the player for 6 sec.

children.name: Thunderdrum Salvo
children.text: Torq rapidly drums his 'launch' button, firing missiles at all players nearby for 6 sec. Each missiles inflicts Nature damage nearby on impact.

children.name: Voltaic Image
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Voltaic Images also detonates upon expiration.

children.name: Lingering Electricity
children.text: Lingering Electricity inflicts Nature damage every 1 seconds to players within the area, silencing and pacifying them.

children.name: Lightning Bash
children.text: Torq smashes his current target, inflicting Physical damage. Additionally, 100% of unmitigated damage is inflicted as Nature damage.

bosses.name: Rik Reverb
bosses.description: Rik Reverb loves the boom of an explosion, the crackle of a firework and most importantly, the sound of his own voice. From his flying sonic resonator, Rik serves as Gallywix's partying promoter by enthralling the citizens of Undermine with addictive and deadly goblin beats.

tips.text:
• Rik Resonates additional power to nearby amplifiers.
• Sonic Blast inflicts Sonic damage in a frontal cone and applies Tinnitus. Sonic damage cannot be blocked or reduced by Armor.
• Amplifier Blowouts knock players into the air as Rik generates deadly Blaring Drops.

• Activating amplifiers drains their energy but applies Lingering Voltage.
• Rik gains a nullifying Sound Cloud in Stage Two.
• Amplifier Blowouts knock players into the air as Rik generates deadly Blaring Drops.

• Activating amplifiers drains their energy but applies Lingering Voltage.
• Faulty Zap inflicts damage to nearby players.
• Amplifier Blowouts knock players into the air as Rik generates deadly Blaring Drops.

bosses.overview:
Rik Reverb places entrancing amplifiers around the yard during Amplification. Upon reaching full power, the amplifiers go Haywire.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Rik unleashes Blaring Drops from his sonic resonator and causes each amplifier to Blowout.

children.name: Timed Release Audio Propagator
children.text: Rik deploys a sonic amplifier beneath his machine as his drones deploy amplifiers nearby. Each amplifier inflicts Physical damage to players near its impact location, knocking them away and stunning for 3 sec.

children.name: Amplifier
children.text: The amplifier gains power over time.

children.name: Feedback Nullifier
children.text: A sonic barrier protects the amplifier from losing power or suffering from Blowout!

children.name: Lingering Voltage
children.text: In Heroic and Mythic difficulties, the electricity lingers, increasing the damage taken from Lingering Voltage by 50% for 15 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Resonant Echoes
children.text: In Mythic difficulty, players hit by Resonant Echoes while already under its effect become entranced.

children.name: Entranced
children.text:
Allured by the sound of Rik's sweet voice, the target is lured towards him, unable to take any actions for 1 min.

Dealing sufficient damage to the charmed target will break them free of the effect.

children.name: Noise Pollution
children.text:
Rik's reverberating Amplifiers produce a low hum that inflicts Sonic damage to all players every 2 sec.

Each active Amplifier increases the damage of Noise Pollution by 25%.

children.name: Haywire
children.text: Upon reaching full power the amplifier goes haywire, inflicting Sonic damage to all players every 1 sec and expelling additional Resonant Echoes.

children.name: Echoing Chant
children.text: Rik rally-chants about Chrome-King Gallywix causing Resonant Echoes to burst out from all amplifiers in random directions.

children.name: Resonant Echoes
children.text: In Mythic difficulty, players hit by Resonant Echoes while already under its effect become entranced.

children.name: Entranced
children.text:
Allured by the sound of Rik's sweet voice, the target is lured towards him, unable to take any actions for 1 min.

Dealing sufficient damage to the charmed target will break them free of the effect.

children.name: Sound Cannon
children.text: In Mythic difficulty, Sound Cannon damage is split evenly among players in its path. Players become entranced if the target is brought below 75%.

children.name: Entranced
children.text:
Allured by the sound of Rik's sweet voice, the target is lured towards him, unable to take any actions for 1 min.

Dealing sufficient damage to the charmed target will break them free of the effect.

children.name: Faulty Zap
children.text: In Mythic difficulty, Faulty Zap causes a Static Jolt when afflicted players collide.

children.name: Static Jolt
children.text:
A burst of electricity erupts from colliding players if both are afflicted by Faulty Zap, inflicting Nature damage to all players.

This disruptive jolt removes Feedback Nullifier from amplifiers nearby.

children.name: Sparkblast Ignition
children.text:
Rik's stagehands toss pyrotechnics into the yard that inflict Fire damage to players near the impact location.

Pyrotechnics scatter burning sparks that inflict Fire damage to players near the impact locations.

Pyrotechnics provide Excitement when attacked.

children.name: Grand Finale
children.text: The pyrotechnic explodes after 15 sec inflicting Fire damage to all players every 1 sec for 15 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Excitement
children.text: Successful attacks on the pyrotechnics spark excitement, increasing movement speed by 10% and haste by 2% for 10 sec. This effect stacks up to times.

children.name: Resonance
children.text: Rik boosts the power generation of amplifiers within yards, causing them to gain additional power.

children.name: Sonic Blast
children.text: Rik's melee attacks inflict Sonic damage to players in a yard frontal cone and apply Tinnitus.

children.name: Tinnitus
children.text: Rik's Sonic Blasts increase the target's Sonic damage taken by 100% for 10 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Stage Two: Hype Hustle!
abilities.text: Rik encases himself in a barrier of sound as he overloads his amplifiers.

children.name: Blowout!
children.text: Haywire Amplifiers blow out from the force of the sound, knocking players nearby up into the air, inflicting Physical damage and granting them immunity to.

children.name: Sound Cloud
children.text: A nullifying bubble protects Rik Reverb and his flying sonic resonator from harm, reducing damage taken by 99% for 36 sec.

children.name: Blaring Drop
children.text: Rik's sonic resonator drops down out of the air, unleashing a ring of sonic demise inflicting Sonic damage to targets in its wake every 0.5 sec for 3 sec.

children.name: Hype Fever!
children.text: The third has no end! Rik consumes his Sound Cloud to increase all damage he inflicts by 300% and continues to cast Blaring Drops endlessly.

bosses.name: Stix Bunkjunker
bosses.description: It could be said that no city service is more essential than garbage collection... or at least that's what Stix Bunkjunker would like you to believe. Stix and his cleanup crew have been finding inventive ways to dispose of the city's unwanteds and unmentionables for as long as anyone can remember.

tips.text:
•Meltdown inflicts major damage to Stix's current target, especially if they are affected by Demolish.
•Scrapmasters and Junkyard Hyenas can be absorbed by Rolling Rubbish, depositing them wherever the ball is destroyed.
•Discarded Doomsplosive inflicts devastating raidwide damage if not absorbed by Rolling Rubbish.

•Scrapmasters and Junkyard Hyenas can be absorbed by Rolling Rubbish, depositing them wherever the ball is destroyed.
•Incinerator can turn nearby garbage piles into Hot Garbage.
•Discarded Doomsplosive inflicts devastating raidwide damage if not absorbed by Rolling Rubbish.

•Electromagnetic Sorting inflicts significant raidwide damage.
•Incinerator can turn nearby garbage piles into Hot Garbage.
•Discarded Doomsplosive inflicts devastating raidwide damage if not absorbed by Rolling Rubbish.

bosses.overview:
Stix assaults the players while slowly gaining energy. Upon reaching 100 energy Stix uses Electromagnetic Sorting, pulling Garbage Piles and Discarded Doomsplosives from the landfill while selecting several players to become Rolling Rubbish.

Eventually, Stix forces his mech into Overdrive and operates at Maximum Output until defeated.

abilities.name: Electromagnetic Sorting
abilities.text: Upon reaching 100 energy, Stix activates his mech's electromagnetic drive, inflicting Nature damage to all players every 1 sec for 5 sec and causing a variety of garbage to emerge from the landfill.

children.name: Rolling Rubbish
children.text:
Balls of garbage emerge beneath up to players, allowing them to control the ball's movement and roll over small enemies and garbage piles to absorb them.

After absorbing enough, the ball increases in size and can absorb even larger objects.

children.name: Garbage Dump
children.text:
Rolling Rubbish explodes on contact with Stix, inflicting up to ${/100}.1% of his maximum health as Nature damage based on the size of the ball.

The Rolling Rubbish is destroyed in the process.

children.name: Messed Up
children.text:
When Rolling Rubbish is destroyed, any enemies it absorbed are ejected to nearby locations.

After this traumatic experience they take 100% increased damage, but can no longer be absorbed by Rolling Rubbish.

children.name: Rolled!
children.text: Rolling Rubbish inflicts Physical damage on contact with other players and stuns them for 1 sec.

children.name: Garbage Pile
children.text:
Piles of garbage emerge from the landfill, knocking away nearby players.

Standing within a Garbage Pile reduces movement speed by 50% and inflicts Nature damage every 1 sec.

children.name: Discarded Doomsplosive
children.text:
An absolutely enormous unused bomb emerges from the landfill.

After 26 sec the bomb explodes, inflicting Fire damage and applying Doomsploded to all players.

children.name: Doomsploded
children.text: Inflicts Fire damage every 2 sec and increases damage taken from Discarded Doomsplosive by 200% for 1 min.

children.name: Muffled Doomsplosion
children.text:
Contact with a large enough Rolling Rubbish absorbs the Discarded Doomsplosive, triggering a muffled explosion that inflicts Fire damage to all players.

The Rolling Rubbish is destroyed in the process.

children.name: Territorial
children.text:
The Territorial Bombshell stubbornly guards its garbage pile, refusing to move and gaining immunity to crowd control effects.

Upon reaching 80% health, it abandons its garbage pile and this effect is removed.

children.name: Short Fuse
children.text:
After 30 sec, the Territorial Bombshell explodes, inflicting Fire damage to all players plus an additional Fire damage every 1 sec for 8 sec and killing itself in the process.

Contact with a large enough Rolling Rubbish triggers this effect instantly, destroying the Rolling Rubbish.

children.name: Prototype Powercoil
children.text:
Experimental powercoils emerge from the landfill.

Powercoils form a link with a random player and discharge their stored energy, inflicting Nature damage and applying 1 stack of Hypercharged every 0.5 sec for 10 sec.

children.name: Hypercharged
children.text: Excess charge builds up in the target's body, increasing damage taken from Prototype Powercoil by 30% per stack.

abilities.name: Cleanup Crew
abilities.text: Stix calls in his Cleanup Crew to help dispose of unwelcome visitors.

children.name: Scrap Rockets
children.text: The Scrapmaster locks on to a player and fires a salvo of salvaged rockets, inflicting Fire damage every ${0.8}.2 sec for 9 sec.

children.name: Dumpster Dive
children.text: The Scrapmaster jetpack jumps toward a player and slams into the landfill at their location, causing an explosion of garbage that inflicts Nature damage and knocks back players nearby.

children.name: The Recycler
children.text: The Scrapmaster locks onto a player for sec, then fires an incredibly destructive rocket that inflicts Fire damage on impact.

children.name: Infected Bite
children.text: The Junkyard Hyena sinks its filthy teeth into its current target, inflicting Physical damage.

abilities.name: Incinerator
abilities.text:
Stix fires rocket salvos at random players over 3 sec, inflicting Fire damage to players nearby and applying Incineration.

If this effect hits a Garbage Pile, it ignites and becomes Hot Garbage.

children.name: Incineration
children.text:
Players hit by Incinerator radiate intense heat every ${0.8}.2 sec for 3 sec, inflicting Fire damage to players nearby.

If this effect hits a Garbage Pile, it ignites and becomes Hot Garbage.

children.name: Hot Garbage
children.text: Ignited garbage inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec to players standing within the area and emits Toxic Fumes that affect all players.

children.name: Toxic Fumes
children.text: Deadly fumes released by burning garbage inflict Nature damage to all players every 2 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Demolish
abilities.text: Stix smashes his current target with a charged attack, inflicting Nature damage and Physical damage. In addition, all damage the target takes is increased by 100% for 50 sec.

abilities.name: Meltdown
abilities.text: Stix fries his current target with intense electricity, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Overdrive
abilities.text:
Stix eventually becomes impatient and forces his mech into Overdrive, temporarily reducing all damage taken by 99% as he soars sky-high and rains down countless Overcharged Bolts.

He then plunges back down with Trash Compactor and operates at Maximum Output until defeated.

children.name: Overcharged Bolt
children.text: Electricity arcs from Stix's mech to a nearby location, inflicting Nature damage to players near the impact.

children.name: Trash Compactor
children.text:
Stix completes the Overdrive process with an explosive landing, releasing an immense wave of electrical energy that inflicts Nature damage to players nearby.

The blast radiates outward inflicting an additional Nature damage to all players and knocking them back.

children.name: Maximum Output
children.text: In Mythic difficulty, Maximum Output increases the number of Scrapmasters summoned as part of Stix's Cleanup Crew.

bosses.name: Sprocketmonger Lockenstock
bosses.description: As one of Gallywix's top minds, Sprocketmonger Lockenstock cannot say no to innovation, meaning that his list of inventions stretches far longer than the conveyor belts in his refinery. Constantly looking to simultaneously cut both corners and costs, Lockenstock's always searching for new markets to test out his gadgets.

tips.text:
•Each application of Gravi-Gunk increases all damage taken.
•The damage of Pyro Party Pack is reduced the further the target is from other players.
•Foot-Blasters cause an Unstable Explosion that increases damage taken by Unstable Explosion for a short duration.

•Foot-Blasters cause an Unstable Explosion that increases damage taken by Unstable Explosion for a short duration.
•Players designated as Screw Ups periodically drop drills at their location.
•Wire Transfer inflicts significant damage to players standing within the effect

•Sonic Ba-Boom applies a damage over time effect to all players.
•Foot-Blasters cause an Unstable Explosion that increases damage taken by Unstable Explosion for a short duration.
•Voidsplosion inflicts significant damage to all players and absorbs healing taken.

bosses.overview:
Sprocketmonger Lockenstock prepares a demonstration for the players while slowly gaining energy. Conveyor belts around the factory produce explosive new technology for Lockenstock to Activate Inventions!.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Lockenstock prepares a Beta Launch of an improved contraption, infusing it with void powers before renewing his assault.

children.name: Activate Inventions!
children.text: Lockenstock halts the conveyors and electrifies them, inflicting Nature damage to players within the area every 0.2 sec. In addition, he activates all of his Inventions.

children.name: Blazing Beam
children.text: The Invention unleashes a line of fire for 4 sec, inflicting Fire damage every 0.2 sec to players within the effect.

children.name: Rocket Barrage
children.text: The Invention fires a massive rocket every 2 sec for 4 sec that inflicts Fire damage upon impact with a player.

children.name: Mega Magnetize
children.text: The Invention pulls players towards itself for 5 sec. Upon contact with the magnet, players become stunned for 6 sec.

children.name: Jumbo Void Beam
children.text: The Invention unleashes a massive beam of void energy inflicting Shadow damage every 0.2 sec to players within the effect.

children.name: Void Barrage
children.text: The Invention launches a void projectile every 2.5 sec for 5 sec. Touching a projectile inflicts Shadow damage and triggers a Voidsplash.

children.name: Voidsplash
children.text: Void energy erupts from the impact, inflicting Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Polarization Generator
children.text: Lockenstock polarizes all players, inflicting Nature damage every 0.5 sec and afflicting them with either Posi-Polarization or Nega-Polarization.

children.name: Posi-Polarization
children.text:
Lockenstock infuses the target with a positive charge until the next cast of Polarization Generator.

Contact with players afflicted with Nega-Polarization will trigger a Polarization Blast.

children.name: Nega-Polarization
children.text:
Lockenstock infuses the target with a negative charge until the next cast of Polarization Generator.

Contact with players afflicted with Posi-Polarization will trigger a Polarization Blast.

children.name: Polarization Blast
children.text: Contact with a player of the opposite charge causes an explosive reaction, knocking both players away from each other and inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec for 6 sec.

children.name: Foot-Blasters
children.text: In Mythic difficulty, Foot-Blasters spawn with Posi-Polarization or Nega-Polarization. Contact with an opposite polarity or Goblin Inventions will trigger a Polarized Catastro-Blast.

children.name: Polarized Catastro-Blast
children.text: The mismatched polarities result in an especially deadly blast, inflicting Fire damage to all players and causing them to take 500% increased damage from Unstable Explosion and Polarized Catastro-Blast for 2 sec.

children.name: Unstable Explosion
children.text: When a Foot-Blaster is detonated, it explodes inflicting Fire damage to all players and causes them to take 200% increased damage from Unstable Explosion for 2 sec.

children.name: Unstable Shrapnel
children.text: Touching the Foot-Blaster causes fragments to embed themselves in the target, inflicting Fire damage and increasing damage taken from Unstable Shrapnel by 1000% for 2 min.

children.name: Wire Transfer
children.text: Lockenstock overloads the capacitors around the factory causing a section of the floor to become electrified. Standing within these areas inflicts Nature damage to players every 1 sec and reduces their movement speed by 40%.

children.name: Screw Up
children.text:
Lockenstock marks players, inflicting Nature damage and causing a deadly drill to emerge at their location every 1.5 sec for 4.5 sec.

Touching a drill causes the player to become Screwed!

children.name: Screwed!
children.text: Touching a drill punctures players, stunning them and causing them to bleed for Physical damage every 1 sec for up to 6 sec.

children.name: Sonic Ba-Boom
children.text: Lockenstock fires an enormous blast of gravitational energy, inflicting Sonic damage to all players and an additional Sonic damage every 0.5 sec for 10 sec.

children.name: Blisterizer Mk. II
children.text: Touching a trap causes it snap shut, launching the player into the air and inflicting Fire damage every 0.5 sec. The pain of the fiery blister additionally increases movement speed by 60% for 6 sec.

children.name: Gravi-Grip
children.text: Lockenstock gifts his current target a package of explosives. After 6 sec the recipient explodes, inflicting up to Fire damage to all players. Players further from the impact position receive less damage.

children.name: Gravi-Gunk
children.text: Lockenstock's attacks cause energy to cling to the current target, increasing all damage taken by 20% and reducing their movement speed by 5%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Beta Launch
children.text: Upon reaching 100 Energy Lockenstock flings pesky players away from him and begins channeling Bleeding Edge.

children.name: [ph] Absorb shield
children.text: Lockenstock debuts his explosive new tech, upgrading an Invention type with potent void energies. In addition, the unstable chemicals unleash a Voidsplosion every 5 sec as torrents of Black Bloodsplatter rain down on the facility for 20 sec.

children.name: Voidsplosion
children.text: Lockenstock teems with unstable black blood unleashing waves of void energy that inflict Shadow damage to all players and cause the next healing to be absorbed.

children.name: Black Bloodsplatter
children.text: Gouts of black blood gush out of the canisters throughout the facility splattering to the ground, inflicting Shadow damage to players near the impact and disorienting them for 2 sec.

children.name: Upgraded Bloodtech
children.text: Lockenstock becomes empowered by the black blood infusion, increasing his damage done by 15%. This effect stacks.

bosses.name: The One-Armed Bandit
bosses.description: The One-Armed Bandit is the premiere slot machine in Gallywix's casino. All the delightful device asks is that you play fairly and don't cheat. The rules by which it determines this are an enigmatic mystery, although the one-armed punishment it dispenses cannot be missed.

tips.text:
•The Big Hit inflicts high damage and leaves behind a Shocking Field.
•Activating a Shock Coil causes Explosive Shrapnel to inflict high damage and absorb nearby Shocking Fields.
•If two tokens are not deposited or a repeat combination is detected during Spin to Win!, the One-Armed Bandit uses Fraud Detected!.

•Reel Assistants called forth from Spin To Win! Bear icons that can be slotted back into the One-Armed Bandit.
•If two tokens are not deposited or a repeat combination is detected during Spin to Win!, the One-Armed Bandit uses Fraud Detected!.
•Standing close to the Pay-Line chip will grant High Roller!.

•If two tokens are not deposited or a repeat combination is detected during Spin to Win!, the One-Armed Bandit uses Fraud Detected!.
•Foul Exhaust reduces the movement speed of all players and absorbs a large amount of healing.
•Standing close to the Pay-Line chip will grant High Roller!.

bosses.overview:
The One-Armed Bandit assaults players while slowly gaining energy. Upon reaching 100 energy, it uses Spin to Win! To call upon Reel Assistants bearing various symbol Tokens. Defeating these assistants and depositing their tokens within the One-Armed Bandit determines the result.

After all of the valid combinations have been rolled, the One-Armed Bandit overloads and takes control of its own reels using Cheat to Win! In a final attempt to destroy its enemies.

children.name: Spin To Win!
children.text:
The One-Armed Bandit pulls its big arm, calling in Reel Assistants and spinning the reels rapidly for 30 sec. Defeating an assistant makes it drop its Token, which players can deposit in the One-Armed Bandit to lock it in.

When two Tokens are locked in, the "Fabulous Prize" is dispensed.

children.name: Fraud Detected!
children.text: The One-Armed Bandit successfully cheats when not enough Tokens are deposited or a previously selected reel combination is locked in, permanently increasing its damage done by 500%.

children.name: Reward: Shock and Flame
children.text: Depositing a Shock Token and a Flame Token creates a Superheated Coil. This electric coil releases Traveling Flames when created or activated.

children.name: Traveling Flames
children.text: Colliding with Traveling Flames inflicts Fire damage and knocks players back.

children.name: Explosive Shrapnel
children.text: Activating a Coil inflicts Physical damage to the player who activates it and triggers the Coil's effect. In addition, the Coil draws in and absorbs the nearest Shocking Fields.

children.name: Reward: Shock and Bomb
children.text: Depositing a Shock Token and a Bomb Token creates a Dynamite-Laden Coil. This electric coil releases Dynamite Booty when created or activated.

children.name: Explosive Gaze
children.text: In Heroic and Mythic difficulty, the Dynamite Booty explosion additionally inflicts Fire damage over time.

children.name: Explosive Shrapnel
children.text: Activating a Coil inflicts Physical damage to the player who activates it and triggers the Coil's effect. In addition, the Coil draws in and absorbs the nearest Shocking Fields.

children.name: Flame and Bomb
children.text: Depositing a Flame Token and a Bomb Token calls forth multiple Fiery Dynamite Booty bots, which have 100% increased health and 30% reduced movement speed. These detonate with a.

children.name: Explosive Gaze
children.text: In Heroic and Mythic difficulty, the Dynamite Booty explosion additionally inflicts Fire damage over time.

children.name: Burning Blast
children.text:
Upon death, the Fiery Dynamite Booty explodes and inflicts Fire damage to players nearby.

This explosion releases waves of Traveling Flames.

children.name: Traveling Flames
children.text: Colliding with Traveling Flames inflicts Fire damage and knocks players back.

children.name: Flame and Coin
children.text: Depositing a Flame Token and a Coin Token causes the One-Armed Bandit to fire searing hot coins at all players every 0.5 sec for 8 sec. These coins inflict Fire damage every 0.5 sec for 6 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Shock and Coin
children.text: Depositing a Coin Token and a Shock Token creates a Premium Currency Coil plated with gold. This electric coil activates Coin Magnet when created or activated.

children.name: Coin Magnet
children.text: The Premium Currency Coil attracts the gold in player bags, pulling them towards itself and inflicting Physical damage every 1 sec for 5 sec.

children.name: Explosive Shrapnel
children.text: Activating a Coil inflicts Physical damage to the player who activates it and triggers the Coil's effect. In addition, the Coil draws in and absorbs the nearest Shocking Fields.

children.name: Coin and Bomb
children.text: Depositing a Coin Token and a Bomb Token calls forth a multiple Premium Dynamite Booty bots plated with gold. The premium currency increases its health by 75% and damage done by 50% and makes it immune to crowd controlling and interrupting effects.

children.name: Explosive Gaze
children.text: In Heroic and Mythic difficulty, the Dynamite Booty explosion additionally inflicts Fire damage over time.

children.name: Dark Lined Cuirass
children.text:
Reel Assistants wear D.L.C. Armor, preventing them from being damaged below 25% health.

Smashing them with a Pay-Line chip unlocks the rest of the health bar.

children.name: Overload!
children.text: The assistant releases a massive jolt of electricity, inflicting Nature damage to all players and knocking them back.

children.name: Flame Vents
children.text:
Reel Assistants wrap flames around a player, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec for 30 sec. This inferno reduces the targets maximum health by 2% every time the flames inflict damage.

Upon removal, Traveling Flames erupt outwards from the player.

children.name: Traveling Flames
children.text: Colliding with Traveling Flames inflicts Fire damage and knocks players back.

children.name: Shock Baton
children.text: The Reel Assistant blasts its target, inflicting Nature damage. Every 2 sec for 6 sec, electricity arcs off of the target and inflicts Nature damage to all other players. This effect stacks.

children.name: Golden Ticket
children.text: Each time the One-Armed Bandit spins its reels, it gains 5% attack speed. This effect stacks.

children.name: Pay-Line
children.text:
The One-Armed Bandit rolls a massive casino chip towards players, causing anyone caught in its path to become Crushed!. Players can stand near the path to become a High Roller!.

Upon reaching its destination, the chip then falls over and inflicts Nature damage to players nearby with an additional Nature damage to all players.

Players may roll these chips back to destroy them.

children.name: High Roller!
children.text: Players become high rollers, increasing damage and healing done by 10% and movement speed by 30% for 15 sec.

children.name: Crushed!
children.text: Players rolled over by the chip are crushed underneath it, suffering Physical damage and becoming stunned for 8 sec.

children.name: Up the Ante
children.text: While a Pay-Line chip is in play, the One-Armed Bandit's damage done is increased by 5%. This effect stacks for each token.

children.name: Rip Fumes
children.text:
The One-Armed Bandit blasts out smoky exhaust at all players every 0.5 sec for 1.5 sec. Each blast absorbs the next healing received.

While this effect persists, it inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec and reduces movement speed by 20% per application.

children.name: The Big Hit
children.text: In Mythic difficulty, The Big Hit also arcs lightning to extra players creating additional Shocking Fields.

children.name: Shocking Field
children.text: Players standing within the electric field take 100% increased damage and suffer Nature damage every 1 sec.

abilities.name: Stage Two: This Game Is Rigged!

children.name: Spin To Win!
children.text: The One-Armed Bandit cheats the system and determines its own results in a specific order.

children.name: Linked Machines
children.text: Three Shock symbols causes the One-Armed Bandit to periodically create Hyper Coils. A Hyper Coil knocks back all players on creation or activation and is linked to the One-Armed Bandit with a Voltaic Streak.

children.name: Voltaic Streak
children.text: Crossing the beam inflicts Nature damage every 0.3 sec to players.

children.name: Explosive Shrapnel
children.text: Activating a Coil inflicts Physical damage to the player who activates it and triggers the Coil's effect. In addition, the Coil draws in and absorbs the nearest Shocking Fields.

children.name: Hot Hot Heat
children.text: Three Flame symbols causes blazing flames to erupt from the One-Armed Bandit, marking random players for 5 sec. Upon expiration or removal, a line of flames blasts out towards them from the One-Armed Bandit, inflicting Fire damage to all players struck.

children.name: Scattered Payout
children.text: Three Coin symbols causes the One-Armed Bandit to fire golden coins wildly, inflicting Physical damage to all players every 2 sec until it is destroyed.

children.name: Explosive Jackpot
children.text: Three Bomb symbols causes the One-Armed Bandit to explode. Killing everybody. Painfully.

children.name: Pay-Line
children.text:
The One-Armed Bandit rolls a massive casino chip towards players, causing anyone caught in its path to become Crushed!. Players can stand near the path to become a High Roller!.

Upon reaching its destination, the chip then falls over and inflicts Nature damage to players nearby with an additional Nature damage to all players.

Players may roll these chips back to destroy them.

children.name: High Roller!
children.text: Players become high rollers, increasing damage and healing done by 10% and movement speed by 30% for 15 sec.

children.name: Crushed!
children.text: Players rolled over by the chip are crushed underneath it, suffering Physical damage and becoming stunned for 8 sec.

children.name: Up the Ante
children.text: While a Pay-Line chip is in play, the One-Armed Bandit's damage done is increased by 5%. This effect stacks for each token.

children.name: Rip Fumes
children.text:
The One-Armed Bandit blasts out smoky exhaust at all players every 0.5 sec for 1.5 sec. Each blast absorbs the next healing received.

While this effect persists, it inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec and reduces movement speed by 20% per application.

children.name: The Big Hit
children.text: In Mythic difficulty, The Big Hit also arcs lightning to extra players creating additional Shocking Fields.

bosses.name: Mug'Zee, Heads of Security
bosses.description: Buddies from the day they were born, Mug'Zee's two heads are the topper of a giant hulk of an ogre enforcer, specifically hired by Gallywix to oversee his casino's day-to-day activities. In recent weeks, Mug'Zee's been reassigned to keep anyone and everyone out of the Gallagio's innermost chambers.

tips.text:
•Molten Gold Knuckles inflict heavy damage in front of Mug and apply Golden Drip to players hit.
•Damage from Double Whammy Shot is mitigated by the closest player hit.

•Earthshaker Gaols splits damage among all players within the effect, trapping them within earthen walls.
•Frostshatter Spears inflict lethal damage to the first player or Earthshaker Gaol wall they hit.
•Touching Unstable Crawler Mines causes them to explode, unleashing an Unstable Cluster Bomb and causing all players to suffer from Searing Shrapnel.

•Elemental Calamity and Uncontrolled Burn inflict persistent damage over time each time Mug'zee swaps which head is the Head Honcho.
•Mug'Zee gains Moxie the longer each head is in command.
•Frostshatter Spears inflict lethal damage to the first player or Earthshaker Gaol wall they hit.

bosses.overview:
The two heads of Mug'Zee, Mug and Zee, begin the encounter in a friendly contest to see who is in control. Whichever head has players on their side of the arena becomes the Head Honcho, activating a unique set of abilities to unleash upon players.

Upon reaching 40% remaining health, Mug and Zee combine their efforts and attack in unison granting them the use of all of their abilities at once.

abilities.name: Stage One: The Heads of Security

children.name: Head Honcho
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Mug'Zee can only swap Head Honcho when all players are on either side of the room.

children.name: Moxie
children.text: Mug'Zee grows resolute over time, increasing their damage done by 1% every 5 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Elemental Carnage
children.text:
Mug takes charge by commanding the elements to assault players, inflicting Elemental damage to all players every 1.5 sec for 6 sec.

Players are then branded with Elemental Calamity.

children.name: Elemental Calamity
children.text: Mug emanates with elemental ferocity, inflicting Elemental damage to all players every 1.5 sec for 10 min. This effect stacks.

children.name: Uncontrolled Destruction
children.text:
Zee takes charge by calling in bombs, rockets, and drones, inflicting Fire damage to all players every 0.5 sec for 6 sec.

Players are then afflicted with Uncontrolled Burn.

children.name: Uncontrolled Burn
children.text: The chaotic destruction burns, inflicting Fire damage to all players every 0.5 sec for 10 min. This effect stacks.

children.name: Double-Minded Fury
children.text: Upon reaching 100 energy, Mug'Zee enrages and fires volleys of lightning and lead, inflicting Fire damage to all players every 1 sec.

children.name: Mug
children.text: Mug commands Gallagio Goons to lock down several players inside earthen gaols, inflicting Nature damage split evenly among all players near the impact.

children.name: Enraged
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Gallagio Goons that become Enraged also have their damage taken reduced by 99%.

children.name: Shakedown
children.text: The goon violently erupts the earth in a frontal cone, inflicting Nature damage.

children.name: Pay Respects
children.text: The goon pays its respects to Mug'Zee, causing him to absorb damage, increasing every 1 sec for 10 sec.

children.name: Gaol Break
children.text:
The goon erupts when killed, inflicting Nature damage to players within the gaol and knocking them back.

Colliding with a wall of Earthshaker Gaol causes it to be destroyed.

children.name: Shaken Earth
children.text: The goons death causes the earth to shake, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec to players within the gaol.

children.name: Frostshatter Boots
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Frostshatter Boots last indefinitely until coming into contact with a Hot Mess.

children.name: Frostshatter Spear
children.text: A lethal ice spear launches at the afflicted player, inflicting Frost damage. Frostshatter Spear impacts the first player, Earthshaker Gaol wall, or Unstable Crawler Mine hit, freezing them for 30 sec.

children.name: Stormfury Finger Gun
children.text:
Mug fulminates lightning outward from his finger, inflicting Nature damage in a frontal cone every 0.5 sec for 4 sec.

The excess electricity in the area creates a Stormfury Cloud.

children.name: Stormfury Cloud
children.text: A looming storm cloud crackles with energy, unleashing bolts that strike the ground, inflicting Nature damage to players near impact locations and stunning players hit for 2 sec.

children.name: Molten Gold Knuckles
children.text:
Mug unleashes a blow of molten gold and lava in a frontal cone, inflicting Physical damage and Fire damage, knocking them back.

Players hit are covered in Golden Drip.

children.name: Golden Drip
children.text:
The blow leaves players covered in molten gold, causing players to drip Molten Gold Pools in their wake. Each pool that is created removes an application of Golden Drip.

After 10 sec, if Golden Drip isn't removed the player is turned to Solid Gold.

children.name: Solid Gold
children.text: The molten gold eventually solidifies, stunning players for 30 sec.

children.name: Molten Gold Pool
children.text: The molten gold drips to the ground and creates pools for 3 min. Contact with the gold inflicts Fire damage every 0.5 sec and slows movement speed by 20%.

children.name: Unstable Crawler Mines
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Unstable Crawler Mine's inflict lethal damage to the player triggering it.

children.name: Unstable Cluster Bomb
children.text:
The mine explodes into a cluster of bombs, inflicting Fire damage to players near the impact locations.

Clusters that fail to hit a player inflict Fire damage to all players.

children.name: Searing Shrapnel
children.text: The blast embeds searing shrapnel in the player's flesh causing them to absorb the next healing. While afflicted by this effect, they also suffer Fire damage every 1 sec. $?diff16,15[This effect stacks.][]

children.name: Experimental Plating
children.text:
The crawler mine is covered in experimental plating, granting immunity to all damage.

Upon reaching 100 energy, the mine becomes immune to crowd control effects and gains 200% movement speed.

children.name: Goblin-guided Rocket
children.text: On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, players hit by Goblin-guided Rocket become afflicted with Radiation Sickness.

children.name: Volunteer Rocketeer
children.text: After surviving the rocket's impact the Rocketeer begins to assault players.

children.name: PH Ability
children.text: The goblin fires a disintigration beam at a random player, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec for 12 sec. Every 1 sec, damage is increased by 100%.

children.name: Rocket Jump
children.text: The goblin activates their rocket belt to jump to a player.

children.name: Hot Mess
children.text: The rocket leaves behind a fiery mess. Players within this effect suffer Fire damage every 1 sec.

children.name: Radiation Sickness
children.text: Players impacted by the rocket suffer radiation sickness, increasing the damage taken from Goblin-guided Rocket by 500% for 3 min.

children.name: Spray and Pray
children.text: Zee unleashes a cone of bullets at a player, inflicting Physical damage every 0.3 for 3 sec to players standing within the effect and detonating any hit Unstable Crawler Mines.

children.name: Mk II Electro Shocker
children.text:
Zee summons MK II Electro Shockers when he becomes the Head Honcho.

On Mythic difficulty, MK II Electro Shockers gain Electro-Charged Shield until hit by Stormfury Finger Gun.

children.name: Surging Arc
children.text: The MK II Electro Shocker fires an arc of electricity at a random player, inflicting Nature damage and then jumping to up to targets. This damage increases by 10% each time it jumps.

children.name: Faulty Wiring
children.text: Upon reaching 80% health the flyer malfunctions, becoming stunned and taking 100% increased damage for 8 sec.

children.name: Electro-Charged Shield
children.text:
The MK II Electro Shocker envelopes itself in charged energy, reducing damage taken by 99%.

Removed upon being hit with Stormfury Finger Gun.

children.name: Double Whammy Shot
children.text:
Zee fires an explosive high caliber round towards a random player, inflicting Physical damage to the closest player and applying Perforating Wound. All other targets take up to Physical damage, reduced by the closest player's total damage mitigation.

Unstable Crawler Mines hit are detonated and all players hit are stunned for 2 sec. In addition, an Explosive Payload is lodged in the original target.

children.name: Perforating Wound
children.text: The force from the round rips through the first player hit, inflicting Physical damage every 1.5 sec for 45 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Explosive Payload
children.text: The round lodges in the original target exploding after 6 sec, inflicting Fire damage to players and detonates Unstable Crawler Mines nearby.

abilities.name: Intermission: Bulletstorm
abilities.text: Upon reaching 40% health both heads decide to work together unleashing a series of Static Charges and Bulletstorms before their final, combined, assault begins.

children.name: Electrocution Matrix
children.text: Mug'Zee unleashes his Electrocution Matrix and divides the arena in two, instantly killing players who come into contact with it.

children.name: Static Charge
children.text:
Mug'Zee harnesses electricity around him and charges, inflicting Physical damage to players in his path, destroying all Earthshaker Gaols and Unstable Crawler Mines.

Upon reaching his target, Mug'Zee unleashes a Bulletstorm.

children.name: Bulletstorm
children.text:
Mug'zee spins in place firing volleys of lightning and lead for 8 sec. Mug unleashes thunderous waves of lightning inflicting Nature damage every 0.5 sec to all players in a cone on one side of Mug'zee and Zee fires a spray of bullets inflicting Physical damage every 0.3 sec to all players in a cone on the opposite side of Mug'zee.

All damage from Bulletstorm destroys Earthshaker Gaol and detonates Unstable Crawler Mines.

children.name: Stormfury Cloud
children.text: A looming storm cloud crackles with energy, unleashing bolts that strike the ground, inflicting Nature damage to players near impact locations and stunning players hit for 2 sec.

children.name: Mug'Zee
children.text: Mug'Zee joins forces as the Head Honcho and gains access to all of their abilities from Stage One.

children.name: Bloodlust
children.text: Mug'Zee empowers themselves, increasing Haste by 30%.

children.name: Moxie
children.text: Mug'Zee grows resolute over time, increasing their damage done by 1% every 5 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Double-Minded Fury
children.text: Upon reaching 100 energy, Mug'Zee enrages and fires volleys of lightning and lead, inflicting Fire damage to all players every 1 sec.

children.name: Mug
children.text: Mug commands Gallagio Goons to lock down several players inside earthen gaols, inflicting Nature damage split evenly among all players near the impact.

children.name: Enraged
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Gallagio Goons that become Enraged also have their damage taken reduced by 99%.

children.name: Shakedown
children.text: The goon violently erupts the earth in a frontal cone, inflicting Nature damage.

children.name: Pay Respects
children.text: The goon pays its respects to Mug'Zee, causing him to absorb damage, increasing every 1 sec for 10 sec.

children.name: Gaol Break
children.text:
The goon erupts when killed, inflicting Nature damage to players within the gaol and knocking them back.

Colliding with a wall of Earthshaker Gaol causes it to be destroyed.

children.name: Shaken Earth
children.text: The goons death causes the earth to shake, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec to players within the gaol.

children.name: Frostshatter Boots
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Frostshatter Boots last indefinitely until coming into contact with a Hot Mess.

children.name: Frostshatter Spear
children.text: A lethal ice spear launches at the afflicted player, inflicting Frost damage. Frostshatter Spear impacts the first player, Earthshaker Gaol wall, or Unstable Crawler Mine hit, freezing them for 30 sec.

children.name: Stormfury Finger Gun
children.text:
Mug fulminates lightning outward from his finger, inflicting Nature damage in a frontal cone every 0.5 sec for 4 sec.

The excess electricity in the area creates a Stormfury Cloud.

children.name: Stormfury Cloud
children.text: A looming storm cloud crackles with energy, unleashing bolts that strike the ground, inflicting Nature damage to players near impact locations and stunning players hit for 2 sec.

children.name: Molten Gold Knuckles
children.text:
Mug unleashes a blow of molten gold and lava in a frontal cone, inflicting Physical damage and Fire damage, knocking them back.

Players hit are covered in Golden Drip.

children.name: Golden Drip
children.text:
The blow leaves players covered in molten gold, causing players to drip Molten Gold Pools in their wake. Each pool that is created removes an application of Golden Drip.

After 10 sec, if Golden Drip isn't removed the player is turned to Solid Gold.

children.name: Solid Gold
children.text: The molten gold eventually solidifies, stunning players for 30 sec.

children.name: Molten Gold Pool
children.text: The molten gold drips to the ground and creates pools for 3 min. Contact with the gold inflicts Fire damage every 0.5 sec and slows movement speed by 20%.

children.name: Unstable Crawler Mines
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Unstable Crawler Mine's inflict lethal damage to the player triggering it.

children.name: Unstable Cluster Bomb
children.text:
The mine explodes into a cluster of bombs, inflicting Fire damage to players near the impact locations.

Clusters that fail to hit a player inflict Fire damage to all players.

children.name: Searing Shrapnel
children.text: The blast embeds searing shrapnel in the player's flesh causing them to absorb the next healing. While afflicted by this effect, they also suffer Fire damage every 1 sec. $?diff16,15[This effect stacks.][]

children.name: Experimental Plating
children.text:
The crawler mine is covered in experimental plating, granting immunity to all damage.

Upon reaching 100 energy, the mine becomes immune to crowd control effects and gains 200% movement speed.

children.name: Goblin-guided Rocket
children.text: On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, players hit by Goblin-guided Rocket become afflicted with Radiation Sickness.

children.name: Volunteer Rocketeer
children.text: After surviving the rocket's impact the Rocketeer begins to assault players.

children.name: PH Ability
children.text: The goblin fires a disintigration beam at a random player, inflicting Fire damage every 1 sec for 12 sec. Every 1 sec, damage is increased by 100%.

children.name: Rocket Jump
children.text: The goblin activates their rocket belt to jump to a player.

children.name: Hot Mess
children.text: The rocket leaves behind a fiery mess. Players within this effect suffer Fire damage every 1 sec.

children.name: Radiation Sickness
children.text: Players impacted by the rocket suffer radiation sickness, increasing the damage taken from Goblin-guided Rocket by 500% for 3 min.

children.name: Spray and Pray
children.text: Zee unleashes a cone of bullets at a player, inflicting Physical damage every 0.3 for 3 sec to players standing within the effect and detonating any hit Unstable Crawler Mines.

children.name: Mk II Electro Shocker
children.text:
Zee summons MK II Electro Shockers when he becomes the Head Honcho.

On Mythic difficulty, MK II Electro Shockers gain Electro-Charged Shield until hit by Stormfury Finger Gun.

children.name: Surging Arc
children.text: The MK II Electro Shocker fires an arc of electricity at a random player, inflicting Nature damage and then jumping to up to targets. This damage increases by 10% each time it jumps.

children.name: Faulty Wiring
children.text: Upon reaching 80% health the flyer malfunctions, becoming stunned and taking 100% increased damage for 8 sec.

children.name: Electro-Charged Shield
children.text:
The MK II Electro Shocker envelopes itself in charged energy, reducing damage taken by 99%.

Removed upon being hit with Stormfury Finger Gun.

children.name: Double Whammy Shot
children.text:
Zee fires an explosive high caliber round towards a random player, inflicting Physical damage to the closest player and applying Perforating Wound. All other targets take up to Physical damage, reduced by the closest player's total damage mitigation.

Unstable Crawler Mines hit are detonated and all players hit are stunned for 2 sec. In addition, an Explosive Payload is lodged in the original target.

children.name: Perforating Wound
children.text: The force from the round rips through the first player hit, inflicting Physical damage every 1.5 sec for 45 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Explosive Payload
children.text: The round lodges in the original target exploding after 6 sec, inflicting Fire damage to players and detonates Unstable Crawler Mines nearby.

bosses.name: Chrome King Gallywix
bosses.description: Having taken a 'strategic retreat,' Jastor Gallywix holed up in the halls of the Gallagio. Whatever Gallywix has been working on, it's guaranteed to be powerful, deadly, and capable of crushing any who oppose him.

tips.text:
•Scatterblast Canisters and Bigger Badder Bomb Blast affect players in Gallywix's frontal direction.
•Dying Darkfuse Technicians drop Giga Bombs that go Giga BOOM! After. Gallywix's Giga Blast detonates these immediately.
•Gallywix release all Trick Shots upon reaching stacks or when changing primary targets.

•Player affected by Mechengineer's Canisters detonate on consumption or expiration causing a Canister Detonation.
•Dying Darkfuse Technicians drop Giga Bombs that go Giga BOOM! After. Gallywix's Giga Blast detonates these immediately.
•Charged Giga Bombs brought to Giga Controls trigger a Giga Bomb Detonation causing Control Meltdown which interrupts Gallywix's Giga Coils.
•Giga Coils, Zagging Zizzler, and TOTAL DESTRUCTION!!! Inflict significant damage.

•Big Bad Buncha Bombs and Bigger Badder Bomb Blast additionally trigger Sapper's Satchel and Overloaded Rockets.
•Dying Darkfuse Technicians drop Giga Bombs that go Giga BOOM! After. Gallywix's Giga Blast detonates these immediately.
•Charged Giga Bombs brought to Giga Controls trigger a Giga Bomb Detonation causing Control Meltdown which interrupts Gallywix's Giga Coils.

bosses.overview:
Gallywix gains energy over time, activating The House of Chrome's Giga Coils at max capacity. Charged Giga Bombs brought to Giga Controls trigger a Giga Bomb Detonation. This causes a Control Meltdown which interrupts Gallywix's Giga Coils. Upon losing both Giga Controls a Sabotage Zone forms.

Additionally, throughout the encounter Gallywix calls in the most overpaid Darkfuse Cronies to aid him.

As the battle rages on Gallywix alters and augments his arsenal bringing maniacal mayhem.

abilities.name: Intermission: Docked and Loaded
abilities.text: Gallywix drops into the arena Cratering any in his way, gaining Armageddon-class Plating and then casts Total Destruction!!! Until interrupted.

children.name: Cratering
children.text: Gallywix slams into the arena inflicting Fire damage to players near the point of impact, and Fire damage to all other players.

children.name: Armageddon-class Plating
children.text: Darkfuse agents hardened this metal as much as they could (then they rubbed some solvent on it - don't know what that's for), granting immunity to interrupt effects and absorbing damage.

children.name: Radiant Electricity
children.text: Energy surges around Gallywix inflicting Nature damage every sec and stunning those caught by the beam of raw lightning for.

children.name: Gallybux Pest Eliminator
children.text: Humane, high-voltage shock. Quickly eliminates pests. Gallywix attaches lightning tethers inflicting Nature damage every sec to targeted players and any additional player between them and Gallywix. This effect increases in damage while tethered targets are further from Gallywix.

children.name: TOTAL DESTRUCTION!!!
children.text: Gallywix rains rockets inflicting Fire damage to all players every sec for. Every sec this damage increases by 20%.

abilities.name: Stage One: What an Arsenal!
abilities.text:
"You certainly don't get your likeness carved into the side of a mountain by letting others push you around"

Gallywix pummels his enemies with his upgraded arsenal.

children.name: Bigger Badder Bomb Blast
children.text:
Gallywix shells his primary target with many explosives inflicting Physical damage and increases Bigger Badder Bomb Blast damage taken by 200% for. This effect stacks and cannot be dodged or parried.

Additionally inflicts Fire damage to players near the primary target, applying Blast Burns. These munitions (mostly) detonate on impact.

However, some of the fuze within the bunch scatters about the arena.

children.name: Blast Burns
children.text: The ordnance singes slowpokes inflicting Fire damage every sec for. This effect stacks.

children.name: Bad Belated Boom
children.text: Loaded with out-of-compliance "safety fuse" these bombs scatter detonating late inflicting Fire damage to players nearby and applies Blast Burns.

children.name: Overloaded Rockets
children.text:
The blast lights the good stuff attaching some OL rockets to unsuspecting fools for.

Upon removal these rockets blast out in indicated directions inflicting Fire damage every second for to impacted players, knocking them back.

children.name: 1500-Pound "Dud"
children.text:
DUD-1500 munitions embed into the arena exploding after inflicting Fire damage to all players plus an additional Fire damage every sec for. This effect stacks.

Interacting with the ordnance instead focuses the blast inflicting Physical damage and applying Focused Detonation, additionally knocking back.

children.name: Focused Detonation
children.text:
The ordnance's blast sears inflicting Fire damage every sec for. This effect stacks.

Focused Detonation triggers a Time-Release Crackle upon removal.

children.name: Time-Release Crackle
children.text: A two-stage effect releases bombettes throughout inflicting Fire damage to all players.

children.name: Zagging Zizzler
children.text: Miniaturized rockets zing from the pile inflicting Fire damage every sec for. This effect stacks.

children.name: Combination Canisters
children.text:
Gallywix taps into his reserve stash firing both Fused Canisters and Tick-Tock Canisters at the same time.

After the Fused Canisters detonate inflicting Fire damage to players nearby, and after the Tick-Tock Canisters detonate inflicting damage to players nearby. These effects split evenly among effected players.

All targets become afflicted with Mechengineer's Canisters.

If this fails to hit at least |4target:targets; all players suffer the full effect.

children.name: Mechengineer's Canisters
children.text:
Gallywix's experiment covers afflicted enemies absorbing healing for.

Upon expiration or consuming this healing implodes the canister incurring Canister Detonation.

children.name: Canister Detonation
children.text: On this difficulty, Canister Detonation effects all players.

children.name: Fused Canisters
children.text:
Gallywix launches shells that attach to marked targets. After these detonate inflicting Fire damage to players nearby. This damage splits evenly among effected players.

All targets become afflicted with Mechengineer's Canisters.

If this fails to hit at least |4target:targets; all players suffer the full effect.

children.name: Tick-Tock Canisters
children.text:
Gallywix ejects volatile containers that embed into the floor. After these detonate inflicting Fire damage to players nearby. This damage splits evenly among effected players.

All targets become afflicted with Mechengineer's Canisters.

If this fails to hit at least |4target:targets; all players suffer the full effect.

children.name: Giga Blast
children.text:
Gallywix collects and ejects Giga Coil power in a direction inflicting Nature damage plus an additional Nature damage every sec for. This effect stacks.

Each successive blast increases Giga Coil damage by 30%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Giga Blast Residue
children.text: Charged ions remain after a Giga Blast for. Upon contact charges a Discharged Giga Bomb, or inflicts Nature damage and stuns for when one is not present. This consumes the residue.

children.name: Giga BOOM!
children.text: Giga Bombs detonate after or when struck by Giga Blast inflicting Nature damage plus an additional Nature damage every sec to all players for. This effect stacks.

children.name: Giga Coils
children.text:
Gallywix charges and activates The House of Chrome's Giga Coils inflicting Nature damage to all players every sec. This effect stacks.

Gallywix then starts Giga Blast-ing!

Giga Bomb Detonation damages the Giga Controls interrupting Gallywix's Giga Coils, and Giga Coils become Sabotaged Coils upon losing both Giga Controls. This creates Sabotage Zone.

children.name: Sabotaged Controls
children.text: Damaged Giga Controls spark profusely inflicting Nature damage to targeted players every sec. This effect stacks for each Sabotaged Control, and is definitely against regulation.

children.name: Control Meltdown
children.text: Sabotaging a Giga Controls causes a Control Meltdown for. During this time if Gallywix activates Giga Coils it backfires, interrupting Giga Coils.

children.name: Sabotage Zone
children.text: Sabotaged Coils discharge energy into The House of Chrome forming a zone. Contact with this zone inflicts Nature damage every sec.

children.name: Overloaded Bolts
children.text: The Giga Coils furiously eject free ions causing strikes throughout inflicting Nature damage to players near each impact.

children.name: Suppression
children.text: Gallywix shrapnels subordinates for inflicting Fire damage plus an additional Fire damage every sec to players near indicated locations for. This effect stacks.

children.name: Gallybux Finale Blast
children.text: Gallywix finishes this Suppression with pizzaz firing a massive shock at a targeted location inflicting Nature damage to all players, decreasing in damage as distance increases.

children.name: Venting Heat
children.text: Gallywix's machines dump excessive heat over inflicting Fire damage to all players plus an additional Fire damage every sec.

children.name: Overheating
children.text: Gallywix's contraption dissipates inefficiently increasing the duration of Venting Heat sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Ego Check
children.text:
Gallywix gives his current target a -hit knuckle sandwich, inflicting Physical damage each strike. These blows cannot be dodged or parried.

Additionally 75% of unmitigated damage is inflicted as a Checked Ego.

children.name: Checked Ego
children.text: Targets struck by Gallywix's Ego Check continually suffer the unmitigated damage as Physical damage every sec for. This effect stacks, adding to the effects of previous Checked Ego.

children.name: Giga-Juiced Technician
children.text: Upon death drops a Discharged Giga Bomb.

children.name: Discharged Giga Bomb
children.text:
Inflicts Nature damage every sec to the nearest players.

Upon interaction gain Discharged Giga Bomb, instead suffering Nature damage every sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Auto-Locking Cuff Bomb
children.text:
After picking up a Giga Bomb the silver bracelets click, preventing Fling Giga Bomb and picking up additional Giga Bombs.

If for any reason this aura removes the shackles detonate inflicting Fire damage to all players.

children.name: Fling Giga Bomb
children.text: Ditch the Giga Bomb you are holding.

children.name: Giga Bomb Detonation
children.text: On this difficulty, Giga Bomb Detonation damages the Giga Controls based on the Giga Bomb's health.

children.name: Giga BOOM!
children.text: Giga Bombs detonate after or when struck by Giga Blast inflicting Nature damage plus an additional Nature damage every sec to all players for. This effect stacks.

children.name: Ionization
children.text: Excites the magnetic field ionizing players inflicting Nature damage every sec and reducing movement speed by 40% for.

children.name: Static Zap
children.text: The techie jolts a targeted player, inflicting Nature damage, stunning them for.

children.name: Wrench
children.text: The hobgoblin is holding a wrench. Doing so he now knows how to strike someone with the wrench inflicting Physical damage and increases Wrench damage taken by 40%. This effect stacks, and causes quite a headache.

children.name: Lumbering Rage
children.text: The hobgoblin does what he does best - get mad. Then he lumbers towards his target inflicting 50% increased damage done with 50% reduced movement speed for.

children.name: Party Crashing Rocket
children.text: Arrive just in time to be the life of the show knocking back and inflicting Fire damage to enemies nearby upon impact. Cool.

lfr.name: Manaforge Omega
lfr.description: Manaforge Omega, built to harness arcane power from the wastes of K'aresh, now hums with a sinister radiance. Within it, Nexus-King Salhadaar attempts to reawaken Dimensius, the All-Devouring, in a bid for ultimate power. The champions of Azeroth must disrupt Manaforge Omega's operations or else risk a reborn Dimensius feasting on reality itself.

bosses.name: Plexus Sentinel
bosses.description: The Plexus Sentinel patrols the colossal machinery of Manaforge Omega, ensuring that energy from the shattered world of K'aresh is filtered through the structure's conduits. All incoming energy must be sterilized. All pollutants must be purged.

tips.text:
• Manifest Matrices leaves behind a Displacement Matrix.

• Purging Lightning inflicts increasing damage while the Plexus Sentinel's shield holds.

• The Reshii Wraps allowPhase Blinking reducing the damage taken from Atomize

• The Plexus Sentinel inflicts increasing damage with Purging Lightning during Protocol: Purge.

• Eradication Salvo inflicts heavy damage to players hit by it.

• The Reshii Wraps allowPhase Blinking reducing the damage taken from Atomize

• Obliteration Arcanocannon inflicts heavy damage to players near the impact.

• The Reshii Wraps allowPhase Blinking reducing the damage taken from Atomize

bosses.overview:
The Arcanomatrix Atomizer will Atomize all beings not made of energy who come into contact with it.

The Plexus Sentinel will continue to gain energy while attacking players with Obliteration Arcanocannon and Eradicating Salvo

Upon reaching 100 Energy, the Plexus Sentinel begins channelling Protocol: Purge as it activates the Arcanomatrix Atomizer

abilities.name: Phase Diving
abilities.text: Activates the Reshii Wraps to enter an ethereal state and making the caster immune to the.

abilities.name: Arcane Sieve
abilities.text: The will Atomize all players who come in contact with it.

children.name: Atomize
children.text: The Arcanomatrix Atomizer inflicts Arcane Damage to players passing through the Sieve.

children.name: Arcane Radiation
children.text: The Plexus Sentinel sections off portions of The Influx with Arcane Radiation, inflicting Arcane damage every 1 sec to players in the area.

children.name: Arcane Purge [PH]
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, if Eradicating Salvo fails to hit at least 5 players, it instead inflicts Arcane damage to all players.

children.name: Overload [PH]
children.text: The Plexus Sentinel fires Arcane energy into players, inflicting Arcane damage every 1 sec for 6 sec. Upon expiration, a Displacement Matrix is created.

children.name: Expulsion Zone
children.text:
The Displacement Matrix detonates when touched, inflicting Arcane damage and stunning players nearby, leaving behind Potent Mana Residue.

Additionally, the activating player will be teleported to a random nearby location.

children.name: Potent Mana Residue
children.text: Residual energy slows players in the area by 50% and inflicts Arcane damage every 2 sec.

children.name: Detonating Surge [PH]
children.text:
The Plexus Sentinel marks its current target, then fires an arcane charge that inflicts Arcane damage to players nearby, and Arcane damage to all other players. Players farther from the target receive less damage. This explosion leaves behind Potent Mana Residue.

The impact causes the primary target to take 1000% damage from Obliteration Arcanocannon for 45 sec.

children.name: Area Denial
children.text: Residual energy slows players in the area by 50% and inflicts Arcane damage every 2 sec.

children.name: Charged Lightning
children.text: The Plexus Sentinel periodically emits arcing energy, inflicting Arcane damage to the target and up to players within 20 yards.

children.name: Protocol: Purge
children.text:
The Plexus Sentinel relocates, pushing players away and activating the Arcanomatrix Atomizer. The Atomizer slowly passes over the chamber, Atomizing any players it contacts.

After relocating, The Plexus Sentinel begins channelling Protocol: Purge and gains a shield that absorbs damage. Breaking this shield interrupts Protocol: Purge.

children.name: Energy Cutter
children.text: A rotating beam of arcane energy that inflicts Arcane damage to players in the area.

children.name: Purging Lightning
children.text: The Plexus Sentinel continuously channels arcane lightning through its chassis, inflicting Arcane damage to all players with each cast. Each cast empowers the chassis, increasing damage of subsequent casts by 25%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Expulsion Zone
children.text: A purging orb of arcane energy that expulses players in the area, knocking them away, and inflicting Arcane damage.

bosses.name: Loom'ithar
bosses.description: Loom'ithar was purposefully bred by the Shadowguard for its unique ability to infuse arcane energy into its prodigious silk weaving. Bound to its fate inside the machinery of the manaforge, Loom'ithar spins endless spools of arcane silk for its masters.

tips.text:
•Piercing Strand causes all targets hit to take increased damage from it for a duration.
• Writhing Wave is split between all targets caught in its area.
• Loom'ithar will give chase to their target while consumed with Unbound Rage

• Infused Tangles inflict heavy damage if players are caught in the collapsing ring of threads.
• Infusion Tether will inflict damge indefinitely until the effect ends.
• Living Silk inflicts heavy Nature damage and reduces movement speed.

• Infusion Tether must be pulled far away from Loom'ithar to end the effect.
• Overinfusion Burst inflicts Arcane damage as it charges and a massive burst when it ends.
• Living Silk inflicts heavy Nature damage and reduces movement speed.

bosses.overview:
Loom'ithar traps enemies within its chamber with Lair Weaving and unleashes infused arcane energy with Overinfusion Burst.

Upon reaching 50% health, Loom'ithar tears itself in two and attacks players directly with Writhing Wave.

children.name: Infusion Tether
children.text: On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, if the target is standing in Living Silk, Infusion Tether applies Silken Snare when it ends.

children.name: Living Silk
children.text: Tendrils of arcane silk inflict Nature damage every second and reduce movement speed by 25%.

children.name: Silken Snare
children.text: Arcane silk encases the target, stunning them for 5 sec.

children.name: Overinfusion Burst
