children.text: Loom'ithar inflicts Arcane damage to all players every 0.5 sec for 8 sec as it absorbs arcane energy. Then, it releases the energy in a massive explosion inflicting Arcane damage to players nearby.

children.name: Primal Spellstorm
children.text: Arcane energy rains down from the chamber above, inflicting Arcane damage near the impact locations.

children.name: Arcane Overflow
children.text: Loom'ithar's excess energy radiates outward, inflicting Arcane damage to all players every 1 sec.

children.name: Piercing Strand
children.text: Loom'ithar launches a heavily infused strand through their current target at high speed, inflicting Arcane damage to all players in a line and increasing damage taken from Piercing Strand by 100% for 45 sec.

children.name: Silk Blast
children.text: Loom'ithar primary attack launches silk that inflicts Physical damage to its current target.

children.name: Unbound Rage
children.text:
Upon reaching 50% health, Loom'ithar rips itself free of its bindings, incurring a great wound that increases its damage taken by 33%. As it crashes down, Loom'ithar inflicts Physical damage to all players and knocking them away.

 Pours endlessly from its severed half above.

children.name: Arcane Ichor
children.text: Ichor pours from Loom'ithar's wounds and inflicts Arcane damage every 1 sec to players within its area.

children.name: Arcane Overflow
children.text: Loom'ithar's excess energy radiates outward, inflicting Arcane damage to all players every 1 sec.

children.name: Primal Spellstorm
children.text: Arcane energy rains down from the chamber above, inflicting Arcane damage near the impact locations.

children.name: Arcane Outrage
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, when Arcane Outrage ends, players erupt with arcane energy inflicting Arcane damage to themselves and allies nearby.

children.name: Arcane Ichor
children.text: Ichor pours from Loom'ithar's wounds and inflicts Arcane damage every 1 sec to players within its area.

children.name: Writhing Wave
children.text: On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, affected players take 100% increased damage from Writhing Wave.

bosses.name: Soulbinder Naazindhri
bosses.description: Within her dark chambers, Soulbinder Naazindhri binds unbound souls of the K'areshi into unwilling servants. Bound in silk wrappings, her victims emerge from their prisons to serve the will of the Shadowguard.

tips.text:
•Mystic Lash inflicts significant damage to primary target and increases the damage they take.
•After completingSoulweave Chrysalis the Unbound Soul is transformed into a more dangerous Ethereal.

•Soulfray Annihilation can destroy all it touches, whether players or Binding Machines.
•Soulfire Convergence causes the Soulrend Orb to be violently expelled from the target player's body. If it strikes another player, it inflicts negative effects upon them.

•Soulfray Annihilation can destroy all it touches, whether players or Binding Machines.
•Mystic Lash inflicts significant damage to primary target, and increase the damage they take.
•The Binding Chamber causes Essence Implosion while it is broken or opened, inflicting massive damage to all players.

bosses.overview: Soulbinder Naazindhri activates the Binding Chambers throughout the room in order to create waves of Shadowguard. The destructive power of Soulfray Annihilation can obliterate her enemies, but may disrupt her chambers' work if caught in its path.

abilities.name: Soul Calling
abilities.text: The Soulbinder Naazindhri activates chambers throughout the room, transforming unbound souls within each chamber to join the Shadowguard. Souls within each chamber are protected as long as the chamber's shield holds.

children.name: Soulweave
children.text: The Unbound Soul is slowly wrapped in silk bindings, transforming into a member of the Shadowguard.

children.name: Voidblade Ambush
children.text: The Shadowguard Assassin targets a random player, vanishing into the shadows then reappearing behind them to deliver a devastating strike infused with Shadow energy, inflicting Shadow damage and an additional Shadow damage every 1 sec for 30 sec.

children.name: Void Burst
children.text: On Mythic difficulties, The cast time halves each time the cast is interrupted.

children.name: Phase Blades
children.text: The Shadowguard Phaseblade sears the target inflicting Shadow damage. The power of Void that scatters after impact jumps between all players, inflicting Shadow damage.

children.name: Essence Implosion
children.text: The Binding Chamber expires and bursts outward, inflicting Arcane damage.

abilities.name: Soulfray Annihilation
abilities.text:
The Soulbinder Naazindhri unleashes an orb in the direction of randomly targeted players, inflicting Arcane damage to any player struck by the orb and causing them to take 12% increased damage for 20 sec.

If a Binding Chamber is hit by the orb, the Unbound Soul within takes 200% increased damage.

abilities.name: Arcane Expulsion
abilities.text: The Soulbinder Naazindhri unleashes a devastating shockwave, inflicting Arcane damage and an additional Arcane damage every 1 sec for 15 sec to them.

abilities.name: Soulfire Convergence
abilities.text: On Mythic difficulties, The Soulrend Orbs can break the Arcane Sigils.

children.name: Soulrend Orb
children.text: An orb of energy that inflicts Arcane damage every 1 sec, and reduced movement speed by 15% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Spellburn
abilities.text: The Soulbinder Naazindhri radiates Arcane energy, inflicting Arcane damage to all players every sec.

abilities.name: Mystic Lash
abilities.text:
The Soulbinder Naazindhri lashes out at her current target, inflicting Arcane damage every 1 sec for 5 sec. $?diff15,diff16[The blow brands the victim, increasing the damage of Mystic Lash by
 10% and Physical damage by 7% for 45 sec.

This effect stacks.
][The blow brands the victim, increasing the damage of Mystic Lash by 10%.

This effect stacks.]

bosses.name: Forgeweaver Araz
bosses.description: Forgeweaver Araz controls all operations within Manaforge Omega, ensuring a constant flow of energy into its central chamber. He now stands as the first witness to Dimensius' rebirth, and will strive to see his work through--at all costs.

tips.text:
•Astral Harvest creates manifestations that cause an Astral Surge when they reach Arcane Collectors.
•Arcane Echoes duplicate Forgeweaver Araz's abilities.
•Arcane Collectors lose their Arcane Barrier during the intermission.

•Astral Harvest inflicts high periodic damage to its target.
•Arcane Obliteration inflicts damage to everyone that is reduced by the number of players at the impact location.
•Astral Burn continously ramps damage during the intermission.

•Overwhelming Power continously stacks on Araz's current target.
•Arcane Convergence inflicts damage to the raid on completion.

bosses.overview:
Forgeweaver Araz activates the Prime Sequence of Arcane Collectors throughout the room. Once all collectors are active, Araz begins an arcane ritual to summon Dimensius.

Disrupting this ritual twice forces Araz's hand as he activates the final sequence, forming a Dark Singularity.

abilities.name: Stage One: Priming the Forge
abilities.text: Forgeweaver Araz funnels energy into the Manaforge to feed Dimensius.

children.name: Invoke Collector
children.text: Araz triggers one of his Arcane Collectors to begin its Prime Sequence.

children.name: Astral Harvest
children.text: The Arcane Collector draws energy from several players, inflicting Arcane damage every 1 sec for 4 sec. Upon expiration, an forms at each player's location.

children.name: Arcane Manifestation
children.text: An orb of raw energy that moves towards the Arcane Collector that summoned it.

children.name: Astral Surge
children.text: The Arcane Collector surges with energy if it contacts an Arcane Manifestation, inflicting Arcane damage to all players and an additional Arcane damage every 2 sec for 16 sec.

children.name: Prime Sequence
children.text: The Arcane Collector activates, unleashing motes of energy that inflict Arcane damage to players in their path.

children.name: Arcane Siphon
children.text: The Arcane Collector thrums with power, inflicting Arcane damage to all players every 2 sec.

children.name: Arcane Barrier
children.text: The Arcane Collector erects a barrier, reducing its damage taken by 99%.

children.name: Arcane Obliteration
children.text:
Araz unleashes a burst of energy onto his current target, inflicting Arcane damage to all players. The damage is reduced by the number of players near the impact location. $?diff15|diff16 [

Players near the impact location also have healing absorbed and suffer.][]$?diff14|diff15|diff16 [

Additionally an is summoned at the location.][]

children.name: Silencing Tempest
children.text: Araz rains down arcane energy at players' destinations every 1 sec for 6 sec, inflicting Arcane damage to players near the impact location and silencing them for 6 sec.

children.name: Overwhelming Power
children.text: The Forgeweaver blasts his current target, inflicting Arcane damage every 2 sec for 46 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Arcane Expulsion
children.text: Araz unleashes energy as he begins a ritual, inflicting Arcane damage to all players and knocking them back.

children.name: Dark Terminus
children.text: Araz abandons the ritual at 15% health and opens a Dark Singularity, inflicting Shadow damage to all players.

abilities.name: Intermission: The Iris Opens
abilities.text: Forgeweaver Araz pushes the forge beyond its limits to complete his ritual.

children.name: Astral Burn
children.text: Escaping energy from the manaforge inflicts Arcane damage every 1 sec for 12 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Unstable Surge
children.text: The Manaforge becomes unstable causing energy to erupt at random destinations, inflicting Arcane damage to players near the impact locations.

children.name: Photon Blast
children.text: The Arcane Collector emits an energy beam, inflicting Arcane damage to players in the area. Victims suffer an additional Arcane damage every 1.5 sec for 6 sec.

children.name: Arcane Convergence
children.text: Upon reaching full energy the Arcane Collector channels into the Manaforge, inflicting Arcane damage to all players every 1 sec for 4 sec.

children.name: Shielded Attendant
children.text: Resilient attendants able to operate within the volatile environment of the Manaforge due to their ability to absorb energy from Arcane Convergence.

children.name: Hardened Shell
children.text: The Shielded Attendant periodically gains a shield that absorbs the next damage.

children.name: Ramping Power
children.text:
With each consecutive melee attack against the same target, the casters' attack speed increases by 8%.

This effect stacks.

children.name: Mana Splinter
children.text: Araz sacrifices his essence to power the manaforge, stunning him and increasing his damage taken by 100% for 12 sec.

children.name: Focusing Iris
children.text: Energy focused through the manaforge inflicts Arcane damage every 1 sec to players within the iris.

abilities.name: Stage Two: Darkness Hungers
abilities.text: Forgeweaver Araz unleashes all his power as he feeds himself to Dimensius opening a door to the void itself.

children.name: Dark Singularity
children.text: A singularity erupts within the forge, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec to players and pulling them into its Crushing Darkness. Over time, the strength of this movement force increases.

children.name: Crushing Darkness
children.text: The crushing force of the inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec to players beyond the event horizon.

children.name: Void Harvest
children.text: The draws energy from several players, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec for 4 sec. Upon expiration, a forms at each player's location

children.name: Void Manifestation
children.text: A mote of void energy that moves towards the Dark Singularity.

children.name: Void Surge
children.text: The surges with energy if it contacts an Void Manifestation, inflicting Shadow damage to all players and an additional Shadow damage every 2 sec for 16 sec.

children.name: Silencing Tempest
children.text: Araz rains down arcane energy at players' destinations every 1 sec for 6 sec, inflicting Arcane damage to players near the impact location and silencing them for 6 sec.

children.name: Overwhelming Power
children.text: The Forgeweaver blasts his current target, inflicting Arcane damage every 2 sec for 46 sec. This effect stacks.

bosses.name: The Soul Hunters
bosses.description: Adarus Duskblaze is a demon hunter brimming with abyssal power, seeking to devour the void energy surrounding Manaforge Omega. Together he and his deadly allies, Ilyssa Darksorrow and Velaryn Bloodwrath, will destroy all who oppose them.

tips.text:
•Eye Beam singes Velaryn's current target with Fel-Singed and blasts them away.
•Fracture cleaves their target's soul into fragments which Ilyssa will attempt to consume with Spirit Bomb.
•Adarus will Voidstep to new locations, summoning images which slice open the fabric of the void with Hungering Slash and leave behind Encroaching Oblivion.

•Adarus continually casts Consume at the players bearing Devourer's Ire.
•Fracture cleaves their target's soul into fragments which Ilyssa will attempt to consume with Spirit Bomb.
•Adarus will Voidstep to new locations, summoning images which slice open the fabric of the void with Hungering Slash and leave behind Encroaching Oblivion.

•Adarus continually casts Consume at the players bearing Devourer's Ire.
•Fracture cleaves their target's soul into fragments which Ilyssa will attempt to consume with Spirit Bomb.
•Adarus will Voidstep to new locations, summoning images which slice open the fabric of the void with Hungering Slash and leave behind Encroaching Oblivion.

bosses.overview:
Adarus tears open a rift to the void and brands players with Devourer's Ire. Adarus will focus his assault on the players bearing this mark.

Velaryn singes any who stand in her path with Eye Beam and lunges towards her prey with The Hunt.

Ilyssa cleaves her target's essence with Fracture and feasts on their rended soul with Spirit Bomb.

Upon reaching 100 Fury, the Demon Hunters unleash their true power and enter Metamorphosis.

children.name: Devourer's Ire
children.text:
Adarus hurls orbs of ravenous void at several locations, inflicting Cosmic damage to all players if not intercepted.

Adarus focuses his gaze upon players who intercepted these orbs, continually assailing them with Consume and increasing their Physical damage taken by 100%.

Upon removal, Devourer's Ire transfers to a nearby player and inflicts Cosmic damage to all players.

children.name: Consume
children.text: Adarus drains the essence of players afflicted with Devourer's Ire, inflicting Cosmic damage and absorbing the next healing received.

children.name: Voidstep
children.text:
Adarus tears open a path through the void and teleports to a new location, inflicting Cosmic damage to players nearby along the path to his destination.

During this movement, Adarus manifests images of himself which cast Hungering Slash.

children.name: Hungering Slash
children.text: Images of Adarus slice open the fabric of the void around them, inflicting Cosmic damage to players nearby and coalescing a pool of Encroaching Oblivion.

children.name: Encroaching Oblivion
children.text:
A growing expanse of void opens, inflicting Cosmic damage every 1 sec to players within and increasing their damage taken by 30%.

The void spreads over time, but players afflicted with Devourer's Ire can greedily consume the essence and reduce its size.

children.name: The Hunt
children.text:
Velaryn marks a player as her prey, charging towards them and inflicting Chaos damage. This effect is reduced for each player standing within the path of The Hunt.

$?|diff15|diff16 [Velaryn additionally strikes players along the path, inflicting Chaos damage to players near each player struck.][Velaryn additionally strikes players along the path, inflicting Chaos damage to players struck.]

children.name: Blade Dance
children.text: Velaryn rapidly slashes at nearby locations, inflicting Chaos damage to players caught in the effect.

children.name: Eye Beam
children.text:
Velaryn channels a torrent of Fel energy towards her current target for 4 sec, inflicting Chaos damage and applying Fel-Singed every ${/2}.1 sec to players within the beam and blasting them away.

After the blast concludes, Velaryn will Felblade towards her current target.

children.name: Fel-Singed
children.text: $?|diff16 [Increases the damage taken from Eye Beam by 10% and Felblade for 36 sec. This effect stacks.][Increases the damage taken from Eye Beam by 10% for 36 sec. This effect stacks.]

children.name: Felblade
children.text: Velaryn charges to her current target, inflicting Fire damage and an additional Fire damage every 1 sec for 25 sec.

children.name: Fel Inferno
children.text:
Velaryn wreathes the arena in flame, inflicting Fire damage to all players and an additional Fire damage every 0.5 sec for 15 sec when each pillar of the inferno is created. This effect stacks.

The flame inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec to any players who step into the firestorm.

children.name: Fracture
children.text:
Ilyssa rapidly slashes her current target, inflicting Physical damage and applying Shattered Soul.

This strike cleaves the target's soul into fragments which each maintain Frailty on the target until another player collects the fragment.

children.name: Shattered Soul
children.text: Ilyssa shatters the target's soul, increasing their damage taken from by 125% for 36 sec.

children.name: Frailty
children.text:
The fragment draws upon the target's soul, reducing their healing received by 33%. This effect stacks.

Players other than the target can collect the fragment, suffering Chaos damage every 0.5 sec for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Spirit Bomb
children.text:
Ilyssa explodes, inflicting Fire damage to all players and applying Soulcrush.

Ilyssa destroys any fragments still present from Fracture, applying Expulsed Soul to all players.

children.name: Soulcrush
children.text: Spirit Bomb causes players to absorb the next healing received.

children.name: Expulsed Soul
children.text: Spirit Bomb explodes any splintered fragments remaining from Fracture, inflicting Fire damage to all players plus an additional Fire damage every 0.5 sec for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Immolation Aura
children.text: Ilyssa engulfs themselves in flame, inflicting Chaos damage to all players every 2 sec.

children.name: Unstable Soul
children.text: When any of the Soul Hunters are slain, their soul begins to pulse with power, inflicting Cosmic or Chaos damage to all players every 4 sec. This effect increases in strength by 25% each pulse.

abilities.name: Intermission: The Ceaseless Hunger
abilities.text: Adarus enshrouds the arena in void and attempts to draw all players into a Collapsing Star.

children.name: Collapsing Star
children.text: In Heroic and Mythic difficulty, stellar fragments apply Dark Residue when they are absorbed.

children.name: Event Horizon
children.text: The Collapsing Star inflicts Cosmic damage every 0.5 sec to players within its mass.

abilities.name: Intermission: The Demon Within
abilities.text: Velaryn scours the arena with Fel Rush.

children.name: Fel Rush
children.text: Velaryn manifests echoes of herself for 24 sec which rush forward, incinerating anything in their path for Chaos damage.

abilities.name: Intermission: The Unrelenting Pain
abilities.text: Ilyssa rampages about the arena with Infernal Strike and annihilates her foes with Fel Devastation.

children.name: Infernal Strike
children.text: Ilyssa leaps to a location, inflicting Fire damage to all players nearby and knocking them away.

children.name: Fel Devastation
children.text: Ilyssa unleashes the Fel within, inflicting Fire damage every 0.5 sec to all players within the effect for 4.5 sec.

bosses.name: Fractillus
bosses.description: An elemental born of the crags and dunes surrounding the Manaforge, Fractillus guards his domain by harnessing the power of the biting sands and hardened glass of the inhospitable wastes.

tips.text:
• Players knocked back by Shattering Backhand will shatter Crystal Nexuses they hit in to.
• Crystalline Shockwave places a Crystal Nexuses extending the Nether Prism's energy towards Fractillus.

• Players knocked back by Shattering Backhand will shatter Crystal Nexuses they hit in to.
• Crystalline Shockwave places a Crystal Nexuses extending the Nether Prism's energy towards Fractillus.

• Players knocked back by Shattering Backhand will shatter Crystal Nexuses they hit in to.
• Crystalline Shockwave places a Crystal Nexuses extending the Nether Prism's energy towards Fractillus.

bosses.overview:
Fractillus calls forth Crystal Nexuses that amplify the power of the Nether Prism. If six nexuses are allowed to amplify a single prism's beam, Fractillus will be empowered with Crystaline Overcharge.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Fractillus will use its Shattering Backhand to knock several players away, shattering any Crystal Nexus in their path.

abilities.name: Nether Prism
abilities.text: Six dark crystals that emit Refracted Entropy in a line towards Fractillus, inflicting Shadow damage every 0.5 sec to players touching it.

children.name: Crystal Nexus
children.text: A crystalline wall of void energy which explodes upon impact with a player affected by Crystal Encasement. The explosion launches.

children.name: Crystaline Overcharge
children.text: Fractillus becomes empowered by Refracted Entropy, increasing the damage it does by 200% and triggers.

children.name: Refracted Entropy
children.text: The crystal nexus emits amplified void energy, inflicting Shadow damage every 0.5 sec.

abilities.name: Crystalline Shockwave
abilities.text: Fractillus unleashes a sequence of crystal shockwaves, inflicting Shadow damage every 2 sec for 12 sec to anyone hit and creates a nexus.

abilities.name: Shattering Backhand
abilities.text: Fractillus does a sweeping backhand, inflicting Shadow damage to all players and knocking back players afflicted by Crystal Encasement.

abilities.name: Shattershell
abilities.text:
Fractillus begins crystallizine several players, inflicting Shadow damage every 1.5 seconds for 12 sec.

Upon expiration, the player is crystallized and rooted for 4 sec.

children.name: Crystal Encasement
children.text: The target becomes crystal, rooting them in place for 4 sec.

abilities.name: Shockwave Slam
abilities.text: On Mythic difficulty, Shockwave Slam will create 3 Crystal Nexuses behind the targeted player.

children.name: Crystalline Shockwave
children.text: Fractillus unleashes a sequence of crystal shockwaves, inflicting Shadow damage every 2 sec for 12 sec to anyone hit and creates a nexus.

bosses.name: Nexus-King Salhadaar
bosses.description: The former ruler of K'aresh and sworn enemy of Dimensius, Nexus-King Salhadaar has emerged unbroken from the shattered husk of K'aresh. Atop his Royal Voidwing, Salhadaar now commands the ultimate will of the Shadowguard. Oaths will be fulfilled. All will be made to serve.

tips.text:
•Salhadaar executes a combination of deadly attacks during Subjugation Rule.
•Cosmic Maw increases damage taken by Dimension Breath.
•Salhadaar's primary targets of Galactic Smash and Starkiller Swing are Starshattered.

•Oath-Bound players are vulnerable to conversion into King's Thrall.
•Manaforged Titans cast Self-Destruct, inflicting massive damage to all players.
•Starkiller Swing erupts in a Starkiller Nova unless consumed by a Dark Star.

•Oath-Bound players are vulnerable to conversion into King's Thrall.
•Banishment, Reap, and Twilight Scar inflict heavy damage over time to affected players.
•Starkiller Swing erupts in a Starkiller Nova unless consumed by a Dark Star.

bosses.overview:
The Nexus-King readies his mace to Conquer armies as images of the Royal Voidwing Behead and Besiege insurgents at his command. Those who lack zeal are destined for servitude when Salhadaar Invokes the Oath.

By regal edict, Oath-Breakers are devoured between cosmic jaws and razed to atoms by the Royal Voidwing's Dimension Breath. Salhadaar governs the battle from atop his steed, rallying elite Shadowguard reinforcements.

When King's Hunger takes reign, Salhadaar's loyal drake is called upon for ultimate sacrifice. Violet skies blacken and galaxies of Dark Stars form at the strike of a gavel as the Nexus-King plunges the world into twilight.

abilities.name: Stage One: Oath-Breakers
abilities.text: Salhadaar forces players under oath and tests their will against the void.

children.name: Decree: Oath-Bound
children.text: Salhadaar declares a trial of loyalty, inflicting Shadow damage to all players every 1 sec for 6 sec and granting applications of.

children.name: King's Thrall
children.text:
A player succumbs to their oath, becoming mind-controlled for 12 sec. The void invigorates the player, healing them to full health.

Upon expiration, the player explodes inflicting Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Oath-Breaker
children.text: An oath shatters, inflicting Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Invoke the Oath
children.text: Salhadaar invokes the oath, inflicting Shadow damage to all players. Any player that is still is converted into King's Thrall.

children.name: Subjugation Rule
children.text: Salhadaar executes a combination of strikes to subdue players.

children.name: Conquer
children.text:
Salhadaar smashes his current target, inflicting Physical damage and an additional Shadow damage split among all players nearby, knocking them upwards.

Players struck lose a stack of. Increases damage taken from Conquer by 100% for 20 sec.

children.name: Vanquish
children.text:
Salhadaar cleaves his current target, inflicting Physical damage and an additional Shadow damage to all players in front of him, knocking them away. 

Increases damage taken from Vanquish by 100% for 20 sec.

children.name: Banishment
children.text:
Salhadaar exiles several players, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

Upon expiration, each target bursts with torturous void inflicting Shadow damage.

children.name: Tyranny
children.text: Salhadaar's imperious presence inflicts Shadow damage to all players every 2 sec.

children.name: Fractal Images
children.text: The Royal Voidwing splits into several cosmic images that mirror its attacks.

children.name: Fractal Claw
children.text: Fractal Images swipe at players that get too close, inflicting Cosmic damage and knocking them back.

children.name: Behead
children.text: The Voidwing shreds through a player with its claws, inflicting Cosmic damage and dragging any player caught within their path.

children.name: Cosmic Rip
children.text: An abyssal fissure that inflicts Cosmic damage every 1 sec to players within the effect.

children.name: Besiege
children.text: The Voidwing sweeps across the sky, exhaling a breath that inflicts Cosmic damage every 0.3 sec to any player within the effect.

abilities.name: Stage Two: Rider of the Dark
abilities.text: Salhadaar orders the draconic images to converge back into one as he takes his rightful seat atop the Royal Voidwing.

children.name: Coalesce Voidwing
children.text: The coalesced Royal Voidwing pierces up from below, inflicting Cosmic damage to any player hit and knocking all players back.

children.name: Netherbreaker
children.text: Salhadaar hurls his mace which ricochets between several targets, inflicting Shadow damage near each impact.

children.name: Tyranny
children.text: Salhadaar's imperious presence inflicts Shadow damage to all players every 2 sec.

children.name: Dimension Breath
children.text:
The Voidwing unleashes a galactic beam from its jaws for 4 sec, inflicting Cosmic damage to any player within it every 0.3 sec.

Several portals tear open, from which this breath is emitted in additional directions.

children.name: Cosmic Maw
children.text:
The Voidwing shreds its current target between stellar jaws, inflicting Physical damage.

The target's essence is devoured, inflicting an additional Cosmic damage every 0.3 sec and increasing damage taken from Dimension Breath by 100% for 10 sec.

children.name: Behead
children.text: The Voidwing shreds through a player with its claws, inflicting Cosmic damage and dragging any player caught within their path.

children.name: Cosmic Rip
children.text: An abyssal fissure that inflicts Cosmic damage every 1 sec to players within the effect.

abilities.name: Intermission One: Nexus Descent
abilities.text: Elite Shadowguard reinforcements arrive as Salhadaar continues to seal the Manaforge.

children.name: Rally the Shadowguard
children.text: Salhadaar summons a wave of Shadowguard that arrive at each side of the loading bay.

children.name: Self-Destruct
children.text:
Upon reaching 100 energy, self-destruction protocol is initiated.

After sec, the automaton detonates inflicting Shadow damage to all players and increasing their damage taken by 250% for 5 min.

children.name: Dread Mortar
children.text: The automaton fires a barrage of dark missiles, inflicting Shadow damage near each impact.

children.name: Nexus Beams
children.text: The ethereal blasts cosmic beams in several directions. Contact with any beam inflicts Shadow damage every 0.3 sec.

children.name: Netherblast
children.text: The ethereal annihilates a player with twilight energy, inflicting Shadow damage.

children.name: Nexus Beams
children.text: The ethereal blasts cosmic beams in several directions. Contact with any beam inflicts Shadow damage every 0.3 sec.

children.name: Netherblast
children.text: The ethereal annihilates a player with twilight energy, inflicting Shadow damage.

children.name: Reap
children.text: The ethereal shadowsteps behind a player and slashes through them, inflicting Shadow damage and an additional Shadow damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

children.name: Seal the Forge
children.text: Salhadaar funnels energy into the door of the Manaforge, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec to players nearby.

children.name: Royal Ward
children.text: Enshrouded in regal shadows, reducing damage taken by 99%.

children.name: Tyranny
children.text: Salhadaar's imperious presence inflicts Shadow damage to all players every 2 sec.

children.name: Royal Ward
children.text: Enshrouded in regal shadows, reducing damage taken by 99%.

abilities.name: Intermission Two: King's Hunger
abilities.text: Salhadaar consumes the energy of the Royal Voidwing to revitalize and empower himself.

children.name: King's Hunger
children.text:
Salhadaar drains the energy from the Voidwing, increases its damage taken by 100% and inflicting Shadow damage to all players every 1 sec for 30 sec.

Upon completion, Salhadaar heals himself equal to the Voidwing's remaining health as the drake fades from existence.

children.name: Royal Ward
children.text: Enshrouded in regal shadows, reducing damage taken by 99%.

children.name: Tyranny
children.text: Salhadaar's imperious presence inflicts Shadow damage to all players every 2 sec.

children.name: Behead
children.text: The Voidwing shreds through a player with its claws, inflicting Cosmic damage and dragging any player caught within their path.

abilities.name: Stage Three: World in Twilight
abilities.text: Salhadaar stands alone as the final champion of the Void Lord's return.

children.name: Galactic Smash
children.text:
Images of Salhadaar emerge alongside him to smash their targets with galactic force, applying Twilight Scar and inflicting Cosmic damage to all players. Players farther from each target take less damage.

Salhadaar's primary target is Starshattered. A Dark Star forms at each impact location.

children.name: Dark Star
children.text:
A star materializes from the Twisting Nether, pulling players towards its center for 5 sec.

Upon emergence, players within the Dark Star are Atomized as Twilight Spikes ripple outward. Inflicts Cosmic damage to all players every sec.

children.name: Atomized
children.text: The Dark Star vaporizes any player within it, reducing movement speed by 80% and inflicting Cosmic damage every 0.5 sec.

children.name: Twilight Spikes
children.text: Rings of stellar spikes surge from below, inflicting Cosmic damage to any player struck.

children.name: Nexus Collapse
children.text: Consuming a Starkiller Nova $?|diff16 [more than once in rapid succession ][]destroys the Dark Star from the inside. Erupting shrapnel inflicts Cosmic damage to all players.

children.name: Twilight Scar
children.text: Mutilated by chaotic magic of another dimension, inflicting Cosmic damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

children.name: Starshattered
children.text: Salhadaar's galactic mace inflicts Physical damage and increases damage taken from Starshattered by 100% for up to 40 sec.

children.name: Starkiller Swing
children.text:
Images of Salhadaar emerge alongside him to swing and erupt a galactic missile at their targets, inflicting Cosmic damage to all players in its path and applying Twilight Scar.

Salhadaar's primary target is Starshattered. Each missile detonates in a Starkiller Nova unless consumed by a Dark Star.

children.name: Starkiller Nova
children.text: The interstellar blast blackens the sky, inflicting Cosmic damage to all players every 1 sec for 2 sec.

children.name: Twilight Scar
children.text: Mutilated by chaotic magic of another dimension, inflicting Cosmic damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

children.name: Starshattered
children.text: Salhadaar's galactic mace inflicts Physical damage and increases damage taken from Starshattered by 100% for up to 40 sec.

children.name: World in Twilight
children.text: Twilight Spikes close in from all sides, engulfing the arena in a sea of cosmic evisceration.

children.name: Tyranny
children.text: Salhadaar's imperious presence inflicts Shadow damage to all players every 2 sec.

bosses.name: Dimensius, the All-Devouring
bosses.description: Deep within Manaforge Omega, Dimensius--the All-Devouring and destroyer of K'aresh--is slowly waking as his devoted ethereal followers use the Dark Heart to give him sustenance. If they succeed, they will unleash a being of unfathomable power that could destroy the very fabric of reality.

tips.text:
•Massive Smash knocks all players away from Dimensius' target.
•Players who receive too many applications of Touch of Oblivion are killed instantly.
•Fists of the Voidlord damages and knocks away players near Dimensius' target with every melee attack.

•Living Mass leaves behind Excess Mass when defeated, which can be used to gain Collective Gravity and rescue Airborne players.
•Players can stand in Antimatter to reduce its raidwide damage.
•Fists of the Voidlord damages and knocks away players near Dimensius' target with every melee attack.

•Devour and Extinguish the Stars inflict heavy damage to all players.
•Players can stand in Antimatter to reduce its raidwide damage.
•Fists of the Voidlord damages and knocks away players near Dimensius' target with every melee attack.

bosses.overview:
Dimensius attempts to Devour players almost immediately, and again every time he reaches 100 energy. His Growing Hunger increases with each cast, pushing the players' Collective Gravity to its limits.

When Dimensius' health is depleted, he pulls players into the Dark Heart where they must quickly fly with Xal'atath to safety. He releases his conquered rivals to halt players' advance and attempts to obliterate them with Extinction and Gamma Burst.

After a devastating counter-attack from the players and Xal'atath, Dimensius begins to Extinguish the Stars. Upon reaching 100 energy he again attempts to Devour everything around him, pulling his Accretion Disk ever closer.

children.name: Oblivion
children.text: Dimensius instantly devours any player who enters his body for any reason, killing them horribly.

children.name: Massive Smash
children.text:
Dimensius smashes his current target with devastating force, inflicting Physical damage and Cosmic damage to players nearby and applying Mortal Fragility.

The force of the attack ripples outward through space inflicting Cosmic damage to all other players, knocking them away from the impact location, and scattering Living Mass.

children.name: Fission
children.text: The Living Mass sustains a high-energy reaction that inflicts Cosmic damage to random players every sec.

children.name: Excess Mass
children.text:
Upon defeat, Living Mass decays into Excess Mass that players can pick up.

During Devour, players with Excess Mass can gather to project a zone of Collective Gravity.

children.name: Collective Gravity
children.text:
When or more players with Excess Mass gather during Devour, they project a yard zone that reduces movement speed by 30% and grants 1 stack of Collective Gravity for each player within who has Excess Mass.

Dimensius can only Devour players with less Collective Gravity than his Growing Hunger.

children.name: Mortal Fragility
children.text: Increases Physical damage taken by 100%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Devour
children.text:
Upon reaching 100 energy, Dimensius attempts to devour all players, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec for 5 sec.

After 5 sec any player with insufficient Collective Gravity is pulled into Dimensius and consigned to Oblivion. He then absorbs all Excess Mass and Living Mass.

children.name: Growing Hunger
children.text: Dimensius' hunger grows with each cast of Devour, increasing the amount of Collective Gravity needed to survive.

children.name: Dark Matter
children.text: Dimensius sweeps his enormous hand over all players and blasts them with dark matter, inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby on impact.

children.name: Shattered Space
children.text:
Dimensius reaches down with both hands and tears at the very fabric of space, inflicting Cosmic damage to players near each hand and Cosmic damage to all other players.

This violent act creates an enormous sphere of Antimatter at each location and causes a flurry of Spatial Fragments to rain down around players.

children.name: Antimatter
children.text:
Spheres of Antimatter form at the location of Shattered Space and remain stable for 10 sec, then trigger an annihilation reaction that inflicts Cosmic damage to all players.

Every ${/10}.1 sec, Antimatter reacts with players nearby inflicting Cosmic damage and reducing the damage of its final reaction by the same amount.

children.name: Spatial Fragment
children.text: Fragments of Shattered Space rain down around players, inflicting Cosmic damage to players near the impact location and stunning them for 4 sec.

children.name: Fists of the Voidlord
children.text:
Dimensius' melee attacks disrupt the very fabric of space, forcing his target into melee range if they can't be reached and inflicting Shadow damage to players near his target.

The force of the impact knocks away other players near his target.

children.name: Cosmic Radiation
children.text: Dimensius radiates intense energy, inflicting Cosmic damage to all players every 2 sec.

children.name: Soaring Reshii
children.text: Xal'atath energizes players' Reshii Wraps, protecting them from Endless Darkness and allowing the use of flying mounts.

children.name: Umbral Gate
children.text: Xal'atath bends space to her advantage creating waygates that refresh the duration of Soaring Reshii, grant a burst of speed and restore Skyriding Charges when players pass through them.

children.name: Oblivion
children.text: Dimensius instantly devours any player who enters his body for any reason, killing them horribly.

children.name: Endless Darkness
children.text: Dimensius consigns players to from any distance if they're not protected by Soaring Reshii.

children.name: Broken World
children.text: Fragments of worlds shattered by Dimensius hurtle through space, inflicting Cosmic damage and dismounting players on impact.

children.name: Astrophysical Jet
children.text:
Dimensius tears through space with an immense stream of radiation that inflicts Cosmic damage every 1 sec to players who stray too close.

Players who attempt to cross the center of the stream are vaporized instantly.

children.name: Black Hole
children.text: When a star dies a singularity forms in its place, lethally spaghettifying any player it touches.

children.name: Spaghettification
children.text: Black Holes shred players into their constituent atoms on contact, killing them.

children.name: Stellar Core
children.text: Concentrated stellar energy that can be collected by flying players, allowing them to launch a Shooting Star at the nearest Voidlord when they land.

children.name: Shooting Star
children.text: Smash concentrated stellar energy into the nearest Voidlord, inflicting Cosmic damage equal to 5% of the Voidlord's maximum health.

children.name: Extinction
children.text: Dimensius hurls a fragment of a broken world at players, inflicting Cosmic damage to players caught in its path and stunning them for 4 sec.

children.name: Gamma Burst
children.text: Dimensius tears through space with an immense stream of radiation that inflicts Cosmic damage every 1 sec to all players and pushes them away over 4 sec.

children.name: The Devoured Lords
children.text: Dimensius releases his conquered rivals to halt the players' advance.

children.name: Eclipse
children.text:
The Voidlord begins a ritual to seal the worldsoul fragment within a veil of impenetrable darkness.

Upon completion of the ritual, the fragment becomes inaccessible.

Upon reaching 100 energy, the Voidlord completes the ritual instantly.

children.name: Mass Ejection
children.text: Arthosion ejects superheated mass at players in a line in front of him, inflicting Cosmic damage and knocking them back.

children.name: Conqueror's Cross
children.text: The Voidlord summons a phalanx of Voidwardens to secure his territory and restrict player movement.

children.name: Voidwarding
children.text: The Voidwarden exerts control over the area around it, knocking back players who enter and inflicting Shadow damage plus an additional Shadow damage every 2 sec for 30 sec.

children.name: Entropic Unity
children.text: Upon death, the Voidwarden's energy is absorbed by all other Voidwardens nearby, fully restoring their health and reducing all damage they take by 99%.

children.name: Stardust Nova
children.text: Pargoth releases a burst of superheated stardust, inflicting Cosmic damage to players nearby.

children.name: Conqueror's Cross
children.text: The Voidlord summons a phalanx of Voidwardens to secure his territory and restrict player movement.

children.name: Voidwarding
children.text: The Voidwarden exerts control over the area around it, knocking back players who enter and inflicting Shadow damage plus an additional Shadow damage every 2 sec for 30 sec.

children.name: Entropic Unity
children.text: Upon death, the Voidwarden's energy is absorbed by all other Voidwardens nearby, fully restoring their health and reducing all damage they take by 99%.

children.name: Oblivion
children.text: Dimensius instantly devours any player who enters his body for any reason, killing them horribly.

children.name: Destabilized
children.text: Dimensius reels from Xal'atath's devastating counter-attack, increasing all damage taken by 50% until he recovers.

children.name: Accretion Disk
children.text: Dimensius' lost mass swirls and churns at the edge of the platform, inflicting Shadow damage to players on contact and knocking them back.

children.name: Extinguish The Stars
children.text:
Dimensius calls Voidstars down around him over 10 sec, each inflicting Shadow damage to all players plus an additional Shadow damage to players near the impact location.

The Voidstars then begin to orbit him and project a Gravity Well.

children.name: Gravity Well
children.text:
Voidstars project a Gravity Well that inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec to players within yards and reduces their movement speed by 30%.

Dimensius cannot Devour players affected by a Gravity Well.

children.name: Devour
children.text:
Upon reaching 100 energy Dimensius increases his Density, creating a powerful inward force that inflicts Shadow damage every 1 for 5 sec and pulls in players, Voidstars, Black Holes, and the Accretion Disk.

After 5 sec any player outside of a Voidstar's Gravity Well is immediately pulled into Dimensius and consigned to Oblivion.

children.name: Density
children.text: Increases damage of Cosmic Radiation by 100%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Darkened Sky
children.text: Dimensius calls down a series of massive celestial objects that collide with the ground one after another. Each impact inflicts Shadow damage to players nearby and triggers a Shadowquake.

children.name: Shadowquake
children.text: A tremendous shockwave of dark energy radiates outward from the impact, inflicting Shadow damage to players on contact and increasing damage taken from Shadowquake by 100% for 3 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Cosmic Collapse
children.text: Dimensius collapses space itself in an attempt to crush his target, inflicting Cosmic damage and Physical damage to players nearby and applying Cosmic Fragility.

children.name: Cosmic Fragility
children.text: Increases Cosmic damage taken by 150%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Supernova
children.text:
Dimensius initiates the death of a Voidstar, causing it to explode after sec inflicting Cosmic damage to all players, reduced based on distance.

A Black Hole appears in place of the Voidstar and continues to orbit Dimensius.

children.name: Black Hole
children.text: When a star dies a singularity forms in its place, lethally spaghettifying any player it touches.

children.name: Spaghettification
children.text: Black Holes shred players into their constituent atoms on contact, killing them.

children.name: Voidgrasp
children.text: Dimensius warps space around random players, reducing their movement speed by 30% and inflicting Cosmic damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

children.name: Cosmic Radiation
children.text: Dimensius radiates intense energy, inflicting Cosmic damage to all players every 2 sec.

loot.name: Formula: Enchant Weapon - Authority of the Depths

normal.name: Manaforge Omega
normal.description: Manaforge Omega, built to harness arcane power from the wastes of K'aresh, now hums with a sinister radiance. Within it, Nexus-King Salhadaar attempts to reawaken Dimensius, the All-Devouring, in a bid for ultimate power. The champions of Azeroth must disrupt Manaforge Omega's operations or else risk a reborn Dimensius feasting on reality itself.

bosses.name: Plexus Sentinel
bosses.description: The Plexus Sentinel patrols the colossal machinery of Manaforge Omega, ensuring that energy from the shattered world of K'aresh is filtered through the structure's conduits. All incoming energy must be sterilized. All pollutants must be purged.

tips.text:
• Manifest Matrices leaves behind a Displacement Matrix.

• Purging Lightning inflicts increasing damage while the Plexus Sentinel's shield holds.

• The Reshii Wraps allowPhase Blinking reducing the damage taken from Atomize

• The Plexus Sentinel inflicts increasing damage with Purging Lightning during Protocol: Purge.

• Eradication Salvo inflicts heavy damage to players hit by it.

• The Reshii Wraps allowPhase Blinking reducing the damage taken from Atomize

• Obliteration Arcanocannon inflicts heavy damage to players near the impact.

• The Reshii Wraps allowPhase Blinking reducing the damage taken from Atomize

bosses.overview:
The Arcanomatrix Atomizer will Atomize all beings not made of energy who come into contact with it.

The Plexus Sentinel will continue to gain energy while attacking players with Obliteration Arcanocannon and Eradicating Salvo

Upon reaching 100 Energy, the Plexus Sentinel begins channelling Protocol: Purge as it activates the Arcanomatrix Atomizer

abilities.name: Phase Diving
abilities.text: Activates the Reshii Wraps to enter an ethereal state and making the caster immune to the.

abilities.name: Arcane Sieve
abilities.text: The will Atomize all players who come in contact with it.

children.name: Atomize
children.text: The Arcanomatrix Atomizer inflicts Arcane Damage to players passing through the Sieve.

children.name: Arcane Radiation
children.text: The Plexus Sentinel sections off portions of The Influx with Arcane Radiation, inflicting Arcane damage every 1 sec to players in the area.

children.name: Arcane Purge [PH]
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, if Eradicating Salvo fails to hit at least 5 players, it instead inflicts Arcane damage to all players.

children.name: Overload [PH]
children.text: The Plexus Sentinel fires Arcane energy into players, inflicting Arcane damage every 1 sec for 6 sec. Upon expiration, a Displacement Matrix is created.

children.name: Expulsion Zone
children.text:
The Displacement Matrix detonates when touched, inflicting Arcane damage and stunning players nearby, leaving behind Potent Mana Residue.

Additionally, the activating player will be teleported to a random nearby location.

children.name: Potent Mana Residue
children.text: Residual energy slows players in the area by 50% and inflicts Arcane damage every 2 sec.

children.name: Detonating Surge [PH]
children.text:
The Plexus Sentinel marks its current target, then fires an arcane charge that inflicts Arcane damage to players nearby, and Arcane damage to all other players. Players farther from the target receive less damage. This explosion leaves behind Potent Mana Residue.

The impact causes the primary target to take 1000% damage from Obliteration Arcanocannon for 45 sec.

children.name: Area Denial
children.text: Residual energy slows players in the area by 50% and inflicts Arcane damage every 2 sec.

children.name: Charged Lightning
children.text: The Plexus Sentinel periodically emits arcing energy, inflicting Arcane damage to the target and up to players within 20 yards.

children.name: Protocol: Purge
children.text:
The Plexus Sentinel relocates, pushing players away and activating the Arcanomatrix Atomizer. The Atomizer slowly passes over the chamber, Atomizing any players it contacts.

After relocating, The Plexus Sentinel begins channelling Protocol: Purge and gains a shield that absorbs damage. Breaking this shield interrupts Protocol: Purge.

children.name: Energy Cutter
children.text: A rotating beam of arcane energy that inflicts Arcane damage to players in the area.

children.name: Purging Lightning
children.text: The Plexus Sentinel continuously channels arcane lightning through its chassis, inflicting Arcane damage to all players with each cast. Each cast empowers the chassis, increasing damage of subsequent casts by 25%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Expulsion Zone
children.text: A purging orb of arcane energy that expulses players in the area, knocking them away, and inflicting Arcane damage.

bosses.name: Loom'ithar
bosses.description: Loom'ithar was purposefully bred by the Shadowguard for its unique ability to infuse arcane energy into its prodigious silk weaving. Bound to its fate inside the machinery of the manaforge, Loom'ithar spins endless spools of arcane silk for its masters.

tips.text:
•Piercing Strand causes all targets hit to take increased damage from it for a duration.
• Writhing Wave is split between all targets caught in its area.
• Loom'ithar will give chase to their target while consumed with Unbound Rage

• Infused Tangles inflict heavy damage if players are caught in the collapsing ring of threads.
• Infusion Tether will inflict damge indefinitely until the effect ends.
• Living Silk inflicts heavy Nature damage and reduces movement speed.

• Infusion Tether must be pulled far away from Loom'ithar to end the effect.
• Overinfusion Burst inflicts Arcane damage as it charges and a massive burst when it ends.
• Living Silk inflicts heavy Nature damage and reduces movement speed.

bosses.overview:
Loom'ithar traps enemies within its chamber with Lair Weaving and unleashes infused arcane energy with Overinfusion Burst.

Upon reaching 50% health, Loom'ithar tears itself in two and attacks players directly with Writhing Wave.

children.name: Lair Weaving
children.text: On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, Infused Tangles are protected by a Woven Ward.

children.name: Infusion Tether
children.text: On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, if the target is standing in Living Silk, Infusion Tether applies Silken Snare when it ends.

children.name: Living Silk
children.text: Tendrils of arcane silk inflict Nature damage every second and reduce movement speed by 25%.

children.name: Silken Snare
children.text: Arcane silk encases the target, stunning them for 5 sec.

children.name: Overinfusion Burst
children.text: Loom'ithar inflicts Arcane damage to all players every 0.5 sec for 8 sec as it absorbs arcane energy. Then, it releases the energy in a massive explosion inflicting Arcane damage to players nearby.

children.name: Primal Spellstorm
children.text: Arcane energy rains down from the chamber above, inflicting Arcane damage near the impact locations.

children.name: Arcane Overflow
children.text: Loom'ithar's excess energy radiates outward, inflicting Arcane damage to all players every 1 sec.

children.name: Piercing Strand
children.text: Loom'ithar launches a heavily infused strand through their current target at high speed, inflicting Arcane damage to all players in a line and increasing damage taken from Piercing Strand by 100% for 45 sec.

children.name: Silk Blast
children.text: Loom'ithar primary attack launches silk that inflicts Physical damage to its current target.

children.name: Unbound Rage
children.text:
Upon reaching 50% health, Loom'ithar rips itself free of its bindings, incurring a great wound that increases its damage taken by 33%. As it crashes down, Loom'ithar inflicts Physical damage to all players and knocking them away.

 Pours endlessly from its severed half above.

children.name: Arcane Ichor
children.text: Ichor pours from Loom'ithar's wounds and inflicts Arcane damage every 1 sec to players within its area.

children.name: Arcane Overflow
children.text: Loom'ithar's excess energy radiates outward, inflicting Arcane damage to all players every 1 sec.

children.name: Primal Spellstorm
children.text: Arcane energy rains down from the chamber above, inflicting Arcane damage near the impact locations.

children.name: Arcane Outrage
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, when Arcane Outrage ends, players erupt with arcane energy inflicting Arcane damage to themselves and allies nearby.

children.name: Arcane Ichor
children.text: Ichor pours from Loom'ithar's wounds and inflicts Arcane damage every 1 sec to players within its area.

children.name: Writhing Wave
children.text: On Heroic and Mythic difficulties, affected players take 100% increased damage from Writhing Wave.

bosses.name: Soulbinder Naazindhri
bosses.description: Within her dark chambers, Soulbinder Naazindhri binds unbound souls of the K'areshi into unwilling servants. Bound in silk wrappings, her victims emerge from their prisons to serve the will of the Shadowguard.

tips.text:
•Mystic Lash inflicts significant damage to primary target and increases the damage they take.
•After completingSoulweave Chrysalis the Unbound Soul is transformed into a more dangerous Ethereal.

•Soulfray Annihilation can destroy all it touches, whether players or Binding Machines.
•Soulfire Convergence causes the Soulrend Orb to be violently expelled from the target player's body. If it strikes another player, it inflicts negative effects upon them.

•Soulfray Annihilation can destroy all it touches, whether players or Binding Machines.
•Mystic Lash inflicts significant damage to primary target, and increase the damage they take.
•The Binding Chamber causes Essence Implosion while it is broken or opened, inflicting massive damage to all players.

bosses.overview: Soulbinder Naazindhri activates the Binding Chambers throughout the room in order to create waves of Shadowguard. The destructive power of Soulfray Annihilation can obliterate her enemies, but may disrupt her chambers' work if caught in its path.

abilities.name: Soul Calling
abilities.text: The Soulbinder Naazindhri activates chambers throughout the room, transforming unbound souls within each chamber to join the Shadowguard. Souls within each chamber are protected as long as the chamber's shield holds.

children.name: Soulweave
children.text: The Unbound Soul is slowly wrapped in silk bindings, transforming into a member of the Shadowguard.

children.name: Voidblade Ambush
children.text: The Shadowguard Assassin targets a random player, vanishing into the shadows then reappearing behind them to deliver a devastating strike infused with Shadow energy, inflicting Shadow damage and an additional Shadow damage every 1 sec for 30 sec.

children.name: Void Burst
children.text: On Mythic difficulties, The cast time halves each time the cast is interrupted.

children.name: Phase Blades
children.text: The Shadowguard Phaseblade sears the target inflicting Shadow damage. The power of Void that scatters after impact jumps between all players, inflicting Shadow damage.

children.name: Essence Implosion
children.text: The Binding Chamber expires and bursts outward, inflicting Arcane damage.

abilities.name: Soulfray Annihilation
abilities.text:
The Soulbinder Naazindhri unleashes an orb in the direction of randomly targeted players, inflicting Arcane damage to any player struck by the orb and causing them to take 12% increased damage for 20 sec.

If a Binding Chamber is hit by the orb, the Unbound Soul within takes 200% increased damage.

abilities.name: Arcane Expulsion
abilities.text: The Soulbinder Naazindhri unleashes a devastating shockwave, inflicting Arcane damage and an additional Arcane damage every 1 sec for 15 sec to them.

abilities.name: Soulfire Convergence
abilities.text: On Mythic difficulties, The Soulrend Orbs can break the Arcane Sigils.

children.name: Soulrend Orb
children.text: An orb of energy that inflicts Arcane damage every 1 sec, and reduced movement speed by 15% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Spellburn
abilities.text: The Soulbinder Naazindhri radiates Arcane energy, inflicting Arcane damage to all players every sec.

abilities.name: Mystic Lash
abilities.text:
The Soulbinder Naazindhri lashes out at her current target, inflicting Arcane damage every 1 sec for 5 sec. $?diff15,diff16[The blow brands the victim, increasing the damage of Mystic Lash by
 10% and Physical damage by 7% for 45 sec.

This effect stacks.
][The blow brands the victim, increasing the damage of Mystic Lash by 10%.

This effect stacks.]

bosses.name: Forgeweaver Araz
bosses.description: Forgeweaver Araz controls all operations within Manaforge Omega, ensuring a constant flow of energy into its central chamber. He now stands as the first witness to Dimensius' rebirth, and will strive to see his work through--at all costs.

tips.text:
•Astral Harvest creates manifestations that cause an Astral Surge when they reach Arcane Collectors.
•Arcane Echoes duplicate Forgeweaver Araz's abilities.
•Arcane Collectors lose their Arcane Barrier during the intermission.

•Astral Harvest inflicts high periodic damage to its target.
•Arcane Obliteration inflicts damage to everyone that is reduced by the number of players at the impact location.
•Astral Burn continously ramps damage during the intermission.

•Overwhelming Power continously stacks on Araz's current target.
•Arcane Convergence inflicts damage to the raid on completion.

bosses.overview:
Forgeweaver Araz activates the Prime Sequence of Arcane Collectors throughout the room. Once all collectors are active, Araz begins an arcane ritual to summon Dimensius.

Disrupting this ritual twice forces Araz's hand as he activates the final sequence, forming a Dark Singularity.

abilities.name: Stage One: Priming the Forge
abilities.text: Forgeweaver Araz funnels energy into the Manaforge to feed Dimensius.

children.name: Invoke Collector
children.text: Araz triggers one of his Arcane Collectors to begin its Prime Sequence.

children.name: Astral Harvest
children.text: The Arcane Collector draws energy from several players, inflicting Arcane damage every 1 sec for 4 sec. Upon expiration, an forms at each player's location.

children.name: Arcane Manifestation
children.text: An orb of raw energy that moves towards the Arcane Collector that summoned it.

children.name: Astral Surge
children.text: The Arcane Collector surges with energy if it contacts an Arcane Manifestation, inflicting Arcane damage to all players and an additional Arcane damage every 2 sec for 16 sec.

children.name: Prime Sequence
children.text: The Arcane Collector activates, unleashing motes of energy that inflict Arcane damage to players in their path.

children.name: Arcane Siphon
children.text: The Arcane Collector thrums with power, inflicting Arcane damage to all players every 2 sec.

children.name: Arcane Barrier
children.text: The Arcane Collector erects a barrier, reducing its damage taken by 99%.

children.name: Arcane Obliteration
children.text:
Araz unleashes a burst of energy onto his current target, inflicting Arcane damage to all players. The damage is reduced by the number of players near the impact location. $?diff15|diff16 [

Players near the impact location also have healing absorbed and suffer.][]$?diff14|diff15|diff16 [

Additionally an is summoned at the location.][]

children.name: Arcane Echo
children.text: An arcane manifestation that duplicates Araz's casts.

children.name: Echoing Invocation
children.text: Araz's echo triggers an Arcane Collector to begin its Prime Sequence.

children.name: Echoing Tempest
children.text: Araz's echo rains down arcane energy at players' destinations every 1 sec for 6 sec, inflicting Arcane damage to players near the impact location and silencing them for 6 sec.

children.name: Silencing Tempest
children.text: Araz rains down arcane energy at players' destinations every 1 sec for 6 sec, inflicting Arcane damage to players near the impact location and silencing them for 6 sec.

children.name: Overwhelming Power
children.text: The Forgeweaver blasts his current target, inflicting Arcane damage every 2 sec for 46 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Arcane Expulsion
children.text: Araz unleashes energy as he begins a ritual, inflicting Arcane damage to all players and knocking them back.

children.name: Dark Terminus
children.text: Araz abandons the ritual at 15% health and opens a Dark Singularity, inflicting Shadow damage to all players.

abilities.name: Intermission: The Iris Opens
abilities.text: Forgeweaver Araz pushes the forge beyond its limits to complete his ritual.

children.name: Astral Burn
children.text: Escaping energy from the manaforge inflicts Arcane damage every 1 sec for 12 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Unstable Surge
children.text: The Manaforge becomes unstable causing energy to erupt at random destinations, inflicting Arcane damage to players near the impact locations.

children.name: Photon Blast
children.text: The Arcane Collector emits an energy beam, inflicting Arcane damage to players in the area. Victims suffer an additional Arcane damage every 1.5 sec for 6 sec.

children.name: Arcane Convergence
children.text: Upon reaching full energy the Arcane Collector channels into the Manaforge, inflicting Arcane damage to all players every 1 sec for 4 sec.

children.name: Shielded Attendant
children.text: Resilient attendants able to operate within the volatile environment of the Manaforge due to their ability to absorb energy from Arcane Convergence.

children.name: Hardened Shell
children.text: The Shielded Attendant periodically gains a shield that absorbs the next damage.

children.name: Ramping Power
children.text:
With each consecutive melee attack against the same target, the casters' attack speed increases by 8%.

This effect stacks.

children.name: Mana Splinter
children.text: Araz sacrifices his essence to power the manaforge, stunning him and increasing his damage taken by 100% for 12 sec.

children.name: Focusing Iris
children.text: Energy focused through the manaforge inflicts Arcane damage every 1 sec to players within the iris.

abilities.name: Stage Two: Darkness Hungers
abilities.text: Forgeweaver Araz unleashes all his power as he feeds himself to Dimensius opening a door to the void itself.

children.name: Dark Singularity
children.text: A singularity erupts within the forge, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec to players and pulling them into its Crushing Darkness. Over time, the strength of this movement force increases.

children.name: Crushing Darkness
children.text: The crushing force of the inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec to players beyond the event horizon.

children.name: Void Harvest
children.text: The draws energy from several players, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec for 4 sec. Upon expiration, a forms at each player's location

children.name: Void Manifestation
children.text: A mote of void energy that moves towards the Dark Singularity.

children.name: Void Surge
children.text: The surges with energy if it contacts an Void Manifestation, inflicting Shadow damage to all players and an additional Shadow damage every 2 sec for 16 sec.

children.name: Silencing Tempest
children.text: Araz rains down arcane energy at players' destinations every 1 sec for 6 sec, inflicting Arcane damage to players near the impact location and silencing them for 6 sec.

children.name: Overwhelming Power
children.text: The Forgeweaver blasts his current target, inflicting Arcane damage every 2 sec for 46 sec. This effect stacks.

bosses.name: The Soul Hunters
bosses.description: Adarus Duskblaze is a demon hunter brimming with abyssal power, seeking to devour the void energy surrounding Manaforge Omega. Together he and his deadly allies, Ilyssa Darksorrow and Velaryn Bloodwrath, will destroy all who oppose them.

tips.text:
•Eye Beam singes Velaryn's current target with Fel-Singed and blasts them away.
•Fracture cleaves their target's soul into fragments which Ilyssa will attempt to consume with Spirit Bomb.
•Adarus will Voidstep to new locations, summoning images which slice open the fabric of the void with Hungering Slash and leave behind Encroaching Oblivion.

•Adarus continually casts Consume at the players bearing Devourer's Ire.
•Fracture cleaves their target's soul into fragments which Ilyssa will attempt to consume with Spirit Bomb.
•Adarus will Voidstep to new locations, summoning images which slice open the fabric of the void with Hungering Slash and leave behind Encroaching Oblivion.

•Adarus continually casts Consume at the players bearing Devourer's Ire.
•Fracture cleaves their target's soul into fragments which Ilyssa will attempt to consume with Spirit Bomb.
•Adarus will Voidstep to new locations, summoning images which slice open the fabric of the void with Hungering Slash and leave behind Encroaching Oblivion.

bosses.overview:
Adarus tears open a rift to the void and brands players with Devourer's Ire. Adarus will focus his assault on the players bearing this mark.

Velaryn singes any who stand in her path with Eye Beam and lunges towards her prey with The Hunt.

Ilyssa cleaves her target's essence with Fracture and feasts on their rended soul with Spirit Bomb.

Upon reaching 100 Fury, the Demon Hunters unleash their true power and enter Metamorphosis.

children.name: Devourer's Ire
children.text:
Adarus hurls orbs of ravenous void at several locations, inflicting Cosmic damage to all players if not intercepted.

Adarus focuses his gaze upon players who intercepted these orbs, continually assailing them with Consume and increasing their Physical damage taken by 100%.

Upon removal, Devourer's Ire transfers to a nearby player and inflicts Cosmic damage to all players.

children.name: Consume
children.text: Adarus drains the essence of players afflicted with Devourer's Ire, inflicting Cosmic damage and absorbing the next healing received.

children.name: Voidstep
children.text:
Adarus tears open a path through the void and teleports to a new location, inflicting Cosmic damage to players nearby along the path to his destination.

During this movement, Adarus manifests images of himself which cast Hungering Slash.

children.name: Hungering Slash
children.text: Images of Adarus slice open the fabric of the void around them, inflicting Cosmic damage to players nearby and coalescing a pool of Encroaching Oblivion.

children.name: Encroaching Oblivion
children.text:
A growing expanse of void opens, inflicting Cosmic damage every 1 sec to players within and increasing their damage taken by 30%.

The void spreads over time, but players afflicted with Devourer's Ire can greedily consume the essence and reduce its size.

children.name: The Hunt
children.text:
Velaryn marks a player as her prey, charging towards them and inflicting Chaos damage. This effect is reduced for each player standing within the path of The Hunt.

$?|diff15|diff16 [Velaryn additionally strikes players along the path, inflicting Chaos damage to players near each player struck.][Velaryn additionally strikes players along the path, inflicting Chaos damage to players struck.]

children.name: Blade Dance
children.text: Velaryn rapidly slashes at nearby locations, inflicting Chaos damage to players caught in the effect.

children.name: Eye Beam
children.text:
Velaryn channels a torrent of Fel energy towards her current target for 4 sec, inflicting Chaos damage and applying Fel-Singed every ${/2}.1 sec to players within the beam and blasting them away.

After the blast concludes, Velaryn will Felblade towards her current target.

children.name: Fel-Singed
children.text: $?|diff16 [Increases the damage taken from Eye Beam by 10% and Felblade for 36 sec. This effect stacks.][Increases the damage taken from Eye Beam by 10% for 36 sec. This effect stacks.]

children.name: Felblade
children.text: Velaryn charges to her current target, inflicting Fire damage and an additional Fire damage every 1 sec for 25 sec.

children.name: Fel Inferno
children.text:
Velaryn wreathes the arena in flame, inflicting Fire damage to all players and an additional Fire damage every 0.5 sec for 15 sec when each pillar of the inferno is created. This effect stacks.

The flame inflicts Fire damage every 1 sec to any players who step into the firestorm.

children.name: Fracture
children.text:
Ilyssa rapidly slashes her current target, inflicting Physical damage and applying Shattered Soul.

This strike cleaves the target's soul into fragments which each maintain Frailty on the target until another player collects the fragment.

children.name: Shattered Soul
children.text: Ilyssa shatters the target's soul, increasing their damage taken from by 125% for 36 sec.

children.name: Frailty
children.text:
The fragment draws upon the target's soul, reducing their healing received by 33%. This effect stacks.

Players other than the target can collect the fragment, suffering Chaos damage every 0.5 sec for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Spirit Bomb
children.text:
Ilyssa explodes, inflicting Fire damage to all players and applying Soulcrush.

Ilyssa destroys any fragments still present from Fracture, applying Expulsed Soul to all players.

children.name: Soulcrush
children.text: Spirit Bomb causes players to absorb the next healing received.

children.name: Expulsed Soul
children.text: Spirit Bomb explodes any splintered fragments remaining from Fracture, inflicting Fire damage to all players plus an additional Fire damage every 0.5 sec for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Immolation Aura
children.text: Ilyssa engulfs themselves in flame, inflicting Chaos damage to all players every 2 sec.

children.name: Unstable Soul
children.text: When any of the Soul Hunters are slain, their soul begins to pulse with power, inflicting Cosmic or Chaos damage to all players every 4 sec. This effect increases in strength by 25% each pulse.

abilities.name: Intermission: The Ceaseless Hunger
abilities.text: Adarus enshrouds the arena in void and attempts to draw all players into a Collapsing Star.

children.name: Collapsing Star
children.text: In Heroic and Mythic difficulty, stellar fragments apply Dark Residue when they are absorbed.

children.name: Event Horizon
children.text: The Collapsing Star inflicts Cosmic damage every 0.5 sec to players within its mass.

abilities.name: Intermission: The Demon Within
abilities.text: Velaryn scours the arena with Fel Rush.

children.name: Fel Rush
children.text: Velaryn manifests echoes of herself for 24 sec which rush forward, incinerating anything in their path for Chaos damage.

abilities.name: Intermission: The Unrelenting Pain
abilities.text: Ilyssa rampages about the arena with Infernal Strike and annihilates her foes with Fel Devastation.

children.name: Infernal Strike
children.text: Ilyssa leaps to a location, inflicting Fire damage to all players nearby and knocking them away.

children.name: Fel Devastation
children.text: Ilyssa unleashes the Fel within, inflicting Fire damage every 0.5 sec to all players within the effect for 4.5 sec.

bosses.name: Fractillus
bosses.description: An elemental born of the crags and dunes surrounding the Manaforge, Fractillus guards his domain by harnessing the power of the biting sands and hardened glass of the inhospitable wastes.

tips.text:
• Players knocked back by Shattering Backhand will shatter Crystal Nexuses they hit in to.
• Crystalline Shockwave places a Crystal Nexuses extending the Nether Prism's energy towards Fractillus.

• Players knocked back by Shattering Backhand will shatter Crystal Nexuses they hit in to.
• Crystalline Shockwave places a Crystal Nexuses extending the Nether Prism's energy towards Fractillus.

• Players knocked back by Shattering Backhand will shatter Crystal Nexuses they hit in to.
• Crystalline Shockwave places a Crystal Nexuses extending the Nether Prism's energy towards Fractillus.

bosses.overview:
Fractillus calls forth Crystal Nexuses that amplify the power of the Nether Prism. If six nexuses are allowed to amplify a single prism's beam, Fractillus will be empowered with Crystaline Overcharge.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Fractillus will use its Shattering Backhand to knock several players away, shattering any Crystal Nexus in their path.

abilities.name: Nether Prism
abilities.text: Six dark crystals that emit Refracted Entropy in a line towards Fractillus, inflicting Shadow damage every 0.5 sec to players touching it.

children.name: Crystal Nexus
children.text: A crystalline wall of void energy which explodes upon impact with a player affected by Crystal Encasement. The explosion launches.

children.name: Crystaline Overcharge
children.text: Fractillus becomes empowered by Refracted Entropy, increasing the damage it does by 200% and triggers.

children.name: Refracted Entropy
children.text: The crystal nexus emits amplified void energy, inflicting Shadow damage every 0.5 sec.

abilities.name: Crystalline Shockwave
abilities.text: Fractillus unleashes a sequence of crystal shockwaves, inflicting Shadow damage every 2 sec for 12 sec to anyone hit and creates a nexus.

abilities.name: Shattering Backhand
abilities.text: Fractillus does a sweeping backhand, inflicting Shadow damage to all players and knocking back players afflicted by Crystal Encasement.

abilities.name: Shattershell
abilities.text:
Fractillus begins crystallizine several players, inflicting Shadow damage every 1.5 seconds for 12 sec.

Upon expiration, the player is crystallized and rooted for 4 sec.

children.name: Crystal Encasement
children.text: The target becomes crystal, rooting them in place for 4 sec.

abilities.name: Shockwave Slam
abilities.text: On Mythic difficulty, Shockwave Slam will create 3 Crystal Nexuses behind the targeted player.

children.name: Crystalline Shockwave
children.text: Fractillus unleashes a sequence of crystal shockwaves, inflicting Shadow damage every 2 sec for 12 sec to anyone hit and creates a nexus.

bosses.name: Nexus-King Salhadaar
bosses.description: The former ruler of K'aresh and sworn enemy of Dimensius, Nexus-King Salhadaar has emerged unbroken from the shattered husk of K'aresh. Atop his Royal Voidwing, Salhadaar now commands the ultimate will of the Shadowguard. Oaths will be fulfilled. All will be made to serve.

tips.text:
•Salhadaar executes a combination of deadly attacks during Subjugation Rule.
•Cosmic Maw increases damage taken by Dimension Breath.
•Salhadaar's primary targets of Galactic Smash and Starkiller Swing are Starshattered.

•Oath-Bound players are vulnerable to conversion into King's Thrall.
•Manaforged Titans cast Self-Destruct, inflicting massive damage to all players.
•Starkiller Swing erupts in a Starkiller Nova unless consumed by a Dark Star.

•Oath-Bound players are vulnerable to conversion into King's Thrall.
•Banishment, Reap, and Twilight Scar inflict heavy damage over time to affected players.
•Starkiller Swing erupts in a Starkiller Nova unless consumed by a Dark Star.

bosses.overview:
The Nexus-King readies his mace to Conquer armies as images of the Royal Voidwing Behead and Besiege insurgents at his command. Those who lack zeal are destined for servitude when Salhadaar Invokes the Oath.

By regal edict, Oath-Breakers are devoured between cosmic jaws and razed to atoms by the Royal Voidwing's Dimension Breath. Salhadaar governs the battle from atop his steed, rallying elite Shadowguard reinforcements.

When King's Hunger takes reign, Salhadaar's loyal drake is called upon for ultimate sacrifice. Violet skies blacken and galaxies of Dark Stars form at the strike of a gavel as the Nexus-King plunges the world into twilight.

abilities.name: Stage One: Oath-Breakers
abilities.text: Salhadaar forces players under oath and tests their will against the void.

children.name: Decree: Oath-Bound
children.text: Salhadaar declares a trial of loyalty, inflicting Shadow damage to all players every 1 sec for 6 sec and granting applications of.

children.name: King's Thrall
children.text:
A player succumbs to their oath, becoming mind-controlled for 12 sec. The void invigorates the player, healing them to full health.

Upon expiration, the player explodes inflicting Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Oath-Breaker
children.text: An oath shatters, inflicting Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Invoke the Oath
children.text: Salhadaar invokes the oath, inflicting Shadow damage to all players. Any player that is still is converted into King's Thrall.

children.name: Subjugation Rule
children.text: Salhadaar executes a combination of strikes to subdue players.

children.name: Conquer
children.text:
Salhadaar smashes his current target, inflicting Physical damage and an additional Shadow damage split among all players nearby, knocking them upwards.

Players struck lose a stack of. Increases damage taken from Conquer by 100% for 20 sec.

children.name: Vanquish
children.text:
Salhadaar cleaves his current target, inflicting Physical damage and an additional Shadow damage to all players in front of him, knocking them away. 

Increases damage taken from Vanquish by 100% for 20 sec.

children.name: Banishment
children.text:
Salhadaar exiles several players, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec for 8 sec.

Upon expiration, each target bursts with torturous void inflicting Shadow damage.

children.name: Tyranny
