children.text: Galactic emptiness engulfs a massive location in darkness for, inflicting Shadow damage every sec and reducing movement speed by 75%.

children.name: Dragon B
children.text:
Ezzorak wreathes all players in shadow, inflicting Shadow damage to players near each player.

Summons a Voidorb at each players' location.

children.name: Voidbolt
children.text: The Voidorb ejects raw void magic at a player, inflicting Shadow damage plus an additional Shadow damage every sec for.

children.name: Rakfang
children.text:
Ezzorak strikes his primary target, inflicting Physical damage and Shadow damage.

This attack empowers Ezzorak's melee attacks, causing them to absorb the next healing. This effect stacks, increasing in intensity each Rakfang until Rakfang strikes a new target.

children.name: Midnight Flames
children.text: Upon reaching 100 energy, Ezzorak and Vaelgor fly as one, each spewing Shadow damage to all players plus an additional Shadow damage every sec for.

children.name: Twilight Bond
children.text: On this difficulty, Twilight Bond also occurs when Vaelgor and Ezzorak's health percentages are 10% apart or greater.

children.name: Twilight Fury
children.text: Upon seeing their sibling perish, the remaining dragon enters a draconic rage, increasing damage done by 30%. This effect stacks, increasing in intensity over time.

children.name: Grappling Maw
children.text:
While flying, the dragon lashes their primary target in cosmic entanglement, inflicting between and ${*10} Shadow damage, increasing in damage as distance between the dragon and their target increases.

The dragon then pulls the distant target nearby.

children.name: Midnight Manifestation
children.text:
Xal'atath appears, tipping the scales and enfeebling targeted players, then vanishes.

This malediction inflicts Shadow damage every sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Lightbound Vanguard
abilities.text: If present, War Chaplain Senn, General Amias Bellamy, and/or Commander Venel Lightblood join in the battle against Vaelgor & Ezzorak.

children.name: Radiant Barrier
children.text:
Senn eminates holy power for, blessing players nearby. Every sec, this applies protection to nearby players that absorbs Midnight Flames damage. If present, Bellamy and/or Lightblood increase the amount of absorb granted. ${100-}% of Midnight Flames damage pierces this absorb.

Additionally, gaining Radiant Barrier consumes Midnight Manifestation, spawning a Manifestation of Midnight or infusing an existing Manifestation for each aura stack consumed.

children.name: Unbound Shadow
children.text: Every sec, the manifestation darkens, increasing attack speed by 75% and reducing the speed at which they can be slowed to by 50%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Aura of Light
children.text:
The presence of the Lightbound Vanguard weakens this enemy's vitality, reducing their maximum health by 5% and damage done by 5%.

This effect stacks for each present member of the Vanguard.

bosses.name: Lightblinded Vanguard
bosses.description: Once paragons of the Light, Senn, Bellamy, and Lightblood have surrendered to their own blinding zealotry--their faith perverted into a ruthless fanaticism that now compels them to smite all who oppose them.

tips.text:
• War Chaplain Senn protects allies within her Aura of Peace, pacifying any players who attack them.
• Damage from Execution Sentence is split evenly between all players hit.
• Sacred Shield grants immunity to interrupt effects while the shield holds.

• Tyr's Wrath absorbs a large amount of healing done to affected players.
• Damage from Execution Sentence is split evenly between all players hit.
• General Bellamy silences players struck by Divine Toll.

• Judgment significantly increases damage taken from Final Verdict and Shield of the Righteous.
• Damage from Execution Sentence is split evenly between all players hit.
• Members of the Vanguard with an active Aura greatly empower their nearby allies.

bosses.overview:
The Lightblinded Vanguard attacks players relentlessly as their energy slowly increases.

When a member of the Vanguard reaches 100 energy, they activate an Aura to empower their allies and unleash their most devastating attack.

children.name: Divine Hammer
children.text: Holy hammers spiral outward, inflicting Holy damage to players in their path.

children.name: Forbearance
children.text: After using a powerful ability, members of the Vanguard cannot be affected by Avenging Wrath or Divine Shield for 150 sec.

children.name: Sacred Toll
children.text: Lightblood deems players nearby unworthy, inflicting Holy damage to them.

children.name: Judgment
children.text:
Lightblood passes judgment on his current target, inflicting Holy damage and increasing damage they take from Final Verdict by 100% for 5 sec.

After passing judgment, Lightblood immediately casts Final Verdict on his current target.

children.name: Final Verdict
children.text: Lightblood unleashes a devastating strike on his current target that inflicts Holy damage.

children.name: Avenging Wrath
children.text: Lightblood calls upon the Light to become an avatar of its fury, increasing his damage done by 30% and damage taken by 20% for 20 sec.

children.name: Forbearance
children.text: After using a powerful ability, members of the Vanguard cannot be affected by Avenging Wrath or Divine Shield for 150 sec.

children.name: Divine Toll
children.text: Bellamy unleashes a volley of holy shields every 2 sec for 18 sec. Shields that hit players inflict Holy damage and silence them for 3 sec.

children.name: Forbearance
children.text: After using a powerful ability, members of the Vanguard cannot be affected by Avenging Wrath or Divine Shield for 150 sec.

children.name: Avenger's Shield
children.text: In Mythic difficulty, Zealous Spirit's empowerment causes Avenger's Shield to target all players.

children.name: Light Infused
children.text:
Bellamy is infused with holy light that inflicts Holy damage to all players every 2 sec. 

This damage increases by 25% every time a member of the Vanguard unleashes their aura.

children.name: Hammer of the Righteous
children.text:
Bellamy passes judgment on her current target, inflicting Holy damage and increasing damage they take from Shield of the Righteous by 100% for 5 sec.

After passing judgment, Bellamy immediately casts Shield of the Righteous on her current target.

children.name: Shield of the Righteous
children.text: Bellamy slams her current target with her shield, inflicting Holy damage.

children.name: Divine Shield
children.text: The Vanguard member calls upon the Light to protect them, becoming immune to all damage and harmful effects for 8 sec.

children.name: Forbearance
children.text: After using a powerful ability, members of the Vanguard cannot be affected by Avenging Wrath or Divine Shield for 150 sec.

children.name: Tyr's Wrath
children.text: Senn brings Tyr's Wrath down upon the players nearest to her every 5 sec, absorbing the next healing they receive. This effect stacks.

children.name: Forbearance
children.text: After using a powerful ability, members of the Vanguard cannot be affected by Avenging Wrath or Divine Shield for 150 sec.

children.name: Searing Shield
children.text: Senn shields herself, absorbing the next damage and becoming immune to interrupt effects. She then charges into battle on her mighty elekk before casting Blinding Light.

children.name: Elekk Charge
children.text: Senn charges forward on her mighty elekk, inflicting Physical damage to players in her path.

children.name: Blinding Light
children.text: Senn emits a blinding flash of light, inflicting Holy damage to all players and disorienting them for 5 sec.

children.name: Holy Shock
children.text: Senn exorcises her current target, inflicting Holy damage.

children.name: Divine Shield
children.text: The Vanguard member calls upon the Light to protect them, becoming immune to all damage and harmful effects for 8 sec.

children.name: Forbearance
children.text: After using a powerful ability, members of the Vanguard cannot be affected by Avenging Wrath or Divine Shield for 150 sec.

bosses.name: Crown of the Cosmos
bosses.description: High atop the Voidspire, Xal'atath marshalls her dark army from across the Voidstorm. Aided by Turalyon, Arator, and Alleria, the mortals of Azeroth must confront her before she unleashes the might of the Voidspire against her enemies.

tips.text:
•Silverstrike Arrow will remove any Void effects from targets struck.
•Void Droplet will splash targets with Corrupting Essence when it dies.
•Aspect of the End reduces healing received until the target moves away from the arrow.

•Silverstrike Arrow will remove any Void effects from targets struck.
•Null Corona absorbs a large amount of healing and can be moved to another player when dispelled.
•Aspect of the End reduces healing received until the target moves away from the arrow.

•Undying Sentinels utilize Echoing Darkness when no players are in melee combat.
•Empowering Darkness affects Alleria's allies within a large area.
•Aspect of the End reduces healing received and Gravity Collapse leaves the target weak to Physical attacks.

bosses.overview:
Alleria Windrunner begins the fight held back by Undying Sentinels from the Void. She periodically strikes out at friend and foe alike with both Void effects and Silverstrike Arrow.

When each of the Undying Sentinels have been destroyed, Alleria crashes into the platform and creates a Rift Simulacrum to assault her enemies with Call of the Void and Ranger Captain's Mark.

When the Rift Simulacrum is shattered, Alleria releases her full Void abilities upon all players.

children.name: Silverstrike Arrow
children.text: Alleria marks a player, firing a silver-lined arrow through them. The arrow inflicts Arcane damage in a line and removes Void effects from players and Voidspawn struck.

children.name: Grasp of Emptiness
children.text: Ancient obelisks grasp a player with Void energy, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec and reducing their movement speed by 50% for 8 sec. Upon removal, Bursting Emptiness fires out through each obelisk.

children.name: Bursting Emptiness
children.text: A backlash of magic blasts out from each obelisk, inflicting Shadow damage to all players struck.

children.name: Void Expulsion
children.text: In Heroic and Mythic difficulty, Void Expulsion also targets additional players.

children.name: Void Remnants
children.text: Void energy remains on the ground, inflicting Shadow damage to all players within it every 1 sec.

children.name: Touch of Harm
children.text: Alleria places a shell of Void magic around a player that absorbs healing. If Null Corona is dispelled, the remaining absorb jumps to another random player.

children.name: Undying Sentinels
children.text: Undying Sentinels are inexorably linked to their void portals, teleporting back if they are more than yards away from them.

children.name: Echoing Darkness
children.text: When no players are within melee range, the Undying Sentinel releases Void energy in a dark wave. This energy inflicts Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Dark Hand
children.text: The Undying Sentinel strikes its current target with a deadly touch, inflicting Physical and Shadow damage and knocking the target back.

children.name: Umbral Tether
children.text: Void magic binds the Sentinel to existence, preventing it from dying.

children.name: Echoing Darkness
children.text: When no players are within melee range, the Undying Sentinel releases Void energy in a dark wave. This energy inflicts Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Interrupting Tremor
children.text: The Undying Sentinel releases shuddering waves, inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby and interrupting spellcasts.

children.name: Umbral Tether
children.text: Void magic binds the Sentinel to existence, preventing it from dying.

children.name: Echoing Darkness
children.text: When no players are within melee range, the Undying Sentinel releases Void energy in a dark wave. This energy inflicts Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Ravenous Abyss
children.text: The Undying Sentinel devours the essence of players nearby, inflicting Shadow damage and reducing their damage done by 70% for 8 sec.

children.name: Umbral Tether
children.text: Void magic binds the Sentinel to existence, preventing it from dying.

children.name: Corrupting Essence
children.text: The droplet erupts with Void upon death and splashes players and Sentinels nearby. This inflicts Shadow damage and causes the target to take 30% increased damage for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Silverstrike Arrow
children.text: Uncontrolled silver-lined arrows fire from Alleria, inflicting Arcane damage and removing Void effects from players struck.

children.name: Stellar Emission
children.text: Raw Void energy arcs outward from Alleria, inflicting Shadow damage every 2 sec and increasing the effects of forced movement by 25% for 8 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Void Eruption
children.text: Wild pockets of gravity surge from Alleria, inflicting Shadow damage to players near each impact and knocking them away.

children.name: Rift Simulacrum
children.text: Alleria utilizes her Spatial Rift to summon forth a void simulacrum to assist her.

children.name: Empowering Darkness
children.text: The Rift Simulacrum grants Alleria 10% reduced damage taken and 10% increased damage done every 1 sec while she is within yards of it. This effect stacks.

children.name: Cosmic Barrier
children.text: A void barrier surrounds the Rift Simulacrum, absorbing damage equal to 13.5% of its maximum health. While this barrier persists, it inflicts Shadow damage to all players every 1 sec.

children.name: Null Corona
children.text: Alleria places a shell of Void magic around a player that absorbs healing. If Null Corona is dispelled, the remaining absorb jumps to another random player.

children.name: Rift Slash
children.text: The Rift Simulacrum strikes its current target with a draining touch, inflicting Physical damage to the player and reducing all of their stats for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Volatile Fissure
children.text: Stepping on a volatile ground fissure inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec for 12 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Ranger General's Mark
children.text: Alleria applies a Ranger Captain's Mark to random players within yards for 6 sec. Upon expiration, she fires a Silverstrike Ricochet at them.

children.name: Ricocheting Arrow
children.text: A silver-lined arrow bounces between players, inflicting Arcane damage and removing Void effects from players and Voidspawn struck.

children.name: Void Expulsion
children.text: In Heroic and Mythic difficulty, Void Expulsion also targets additional players.

children.name: Void Remnants
children.text: Void energy remains on the ground, inflicting Shadow damage to all players within it every 1 sec.

children.name: Voidstalker Sting
children.text: Alleria fires a Void-tipped arrow at several players, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec for 10 min. This effect stacks.

children.name: Call of the Void
children.text: Celestial energy bursts around Alleria, inflicting Shadow damage near each impact and calling forth a Shattered Voidspawn.

children.name: Void Barrage
children.text: The Voidspawn blasts random players, inflicting Shadow damage.

children.name: Stellar Emission
children.text: Raw Void energy arcs outward from Alleria, inflicting Shadow damage every 2 sec and increasing the effects of forced movement by 25% for 8 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Silverstrike Arrow
children.text: Uncontrolled silver-lined arrows fire from Alleria, inflicting Arcane damage and removing Void effects from players struck.

children.name: Orbiting Matter
children.text: Stellar mass orbits around Alleria, inflicting Shadow damage and pulling players it collides with.

abilities.name: Stage Three: The End of the End

children.name: Devouring Cosmos
children.text: Alleria calls upon the unending cosmos to consume her foes. Players caught within suffer Shadow damage every 1 sec and receive 99% reduced healing and absorbs.

children.name: Aspect of the End
children.text:
Alleria marks players with a consuming arrow, reducing their healing received by 10% until they move yards away from the arrow. This effect stacks, growing in intensity every 2 sec.

Upon being removed, a Gravity Collapse is triggered.

children.name: Gravity Collapse
children.text: Reverberating darkness knocks the target upwards and increases their Physical damage taken by 300% for 12 sec. The cosmic tremors additionally inflict Shadow damage to all other players.

children.name: Grasp of Emptiness
children.text: Ancient obelisks grasp a player with Void energy, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec and reducing their movement speed by 50% for 8 sec. Upon removal, Bursting Emptiness fires out through each obelisk.

children.name: Bursting Emptiness
children.text: A backlash of magic blasts out from each obelisk, inflicting Shadow damage to all players struck.

children.name: Null Corona
children.text: Alleria places a shell of Void magic around a player that absorbs healing. If Null Corona is dispelled, the remaining absorb jumps to another random player.

children.name: Voidstalker Sting
children.text: Alleria fires a Void-tipped arrow at several players, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec for 10 min. This effect stacks.

children.name: Dark Rush
children.text: A player touching a cosmic feather fallen from Alleria's quiver gains greatly increased movement speed and suffers Shadow damage every 1 sec for 12 sec.

normal.name: The Voidspire
normal.description: From high above the Voidstorm, Xal'atath has gathered the Devouring Host beneath her dark banner. The towering Voidspire looms like a spear of darkness, a citadel guarded by an army of the void. The forces of the light - led by Alleria Windrunner and the Champions of Azeroth - must rally for one last desperate assault before all is lost.

bosses.name: Imperator Averzian
bosses.description: Imperator Averzian wages a relentless campaign, seeking not conquest, but annihilation. His entire will is bent to a singular ambition: to rend the veil between worlds and carve a breach into the Void itself. Through this wound, his infinite host shall pour forth, drowning Azeroth in darkness.

tips.text:
• Abyssal Voidshapers attempt to use Gathering Darkness at full power.
• Shadowguard Stalwarts attempt to empower their allies with Pitch Bulwark.

•Dark Upheaval inflicts periodic damage to all players.
•Umbral Collapse inflicts damage to everyone that is reduced by the number of players at the impact location.

• Averzian gains Imperator's Glory while close to territory he controls.
• When Averzian strikes his current target he infects them with Blackening Wounds.

bosses.overview:
Averzian uses Shadow's Advance to claim territory on the battlefield. Territory claimed cannot be retaken, and if Averzian claims three adjacent territories in a row he unleashes the March of the Endless.

Causing an Umbral Collapse on a territory being taken prevents its capture.

abilities.name: Stage One
abilities.text: Averzian summons Abyssal Voidshapers onto the battlefield. As his minions emerge, they inflict Shadow damage to players nearby and knocks them away.

children.name: Umbral Barrier
children.text: Enshrouded by the Void, the caster reduces all damage taken by 99% unless impacted by an Umbral Collapse.

children.name: Void Rupture
children.text:
The Abyssal Voidshaper claims territory for Averzian, inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby and an additional Shadow damage to players caught in the star burst blast.

Each claimed territory brings Averzian's army closer to the March of the Endless.

children.name: Gnashing Void
children.text: The Voidmaw's melee attacks inflict Shadow damage every 1 sec for 10 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Pitch Bulwark
children.text: The caster grants a shield to allies that absorbs the next damage.

children.name: Pitch Bulwark
children.text: The caster grants a shield to allies that absorbs the next damage.

children.name: Dark Barrage
children.text: The caster hurls dark energy at several players, inflicting Shadow damage upon impact.

abilities.name: Umbral Collapse
abilities.text: Averzian collapses void energy around his target, inflicting Shadow damage to all players. This damage is reduced by the number of players near the impact location.

abilities.name: Oblivion's Wrath
abilities.text: Averzian launches void lances outward, inflicting Shadow damage to players in their path and knocking them back.

abilities.name: Void Fall
abilities.text: Averzian knocks back players and rains destruction onto the field at several destinations, inflicting Shadow damage to players near the impact locations.

abilities.name: Shadow Phalanx
abilities.text: A column of Averzian's troops march across the field, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec to players in their path.

abilities.name: March of the Endless
abilities.text: With three adjacent portals empowering each other, Averzian tears open the void unleashing the endless march, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec to players in its path.

abilities.name: Dark Upheaval
abilities.text:
Averzian harnesses the Void, inflicting Shadow damage to all players.

He then continues to radiate energy, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec.

abilities.name: Blackening Wounds
abilities.text:
Averzian's melee attacks infect his target with void, reducing their maximum health by 4% for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

When Averzian's troops take the field, the target with the highest amount of Blackening Wounds becomes Weakened.

children.name: Weakened
children.text: Voidspawn rush toward the player with the highest amount of Blackening Wounds for the next 10 sec.

abilities.name: Imperator's Glory
abilities.text: Averzian gains 75% increased damage and reduces his damage taken by 99% while near claimed territory.

bosses.name: Vorasius
bosses.description: A colossal predator born in the wastes of the Voidstorm, Vorasius grew to an incredible size fueled by an endless hunger. Summoned to the battle raging at the base of the Voidspire by Voidlight Everdawn, this colossal monster now feasts on both sides.

tips.text:
• The explosion of Blisterburst is powerful enough to damage Void Crystals.

• Shadowclaw Slam causes reverberating Aftershocks from its impact location.

• The explosion of Blisterburst is powerful enough to damage Void Crystals.

• Primordial Roar causes Vorasius to gain more Primordial Power with each cast.

• Shadowclaw Slam inflicts deadly damage to the raid if it fails to hit at least one player.

• Overpowering Pulse is triggered when no enemies are near Vorasius.

bosses.overview:
Vorasius periodically strikes the ground with Shadowclaw Slam, creating crystals that divide the battlefield. The behemoth then shakes off parasitic creeps that explode in a Blisterburst upon death.

As the battle rages, Vorasius sweeps his deadly Void Breath from one side of the battlefield to the other, decimating anything caught in its path.

abilities.name: Void Breath
abilities.text: Vorasius sweeps a deadly beam across the battlefield, immediately inflicting Shadow damage to all players in front of him and Shadow damage every 1 sec to players caught in its path. The beam radiates Dark Energy while active, inflicting Shadow damage every 0.5 sec for 15 sec.

children.name: Dark Energy
children.text: Vorasius sweeps a deadly beam across the battlefield, immediately inflicting Shadow damage to all players in front of him and Shadow damage every 1 sec to players caught in its path. The beam radiates Dark Energy while active, inflicting Shadow damage every 0.5 sec for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Parasite Expulsion
abilities.text: Vorasius shakes off parasitic Blistercreeps, spraying the battlefield with globs of dark ichor that inflict Shadow damage to players nearby upon impact.

children.name: Blistercreep
children.text: A parasitic spawn that fixates on a player.

children.name: Blisterburst
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Blisterburst leaves behind Dark Goo.

children.name: Creep Spit
children.text: The Blistercreep periodically spits void ichor at a player, reducing their movement speed by 10% for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Shadowclaw Slam
abilities.text: Vorasius slams a giant claw into the ground, inflicting Shadow and Physical damage to players in the impact area and Shadow damage to all players. If the central impact fails to hit at least 1 player, Vorasius inflicts Shadow damage to all players instead. The impact of the larger claws applies Smashed and creates Void Crystals.

children.name: Smashed
children.text: The impact from Vorasius's larger claws increases the victim's Physical damage taken by 150% for 2 min. This effect stacks.

children.name: Aftershock
children.text: Shadowclaw Slam creates seismic aftershocks that reverberate from the impact location, inflicting Physical damage to players within the area.

children.name: Void Crystal
children.text:
Dark crystals that divide the battlefield. Strong enough to withstand anything but the explosions of Blisterburst.

On Heroic difficulty, Void Crystals can withstand an additional blast.On Mythic difficulty, Void Crystals can withstand an additional blast.

abilities.name: Primordial Roar
abilities.text: Vorasius takes a deep breath, pulling players closer before unleashing a deafening roar that inflicts Physical damage to all players and knocks them away.

children.name: Primordial Power
children.text: Vorasius gathers power with each roar, radiating Shadow damage to all players every sec.

abilities.name: Overpowering Pulse
abilities.text: If no player is within reach, Vorasius pulses with deadly void energy.

bosses.name: Fallen-King Salhadaar
bosses.description: After turning on Xal'atath, the fallen king Salhadaar has become a captive of the very Shadowguard he once commanded. Tortured, delirious, and infused with the Void, he awaits his death--or a chance to win his people's freedom from Xal'atath's grasp.

tips.text:
• Orbs of Concentrated Void cause a Void Infusion when they reach Salhadaar.
• Salhadaar takes increased damage during Entropic Unraveling.
• Salhadaar creates several Fractured Images that cast Shadow Fracture.

• When orbs of Concentrated Void are destroyed, they apply Dark Radiation to all players.
• Despotic Command inflicts periodic damage to nearby players and applies Oppressive Darkness when removed.
• Entropic Unraveling inflicts heavy periodic damage to all players.

• Orbs of Concentrated Void cause a Void Infusion when they reach Salhadaar.
• Spikes erupt from the target of Shattering Twilight.
• Salhadaar's melee attacks apply Destabilizing Strikes.

bosses.overview:
Fallen-King Salhadaar is infused with power from the surrounding machinery, slowly increasing his energy over time. Upon reaching 100 energy, he is overwhelmed by the Void and begins his Entropic Unraveling.

Periodically, the Riftlabs produce orbs of Concentrated Void that are drawn toward Salhadaar. When an orb of Concentrated Void reaches him, he performs a Void Infusion.

abilities.name: Void Convergence
abilities.text:
The machinery of the Riftlabs produces orbs of Concentrated Void that are drawn towards Salhadaar. Players who come into contact with an orb are afflicted by Void Exposure.

Salhadaar consumes orbs on contact, causing a Void Infusion.

children.name: Concentrated Void
children.text: An orb of dark energy that is drawn towards Salhadaar.

children.name: Void Exposure
children.text: Exposes players to an excessive amount of void energy, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec to players within it.

children.name: Void Infusion
children.text: Salhadaar consumes the orb on contact, inflicting Shadow damage to all players and an additional Shadow damage every 1 sec for 1 min.

abilities.name: Abilities
abilities.text:
Upon reaching 100 energy, Salhadaar is overwhelmed by the Void. He unravels violently, inflicting Shadow damage to all players every 1 sec and taking 25% increased damage for 20 sec.

Upon expiration, Salhadaar leaves behind Torturous Extract.

children.name: Torturous Extract
children.text: Lingering void energy that inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec to players within it.

children.name: Umbral Beams
children.text: Beams of pure void radiate from Salhadaar, inflicting Shadow damage every 0.3 sec to players within them.

abilities.name: Shattering Twilight
abilities.text: Salhadaar hurls a dark star at his current target, inflicting Shadow damage upon impact and causing Twilight Spikes to erupt outwards from the impact location.

children.name: Twilight Spikes
children.text: Dark energy erupts from the ground, inflicting Shadow damage every 2 sec to players within it.

abilities.name: Fractured Projection
abilities.text: Salhadaar manifests several Fractured Images of himself nearby.

children.name: Shadow Fracture
children.text: The Fractured Image releases a burst of void energy, inflicting Shadow damage to all players and leaving behind Torturous Extract. The image then reintegrates with Salhadaar.

abilities.name: Despotic Command
abilities.text:
Salhadaar attempts to bend several players to his will, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec to players within yd of afflicted players for 13 sec.

When this aura expires, Salhadaar shrouds the wearer in Oppressive Darkness.

children.name: Oppressive Darkness
children.text: Darkness smothers the affected player, absorbing healing.

children.name: Torturous Extract
children.text: Lingering void energy that inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec to players within it.

abilities.name: Twisting Obscurity
abilities.text: Salhadaar releases a bolt of twisting darkness that jumps between all players, inflicting Shadow damage upon contact and an additional Shadow damage every 1 sec for 26 sec.

abilities.name: Destabilizing Strikes
abilities.text: Salhadaar's melee attacks destabilize his current target, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec for 15 sec. This effect stacks.

bosses.name: Vaelgor & Ezzorak
bosses.description: Born as clutchmates in the red dragonflight, Vaelgor and Ezzorak were once the guardians of all living things. Now, twisted by the dark will of Xal'atath, all that remains of their former selves is their unyielding bond to one another.

tips.text: •Gloom applies Gloomtouched upon contact and shrinks the Gloomfield formed.

•The Lightbound Vanguard grant Radiant Barrier to players nearby, reducing Midnight Flames' high damage.
•Gloomtouched players decrease the total damage inflicted by Gloom and shrink the Gloomfield formed.

•Rakfang and Vaelwing empower the dragon when cast at the same target.
•Receiving Nullbeam stacks decrease the Nullzone's pull magnitude for all players.

bosses.overview:
The dragon siblings begin battle alternating between flying and grounded combat, swapping after Midnight Flames at full power. In response, the Lightbound Vanguard offer aid by providing their Radiant Barrier to nearby players.

Eventually, both dragons land, combining their draconic might to annihilate players once and for all.

children.name: Nullbeam
children.text:
Vaelgor expels crystalline spacetime every sec for to players in a frontal direction. This outpouring inflicts Physical damage plus an additional Shadow damage every sec for. This effect stacks.

Upon completion, the lattice shatters, forming a Nullzone and tethering all players. Nullzone's pull magnitude weakens as Nullbeam stacks, up to times.

children.name: Nullzone
children.text: On this difficulty, a Nullzone Implosion occurs instead of Nullsnap when no other tethers remain.

children.name: Nullsnap
children.text: The cosmic bindings shatter, inflicting Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Dread Breath
children.text: Vaelgor roars toward a targeted player, fearing players in a massive frontal cone. The dragon's breath inflicts Shadow damage and an additional Shadow damage every sec, reducing movement speed by 30%, fearing them for.

children.name: Vaelwing
children.text:
Vaelgor buffets his primary target, knocking them away and inflicting Shadow damage and Physical damage.

This attack empowers Vaelgor's melee attacks, causing them to inflict Shadow damage. This effect stacks, increasing in intensity each Vaelwing until Vaelwing strikes a new target.

children.name: Tail Lash
children.text: Vaelgor knocks away players within a yard rear cone, bleeding for Physical damage plus an additional Physical damage every sec for.

children.name: Gloom
children.text:
Ezzorak ejects a moving mass of pure darkness in a frontal direction, inflicting to ${*} Shadow damage to all players upon arrival, creating a Gloomfield.

Gloom damage done and the size of Gloomfield decreases up to times as players contact the darkness, applying Gloomtouched.

children.name: Gloomtouched
children.text:
On this difficulty, Gloomtouched applies within a radius upon contact.

On this difficulty, Gloomtouched applies Diminish upon removal.

children.name: Diminish
children.text: Gloomtouched's affliction weighs heavily on targets, increasing damage taken by Gloomtouched by 500% for. This effect stacks.

children.name: Gloomfield
children.text: Galactic emptiness engulfs a massive location in darkness for, inflicting Shadow damage every sec and reducing movement speed by 75%.

children.name: Dragon B
children.text:
Ezzorak wreathes all players in shadow, inflicting Shadow damage to players near each player.

Summons a Voidorb at each players' location.

children.name: Voidbolt
children.text: The Voidorb ejects raw void magic at a player, inflicting Shadow damage plus an additional Shadow damage every sec for.

children.name: Rakfang
children.text:
Ezzorak strikes his primary target, inflicting Physical damage and Shadow damage.

This attack empowers Ezzorak's melee attacks, causing them to absorb the next healing. This effect stacks, increasing in intensity each Rakfang until Rakfang strikes a new target.

children.name: Impale
children.text:
Ezzorak slams targets within a yard rear cone, bleeding for Physical damage plus an additional Physical damage every sec and stunning for.

This occurs immediately after casting Rakfang.

children.name: Midnight Flames
children.text: Upon reaching 100 energy, Ezzorak and Vaelgor fly as one, each spewing Shadow damage to all players plus an additional Shadow damage every sec for.

children.name: Twilight Bond
children.text: On this difficulty, Twilight Bond also occurs when Vaelgor and Ezzorak's health percentages are 10% apart or greater.

children.name: Twilight Fury
children.text: Upon seeing their sibling perish, the remaining dragon enters a draconic rage, increasing damage done by 30%. This effect stacks, increasing in intensity over time.

children.name: Grappling Maw
children.text:
While flying, the dragon lashes their primary target in cosmic entanglement, inflicting between and ${*10} Shadow damage, increasing in damage as distance between the dragon and their target increases.

The dragon then pulls the distant target nearby.

children.name: Midnight Manifestation
children.text:
Xal'atath appears, tipping the scales and enfeebling targeted players, then vanishes.

This malediction inflicts Shadow damage every sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Lightbound Vanguard
abilities.text: If present, War Chaplain Senn, General Amias Bellamy, and/or Commander Venel Lightblood join in the battle against Vaelgor & Ezzorak.

children.name: Radiant Barrier
children.text:
Senn eminates holy power for, blessing players nearby. Every sec, this applies protection to nearby players that absorbs Midnight Flames damage. If present, Bellamy and/or Lightblood increase the amount of absorb granted. ${100-}% of Midnight Flames damage pierces this absorb.

Additionally, gaining Radiant Barrier consumes Midnight Manifestation, spawning a Manifestation of Midnight or infusing an existing Manifestation for each aura stack consumed.

children.name: Shadowmark
children.text:
The manifestation taints targets inflicting Shadow damage every sec for.

Upon expiration the mark detonates inflicting Shadow damage to other players near the marked target.

children.name: Unbound Shadow
children.text: Every sec, the manifestation darkens, increasing attack speed by 75% and reducing the speed at which they can be slowed to by 50%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Aura of Light
children.text:
The presence of the Lightbound Vanguard weakens this enemy's vitality, reducing their maximum health by 5% and damage done by 5%.

This effect stacks for each present member of the Vanguard.

bosses.name: Lightblinded Vanguard
bosses.description: Once paragons of the Light, Senn, Bellamy, and Lightblood have surrendered to their own blinding zealotry--their faith perverted into a ruthless fanaticism that now compels them to smite all who oppose them.

tips.text:
• War Chaplain Senn protects allies within her Aura of Peace, pacifying any players who attack them.
• Damage from Execution Sentence is split evenly between all players hit.
• Sacred Shield grants immunity to interrupt effects while the shield holds.

• Tyr's Wrath absorbs a large amount of healing done to affected players.
• Damage from Execution Sentence is split evenly between all players hit.
• General Bellamy silences players struck by Divine Toll.

• Judgment significantly increases damage taken from Final Verdict and Shield of the Righteous.
• Damage from Execution Sentence is split evenly between all players hit.
• Members of the Vanguard with an active Aura greatly empower their nearby allies.

bosses.overview:
The Lightblinded Vanguard attacks players relentlessly as their energy slowly increases.

When a member of the Vanguard reaches 100 energy, they activate an Aura to empower their allies and unleash their most devastating attack.

children.name: Divine Hammer
children.text: Holy hammers spiral outward, inflicting Holy damage to players in their path.

children.name: Forbearance
children.text: After using a powerful ability, members of the Vanguard cannot be affected by Avenging Wrath or Divine Shield for 150 sec.

children.name: Sacred Toll
children.text: Lightblood deems players nearby unworthy, inflicting Holy damage to them.

children.name: Judgment
children.text:
Lightblood passes judgment on his current target, inflicting Holy damage and increasing damage they take from Final Verdict by 100% for 5 sec.

After passing judgment, Lightblood immediately casts Final Verdict on his current target.

children.name: Final Verdict
children.text: Lightblood unleashes a devastating strike on his current target that inflicts Holy damage.

children.name: Avenging Wrath
children.text: Lightblood calls upon the Light to become an avatar of its fury, increasing his damage done by 30% and damage taken by 20% for 20 sec.

children.name: Forbearance
children.text: After using a powerful ability, members of the Vanguard cannot be affected by Avenging Wrath or Divine Shield for 150 sec.

children.name: Divine Toll
children.text: Bellamy unleashes a volley of holy shields every 2 sec for 18 sec. Shields that hit players inflict Holy damage and silence them for 3 sec.

children.name: Forbearance
children.text: After using a powerful ability, members of the Vanguard cannot be affected by Avenging Wrath or Divine Shield for 150 sec.

children.name: Avenger's Shield
children.text: In Mythic difficulty, Zealous Spirit's empowerment causes Avenger's Shield to target all players.

children.name: Light Infused
children.text:
Bellamy is infused with holy light that inflicts Holy damage to all players every 2 sec. 

This damage increases by 25% every time a member of the Vanguard unleashes their aura.

children.name: Hammer of the Righteous
children.text:
Bellamy passes judgment on her current target, inflicting Holy damage and increasing damage they take from Shield of the Righteous by 100% for 5 sec.

After passing judgment, Bellamy immediately casts Shield of the Righteous on her current target.

children.name: Shield of the Righteous
children.text: Bellamy slams her current target with her shield, inflicting Holy damage.

children.name: Divine Shield
children.text: The Vanguard member calls upon the Light to protect them, becoming immune to all damage and harmful effects for 8 sec.

children.name: Forbearance
children.text: After using a powerful ability, members of the Vanguard cannot be affected by Avenging Wrath or Divine Shield for 150 sec.

children.name: Tyr's Wrath
children.text: Senn brings Tyr's Wrath down upon the players nearest to her every 5 sec, absorbing the next healing they receive. This effect stacks.

children.name: Forbearance
children.text: After using a powerful ability, members of the Vanguard cannot be affected by Avenging Wrath or Divine Shield for 150 sec.

children.name: Searing Shield
children.text: Senn shields herself, absorbing the next damage and becoming immune to interrupt effects. She then charges into battle on her mighty elekk before casting Blinding Light.

children.name: Elekk Charge
children.text: Senn charges forward on her mighty elekk, inflicting Physical damage to players in her path.

children.name: Blinding Light
children.text: Senn emits a blinding flash of light, inflicting Holy damage to all players and disorienting them for 5 sec.

children.name: Holy Shock
children.text: Senn exorcises her current target, inflicting Holy damage.

children.name: Divine Shield
children.text: The Vanguard member calls upon the Light to protect them, becoming immune to all damage and harmful effects for 8 sec.

children.name: Forbearance
children.text: After using a powerful ability, members of the Vanguard cannot be affected by Avenging Wrath or Divine Shield for 150 sec.

abilities.name: Retribution
abilities.text: The Lightblinded Vanguard seek retribution for any of their allies slain in battle, increasing their damage done by 5% every 2 sec until they avenge their fallen ally or die trying.

bosses.name: Crown of the Cosmos
bosses.description: High atop the Voidspire, Xal'atath marshalls her dark army from across the Voidstorm. Aided by Turalyon, Arator, and Alleria, the mortals of Azeroth must confront her before she unleashes the might of the Voidspire against her enemies.

tips.text:
•Silverstrike Arrow will remove any Void effects from targets struck.
•Void Droplet will splash targets with Corrupting Essence when it dies.
•Aspect of the End reduces healing received until the target moves away from the arrow.

•Silverstrike Arrow will remove any Void effects from targets struck.
•Null Corona absorbs a large amount of healing and can be moved to another player when dispelled.
•Aspect of the End reduces healing received until the target moves away from the arrow.

•Undying Sentinels utilize Echoing Darkness when no players are in melee combat.
•Empowering Darkness affects Alleria's allies within a large area.
•Aspect of the End reduces healing received and Gravity Collapse leaves the target weak to Physical attacks.

bosses.overview:
Alleria Windrunner begins the fight held back by Undying Sentinels from the Void. She periodically strikes out at friend and foe alike with both Void effects and Silverstrike Arrow.

When each of the Undying Sentinels have been destroyed, Alleria crashes into the platform and creates a Rift Simulacrum to assault her enemies with Call of the Void and Ranger Captain's Mark.

When the Rift Simulacrum is shattered, Alleria releases her full Void abilities upon all players.

children.name: Silverstrike Arrow
children.text: Alleria marks a player, firing a silver-lined arrow through them. The arrow inflicts Arcane damage in a line and removes Void effects from players and Voidspawn struck.

children.name: Grasp of Emptiness
children.text: Ancient obelisks grasp a player with Void energy, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec and reducing their movement speed by 50% for 8 sec. Upon removal, Bursting Emptiness fires out through each obelisk.

children.name: Bursting Emptiness
children.text: A backlash of magic blasts out from each obelisk, inflicting Shadow damage to all players struck.

children.name: Void Expulsion
children.text: In Heroic and Mythic difficulty, Void Expulsion also targets additional players.

children.name: Void Remnants
children.text: Void energy remains on the ground, inflicting Shadow damage to all players within it every 1 sec.

children.name: Touch of Harm
children.text: Alleria places a shell of Void magic around a player that absorbs healing. If Null Corona is dispelled, the remaining absorb jumps to another random player.

children.name: Undying Sentinels
children.text: Undying Sentinels are inexorably linked to their void portals, teleporting back if they are more than yards away from them.

children.name: Echoing Darkness
children.text: When no players are within melee range, the Undying Sentinel releases Void energy in a dark wave. This energy inflicts Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Dark Hand
children.text: The Undying Sentinel strikes its current target with a deadly touch, inflicting Physical and Shadow damage and knocking the target back.

children.name: Umbral Tether
children.text: Void magic binds the Sentinel to existence, preventing it from dying.

children.name: Echoing Darkness
children.text: When no players are within melee range, the Undying Sentinel releases Void energy in a dark wave. This energy inflicts Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Interrupting Tremor
children.text: The Undying Sentinel releases shuddering waves, inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby and interrupting spellcasts.

children.name: Umbral Tether
children.text: Void magic binds the Sentinel to existence, preventing it from dying.

children.name: Echoing Darkness
children.text: When no players are within melee range, the Undying Sentinel releases Void energy in a dark wave. This energy inflicts Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Ravenous Abyss
children.text: The Undying Sentinel devours the essence of players nearby, inflicting Shadow damage and reducing their damage done by 70% for 8 sec.

children.name: Umbral Tether
children.text: Void magic binds the Sentinel to existence, preventing it from dying.

children.name: Corrupting Essence
children.text: The droplet erupts with Void upon death and splashes players and Sentinels nearby. This inflicts Shadow damage and causes the target to take 30% increased damage for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Silverstrike Arrow
children.text: Uncontrolled silver-lined arrows fire from Alleria, inflicting Arcane damage and removing Void effects from players struck.

children.name: Stellar Emission
children.text: Raw Void energy arcs outward from Alleria, inflicting Shadow damage every 2 sec and increasing the effects of forced movement by 25% for 8 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Void Eruption
children.text: Wild pockets of gravity surge from Alleria, inflicting Shadow damage to players near each impact and knocking them away.

children.name: Rift Simulacrum
children.text: Alleria utilizes her Spatial Rift to summon forth a void simulacrum to assist her.

children.name: Empowering Darkness
children.text: The Rift Simulacrum grants Alleria 10% reduced damage taken and 10% increased damage done every 1 sec while she is within yards of it. This effect stacks.

children.name: Cosmic Barrier
children.text: A void barrier surrounds the Rift Simulacrum, absorbing damage equal to 13.5% of its maximum health. While this barrier persists, it inflicts Shadow damage to all players every 1 sec.

children.name: Null Corona
children.text: Alleria places a shell of Void magic around a player that absorbs healing. If Null Corona is dispelled, the remaining absorb jumps to another random player.

children.name: Rift Slash
children.text: The Rift Simulacrum strikes its current target with a draining touch, inflicting Physical damage to the player and reducing all of their stats for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Volatile Fissure
children.text: Stepping on a volatile ground fissure inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec for 12 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Ranger General's Mark
children.text: Alleria applies a Ranger Captain's Mark to random players within yards for 6 sec. Upon expiration, she fires a Silverstrike Ricochet at them.

children.name: Ricocheting Arrow
children.text: A silver-lined arrow bounces between players, inflicting Arcane damage and removing Void effects from players and Voidspawn struck.

children.name: Void Expulsion
children.text: In Heroic and Mythic difficulty, Void Expulsion also targets additional players.

children.name: Void Remnants
children.text: Void energy remains on the ground, inflicting Shadow damage to all players within it every 1 sec.

children.name: Voidstalker Sting
children.text: Alleria fires a Void-tipped arrow at several players, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec for 10 min. This effect stacks.

children.name: Call of the Void
children.text: Celestial energy bursts around Alleria, inflicting Shadow damage near each impact and calling forth an Undying Voidspawn.

children.name: Umbral Tether
children.text: Void magic binds the Voidspawn to existence, preventing it from dying.

children.name: Void Barrage
children.text: The Voidspawn blasts random players, inflicting Shadow damage.

children.name: Coalesced Form
children.text: Upon reaching 100 energy, the Voidspawn permanently gains 300% movement speed, 500% damage done, and immunity to crowd controlling effects.

children.name: Stellar Emission
children.text: Raw Void energy arcs outward from Alleria, inflicting Shadow damage every 2 sec and increasing the effects of forced movement by 25% for 8 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Silverstrike Arrow
children.text: Uncontrolled silver-lined arrows fire from Alleria, inflicting Arcane damage and removing Void effects from players struck.

children.name: Orbiting Matter
children.text: Stellar mass orbits around Alleria, inflicting Shadow damage and pulling players it collides with.

abilities.name: Stage Three: The End of the End

children.name: Devouring Cosmos
children.text: Alleria calls upon the unending cosmos to consume her foes. Players caught within suffer Shadow damage every 1 sec and receive 99% reduced healing and absorbs.

children.name: Aspect of the End
children.text:
Alleria marks players with a consuming arrow, reducing their healing received by 10% until they move yards away from the arrow. This effect stacks, growing in intensity every 2 sec.

Upon being removed, a Gravity Collapse is triggered.

children.name: Gravity Collapse
children.text: Reverberating darkness knocks the target upwards and increases their Physical damage taken by 300% for 12 sec. The cosmic tremors additionally inflict Shadow damage to all other players.

children.name: Grasp of Emptiness
children.text: Ancient obelisks grasp a player with Void energy, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec and reducing their movement speed by 50% for 8 sec. Upon removal, Bursting Emptiness fires out through each obelisk.

children.name: Bursting Emptiness
children.text: A backlash of magic blasts out from each obelisk, inflicting Shadow damage to all players struck.

children.name: Null Corona
children.text: Alleria places a shell of Void magic around a player that absorbs healing. If Null Corona is dispelled, the remaining absorb jumps to another random player.

children.name: Voidstalker Sting
children.text: Alleria fires a Void-tipped arrow at several players, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec for 10 min. This effect stacks.

children.name: Dark Rush
children.text: A player touching a cosmic feather fallen from Alleria's quiver gains greatly increased movement speed and suffers Shadow damage every 1 sec for 12 sec.

heroic.name: The Voidspire
heroic.description: From high above the Voidstorm, Xal'atath has gathered the Devouring Host beneath her dark banner. The towering Voidspire looms like a spear of darkness, a citadel guarded by an army of the void. The forces of the light - led by Alleria Windrunner and the Champions of Azeroth - must rally for one last desperate assault before all is lost.

bosses.name: Imperator Averzian
bosses.description: Imperator Averzian wages a relentless campaign, seeking not conquest, but annihilation. His entire will is bent to a singular ambition: to rend the veil between worlds and carve a breach into the Void itself. Through this wound, his infinite host shall pour forth, drowning Azeroth in darkness.

tips.text:
• Abyssal Voidshapers attempt to use Gathering Darkness at full power.
• Shadowguard Stalwarts attempt to empower their allies with Pitch Bulwark.

•Dark Upheaval inflicts periodic damage to all players.
•Umbral Collapse inflicts damage to everyone that is reduced by the number of players at the impact location.

• Averzian gains Imperator's Glory while close to territory he controls.
• When Averzian strikes his current target he infects them with Blackening Wounds.

bosses.overview:
Averzian uses Shadow's Advance to claim territory on the battlefield. Territory claimed cannot be retaken, and if Averzian claims three adjacent territories in a row he unleashes the March of the Endless.

Causing an Umbral Collapse on a territory being taken prevents its capture.

abilities.name: Stage One
abilities.text: Averzian summons Abyssal Voidshapers onto the battlefield. As his minions emerge, they inflict Shadow damage to players nearby and knocks them away.

children.name: Abyssal Voidshaper
children.text: $[!15 On Heroic difficulty, Abyssal Voidshapers cast Gathering Darkness to transform into Obscurion Endwalkers.

children.name: Umbral Barrier
children.text: Enshrouded by the Void, the caster reduces all damage taken by 99% unless impacted by an Umbral Collapse.

children.name: Void Rupture
children.text:
The Abyssal Voidshaper claims territory for Averzian, inflicting Shadow damage to players nearby and an additional Shadow damage to players caught in the star burst blast.

Each claimed territory brings Averzian's army closer to the March of the Endless.

children.name: Gathering Darkness
children.text: At full power, the Voidshaper transforms into an Obscurion Endwalker.

children.name: Voidmaw
children.text: $[!15 On Heroic difficulty, at 35% health remaining the Voidmaw crawls towards the nearest void-claimed space to restore its health.

children.name: Gnashing Void
children.text: The Voidmaw's melee attacks inflict Shadow damage every 1 sec for 10 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Hobbled
children.text: While at 35% health remaining, the Voidmaw's movement speed is reduced by 75%.

children.name: Dark Resilience
children.text: Upon reaching 35% health remaining, the Voidmaw approaches the closest void-claimed space to restore its health.

children.name: Pitch Bulwark
children.text: The caster grants a shield to allies that absorbs the next damage.

children.name: Pitch Bulwark
children.text: The caster grants a shield to allies that absorbs the next damage.

children.name: Dark Barrage
children.text: The caster hurls dark energy at several players, inflicting Shadow damage upon impact.

abilities.name: Umbral Collapse
abilities.text: Averzian collapses void energy around his target, inflicting Shadow damage to all players. This damage is reduced by the number of players near the impact location.

abilities.name: Oblivion's Wrath
abilities.text: Averzian launches void lances outward, inflicting Shadow damage to players in their path and knocking them back.

abilities.name: Void Fall
abilities.text: Averzian knocks back players and rains destruction onto the field at several destinations, inflicting Shadow damage to players near the impact locations.

abilities.name: Shadow Phalanx
abilities.text: A column of Averzian's troops march across the field, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec to players in their path.

abilities.name: March of the Endless
abilities.text: With three adjacent portals empowering each other, Averzian tears open the void unleashing the endless march, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec to players in its path.

abilities.name: Dark Upheaval
abilities.text:
Averzian harnesses the Void, inflicting Shadow damage to all players.

He then continues to radiate energy, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec.

abilities.name: Blackening Wounds
abilities.text:
Averzian's melee attacks infect his target with void, reducing their maximum health by 4% for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

When Averzian's troops take the field, the target with the highest amount of Blackening Wounds becomes Weakened.

children.name: Weakened
children.text: Voidspawn rush toward the player with the highest amount of Blackening Wounds for the next 10 sec.

abilities.name: Imperator's Glory
abilities.text:
$[!15

On Heroic difficulty, Averzian and his soldiers gain Imperator's Glory while within 10 yards of each other.

bosses.name: Vorasius
bosses.description: A colossal predator born in the wastes of the Voidstorm, Vorasius grew to an incredible size fueled by an endless hunger. Summoned to the battle raging at the base of the Voidspire by Voidlight Everdawn, this colossal monster now feasts on both sides.

tips.text:
• The explosion of Blisterburst is powerful enough to damage Void Crystals.

• Shadowclaw Slam causes reverberating Aftershocks from its impact location.

• The explosion of Blisterburst is powerful enough to damage Void Crystals.

• Primordial Roar causes Vorasius to gain more Primordial Power with each cast.

• Shadowclaw Slam inflicts deadly damage to the raid if it fails to hit at least one player.

• Overpowering Pulse is triggered when no enemies are near Vorasius.

bosses.overview:
Vorasius periodically strikes the ground with Shadowclaw Slam, creating crystals that divide the battlefield. The behemoth then shakes off parasitic creeps that explode in a Blisterburst upon death.

As the battle rages, Vorasius sweeps his deadly Void Breath from one side of the battlefield to the other, decimating anything caught in its path.

abilities.name: Void Breath
abilities.text: Vorasius sweeps a deadly beam across the battlefield, immediately inflicting Shadow damage to all players in front of him and Shadow damage every 1 sec to players caught in its path. The beam radiates Dark Energy while active, inflicting Shadow damage every 0.5 sec for 15 sec.

children.name: Dark Energy
children.text: Vorasius sweeps a deadly beam across the battlefield, immediately inflicting Shadow damage to all players in front of him and Shadow damage every 1 sec to players caught in its path. The beam radiates Dark Energy while active, inflicting Shadow damage every 0.5 sec for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Parasite Expulsion
abilities.text: Vorasius shakes off parasitic Blistercreeps, spraying the battlefield with globs of dark ichor that inflict Shadow damage to players nearby upon impact.

children.name: Blistercreep
children.text: A parasitic spawn that fixates on a player.

children.name: Blisterburst
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Blisterburst leaves behind Dark Goo.

children.name: Creep Spit
children.text: The Blistercreep periodically spits void ichor at a player, reducing their movement speed by 10% for 20 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Shadowclaw Slam
abilities.text: Vorasius slams a giant claw into the ground, inflicting Shadow and Physical damage to players in the impact area and Shadow damage to all players. If the central impact fails to hit at least 1 player, Vorasius inflicts Shadow damage to all players instead. The impact of the larger claws applies Smashed and creates Void Crystals.

children.name: Smashed
children.text: The impact from Vorasius's larger claws increases the victim's Physical damage taken by 150% for 2 min. This effect stacks.

children.name: Aftershock
children.text: Shadowclaw Slam creates seismic aftershocks that reverberate from the impact location, inflicting Physical damage to players within the area.

children.name: Void Crystal
children.text:
Dark crystals that divide the battlefield. Strong enough to withstand anything but the explosions of Blisterburst.

On Heroic difficulty, Void Crystals can withstand an additional blast.On Mythic difficulty, Void Crystals can withstand an additional blast.

abilities.name: Primordial Roar
abilities.text: Vorasius takes a deep breath, pulling players closer before unleashing a deafening roar that inflicts Physical damage to all players and knocks them away.

children.name: Primordial Power
children.text: Vorasius gathers power with each roar, radiating Shadow damage to all players every sec.

abilities.name: Overpowering Pulse
abilities.text: If no player is within reach, Vorasius pulses with deadly void energy.

bosses.name: Fallen-King Salhadaar
bosses.description: After turning on Xal'atath, the fallen king Salhadaar has become a captive of the very Shadowguard he once commanded. Tortured, delirious, and infused with the Void, he awaits his death--or a chance to win his people's freedom from Xal'atath's grasp.

tips.text:
• Orbs of Concentrated Void cause a Void Infusion when they reach Salhadaar.
• Salhadaar takes increased damage during Entropic Unraveling.
• Salhadaar creates several Fractured Images that cast Shadow Fracture.

• When orbs of Concentrated Void are destroyed, they apply Dark Radiation to all players.
• Despotic Command inflicts periodic damage to nearby players and applies Oppressive Darkness when removed.
• Entropic Unraveling inflicts heavy periodic damage to all players.

• Orbs of Concentrated Void cause a Void Infusion when they reach Salhadaar.
• Spikes erupt from the target of Shattering Twilight.
• Salhadaar's melee attacks apply Destabilizing Strikes.

bosses.overview:
Fallen-King Salhadaar is infused with power from the surrounding machinery, slowly increasing his energy over time. Upon reaching 100 energy, he is overwhelmed by the Void and begins his Entropic Unraveling.

Periodically, the Riftlabs produce orbs of Concentrated Void that are drawn toward Salhadaar. When an orb of Concentrated Void reaches him, he performs a Void Infusion.

abilities.name: Void Convergence
abilities.text: $[!15 On Heroic difficulty, Concentrated Void release Dark Radiation when destroyed.

children.name: Concentrated Void
children.text: An orb of dark energy that is drawn towards Salhadaar.

children.name: Void Exposure
children.text: Exposes players to an excessive amount of void energy, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec to players within it.

children.name: Dark Radiation
children.text: Orbs of Concentrated Void cover all players in void essence when destroyed, inflicting Shadow damage every sec for 8 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Void Infusion
children.text: Salhadaar consumes the orb on contact, inflicting Shadow damage to all players and an additional Shadow damage every 1 sec for 1 min.

abilities.name: Abilities
abilities.text:
Upon reaching 100 energy, Salhadaar is overwhelmed by the Void. He unravels violently, inflicting Shadow damage to all players every 1 sec and taking 25% increased damage for 20 sec.

Upon expiration, Salhadaar leaves behind Torturous Extract.

children.name: Torturous Extract
children.text: Lingering void energy that inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec to players within it.

children.name: Umbral Beams
children.text: Beams of pure void radiate from Salhadaar, inflicting Shadow damage every 0.3 sec to players within them.

abilities.name: Shattering Twilight
abilities.text: On Heroic difficulty, the star bounces to several other players upon impact.

children.name: Twilight Spikes
children.text: Dark energy erupts from the ground, inflicting Shadow damage every 2 sec to players within it.

abilities.name: Fractured Projection
abilities.text: Salhadaar manifests several Fractured Images of himself nearby.

children.name: Shadow Fracture
children.text: The Fractured Image releases a burst of void energy, inflicting Shadow damage to all players and leaving behind Torturous Extract. The image then reintegrates with Salhadaar.

abilities.name: Despotic Command
abilities.text:
Salhadaar attempts to bend several players to his will, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec to players within yd of afflicted players for 13 sec.

When this aura expires, Salhadaar shrouds the wearer in Oppressive Darkness.

children.name: Oppressive Darkness
children.text: Darkness smothers the affected player, absorbing healing.

children.name: Torturous Extract
children.text: Lingering void energy that inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec to players within it.

abilities.name: Twisting Obscurity
abilities.text: Salhadaar releases a bolt of twisting darkness that jumps between all players, inflicting Shadow damage upon contact and an additional Shadow damage every 1 sec for 26 sec.

abilities.name: Destabilizing Strikes
abilities.text: Salhadaar's melee attacks destabilize his current target, inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec for 15 sec. This effect stacks.

bosses.name: Vaelgor & Ezzorak
bosses.description: Born as clutchmates in the red dragonflight, Vaelgor and Ezzorak were once the guardians of all living things. Now, twisted by the dark will of Xal'atath, all that remains of their former selves is their unyielding bond to one another.

tips.text: •Gloom applies Gloomtouched upon contact and shrinks the Gloomfield formed.

•The Lightbound Vanguard grant Radiant Barrier to players nearby, reducing Midnight Flames' high damage.
•Gloomtouched players decrease the total damage inflicted by Gloom and shrink the Gloomfield formed.

•Rakfang and Vaelwing empower the dragon when cast at the same target.
•Receiving Nullbeam stacks decrease the Nullzone's pull magnitude for all players.

bosses.overview:
The dragon siblings begin battle alternating between flying and grounded combat, swapping after Midnight Flames at full power. In response, the Lightbound Vanguard offer aid by providing their Radiant Barrier to nearby players.

Eventually, both dragons land, combining their draconic might to annihilate players once and for all.

children.name: Nullbeam
children.text:
Vaelgor expels crystalline spacetime every sec for to players in a frontal direction. This outpouring inflicts Physical damage plus an additional Shadow damage every sec for. This effect stacks.

Upon completion, the lattice shatters, forming a Nullzone and tethering all players. Nullzone's pull magnitude weakens as Nullbeam stacks, up to times.

children.name: Nullzone
children.text: On this difficulty, a Nullzone Implosion occurs instead of Nullsnap when no other tethers remain.

children.name: Nullsnap
children.text: The cosmic bindings shatter, inflicting Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Nullzone Implosion
children.text: The cosmic field collapses, inflicting Shadow damage and an additional Shadow damage every sec for to all players.

children.name: Dread Breath
children.text: Vaelgor roars toward a targeted player, fearing players in a massive frontal cone. The dragon's breath inflicts Shadow damage and an additional Shadow damage every sec, reducing movement speed by 30%, fearing them for.

children.name: Vaelwing
children.text:
Vaelgor buffets his primary target, knocking them away and inflicting Shadow damage and Physical damage.

This attack empowers Vaelgor's melee attacks, causing them to inflict Shadow damage. This effect stacks, increasing in intensity each Vaelwing until Vaelwing strikes a new target.

children.name: Tail Lash
children.text: Vaelgor knocks away players within a yard rear cone, bleeding for Physical damage plus an additional Physical damage every sec for.

children.name: Gloom
children.text:
Ezzorak ejects a moving mass of pure darkness in a frontal direction, inflicting to ${*} Shadow damage to all players upon arrival, creating a Gloomfield.

Gloom damage done and the size of Gloomfield decreases up to times as players contact the darkness, applying Gloomtouched.

children.name: Gloomtouched
children.text:
On this difficulty, Gloomtouched applies within a radius upon contact.

On this difficulty, Gloomtouched applies Diminish upon removal.

children.name: Diminish
children.text: Gloomtouched's affliction weighs heavily on targets, increasing damage taken by Gloomtouched by 500% for. This effect stacks.

children.name: Gloomfield
children.text: Galactic emptiness engulfs a massive location in darkness for, inflicting Shadow damage every sec and reducing movement speed by 75%.

children.name: Dragon B
children.text:
Ezzorak wreathes all players in shadow, inflicting Shadow damage to players near each player.

Summons a Voidorb at each players' location.

children.name: Voidbolt
children.text: The Voidorb ejects raw void magic at a player, inflicting Shadow damage plus an additional Shadow damage every sec for.

children.name: Rakfang
children.text:
Ezzorak strikes his primary target, inflicting Physical damage and Shadow damage.

This attack empowers Ezzorak's melee attacks, causing them to absorb the next healing. This effect stacks, increasing in intensity each Rakfang until Rakfang strikes a new target.

children.name: Impale
children.text:
Ezzorak slams targets within a yard rear cone, bleeding for Physical damage plus an additional Physical damage every sec and stunning for.

This occurs immediately after casting Rakfang.

children.name: Midnight Flames
children.text: Upon reaching 100 energy, Ezzorak and Vaelgor fly as one, each spewing Shadow damage to all players plus an additional Shadow damage every sec for.

children.name: Twilight Bond
children.text: On this difficulty, Twilight Bond also occurs when Vaelgor and Ezzorak's health percentages are 10% apart or greater.

children.name: Twilight Fury
children.text: Upon seeing their sibling perish, the remaining dragon enters a draconic rage, increasing damage done by 30%. This effect stacks, increasing in intensity over time.

children.name: Grappling Maw
children.text:
While flying, the dragon lashes their primary target in cosmic entanglement, inflicting between and ${*10} Shadow damage, increasing in damage as distance between the dragon and their target increases.

The dragon then pulls the distant target nearby.

children.name: Midnight Manifestation
children.text:
Xal'atath appears, tipping the scales and enfeebling targeted players, then vanishes.

This malediction inflicts Shadow damage every sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Lightbound Vanguard
abilities.text: If present, War Chaplain Senn, General Amias Bellamy, and/or Commander Venel Lightblood join in the battle against Vaelgor & Ezzorak.

children.name: Radiant Barrier
children.text:
Senn eminates holy power for, blessing players nearby. Every sec, this applies protection to nearby players that absorbs Midnight Flames damage. If present, Bellamy and/or Lightblood increase the amount of absorb granted. ${100-}% of Midnight Flames damage pierces this absorb.

Additionally, gaining Radiant Barrier consumes Midnight Manifestation, spawning a Manifestation of Midnight or infusing an existing Manifestation for each aura stack consumed.

children.name: Shadowmark
children.text:
The manifestation taints targets inflicting Shadow damage every sec for.

Upon expiration the mark detonates inflicting Shadow damage to other players near the marked target.

children.name: Unbound Shadow
children.text: Every sec, the manifestation darkens, increasing attack speed by 75% and reducing the speed at which they can be slowed to by 50%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Aura of Light
children.text:
The presence of the Lightbound Vanguard weakens this enemy's vitality, reducing their maximum health by 5% and damage done by 5%.

This effect stacks for each present member of the Vanguard.

bosses.name: Lightblinded Vanguard
bosses.description: Once paragons of the Light, Senn, Bellamy, and Lightblood have surrendered to their own blinding zealotry--their faith perverted into a ruthless fanaticism that now compels them to smite all who oppose them.

tips.text:
• War Chaplain Senn protects allies within her Aura of Peace, pacifying any players who attack them.
• Damage from Execution Sentence is split evenly between all players hit.
• Sacred Shield grants immunity to interrupt effects while the shield holds.

• Tyr's Wrath absorbs a large amount of healing done to affected players.
• Damage from Execution Sentence is split evenly between all players hit.
• General Bellamy silences players struck by Divine Toll.

• Judgment significantly increases damage taken from Final Verdict and Shield of the Righteous.
• Damage from Execution Sentence is split evenly between all players hit.
• Members of the Vanguard with an active Aura greatly empower their nearby allies.

bosses.overview:
The Lightblinded Vanguard attacks players relentlessly as their energy slowly increases.

When a member of the Vanguard reaches 100 energy, they activate an Aura to empower their allies and unleash their most devastating attack.

children.name: Consecration
children.text: Consecrated ground inflicts Holy damage to players within every sec.

children.name: Execution Sentence
children.text:
Lightblood marks several players then attempts to execute them sec later, inflicting Holy damage split evenly among players near their location and increasing damage taken from Execution Sentence by 500% for 5 sec.

Divine Hammers then spiral outward from the impact location.

children.name: Divine Hammer
children.text: Holy hammers spiral outward, inflicting Holy damage to players in their path.

children.name: Forbearance
children.text: After using a powerful ability, members of the Vanguard cannot be affected by Avenging Wrath or Divine Shield for 150 sec.

children.name: Divine Storm
children.text: In Mythic difficulty, Zealous Spirit's empowerment causes Divine Storm to create several Divine Tempests that slowly converge on Lightblood.

children.name: Sacred Toll
children.text: Lightblood deems players nearby unworthy, inflicting Holy damage to them.

children.name: Judgment
children.text:
Lightblood passes judgment on his current target, inflicting Holy damage and increasing damage they take from Final Verdict by 100% for 5 sec.

After passing judgment, Lightblood immediately casts Final Verdict on his current target.

children.name: Final Verdict
children.text: Lightblood unleashes a devastating strike on his current target that inflicts Holy damage.

children.name: Avenging Wrath
children.text: Lightblood calls upon the Light to become an avatar of its fury, increasing his damage done by 30% and damage taken by 20% for 20 sec.

children.name: Forbearance
children.text: After using a powerful ability, members of the Vanguard cannot be affected by Avenging Wrath or Divine Shield for 150 sec.

children.name: Consecration
children.text: Consecrated ground inflicts Holy damage to players within every sec.

children.name: Divine Toll
children.text: Bellamy unleashes a volley of holy shields every 2 sec for 18 sec. Shields that hit players inflict Holy damage and silence them for 3 sec.

children.name: Forbearance
children.text: After using a powerful ability, members of the Vanguard cannot be affected by Avenging Wrath or Divine Shield for 150 sec.

children.name: Avenger's Shield
children.text: In Mythic difficulty, Zealous Spirit's empowerment causes Avenger's Shield to target all players.

children.name: Light Infused
children.text:
Bellamy is infused with holy light that inflicts Holy damage to all players every 2 sec. 

This damage increases by 25% every time a member of the Vanguard unleashes their aura.

children.name: Hammer of the Righteous
children.text:
Bellamy passes judgment on her current target, inflicting Holy damage and increasing damage they take from Shield of the Righteous by 100% for 5 sec.

After passing judgment, Bellamy immediately casts Shield of the Righteous on her current target.

children.name: Shield of the Righteous
children.text: Bellamy slams her current target with her shield, inflicting Holy damage.

children.name: Divine Shield
children.text: The Vanguard member calls upon the Light to protect them, becoming immune to all damage and harmful effects for 8 sec.

children.name: Forbearance
children.text: After using a powerful ability, members of the Vanguard cannot be affected by Avenging Wrath or Divine Shield for 150 sec.

children.name: Consecration
children.text: Consecrated ground inflicts Holy damage to players within every sec.

children.name: Tyr's Wrath
children.text: Senn brings Tyr's Wrath down upon the players nearest to her every 5 sec, absorbing the next healing they receive. This effect stacks.

children.name: Forbearance
children.text: After using a powerful ability, members of the Vanguard cannot be affected by Avenging Wrath or Divine Shield for 150 sec.

children.name: Searing Radiance
children.text: In Mythic difficulty, Zealous Spirit's empowerment causes Searing Radiance's damage to increase by 10% every 1 sec.

children.name: Searing Shield
children.text: Senn shields herself, absorbing the next damage and becoming immune to interrupt effects. She then charges into battle on her mighty elekk before casting Blinding Light.

children.name: Elekk Charge
children.text: Senn charges forward on her mighty elekk, inflicting Physical damage to players in her path.

children.name: Blinding Light
children.text: Senn emits a blinding flash of light, inflicting Holy damage to all players and disorienting them for 5 sec.

children.name: Holy Shock
children.text: Senn exorcises her current target, inflicting Holy damage.

children.name: Divine Shield
children.text: The Vanguard member calls upon the Light to protect them, becoming immune to all damage and harmful effects for 8 sec.

children.name: Forbearance
children.text: After using a powerful ability, members of the Vanguard cannot be affected by Avenging Wrath or Divine Shield for 150 sec.

abilities.name: Retribution
abilities.text: The Lightblinded Vanguard seek retribution for any of their allies slain in battle, increasing their damage done by 5% every 2 sec until they avenge their fallen ally or die trying.

bosses.name: Crown of the Cosmos
bosses.description: High atop the Voidspire, Xal'atath marshalls her dark army from across the Voidstorm. Aided by Turalyon, Arator, and Alleria, the mortals of Azeroth must confront her before she unleashes the might of the Voidspire against her enemies.

tips.text:
•Silverstrike Arrow will remove any Void effects from targets struck.
•Void Droplet will splash targets with Corrupting Essence when it dies.
•Aspect of the End reduces healing received until the target moves away from the arrow.

•Silverstrike Arrow will remove any Void effects from targets struck.
•Null Corona absorbs a large amount of healing and can be moved to another player when dispelled.
•Aspect of the End reduces healing received until the target moves away from the arrow.

•Undying Sentinels utilize Echoing Darkness when no players are in melee combat.
•Empowering Darkness affects Alleria's allies within a large area.
•Aspect of the End reduces healing received and Gravity Collapse leaves the target weak to Physical attacks.

bosses.overview:
Alleria Windrunner begins the fight held back by Undying Sentinels from the Void. She periodically strikes out at friend and foe alike with both Void effects and Silverstrike Arrow.
