children.name: Eclipsed
children.text: Enveloped in refracting shadows, absorbing the next healing received.

children.name: Black Shroud
children.text: Dark shadows encircle the chamber, pushing players towards the center.

children.name: Starsplinter
children.text:
L'ura coalesces glass spikes that descend upon random players, inflicting Cosmic damage.

abilities.name: Stage Two: The Dark Reactor
abilities.text: Venture into the engine of desolation.

children.name: Into the Darkwell
children.text: L'ura exerts her cosmic grip upon all players, pulling them into the heart of the Darkwell.

children.name: Iris of Oblivion
children.text: The surrounding iris of pure void atomizes any players attempting to escape.

children.name: Abyssal Pool
children.text: All players are bathed in the Darkwell's nebulous liquid, inflicting Cosmic damage every 1 sec.

children.name: Void Cores
children.text: Singularities within the Darkwell capable of containing infinite void energy.

children.name: Galvanize
children.text:
L'ura fires electric beams at random players, each inflicting Cosmic damage to all players hit.

children.text: The opens, pulling all players towards it and inflicting Cosmic damage every 0.5 sec for 5 sec as their atoms are ripped away and consumed to create a Charged Core.

children.name: Charged Core
children.text: The brims with power, inflicting Cosmic damage to players on contact.

children.name: Core Harvest
children.text: L'ura pulls each Charged Core into herself for absorption, inflicting Cosmic damage to all players and regenerating her energy.

children.name: Dark Meltdown

children.name: Decay

bosses.overview:
The Dark Naaru counts down the minutes with each harrowing toll of Death's Dirge that echoes off the sacred walls. Heaven's Glaives rip and tear through the armies of light as L'ura conducts the infinite power held within The Darkwell to extinguish all that is holy.

When Midnight falls and Azeroth descends into darkness, brave Torchbearers emerge from the shadows to face The Dark Archangel and fight to see another sunrise.

children.name: The Darkwell

children.name: Dark Quasar

children.name: Heaven's Glaives

mythic.name: March on Quel'Danas
mythic.description: Darkness has eclipsed the Isle of Quel'Danas, clouding the skies above Silvermoon City. With Arator the Redeemer by their side, the Champions of Azeroth must march on the Sunwell before the light of the blood elves is lost forever.

bosses.name: Belo'ren, Child of Al'ar
bosses.description: One of the last clutch of Al'ar, Belo'ren was raised for the purpose of protecting the Isle of Quel'Danas. In the aftermath of the Voidspire, Belo'ren has been irradiated by Void. Confused and freshly hatched, the phoenix is focused on its sole task: Keep any invaders from reaching the Sunwell.
bosses.overview:
Belo'ren guards the Sunwell with both Light and Void magic. His Voidlight Convergence infuses players with either Light or Void, protecting them from one while leaving them vulnerable to the other.

When his health is depleted, Belo'ren retreats into an ashen egg and begins to cast Rebirth. Players must damage Belo'ren to diminish his Immortal Flame before he is reborn anew.

abilities.name: Stage One: Phoenix Reborn
abilities.text: Belo'ren ascends in his majestic phoenix form wielding the power of the radiant Light and devouring Void.

children.name: Voidlight Convergence
children.text: Belo'ren takes hold of the Light and Void within, erupting for Twilight damage to all players every 1.5 sec for 6 sec and infusing players with a Light or Void feather.

children.name: Light Feather
children.text: Infused with a luminous feather, reducing Holy damage taken by 50%.

children.name: Void Feather
children.text: Infused with a darkened feather, reducing Shadow damage taken by 50%.

children.name: Immortal Flame
children.text: Eternal flames fuel Belo'ren's energy, allowing him to use Rebirth when his health is fully depleted.

children.name: Burning Heart
children.text: The flames within Belo'ren radiate intense heat, causing him to inflict Fire damage to all players every 3 sec.

children.name: Embers of Belo'ren
children.text: Belo'ren summons Light or Void Embers that attack players.

children.name: Light Dive
children.text: The ember focuses on a player for 8 sec, then dives into them inflicting Holy damage split evenly among players nearby, knocking them away and leaving behind a Light Patch.

children.name: Light Patch
children.text: Lingering light energy inflicts Holy damage to players within every 1 sec and increases Holy damage they take by 100%.

children.name: Light Blast
children.text: The ember blasts a random player, inflicting Holy damage.

children.name: Light Eruption
children.text:
The ember unleashes the radiant light within, inflicting Holy damage to all players.

This spell can only be interrupted by players infused with a.

children.name: Rebirth
children.text: When an ember's health is depleted, they retreat into an ashen egg. If the egg is not killed within sec a new ember hatches from the egg, inflicting Fire damage to all players.

children.name: Void Dive
children.text: The ember focuses on a player for 8 sec, then dives into them inflicting Shadow damage split evenly among players nearby, knocking them away and leaving behind a Void Patch.

children.name: Void Patch
children.text: Lingering void energy inflicts Shadow damage to players within every 1 sec and increases Shadow damage they take by 100%.

children.name: Void Blast
children.text: The ember blasts a random player, inflicting Shadow damage.

children.name: Void Eruption
children.text:
The ember unleashes the devouring void within, inflicting Shadow damage to all players.

This spell can only be interrupted by players infused with a.

children.name: Rebirth
children.text: When an ember's health is depleted, they retreat into an ashen egg. If the egg is not killed within sec a new ember hatches from the egg, inflicting Fire damage to all players.

children.name: Radiant Echoes
children.text: In Mythic difficulty, echoes burst on contact with Belo'ren inflicting Holy or Shadow damage to all players.

children.name: Light Echo
children.text: Bursts on contact with a player, inflicting Holy damage.

children.name: Void Echo
children.text: Bursts on contact with a player, inflicting Shadow damage.

children.name: Voidlight Rupture
children.text: Echoes react violently on contact with players infused with the opposing element, inflicting Twilight damage instantly and Twilight damage over 1 min.

children.name: Guardian's Edict
children.text:
Belo'ren performs a devastating combination of Light and Void attacks.

Failing to attack a player or attacking a player that is infused with an opposing element empowers Belo'ren, increasing all damage done by 20% for 30 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Light Edict
children.text: Belo'ren lashes out, inflicting Holy damage and Physical damage to players in a cone in front of him and knocking them back.

children.name: Void Edict
children.text: Belo'ren lashes out, inflicting Shadow damage and Physical damage to players in a cone in front of him and knocking them back.

children.name: Voidlight Edict
children.text: Belo'ren casts Light Edict and Void Edict simultaneously.

children.name: Eternal Burns
children.text: Belo'ren burns players with searing Light and consuming Void, absorbing healing and periodically inflicting damage to the target until the burn is healed.

children.name: Light Burn
children.text: Absorbs healing and inflicts Holy damage every 1 sec until the burn is fully healed.

children.name: Void Burn
children.text: Absorbs healing and inflicts Shadow damage every 1 sec until the burn is fully healed.

children.name: Infused Quills
children.text: In Mythic difficulty, quills damage all players nearby on impact.

children.name: Light Quill
children.text: Inflicts Holy damage.

children.name: Void Quill
children.text: Inflicts Shadow damage.

children.name: Death Drop
children.text: When Belo'ren's health is depleted, he soars sky-high and slams into the center of the arena inflicting Physical damage to all players and knocking them upward. Players farther from the impact location receive less damage and are not knocked up as high.

abilities.name: Stage Two: Ashen Shell
abilities.text: As Belo'ren falls he retreats into an ashen egg and kindles the fire of rebirth.

children.name: Rebirth
children.text:
Belo'ren's ashen egg burns brightly, increasing the frequency of damage from Burning Heart by 50%.

Damaging Belo'ren in this state diminishes his Immortal Flame, and depleting his energy prevents his rebirth entirely.

After sec, Belo'ren's rebirth is complete and he returns to battle players at full health.

children.name: Ashen Benediction
children.text: Belo'ren's rebirth inflicts Fire damage to all players and reduces their healing done by 5%. This effect stacks.

children.name: Incubation of Flames
children.text: Belo'ren periodically engulfs the arena in flames of Light and Void that erupt after 5 sec to inflict Holy or Shadow damage to players within them.

children.name: Light Flames
children.text:
Inflicts Holy damage.

Players infused with opposing element also take Holy damage over 1 min. This effect stacks.

children.name: Void Flames
children.text:
Inflicts Shadow damage.

Players infused with the opposing element also take Shadow damage over 1 min. This effect stacks.

bosses.name: Midnight Falls
bosses.description: Once a creature of Light, L'ura fell to the Void long ago on Argus, her essence siphoned by Alleria Windrunner in the Seat of the Triumvirate. Freed from her bindings, L'ura's dark energies now threaten the very Sunwell itself.

children.text:
Excess power arcs between all players, inflicting up to Cosmic damage.

Each player within the effect of Galvanize diffuses its overflow, reducing this damage.

children.name: Cosmic Fission
children.text: On Mythic difficulty, Cosmic Fission reaches Criticality.

children.name: Criticality
children.text: A chain reaction inflicts Cosmic damage near all players.

children.name: Charged Core
children.text: The brims with power, inflicting Cosmic damage to players on contact.

children.name: Core Harvest
children.text: L'ura pulls each Charged Core into herself for absorption, inflicting Cosmic damage to all players and regenerating her energy.

children.name: Charged Core
children.text: The brims with power, inflicting Cosmic damage to players on contact.

children.name: Dark Meltdown
children.text: Upon reaching 100 energy, L'ura activates the Darkwell's full potential, expelling all players with an astronomic blast inflicting Cosmic damage.

children.name: Decay
children.text:
Remaining Void Cores overheat and detonate, regenerating L'ura's energy.

Each blast inflicts Cosmic damage to all players and an additional Cosmic damage every 1 sec for 1 min. This effect stacks.

children.name: Dawn Crystal
children.text:
A purified Naaru fragment that can be held by players.

On Mythic difficulty, Dawn Crystals are at risk of Light's End.

children.name: Light's End
children.text: The destruction of a induces utter despair, inflicting Holy damage to all players and increasing all damage taken by 500% for 10 min.

children.name: Tears of L'ura
children.text:
When hit directly by Cosmic damage, the sheds tears of anguish inflicting Holy damage to players nearby upon impact.

Tears that fail to hit at least one player elicit Naaru's Lament.

children.name: Naaru's Lament
children.text: L'ura weeps alone, inflicting Holy damage to all players.

children.name: Radiance
children.text: While not held by a player, the surges with overwhelming light, inflicting increasing Holy damage to all players every sec.

children.name: Glimmering
children.text: The shimmers, inflicting Holy damage every 1 sec to the player holding it.

children.name: Heaven's Lance
children.text:
L'ura regenerates a halo of glass ornaments over time. Upon reaching applications, she forges the glass into spikes that fire into her current target.

Each impact inflicts Cosmic damage and applies Impaled.

children.name: Impaled
children.text: Glass spikes embed deep into flesh, inflicting Cosmic damage every 1 sec and increasing damage taken from Heaven's Lance by 50% for 25 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Shattered Sky
children.text: L'ura showers the chamber in infinite darkness, inflicting Shadow damage to all players every 1 sec for 25 sec.

abilities.name: Stage Three: Midnight Falls
abilities.text: Time is up. Can you end the ending itself?

children.name: The Darkwell
children.text: The Darkwell's colossal void beam instantly vaporizes any player that dares to enter.

children.name: Thunderous Well
children.text: The Darkwell rages with overflowing void, inflicting Cosmic damage to all players every 2 sec.

children.name: The Dark Archangel
children.text: L'ura transfigures into an unholy weapon of godlike destruction, firing a cataclysmic blast that inflicts Cosmic damage to all players.

children.name: Black Tide
children.text: The aftershocks trigger a wave of void to cascade from the Darkwell, inflicting Cosmic damage and an additional Cosmic damage every 1 sec to players caught within.

children.name: Midnight
children.text: True darkness suffocates any player forsaken within, reducing movement speed and inflicting Shadow damage every 1 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Dark Constellation
children.text:
L'ura calls down dark stars, inflicting Cosmic damage near each impact.

The stars interconnect, inflicting Cosmic damage to players within the patterns.

children.name: Severance
children.text: L'ura transcends, diverging both players and her own being across two alternate dimensions. The violent division inflicts Cosmic damage to all players.

children.name: Severed Surge
children.text: If either dimension is devoid of players, L'ura inflicts increasing Cosmic damage to all players every 1 sec.

children.name: Dimension Breach
children.text: Collision between players in opposite realities causes a dimensional rupture, ending their existence.

children.name: Dimension Link
children.text: L'ura's beings remain bonded across realities, inflicting 100% of their damage taken to each other.

children.name: Death's Requiem
children.text: L'ura sings a dreadful melody before marking players with a Dark Rune corresponding to each note. Collision between marked players activates each Dark Rune.

children.name: Dark Rune
children.text:
Marked with a musical note, inflicting Cosmic damage every 1 sec.

Upon activation, triggers either Resonance or Dissonance.

children.name: Resonance
children.text: A Dark Rune hit in the correct order creates a transcendant toll, inflicting Cosmic damage to players nearby.

children.name: Dissonance
children.text: A Dark Rune hit out of order creates an echoing clamor, inflicting Cosmic damage to all players every 1 sec for 5 sec.

children.name: Light Siphon
children.text:
L'ura invokes voracious rifts that hunger for light, inflicting Cosmic damage to players within yards every ${/10}.1 for up to 22 sec.

Rifts that expire before they are satiated detonate in a Stellar Implosion.

children.name: Stellar Implosion
children.text: Space-time collapses, inflicting Cosmic damage to all players.

children.name: Dawn Crystal
children.text:
A purified Naaru fragment that can be held by players.

On Mythic difficulty, Dawn Crystals are at risk of Light's End.

children.name: Torchbearer
children.text: Any player holding a becomes a beacon of hope for their allies, protecting players within yards from the darkness of Midnight.

children.name: Dawnlight Barrier
children.text:
The scintillates with holy light during dire moments, briefly allowing its holder to cast Dawnlight Barrier.

The crystal tessellates into a brilliant dome, reducing damage taken by players within by 99% for up to 6 sec. This consumes the.

heroic.name: Sporefall
heroic.description: Deep in the fungal valleys of Harandar, the fungarian sporecallers have been growing a new threat for The Grudge Pit. Shaded by towering mushrooms, Sporefall is the perfect site to empower their new creation.

bosses.name: Rotmire
bosses.description: The fungarians of Sporefall have nurtured a fungal giant to grow far beyond its natural growth cycle. Rotmire is a beast of brute strength whose spores can catalyze the growth of surrounding fungi, sprouting new dangers for the unwary.

tips.text:
• Rotmire inflicts heavy damage to his current target with Putrid Fist.
• Fungal Bloom grows deadly Bursting Shrooms from minions' corpses.

• Awaken Fungi grows fungal minions from the earth.
• Fungal Bloom grows deadly Bursting Shrooms from minions' corpses.

• Rotmire inflicts massive damage to all players with Fungal Bloom.
• Festering Vines inflict heavy damage to several players.
• The Rotting Pustules leftover from Bursting Pustules inflict steadily increasing damage over time.

bosses.overview:
Rotmire catalyzes the growth of new fungal minions with Awaken Fungi.

Upon reaching 100 energy, Rotmire creates a Fungal Bloom that grows Bursting Shrooms from minions' corpses.

abilities.name: Awaken Fungi
abilities.text:
Rotmire blooms with fungal growths that rapidly explode, inflicting Nature damage to players near their locations and knocking them away.

Creates a fungal minion.

children.name: Shroomling
children.text: The fungarian pursues its target relentlessly.

children.name: Poison Burst
children.text: The Sporecap emits a burst of poisonous spores, inflicting Nature damage to all players and an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 16 sec. This effect stacks.

children.name: Blightshot
children.text: The Sporecap shoots a glob of poison at a player, inflicting Nature damage.

abilities.name: Fungal Bloom
abilities.text:
Rotmire unleashes a putrid miasma, inflicting Nature damage to all players, with an additional Nature damage every 1 sec for 16 sec, and knocking them away.

The spores empower fungal minions, applying Fungal Frenzy and healing them for 100% of their maximum health. Creates a Bursting Shroom at each fungal corpse.

children.name: Bursting Shroom
children.text: The shroom explodes, inflicting Nature damage to all players.

children.name: Fungal Frenzy
children.text: Putrid spores enrage the fungal minion, increasing its damage by 100% and movement speed by 50%, and granting it immunity to crowd control effects and interrupts.

abilities.name: Festering Vines
abilities.text:
Rotmire wraps several players in thorny vines, inflicting Nature damage every 1 sec and decreasing their movement speed by 30%.

Upon expiration, the vines snap apart, inflicting Nature damage to players nearby and leaving behind Writhing Vines.

children.name: Writhing Vines
children.text: Writhing vines inflict Nature damage every 1 sec to players within the area.

abilities.name: Bursting Pustules
abilities.text: Rotmire bursts several bulging pustules on its back, inflicting Nature damage to all players and gaining an application of Rotting Pustules for each burst.

children.name: Rotting Pustules
children.text: A rotting wound that inflicts Nature damage to all players every 1 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.name: Putrid Fist
abilities.text: Rotmire smashes its current target with a rotting fist, inflicting Physical damage and knocking the player upwards. Increases Physical damage taken by 35% for 14 sec. This effect stacks.
